word_meanings: सः he, तस्मिन् in his, गृहे in the house, रक्तान् red, श्वेतान् white, सितांश्चैव pure white coloured, महाजवान् of good speed, हरींश्चापि horses also, कुलीनान् wellbred ones, रूपसम्पन्नान् goodlooking, परगजारुजान् those whch were not inferior to enemy's elephants, गजान् elephants, गजशिक्षयाम् in training elephants, निष्ठितान् exceedingly welltrained, ऐरावतसमान् equal to Airavata, युधि in battle, परसैन्यानाम् of enemy forces, निहन्त्रून् destroyers, क्षरतः shedding, मेघान् यथा clouds like, स्रवतः pouring forth rut, गिरीन् यथा like mountains, मेघस्न्तिन्तिर्घोषान् trumpeting like a group of clouds, समरे in war, परैः by enemies, दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, गजान् elephants, ददर्श saw

text: निहन्त्रून् परसैन्यानां गृहे तस्मिन् ददर्श सः । क्षरतश्च यथा मेघान् स्रवतश्च यथा गिरीन् ॥५-६-३३॥
translation: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.
word_meanings: सः he, तस्मिन् in his, गृहे in the house, रक्तान् red, श्वेतान् white, सितांश्चैव pure white coloured, महाजवान् of good speed, हरींश्चापि horses also, कुलीनान् wellbred ones, रूपसम्पन्नान् goodlooking, परगजारुजान् those whch were not inferior to enemy's elephants, गजान् elephants, गजशिक्षयाम् in training elephants, निष्ठितान् exceedingly welltrained, ऐरावतसमान् equal to Airavata, युधि in battle, परसैन्यानाम् of enemy forces, निहन्त्रून् destroyers, क्षरतः shedding, मेघान् यथा clouds like, स्रवतः pouring forth rut, गिरीन् यथा like mountains, मेघस्न्तिन्तिर्घोषान् trumpeting like a group of clouds, समरे in war, परैः by enemies, दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, गजान् elephants, ददर्श saw

text: मेघ स्तनित निर्घोषान् दुर्धर्षान् समरे परैः । सहस्रम् वाहिनीः तत्र जाम्बूनद परिष्कृताः ॥५-६-३४॥
हेम जालैर् अविच्चिन्नाः तरुण आदित्य सम्निभाः । ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-६-३५॥
translation: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.
word_meanings: तत्र there, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the residence, जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताः bedecked with the gold, हेमजालपरिच्छन्नाः protected by the rays emerging from, तरुणादित्यसन्निभाः like the rising Sun, सहस्रम् thousands, वाहिनीः troops, ददर्श saw

text: शिबिका विविध आकाराः स कपिर् मारुत आत्मजः । लता गृहाणि चित्राणि चित्र शाला गृहाणि च ॥५-६-३६॥
translation: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः कपिः that monkey (Hanuman), राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of demons, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the dwelling, विविधाकाराः of several foms, शिबिकाः palanquins, चित्राणि colourful, लतागृहाणि bowers, चित्रशालागृहाणि homes with picture galleries, अन्यानि and other, क्रीडागृहाणि sporting homes, दारुपर्वतकानपि hillocks made of wood, कामस्य for lovemaking (romance), गृहकम् home, रम्यम् delighting, दिवागृहकमेव च for daytime activities, ददर्श saw

text: क्रीडा गृहाणि च अन्यानि दारु पर्वतकान् अपि । कामस्य गृहकम् रम्यम् दिवा गृहकम् एव च ॥५-६-३७॥
translation: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः कपिः that monkey (Hanuman), राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of demons, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the dwelling, विविधाकाराः of several foms, शिबिकाः palanquins, चित्राणि colourful, लतागृहाणि bowers, चित्रशालागृहाणि homes with picture galleries, अन्यानि and other, क्रीडागृहाणि sporting homes, दारुपर्वतकानपि hillocks made of wood, कामस्य for lovemaking (romance), गृहकम् home, रम्यम् delighting, दिवागृहकमेव च for daytime activities, ददर्श saw

text: ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने । स मन्दर तल प्रख्यम् मयूर स्थान सम्कुलम् ॥५-६-३८॥
ध्वज यष्टिभिर् आकीर्णम् ददर्श भवन उत्तमम् । अनन्त रत्न निचयम् निधि जालम् समन्ततः ॥५-६-३९॥
translation: Comparable to mount Mandara, it was crowded with peacocks, set with flag staffs fixed all over, magnificent mansions built by skilled craftsmen with great efforts, decked with gems of several kinds, rich with treasures comparable to Kailasa, the home of Siva, the Lord of all beings.
word_meanings: सः he, मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यम् comaparable to mount Mandara, मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम् places crowded with peacocks, ध्वजयष्टिभिः with flag staffs fixed, आकीर्णम् filled with, धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तम् built by skilled craftsmen with great care, भूतपतेः of Siva, the lord of all creatures, गृहमिव like home, भवनोत्तमम् magnificent mansion, समन्ततः every where, अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णम् full of gems, निधिजालम् treasure troves, ददर्श saw

text: धीर निष्ठित कर्म अन्तम् गृहम् भूत पतेर् इव । अर्चिर्भिः च अपि रत्नानाम् तेजसा रावणस्य च ॥५-६-४०॥
विरराज अथ तद् वेश्म रश्मिमान् इव रश्मिभिः । जाम्बू नदमयानि एव शयनानि आसनानि च ॥५-६-४१॥
भाजनानि च शुभ्राणि ददर्श हरि यूथपः । मध्व् आसव कृत क्लेदम् मणि भाजन सम्कुलम् ॥५-६-४२॥
मनो रमम् असम्बाधम् कुबेर भवनम् यथा । नूपुराणाम् च घोषेण कान्चीनाम् निनदेन च ॥५-६-४३॥
मृदन्ग तल घोषैः च घोषवद्भिर् विनादितम् । प्रासाद सम्घात युतम् स्त्री रत्न शत सम्कुलम् ॥५-६-४४॥
सुव्यूढ कक्ष्यम् हनुमान् प्रविवेश महा गृहम् ॥५-६-४५॥
translation: Hanuman entered the delightful, lofty palace comparable to Kubera's mansion. It was filled with vessels encrusted with gems scattered all over. The floor was drenched with liquor. It was resonating with sounds of golden anklets of women and of drums. The rows of mansions, lofty palaces with welllaid apartments were full of hundreds of exquisite women. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ध्वासवकृतक्लेदम् drenched with liqour and other drinks, मणिभाजनसङ्कुलम् with gemencrusted vessels scattered all over, मनोरमम् very delightful, असम्बाधम् spacious, कुबेरभवनं यथा like the mansion of Kubera, नूपुराणाम् of anklets, घोषेण by the sound, काञ्चीनाम् of girdles, निनदेन with the sounds, घोषवद्भि: filled with sounds of, मृदङ्गतल घोषैश्च with the sounds of drums, विनादितम् resonating, प्रासादसङ्घातयुतम् with rows of mansions, स्त्रीरत्नशतसङ्कुलम् filled with hundreds of exquisite women, सुव्यूढकक्ष्यम् with welllaid apartments, महागृहम् lofty palace, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रविवेश entered

text: स वेश्मजालं बलवान् ददर्श व्यासक्तवैडूर्यसुवर्णजालम् । यथा महत् प्रावृषि मेघजालं विद्युत्पिनद्धं सविहङ्गजालम् ॥५-७-१॥
translation: Powerful Hanuman beheld the conglomeration of buildings with golden lattices encrusted with vaidurya, with flocks of birds comparable to a complex of clouds pierced by lightning during rainy season.
word_meanings: बलवान् powerful, सः he, व्यासक्तवैडूर्यसुवर्णजालम् fitted with golden lattices encrusted with vaidurya, प्रावृषि in the rainy season, विद्युत्पिनद्धम् with streaks of lightning, सविहङ्गजालम् with flocks of birds, महत् great, मेघजालं यथा like the abode of clouds, वेश्मजालम् conglomeration of houses, ददर्श saw.

text: निवेशनानाम् विविधाः च शालाः । प्रधान शन्ख आयुध चाप शालाः । मनो हराः च अपि पुनर् विशाला । ददर्श वेश्म अद्रिषु चन्द्र शालाः ॥५-७-२॥
translation: Attached to the spacious halls of the houses, were storehouses for valuable conches, weapons, bows and arrows. On the top of the attics on these mansions, were large and delightful terraces open to the Moon.
word_meanings: निवेशनानाम् of the houses, विविधाः several, शालाः halls, प्रधानशङ्खायुधचापशालाः for storing valuable conches, weapons and bows, पुनः again, वेश्माद्रिषु on top of attics on the houses, मनोहराः delightful, विशालाः spacious, चन्द्रशालाः terraces, ददर्श saw.

text: गृहाणि नाना वसु राजितानि । देव असुरैः च अपि सुपूजितानि । सर्वैः च दोषैः परिवर्जितानि । कपिर् ददर्श स्व बल अर्जितानि ॥५-७-३॥
translation: The monkey saw numerous kinds of treasures, cherished by gods and demons, which were won by Ravana's might.
word_meanings: कपिः monkey, नानावसुराजितानि various kinds treasures, देवासुरैश्चापि even by gods and demons, सुपूजितानि worshipped by, सर्वैः by all, दोषैः defects, परिवर्जितानि devoid, स्वबलार्जितानि earned by his might, गृहाणि houses, ददर्श saw.

text: तानि प्रयत्नाभिसमाहितानि मयेन साक्षादिव निर्मितानि । महीतले सर्वगुणोत्तराणि ददर्श लङ्काधिपतेर्गृहाणि ॥५-७-४॥
translation: The mansions of the lord of Lanka built with great care and effort on earth were by all means excellent and appeared as though built personally by Maya (the divine architect wellknown for magical skills).
word_meanings: तानि those, प्रयत्नाभिसमाहितानि collected with great care and effort, साक्षात् directly, मयेन by Maya, निर्मितानीव as though built, महीतले on earth, सर्वगुणोत्तराणि of excellent quality, लङ्काधिपतेः of the lord of Lanka, गृहाणि mansions, ददर्श saw.

text: ततो ददर्श उच्च्रित मेघ रूपम् । मनो हरम् कान्चन चारु रूपम् । रक्षो अधिपस्य आत्म बल अनुरूपम् । गृह उत्तमम् हि अप्रतिरूप रूपम् ॥५-७-५॥
translation: Hanuman beheld the magnificent and soulcaptivating palace possessing the splendour of molten gold. Of matchless beauty, it looked like a towering cloud worthy of the might of Ravana, the lord of ogresses.
word_meanings: ततः then, उछ्रचितमेघरूपम् appearing like a towering cloud, मनोहरम् soulcaptivating, काञ्चनचारुरूपम् golden palace possessing splendour of molten gold, अप्रतिरूपरूपम् matchless, आत्मबलानुरूपम् worthy of the might of Ravana, रक्षोधिपस्य of the lord of demons, गृहोत्तमम् magnificent palace, ददर्श saw.

text: मही तले स्वर्गम् इव प्रकीर्णम् । श्रिया ज्वलन्तम् बहु रत्न कीर्णम् । नाना तरूणाम् कुसुम अवकीर्णम् । गिरेर् इव अग्रम् रजसा अवकीर्णम् ॥५-७-६॥
translation: It appeared splendid like a scattered piece of heaven on earth, glittering with countless gems. It looked like a mountain peak covered with pollen of flowers dropped from all kinds of trees.
word_meanings: महीतले on earth, प्रकीर्णम् scattered, स्वर्गमिव like heaven, श्रिया with splendour, ज्वलन्तम् while glittering, बहुरत्नकीर्णम् with many gems, नानातरूणाम् of all kinds of trees, कुसुमावकीर्णम् scattered with flowers, रजसा with dust, अवकीर्णम् covered, गिरेः mountain, अग्रमिव like the peak.

text: नारीप्रवेकैरिव दीप्यमानं तटिद्भिरम्भोदवदर्च्यमानम् । हंसप्रवेकैरिव वाह्यमानं श्रिया युतं खे सुकृतां विमानम् ॥५-७-७॥
translation: The aerial chariot was lit up by resplendent women just as a raincloud dazzles with flashes of lightning. It was auspicious, worthy of worship. It looked as if it was drawn by royal swans in the sky.
word_meanings: नारीप्रवेकैः by resplendent women,दीप्यमानमिव as if lit up,तटिद्भिः with lightning, अम्भोदवत् like a raincloud, अर्च्यमानम् worshipped, हंसप्रवेकैः borne by swans, वाह्यमानम् इव as if being drawn by, श्रिया auspicious, युतम् endowed, खे in the sky, सुकृताम् royal, विमानम् aerial chariot.

text: यथा नग अग्रम् बहु धातु चित्रम् । यथा नभः च ग्रह चन्द्र चित्रम् । ददर्श युक्ती कृत मेघ चित्रम् । विमान रत्नम् बहु रत्न चित्रम् ॥५-७-८॥
translation: A jewel among aerial chariots, it looked colourful with many gems beset. It appeared like the summit of a mountain decorated with the colours of minerals, like the sky bespangled with planets and the Moon and like a mass of multicoloured clouds adorned by a rainbow.
word_meanings: युक्तीकृतमेघचित्रम् mass of colourful clouds, ग्रहचन्द्रचित्रम् looking colourful with planets and Moon, नभः यथा like the sky, बहुरत्नचित्रम् colourful on account of gems encrusted, बहुधातुचित्रम् colourful on account of many minerals, नगाग्रं यथा like the peak of a mountain, विमानरत्नम् jewel of a chariot, ददर्श saw.

text: मही कृता पर्वतराजिपूर्णा शैलाः कृता वृक्षवितानपूर्णाः । वृक्षाः कृताः पुष्पवितानपूर्णाः पुष्पं कृतं केसरपत्रपूर्णम् ॥५-७-९॥
translation: The whole earth had been picturised on it. It was filled with rows of mountains and a canopy of trees all over. The trees were filled with lovely flowers with petals and filaments drawn on them.
word_meanings: मही earth, पर्वतराजिपूर्णा filled with mountain ranges, कृता drawn, शैलाः mountains, वृक्षवितानपूर्णाः filled with a canopy of trees, कृताः drawn, वृक्षाः trees, पुष्पवितानपूर्णाः filled with a canopy of flowers, कृताः drawn on it, पुष्पम् flowers, केसरपत्रपूर्णम् filled with petals and filaments, कृतम् drawn.

text: कृतानि वेश्मानि च पाण्डुराणि । तथा सुपुष्पा अपि पुष्करिण्यः । पुनः च पद्मानि सकेसराणि । धन्यानि चित्राणि तथा वनानि ॥५-७-१०॥
translation: There were pictures of mansions white in colour and pools of crystalclear water filled with lovely flowers. There were pictures of beautiful lotuses drawn on it.
word_meanings: पाण्डुराणि white in colour, वेश्मानि च houses, कृतानि drawn, तथा so also, सुपुष्पाणि with beautiful flowers, पुष्कराणि च ponds also, पुनश्च again, स केसराणि having filaments, पद्मानि lotuses, तथा so also, धन्यानि complete, चित्राणि paintings, वनानि gardens.

text: पुष्प आह्वयम् नाम विराजमानम् । रत्न प्रभाभिः च विवर्धमानम् । वेश्म उत्तमानाम् अपि च उच्च मानम् । महा कपिः तत्र महा विमानम् ॥५-७-११॥
translation: There, the great Hanuman indeed saw a splendid chariot called Pushpaka. It was glowing with glittering gems. Taller than the biggest mansion, it was a great chariot.
word_meanings: तत्र there, महाकपिः great vanara, पुष्पाह्वयम् Pushpaka chariot by name, नामविराजमानम् splendid indeed, रत्नप्रभाभिः glitter of gems, विवर्धमानम् glowing, वेश्मोत्तमानामपि of magnificent mansions, उच्यमानम् tall, महाविमानम् great chariot.

text: कृताः च वैदूर्यमया विहम्गा । रूप्य प्रवालैः च तथा विहम्गाः । चित्राः च नाना वसुभिर् भुजम्गा । जात्या अनुरूपाः तुरगाः शुभ अन्गाः ॥५-७-१२॥
translation: Inside were birds made of vaidurya, silver and corals. There were colourful serpents made of various gems, and highclass horses of exquisite limbs drawn.
word_meanings: वैडूर्यमयाः made of vaidurya, विहङ्गाः birds, तथा similarly, रूप्यप्रवालैश्च made of silver and corals, विहङ्गाः birds, नानावसुभिः with various gems, चित्राः colourful, भुजङ्गाः serpents, जात्याः due to there good breeding, अनुरूपाः similar, शुभाङ्गाः with auspicious limbs, तुरगाः horses, कृताः drawn.

text: प्रवाल जाम्बूनद पुष्प पक्षाः । सलीलम् आवर्जित जिह्म पक्षाः । कामस्य साक्षाद् इव भान्ति पक्षाः । कृता विहम्गाः सुमुखाः सुपक्षाः ॥५-७-१३॥
translation: It had curved figures of birds with beautiful wings carved out of corals and gold The wings were shining as if they were really the wings of allies of Cupid, the god of love.
word_meanings: प्रवालजाम्बूनदपुष्पपक्षाः wings engraved with corals and gold, सुपक्षाः having beautiful wings, सलीलम् in a sportive way, आवर्जितजिह्मपक्षाः with their artificial wings bent down (tossed), विहङ्गाः birds, कृताः were drawn, साक्षात् truly, कामस्य cupid's, पक्षाः इव like wings, भान्ति seemed.

text: नियुज्यमानाः च गजाः सुहस्ताः । सकेसराः च उत्पल पत्र हस्ताः । बभूव देवी च कृता सुहस्ता । लक्ष्मीः तथा पद्मिनि पद्म हस्ता ॥५-७-१४॥
translation: He saw on it lotus ponds, artificial elephants with shapely trunks, offering to Laxmi who herself was a lotus, holding in her beautiful hands blue lotuses shining with filaments.
word_meanings: पद्मिनि in a lotuspond, सुहस्ता having beautiful hands, सकेसराश्च with filaments, उत्पलपत्रहस्ताः blue lotuses by their trunk carried, लक्ष्मीः goddess of wealth, नियुज्यमानास्तु stationed in place, गजाः elephants, तथा similarly, पद्महस्ता holding a lotus in hand, सुहस्ता of beautiful hand, देवी च goddess, कृता drawn, बभूव appeared.

text: इतीव तद्गृहमभिगम्य शोभनम् सविस्मयो नगमिव चारुशोभनम् । पुनश्च तत्परमसुगन्धि सुन्दरम् हिमात्यये नगमिव चारुकन्दरम् ॥५-७-१५॥
translation: Thus he reached the auspicious palace appearing like a beautiful mountain and stood wonderstruck. Once again he looked at that beautiful palace which appeared like a mountain with lovely caverns in spring time filled with wonderful fragrance
word_meanings: इतीव in that way, शोभनम् auspicious, चारुशोभनम् beautifully fashioned, नगमिव like a mountain, तद्गृहम् that palace, अभिगम्य having reached, सविस्मयः wonderstruck, परमसुगन्धि highly fragrant, सुन्दरम् beautiful, हिमात्यये at the end of winter, चारुकन्दरम् having beautiful caves, नगमिव like mountain, तत् that, पुनश्च once again.

text: ततः स ताम् कपिर् अभिपत्य पूजिताम् । चरन् पुरीम् दश मुख बाहु पालिताम् । अदृश्य ताम् जनक सुताम् सुपूजिताम् । सुदुह्खिताम् पति गुण वेग निर्जिताम् ॥५-७-१६॥
translation: Then Hanuman moved about that cherished city ruled by the strength of arms of the tenheaded king. Unable to find venerable Sita, who was deprived of the benefit of her husband's virtuous proximity, he became deeply sad.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः कपिः monkey, पूजिताम् worshipped, दशमुखबाहुपालिताम् ruled by the arms of the tenheaded king, तां पुरीम् that city, अभिपत्य having reached, चरन् while moving about, सुपूजिताम् venerable, पतिगुणवेगवर्जिताम् who was deprived of the benefit of her husband's virtuous conduct, तां जनकसुताम् that Janaka's daughter Sita, अदृश्य unable to find, सुदुःखितः was deeply sorrowful.

text: ततः तदा बहु विध भावित आत्मनः । कृत आत्मनो जनक सुताम् सुवर्त्मनः । अपश्यतो अभवद् अतिदुह्खितम् मनः । सुचक्षुषः प्रविचरतो महात्मनः ॥५-७-१७॥
translation: Unable to find Sita, the disciplined and foresighted Hanuman, who always kept the righteous path, felt distressed while moving about, his mind oppressed by all kinds of thought. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः from there, तदा then, बहुविधभावितात्मनः thinking of many things in his mind, कृतात्मनः of a great soul, सुवर्त्मनः of the followers of righteous path, सुचक्षुषः foresighted, प्रविचरतः while he moved, जनकसुताम् daughter of Janaka, अपश्यत: unable to find, महात्मनः of the great self, मनः mind, अतिदुःखितम् very distressed, अभवत् became.

text: स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य सम्स्थितम् । महद्विमानम् मणिवज्रचित्रितम् । प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालकृत्रिमम् । ददर्श वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः ॥५-८-१॥
translation: The courageous son of the Windgod, Hanuman, the vanara saw the aerial chariot kept in the middle of the mansion inlaid with gems and diamonds latticed with artificial windows of barnished gold.
word_meanings: वीरः courageous, पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः कपिः that vanara, तस्य भवनस्य of that mansion, मध्ये in the middle, संस्थितम् standing, मणिवज्रचित्रितम् rendered beautiful with gems and diamonds, प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालकृत्रिमम् adorned with latticed windows of barnished gold, महत् great, विमानम् aerial chariot, ददर्श saw.

text: तदप्रमेयाप्रतिकारकृत्रिमम् । कृतम् स्वयम् साध्विति विश्वकर्मणाः । दिवम् गतम् वायुपथप्रतिष्ठितम् । व्यराजतादित्यपथस्य लक्ष्मिवत् ॥५-८-२॥
translation: The immeasurable Pushpaka fashioned by Visvakarma with images of incomparable beauty was not possible to describe. An excellent product of his achievement, it was placed in the aerial path appearing as a beaconlight (signpost) in the orbit of the Sun.
word_meanings: अप्रमेयाप्रतिकारकृत्रिमम् with images of incomparable beauty and immeasureable skill, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, स्वयम् himself, साध्विति product of excellent achievement, कृतम् fashioned, दिवम् sky, गतम् going, वायुपथप्रतिष्ठितम् which was placed in the aerial path, तत् that, आदित्यपथस्य in the orbit of the Sun, लक्ष्मवत् like a beaconlight, व्यराजत shone.

text: न तत्र किम्चिन्न कृतम् प्रयत्नतो । न तत्र किम्चिन्न महर्हरत्नवत् । न ते विशेषा नियताः सुरेष्वपि । न तत्र किम्चिन्न महाविशेषवत् ॥५-८-३॥
translation: There was nothing in Pushpaka which was not executed carefully with special effort, nothing which was not made of precious stones. Such privileges were not available to even gods. Indeed there was nothing which was not unique.
word_meanings: तत्र there, प्रयत्नतः by special effort, न कृतम् not only done, किञ्चित् anything, न not, तत्र there, न महार्हरत्नवत् with costly gems, किञ्चित् a litttle, न not, ते those, विशेषाः unique, सुरेष्वपि even to deities, न नियताः not present, तत्र there, न महाविशेषवत् very special, किञ्चित् न indeed it was.

text: तपह्समाधानपराक्रमार्जितम् । मनःसमाधानविचारचारिणम् । अनेकसम्स्थानविषेषनिर्मितम् । ततस्ततस्तुल्यविशेषदर्शनम् ॥५-८-४॥
translation: (The Pushpaka) was designed by dint of divine efforts and prowess (of Kubera). It could touch any place its master commanded with a cool mind. It had many beautiful places of rest.
word_meanings: तपः spiritual efforts, समाधानपराक्रमार्जितम् designed through concentration and prowess, मनः समाधानविचारचारिणम् which can reach the places desired by the thought of its master, अनेकसंस्थानविशेषनिर्मितम् built with many special seats, ततस्ततः at all places, तुल्यविशेषदर्शनम् of equally good appearance

text: विशेषमालम्ब्य विशेषसम्स्थितम् । विचित्रकूटम् बहुकूटमण्डितम् । मनोऽभिरामम् शरद्न्दुनिर्मलम् । विचित्रकूटम् शिखरम् गिरेर्यथा ॥५-८-५॥
translation: The Pushpaka was specially designed in a unique manner. It was decorated with many colourful peaks. It was delghtful and pleasing to the mind and bright like the autumnal fullmoon. It looked like a mountain with many wonderful towers around.
word_meanings: विशेषम् special, आलम्ब्य resorting to, विशेषसंस्थितम् designed in a unique manner, विचित्रकूटम् with wonderful peaks, बहुकूटमण्डितम् decorated with many peaks, मनोऽभिरामम् delightful to the mind, शरदिन्दुनिर्मलम् pleasing as autumnal fullmoon, गिरेः mountain's, विचित्रकूटम् wonderful towers, शिखरं यथा like the peak.

text: वहन्ति यम् कुण्डशोभितानना । महाशना व्योमचरा निशाचराः । विवृत्तविध्वस्तविशाललोचना । महाजवा भूतगणाः सहस्रशः ॥५-८-६॥
translation: The Pushpaka was borne by multitudes of Bhutas whose faces were shining with earrings, who were demons ranging in the night sky. They were gluttons endowed with great speed, and they had big, rolling and frightening eyes.
word_meanings: यम् such (a chariot), कुण्डलशोभिताननाः faces brightened by the earrings, महाशनाः gluttons, व्योमचराः ranging in the sky, निशाचराः nightrangers, विवृत्तविध्वस्त विशाललोचनाः with big rolling and frightening eyes, महाजवाः of tremendous speed, भूतगणाः groups of Bhutas, सहस्रशः in thousands, वहन्ति drawing.

text: वसन्तपुष्पोत्करचारुदर्शनम् । वसन्तमासदपि कान्तदर्शनम् । स पुष्पकम् तत्र विमानमुत्तमम् । ददर्श तद्वानरवीरसत्तमः ॥५-८-७॥
translation: That hero among monkeys, beheld the aerial chariot looking beautiful like a colourful collection of spring blossoms. Its appearance was more pleasant than spring itself. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तत् that, वानरवीरसत्तमः hero among monkeys, सः he, वसन्तपुष्पोत्करचारुदर्शनम् looking beautiful like a collection of blossoms of spring, वसन्तमासादपि more delightful than spring, कान्तदर्शनम् appearing beautiful, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, उत्तमम् excellent, विमानम् aerial chariot, तत्र there, ददर्श saw.

text: तस्य आलय वरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलम् आयतम् । ददर्श भवन श्रेष्ठम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-९-१॥
translation: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, saw a huge, spacious and excellent of all mansions in the centre of the palace.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, आलयवरिष्ठस्य of the main building, मध्ये in the centre, विपुलम् spacious, आयतम् huge, भवनश्रेष्ठम् excellent among mansions, ददर्श saw.

text: अर्ध योजन विस्तीर्णम् आयतम् योजनम् हि तत् । भवनम् राक्षस इन्द्रस्य बहु प्रासाद सम्कुलम् ॥५-९-२॥
translation: The mansion of the lord of demons was a conglomeration of palaces half a yojana long and half a yojana wide.
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of Indra among demons, तत् that, बहुप्रासादसङ्कुलम् of multitude of palaces, भवनम् mansion, अर्धयोजनविस्तीर्णम् width of half yojana, योजनम् yojana, आयतम् long.

text: मार्गमाणः तु वैदेहीम् सीताम् आयत लोचनाम् । सर्वतः परिचक्राम हनूमान् अरि सूदनः ॥५-९-३॥
translation: Hanuman, the subduer of enemies, went around in search of the largeeyed Vaidehi.
word_meanings: अरिसूदनः subduer of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, आयतलोचनाम् broadeyed, सीताम् for Sita, मार्गमाणः तु in search, सर्वतः all over, परिचक्राम went allround .

text: उत्तमम् राक्षसावासम् हनुमानवलोकयन् । आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् ॥५-९-४॥
translation: Searching the excellent residences of important demons, Hanuman finally reached the palace of the lord of ogres guarded by armed demons with elephants with two or three or four tusks.
word_meanings: अथ now, लक्ष्मीवान् endowed with brightness, हनुमान् Hanuman, उत्तमम् best, राक्षसावासम् residence of demons, चतुर्विषाणैः fourtusked, तथैव च and similarly, त्रिविषाणैः threetusked, द्विरदैः twotusked, परिक्षिप्तम् surrounded by, असम्बाधम् spacious, उदायुधैः holding weapons, रक्ष्यमाणम् guarded by, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् home of the lord of the ogres, अवलोकयन् seeing, आससाद reached.

text: चतुर् विषाणैर् द्विरदैः त्रिविषाणैः तथैव च । परिक्षिप्तम् असम्बाधम् रक्ष्यमाणम् उदायुधैः ॥५-९-५॥
translation: Searching the excellent residences of important demons, Hanuman finally reached the palace of the lord of ogres guarded by armed demons with elephants with two or three or four tusks.
word_meanings: अथ now, लक्ष्मीवान् endowed with brightness, हनुमान् Hanuman, उत्तमम् best, राक्षसावासम् residence of demons, चतुर्विषाणैः fourtusked, तथैव च and similarly, त्रिविषाणैः threetusked, द्विरदैः twotusked, परिक्षिप्तम् surrounded by, असम्बाधम् spacious, उदायुधैः holding weapons, रक्ष्यमाणम् guarded by, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् home of the lord of the ogres, अवलोकयन् seeing, आससाद reached.

text: राक्षसीभिश्च पत्नीभी रावणस्य निवेशनम् । आहृताभिश्च विक्रम्य राजकन्याभिरावृतम् ॥५-९-६॥
translation: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.
word_meanings: रावणस्य Ravana's, पत्नीभिः with wives, राक्षसीभिः च by demonesses also, विक्रम्य by winning, आहृताभिः brought, राजकन्याभिः by princesses, आवृतम् surrounded, निवेशनम् palace, तत् नक्रमकराकीर्णम् filled with crocodiles and sharks, तिमिङ्गिलझषाकुलम् with whales and fish, वायुवेगसमाधूतम् shaken by the force of the wind, पन्नगैः with serpents, सागरम् इव like an ocean, तत् he saw.

text: तन् नक्र मकर आकीर्णम् तिमिम्गिल झष आकुलम् । वायु वेग समाधूतम् पन्नगैर् इव सागरम् ॥५-९-७॥
translation: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.
word_meanings: रावणस्य Ravana's, पत्नीभिः with wives, राक्षसीभिः च by demonesses also, विक्रम्य by winning, आहृताभिः brought, राजकन्याभिः by princesses, आवृतम् surrounded, निवेशनम् palace, तत् नक्रमकराकीर्णम् filled with crocodiles and sharks, तिमिङ्गिलझषाकुलम् with whales and fish, वायुवेगसमाधूतम् shaken by the force of the wind, पन्नगैः with serpents, सागरम् इव like an ocean, तत् he saw.

text: या हि वैश्रवणे लक्ष्मीर्या चेन्द्रे हरिवाहने । सा रावणगृहे सर्वा नित्यमेवानपायिनी ॥५-९-८॥
translation: Whatever wealth was possessed by Vaisravana (Kubera, the son of sage Vishrava) and also Indra who rides the Ucchaisrava green horse, was there in the palace of Ravana.
word_meanings: वैश्रवणे by Vaisravana, या whatever, लक्ष्मीः wealth हरिवाहने on greenish horse, the mount, इन्द्रे च of Indra, या as much, सा that, सर्वा everything, रावणगृहे in the residence of Ravana, नित्यमेव always, अनपायिनी present.

text: या च राज्ञः कुबेरस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च । तादृशी तद्विशिष्टा वा ऋद्धी रक्षोगृहेष्विह ॥५-९-९॥
translation: The wealth stored in Ravana's palace was akin to what lay in the palaces of Kubera, Yama or Varuna, and ever more exquisite.
word_meanings: राज्ञः of the king, कुबेरस्य Kubera's, या whatever, यमस्य Yama's, वरुणस्य Varuna's, च and, या whatever, तादृशी such, तद्विशिष्टा वा or more exquisite than, ऋद्धि: wealth इह here, रक्षोगृहेषु in the houses of demons.

text: तस्य हर्म्यस्य मध्यस्थम् वेश्म च अन्यत् सुनिर्मितम् । बहुनिर्यूह सम्कीर्णम् ददर्श पवन आत्मजः ॥५-९-१०॥
translation: Hanuman saw in the centre of that palace a complex of many wellbuilt houses.
word_meanings: पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, तस्य of that, हर्म्यस्य of the palace, मध्यस्थम् in the centre, सुनिर्मितम् well built, बहुनिर्यूहसङ्कीर्णम् a complex many houses, अन्यत् another, वेश्म home, ददर्श saw.

text: ब्रह्मणोऽर्थे कृतं दिव्यं दिवि यद्विश्वकर्मणा । विमानं पुष्पकं नाम सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ॥५-९-११॥
translation: There was a wonderful aerial chariot called Pushpaka embellished with all kinds of gems built by Visvakarma for Brahma. It was the same one that Kubera had won from his grandfather, the creator Brahma, through his supreme penance. The lord of ogres acquired it (as a memento for his victory) by defeating Kubera with his might.
word_meanings: सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, पुष्पकं नाम called Pushpaka, यत् that, दिव्यम् wonderful, विमानम् aerial chariot, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दिवि in the sky, ब्रह्मणः अर्थे for Brahma, कृतम् built, यत् the same one, कुबेरः Kubera, पितामहात् from grandfather the creator, परेण with supreme, तपसा by penance, लेभे got, तत् that, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demons, ओजसा by his might, कुबेरम् Kubera, जित्वा after defeating, लेभे acquired.

text: परेण तपसा लेभे यत् कुबेरः पितामहात् । कुबेरम् ओजसा जित्वा लेभे तद् राक्षस ईश्वरः ॥५-९-१२॥
translation: There was a wonderful aerial chariot called Pushpaka embellished with all kinds of gems built by Visvakarma for Brahma. It was the same one that Kubera had won from his grandfather, the creator Brahma, through his supreme penance. The lord of ogres acquired it (as a memento for his victory) by defeating Kubera with his might.
word_meanings: सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, पुष्पकं नाम called Pushpaka, यत् that, दिव्यम् wonderful, विमानम् aerial chariot, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दिवि in the sky, ब्रह्मणः अर्थे for Brahma, कृतम् built, यत् the same one, कुबेरः Kubera, पितामहात् from grandfather the creator, परेण with supreme, तपसा by penance, लेभे got, तत् that, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demons, ओजसा by his might, कुबेरम् Kubera, जित्वा after defeating, लेभे acquired.

text: ईहामृगसमायुक्त्तै: कार्तस्वरहिरमण्मयैः । सुकृतैराचितं स्तम्भैः प्रदीप्तमिव च श्रिया ॥५-९-१३॥
translation: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.
word_meanings: ईहामृगसमायुक्तै: with images of wolves carved, कार्तस्वरहिरण्मयैः made of Kartaswara and Hiranmaya, two types of gold, सुकृतैः finely built, स्तम्भैः with pillars, आचितम् supported, श्रिया lustrous, प्रदीप्तमिव as though blazing, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैः resembling mountain Meru and Mandara, अम्बरम् sky, उल्लिखद्भिरिव as though scraping, शुभाकारैः by auspicious, कूटागारैः with multitude of pleasurehouses, सर्वतः everywhere, समलङ्कृतम् decorated.

text: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैरुल्लिखद्भिरिवाम्बरं । कूटागारैश्शुभाकारैस्सर्वतस्समलङ्कृतम् ॥५-९-१४॥
translation: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.
word_meanings: ईहामृगसमायुक्तै: with images of wolves carved, कार्तस्वरहिरण्मयैः made of Kartaswara and Hiranmaya, two types of gold, सुकृतैः finely built, स्तम्भैः with pillars, आचितम् supported, श्रिया lustrous, प्रदीप्तमिव as though blazing, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैः resembling mountain Meru and Mandara, अम्बरम् sky, उल्लिखद्भिरिव as though scraping, शुभाकारैः by auspicious, कूटागारैः with multitude of pleasurehouses, सर्वतः everywhere, समलङ्कृतम् decorated.

text: ज्वलनार्कप्रतीकाशं सुकृतं विश्वकर्मणा । हेमसोपानसंयुक्तं चारुप्रवरवेदिकम् ॥५-९-१५॥
translation: It was well built by Visvakarma and and had golden stairways, with radiant platforms glowing like fire and Sun.
word_meanings: विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, सुकृतम् well built, ज्वलनार्कप्रतीकाशम् glowing like fire and the Sun, हेमसोपानसंयुक्तम् had stairways of gold, चारुप्रवरवेदिकम् had beautiful paltforms.

text: जाल वात अयनैर् युक्तम् कान्चनैः स्थाटिकैर् अपि । इन्द्र नील महा नील मणि प्रवरवेदिकम् ॥५-९-१६॥
translation: It had latticed windows made of gold inlaid with crystals. The platforms were encrusted with saphires called Indraneela and Mahaneela appropriately.
word_meanings: काञ्चनैः with gold, स्फाटिकैरपि with crystal also, जालवातायनैः by latticed windows, युक्तम् endowed, इन्द्रनीलमहानीलमणिप्रवरवेदिकम् platforms encrusted with saphires called Indraneela and Mahaneela.

text: विद्रुमेण विचित्रेण मणिभिश्च महाधनैः । विस्तुलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिस्तलेनाभिविराजितम् ॥५-९-१७॥
translation: It was shining bright with colourful corals, precious gems and peerless pearls fixed on its floor.
word_meanings: विचित्रेण with colourful, विद्रुमेण with corals, महाघनैः by very precious, मणिभिश्च by gems even, निस्तुलाभिः with peerless (invaluable), मुक्ताभिः with pearls, तलेन on the surface, अभिविराजितम् shining very brightly.

text: चन्दनेन च रक्तेन तपनीयनिभेन च । सुपुण्यगन्धिना युक्तमादित्यतरुणोपमम् ॥५-९-१८॥
translation: It was bright like molten gold, fragrant with red sandal comparable to the rising Sun.
word_meanings: रक्तेन in red, तपनीयनिभेन च comparable to pure and polished gold, सुपुण्यगन्धिना with sweet fragrance, चन्दनेन with sandal, युक्तम् endowed, आदित्यतरुणोपमम् like the rising Sun.

text: कूटागारैर्वराकारैर्विविधैः समलम्कृतम् । विमानम् पुष्पकम् दिव्यम् आरुरोह महा कपिः ॥५-९-१९॥
translation: Hanuman ascended the wonderful Pushpaka, welldecked with many corridors.
word_meanings: महाकपिः Hanuman, वराकारैः of excellent appearance, कूटागारैः with many corridors, समलङ्कृतम् decorated, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकं विमानम् Pushpaka chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

text: तत्रस्थः स तदा गन्धम् पान भक्ष्य अन्न सम्भवम् । दिव्यम् सम्मूर्चितम् जिघ्रन् रूपवन्तम् इव अनिलम् ॥५-९-२०॥
translation: There he smelt the stupefying, unearthly odour of food and drink. He felt as though the fragrance had taken a potentially solid form. (Note: The wind has no form. But when he carried the aroma of food and drink it appeared like the personification of wind which could be smelt. गन्धवती पृथवी fragrance comes from earth पृथवीतत्त्व the poet transmits the same to the wind who has got only स्पर्श sense of touch).
word_meanings: स: he, तदा then, तत्रस्थः present there, पानभक्ष्यान्नसम्भवम् rising from drinks and food, दिव्यम् divine, सम्मूर्छितम् stupefying, रूपवन्तम् having a solid form, आनिलमिव like wind, गन्धम् fragrance, जिघ्रत् smelt.

text: स गन्धः तम् महा सत्त्वम् बन्धुर् बन्धुम् इव उत्तमम् । इत एहि इति उवाच इव तत्र यत्र स रावणः ॥५-९-२१॥
translation: The fragrance was as if inviting the mighty hero like a relative inviting his kith and kin, saying 'come here' and leading him to a place where Ravana rested.
word_meanings: स: गन्धः that fragrance, महासत्त्वम् mighty, तम् him (Hanuman), उत्तमम् great, बन्धुम् relative, बन्धुरिव like a relative, सः रावणः that Ravana, यत्र wherever, तत्र there, इतः एहि come here, इति thus, उवाच इव as if told.

text: ततः ताम् प्रस्थितः शालाम् ददर्श महतीम् शुभाम् । रावणस्य मनः कान्ताम् कान्ताम् इव वर स्त्रियम् ॥५-९-२२॥
translation: Then he proceeded to an auspicious hall, which was Ravana's favourite like his chief queen dear to his heart.
word_meanings: ततः then, प्रस्थितः he started, कान्ताम् beloved, वरस्त्रियमिव like his chief queen, रावणस्य Ravana's, मनः कान्ताम् dear his to heart, शुभाम् auspicious, महतीम् great, शालाम् hall, ददर्श saw.

text: मणिसोपानविकृतां हेमजालविभूषिताम् । स्फाटिकैरावृततलां दन्तान्तरितरूपिकाम् ॥५-९-२३॥
translation: The stairways of the mansion were inlaid with special gems, windows were latticed with gold, floors were covered with crystals, figures of ivory with silver.
word_meanings: मणिसोपानाविकृताम् staircase inlaid with special gems, हेमजालविभूषिताम् latticed with gold, स्फाटिकैः with crystals, आवृततलाम् floors covered with, दन्तान्तरितरूपिकाम् inlaid with silver set in ivory frame.

text: मुक्ताभिः च प्रवालैः च रूप्य चामी करैर् अपि । विभूषिताम् मणि स्तम्भैः सुबहु स्तम्भ भूषिताम् ॥५-९-२४॥
translation: It was decorated with pillars of silver and gold inlaid with pearls and corals and gems.
word_meanings: मुक्ताभिश्च with pearls, प्रवालैश्च with corals also, रूप्यचामीकरैरपि with silver and gold, मणिस्तम्भैः with pillars inlaid with gems, विभूषिताम् ornamented, सुबहुस्तम्भभूषिताम् with pillars.

text: नम्रैरृजुभिरत्युच्चैः समन्तात्सुविभूषितैः । स्तम्भैः पक्षैर् इव अत्युच्चैर् दिवम् सम्प्रस्थिताम् इव ॥५-९-२५॥
translation: It had highly ornamented pillars all over, some slightly bent and others straight. With lofty columns looking like wings it appeared as if the mansion had started on its journey to heaven.
word_meanings: नम्रैः bent, ऋजुभिः straight ones, अत्युच्चै: with very lofty, समन्तात् all over, सुविभूषितैः well decorated, स्तम्भैः with columns, अत्युच्छैः long, पक्षैः with wings, दिवम् heaven, सम्प्रस्थितामिव as if started to reach

text: महत्या कुथयास्तीर्णां पृथिवीलक्षणाङ्कया । पृथिवीमिव विस्तीर्णां सराष्ट्रगृहमालिनीम् ॥५-९-२६॥
translation: The floor was covered with a wide carpet spread from wall to wall with designs of different murals of many places and houses drawn in a row (garland like). The big carpet appeared like the expanse of earth itself.
word_meanings: पृथिवीलक्षणाङ्कया with several murals of earth, महत्या with expansive, कुथया with a carpet, आस्तीर्णाम् covered, सराष्ट्रगृहमालिनीम् having the garland of places and houses drawn on it, विस्तीर्णाम् expansive, पृथिवीमिव like the earth itself.

text: नादिताम् मत्त विहगैर् दिव्य गन्ध अधिवासिताम् । पर अर्ध्य आस्तरण उपेताम् रक्षो अधिप निषेविताम् ॥५-९-२७॥
translation: The mansion was resounding with the noise of birds singing in heat. It had wonderful fragrance. It was laid with exquisite tapestries and served as a dwelling place for the king of demons.
word_meanings: मत्तविहगैः with birds in heat, नादिताम् resounding, दिव्यगन्धाधिवासिताम् scented with divine fragrance, परार्ध्यास्तरणोपेताम् laid with valuable tapestries, रक्षोधिपनिषेविताम् inhabitted by the king of demons.

text: धूम्राम् अगरु धूपेन विमलाम् हम्स पाण्डुराम् । चित्राम् पुष्प उपहारेण कल्माषीम् इव सुप्रभाम् ॥५-९-२८॥
translation: It was smoky with fumes of agaru incence though spotless like a swan. It was colourful and radiant like Kamadhenu, the wishfulfilling cow, because of the offering of flowers.
word_meanings: अगरुधूपेन with smoke of agaru, धूम्राम् smoky, विमलाम् pure white, हंसपाण्डुराम् white like swan, पुष्पोपहारेण due to offering of flowers, चित्राम् colourful, सुप्रभाम् shining, कल्माषीमिव like the wishfulfilling cow.

text: मनः सम्ह्लाद जननीम् वर्णस्य अपि प्रसादिनीम् । ताम् शोक नाशिनीम् दिव्याम् श्रियः सम्जननीम् इव ॥५-९-२९॥
translation: (The mansion) was so full of effulgence and soul ravishing that it served as an adornment even to splendour. It looked as though it banished all sorrow and was a source of prosperity.
word_meanings: मनः संह्लादजननीम् one which was soul ravishing, वर्णस्यापि with colour and complexion, प्रसादिनीम् pleasing, शोकनाशिनीम् banished sorrow, श्रियः of prosperity, सञ्जननीमिव like the source, दिव्याम् wonderful, ताम् it was.

text: इन्द्रियाणि इन्द्रिय अर्थैः तु पन्च पन्चभिर् उत्तमैः । तर्पयाम् आस माता इव तदा रावण पालिता ॥५-९-३०॥
translation: The chamber of Ravana, like a mother, gratified all the five senses of Hanuman with proper objects of the senses.
word_meanings: रावणपालिता chamber of Ravana, तदा then, माता इव like a mother, उत्तमैः with excellent, पञ्चभिः with the five, इन्द्रियार्थैः with objects of the senses, पञ्च five, इन्द्रियाणि sense organs, तर्पयामास satisfied.

text: स्वर्गो अयम् देव लोको अयम् इन्द्रस्य इयम् पुरी भवेत् । सिद्धिर् वा इयम् परा हि स्याद् इति अमन्यत मारुतिः ॥५-९-३१॥
translation: 'This may be heaven or world of gods. It may be Amaravati, the abode of Indra or else it may be the supreme achievment (of the Creator), thought Maruti৷৷
word_meanings: अयम् this, स्वर्गः heaven, अयम् this, देवलोकः world of gods, इयम् thus, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, पुरी city (of Amaravati), भवेत् may be, इयम् this one, परा supreme, सिद्धि: achievement, स्यात् may be, इति thus, मारुतिः Maruti, अमन्यत thought.

text: प्रध्यायत इव अपश्यत् प्रदीपामः तत्र कान्चनान् (ःइअतुस्!) । धूर्तान् इव महा धूर्तैर् देवनेन पराजितान् ॥५-९-३२॥
translation: Seeing the golden lamps that stood burning steadily, Hanuman thought they looked like gamblers in deep thought defeated by expert gamblers in a game of dice.
word_meanings: महाधूर्तै: with expert gamblers, देवनेन by a game of dice, पराजिताम् defeated, धूर्तानिव like the gamblers, प्रध्यायत इव like one who is deep in thought, काञ्चनान् golden, प्रदीपान् lamps, आपश्यत् he saw.

text: दीपानाम् च प्रकाशेन तेजसा रावणस्य च । अर्चिर्भिर् भूषणानाम् च प्रदीप्ता इति अभ्यमन्यत ॥५-९-३३॥
translation: Hanuman fancied that the entire place was set ablaze with the glow of lamps, the lustre of Ravana and the brilliant glow of Ravana's ornaments (everything was shining).
word_meanings: दीपानाम् of the lamps, प्रकाशेन by the glow, रावणस्य Ravana's, तेजसा च and by his brightness, भूषणानाम् of ornaments, अर्चिर्भिः च by the glow spread there, प्रदीप्ता इति as if glowing like fire, अमन्यत he thought in his mind.

text: ततो अपश्यत् कुथा आसीनम् नाना वर्ण अम्बर स्रजम् । सहस्रम् वर नारीणाम् नाना वेष विभूषितम् ॥५-९-३४॥
translation: He found thousands of beautiful women seated on carpets wearing different clothes and garlands and dressed in various attires.
word_meanings: ततः then, कुथासीनम् seated on carpets, नानावर्णाम्बरस्रजम् wearing clothes and garlands of different colours, नानावेषविभूषितम् dressed various clothes, वरनारीणाम् of beautiful women, सहस्रम् thousand, अपश्यत् he saw.

text: परिवृत्तेऽर्धरात्रे तु पाननिद्रावशं गतम् । क्रीडित्वोपरतं रात्रौ सुष्वाप बलवत्तदा ॥५-९-३५॥
translation: Drinking and sporting until midnight, they had dropped off to sleeptired.
word_meanings: रात्रौ at night, क्रीडित्वा having sported, उपरतम् wearied, पाननिद्रावशं गतम् succumbed to drinks and sleep, तदा then, अर्धरात्रे when midnight, परिवृत्ते rolled away, बलवत् compelled, सुष्वाप to sleep.

text: तत् प्रसुप्तम् विरुरुचे निह्शब्द अन्तर भूषणम् । निह्शब्द हम्स भ्रमरम् यथा पद्म वनम् महत् ॥५-९-३६॥
translation: Fast asleep, sounds of their ornaments silenced, the young women looked like a large bed of lotuses with swans and bees sitting calm without their usual noise.
word_meanings: नि:शब्दान्तरभूषणम् the sounds of ornaments stilled, प्रसुप्तम् slept, तत् that, निःशब्दहंसभ्रमरम् like silent swans and bees, महत् great, पद्मवनं यथा resembling a forest of lotuses, विरुरुचे looked beautiful.

text: तासां संवृतदन्तानि मीलिताक्षीणि मारुतिः । अपश्यत्पद्मगन्धीनि वदनानि सुयोषिताम् ॥५-९-३७॥
translation: Hanuman looked at the faces of the wellbred young women with closed eyes and concealed teeth, fragrant like lotuses.
word_meanings: मारुतिः son of the Windgod, तासां सुयोषिताम् of those wellbred young women, संवृतदन्तानि with teeth concealed, मीलिताक्षीणि closed eyes, पद्मगन्धीनि giving out smell of lotuses, वदनानि faces, अपश्यत् looked.

text: प्रबुद्धानीव पद्मानि तासां भूत्वा क्षपाक्षये । पुनस्संवृतपत्राणि रात्राविव बभुस्तदा ॥५-९-३८॥
translation: The faces of the women looked like blooming lotuses at daybreak, their petals closed up again at night.
word_meanings: तासाम् of those women, क्षपाक्षये at the end of night, प्रबुद्धानि from early morning, पद्मानीव like lotuses, भूत्वा having been, पुनः again, रात्रौ at night, संवृतपत्राणिव closing up their petals, तदा then, बभुः looked.

text: इमानि मुख पद्मानि नियतम् मत्त षट्पदाः । अम्बुजानि इव फुल्लानि प्रार्थयन्ति पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-३९॥
translation: The intoxicated bees would again and again long to enjoy these beautiful faces which were like blooming lotuses.
word_meanings: मत्तषट्पदाः intoxicated bees, इमानि these, मुखपद्मानि lotuslike faces, फुल्लानि bloomed, अम्बुजानीव like lotuses, पुनः पुनः again and again, नियतम् always, प्रार्थयन्ति desire.

text: इति वा अमन्यत श्रीमान् उपपत्त्या महा कपिः । मेने हि गुणतः तानि समानि सलिल उद्भवैः ॥५-९-४०॥
translation: The illustrious Hanuman felt it to be correct to compare those faces with lotuses for their fragrance.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् the illustrious, महाकपिः great monkey, उपपत्त्या ascertained to be true, इति thus, अमन्यत felt, तानि those, गुणतः by their qualities, सलिलोद्भवैः with waterborn lotuses, समानि similar मेने हि he thought.

text: सा तस्य शुशुभे शाला ताभिः स्त्रीभिर् विराजिता । शारदी इव प्रसन्ना द्यौः ताराभिर् अभिशोभिता ॥५-९-४१॥
translation: Brightened by (the beauty of) the maidens, the mansion shone like the autumnal sky endearing and pleasing with stars.
word_meanings: तस्य his (Ravana's), सा शाला that mansion, ताभिः स्त्रीभिः by the women, विराजिता shone, ताराभिः with stars, अभिशोभिता very endearing, प्रसन्ना pleasant, शारदी autumnal, द्यौः इव sky like, शुशुभे seemed.

text: स च ताभिः परिवृतश्शुशुभे राक्षसाधिपः । यथा ह्युडुपतिश्शीमांस्ताराभिरभिसंवृतः ॥५-९-४२॥
translation: The lord of demons surrounded by women shone like the beautiful Moon encircled by stars.
word_meanings: ताभिः with them, परिवृतः surrounded, सः राक्षसाधिपः the lord of demons, ताराभिः with stars, अभिसंवृतः encircled, श्रीमान् beautiful, उडुपतिः यथा like the Moon, शुशुभे shone.

text: याश्च्यवन्तेऽम्बरात्ताराः पुण्यशेषसमावृताः । इमास्तास्सङ्गताः कृत्स्ना इति मेने हरिस्तदा ॥५-९-४३॥
translation: Seeing those women lying together Hanuman imagined them to be numerous meteors dropped from heaven after enjoying their merits, enjoyed and exhausted.
word_meanings: याः those, ताराः stars, पुण्यशेषसमावृताः with left over merits, अम्बरात् from the sky, च्यवन्ते fallen, ताः those, कृत्स्नाः entirely, इमाः these women, सङ्गताः collected together, इति thus, तदा then, हरिः the monkey, मेने thought.

text: ताराणाम् इव सुव्यक्तम् महतीनाम् शुभ अर्चिषाम् । प्रभा वर्ण प्रसादाः च विरेजुः तत्र योषिताम् ॥५-९-४४॥
translation: It was clear that the grace and lustre of those women looked brilliant like the lustre and grace of brilliant stars releasing an auspicious glow.
word_meanings: तत्र there, योषिताम् of the young women, प्रभावर्णप्रसादाश्च lustre and grace, शुभार्चिषाम् releasing auspicious glow, महतीनाम् of the great, ताराणामिव like the stars, सुव्यक्तम् clearly, विरेजुः looked brilliant.

text: व्यावृत्तगुरुपीनस्रक्प्रकीर्णवरभूषणाः । पानव्यायामकालेषु निद्रापहृतचेतसः ॥५-९-४५॥
translation: Garlands displaced and jewels scattered, they were drowsy due to drink and sexual exercise.
word_meanings: पानव्यायामकालेषु drinking and sexual exercise, व्यावृत्तगुरुपीनस्रक्प्रकीर्णवरभूषणाः jewels scattered and garlands displaced, निद्रापहृतचेतसः minds dazed in slumber.

text: व्यावृत्ततिलकाः काश्चित्काश्चिदुद्भ्रन्तनूपुराः । पार्श्वे गलितहाराश्च काश्चित्परमयोषितः ॥५-९-४६॥
translation: A few young women had their circular vermilion mark (on the forehead) smudged, some had their anklets loosened and a few had their necklaces.
word_meanings: कश्चित् a few, परमयोषितः other women, व्यावृत्ततिलकाः had vermilion mark (on the forehead) smudged, काश्चित् and a few, उद्भ्रान्तनूपुराः anklets let loose, काश्चित् a few, पार्श्वे on one side, गलितहाराश्च neckalces dislodged.

text: मुक्ताहाराऽवृताश्चान्याः काश्चिद्विस्रस्तवाससः । व्याविद्धरशनादामाः किशोर्य इव वाहिताः ॥५-९-४७॥
translation: Some had their strings of pearl broken, others had their clothes slipped off, and some had their waist belts snapped. They were like young mares fallen to rest after carrying heavy loads.
word_meanings: अन्याः others, मुक्ताहारावृताः had broken pearl strings on girdle, काश्चित् some, विस्रस्तवाससः had their clothes slipped off, व्यावद्धिरशनादामाः waist belts snapped, वाहिताः fallen to rest, किशोर्यः इव like young mares.

text: सुकुण्डलधराश्चान्या विच्छिन्नमृदितस्रजः । गजेन्द्रमृदिताः फुल्ला लता इव महावने ॥५-९-४८॥
translation: With their good eartops broken and flower garlands crushed some looked like blooming creepers in a dense forest crushed by mighty elephants.
word_meanings: सुकुण्डलधराः good eartops, अन्याः others, विच्छिन्नमृदितस्रजः with broken and crushed flower garlands, महावने in the dense forest, गजेन्द्रमृदिताः crushed by mighty elephants, फुल्लाः blooming, लताः इव like creepers.

text: चन्द्र अम्शु किरण आभाः च हाराः कासाम्चिद् उत्कटाः । हम्सा इव बभुः सुप्ताः स्तन मध्येषु योषिताम् ॥५-९-४९॥
translation: The pearl chains, large and shining like rays of the Moon in the space between the breasts looked like sleeping swans.
word_meanings: कासांचित् some, योषिताम् of young women, स्तनमध्येषु between their breasts, उत्कटाः large, चन्द्रांशुकिरणाभाश्च resembling the rays of the Moon, हाराः chains, सुप्ताः sleeping, हंसाः इव like the swans, बभुः appeared.

text: अपरासाम् च वैदूर्याः कादम्बा इव पक्षिणः । हेम सूत्राणि च अन्यासाम् चक्र वाका इव अभवन् ॥५-९-५०॥
translation: The vaidurya worn by women (on the breasts) looked like Kadamba birds while the golden chains put on by some others appeared like ruddy geese.
word_meanings: परासां च and for some, वैडूर्याः vaidurya, कादम्बाः kadamba, पक्षिणः इव like birds, अन्यासाम् of others, हेमसूत्राणि golden chains ,चक्रवाकाः इव like ruddy geese, अभवन् seemed.

text: हम्स कारण्डव आकीर्णाः चक्र वाक उपशोभिताः । आपगा इव ता रेजुर् जघनैः पुलिनैर् इव ॥५-९-५१॥
translation: Their hips were like river banks crowded with swans, karandava and Chakravaka birds shining like rivers.
word_meanings: पुलिनैरिव like river banks, जघनैः with hips, ताः those women, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः crowded with swans and Karandava birds, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः abounded with ruddy geese, आपगा इव like rivers, रेजुः were shining.

text: किन्किणी जाल सम्काशाः ता हेम विपुल अम्बुजाः । भाव ग्राहा यशः तीराः सुप्ता नद्य इव आबभुः ॥५-९-५२॥
translation: With their tiny bells round their girdle looking like buds, the bold golden ornaments like lotuses, their gestures of love like crocodiles and their radiant beauty like silver banks, the women looked like smoky rivers.
word_meanings: किङ्किणीजालसङ्कोशाः tiny bells tied round the waist looking like buds, हैमविपुलाम्बुजाः bold golden ornaments looking like lotuses, भावग्राहाः their amorous gestures of love play like crocodiles, यशस्तीराः radiant beauty of silver banks, सुप्ताः sleeping, नद्यः इव resembled rivers, आबभुः appeared.

text: मृदुष्व् अन्गेषु कासाम्चित् कुच अग्रेषु च सम्स्थिताः । बभूवुर् भूषणानि इव शुभा भूषण राजयः ॥५-९-५३॥
translation: The beautiful imprints made by the (heavy) ornaments on the tender limbs, breasts and nipples of some women appeared like many ornaments.
word_meanings: कासांचित् for some women, मृदुषु on their tender, अङ्गेषु limbs, कुचाग्रेषु च and on the nipples of breasts, संस्थिताः set, शुभाः beautiful, भूषणराजयः collections of ornaments, भूषणानीव like ornaments, बभूवुः appeared.

text: अम्शु कान्ताः च कासाम्चिन् मुख मारुत कम्पिताः । उपरि उपरि वक्त्राणाम् व्याधूयन्ते पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-५४॥
translation: Shaken by the breath released from their mouths the fringes of the garments of some women were drawn towards their faces again and againfluttering.
word_meanings: कासाञ्चित् for some, मुखमारुतकम्पिताः shaken by the breath released by their mouth, अंशुकान्ताश्च the fringes of garments, वक्त्राणाम् on their faces, उपर्युपरि drawn, पुनः पुनः again and again, व्याधूयन्ते fluttered.

text: ताः पाताका इव उद्धूताः पत्नीनाम् रुचिर प्रभाः । नाना वर्ण सुवर्णानाम् वक्त्र मूलेषु रेजिरे ॥५-९-५५॥
translation: The fringes of their garments glowing beautifully close to the faces of the wives (of Ravana) with different beautiful hues, shone splendid like flags.
word_meanings: नानावर्णसुवर्णानाम् of the women of different beautiful hues, पत्नीनाम् of the wives, वक्त्रमूलेषु on the edges of their faces, ताः those, रुचिरप्रभाः with beautiful glow, उध्दूताः raised, पताकाः इव like flags, रेजिरे shone.

text: ववल्गुः च अत्र कासाम्चित् कुण्डलानि शुभ अर्चिषाम् । मुख मारुत सम्सर्गान् मन्दम् मन्दम् सुयोषिताम् ॥५-९-५६॥
translation: The eartops of some women endowed with auspicious charm were swinging softly generating a gentle sound by the touch of their breath.
word_meanings: शुभार्चिषाम् with auspicious radiance, कासाञ्चित् for some, योषिताम् women, कुण्डलानि eartops, अत्र here,मुखमारुतसंसर्गात् by the touch of their breath, मन्दं मन्दम् softly and gently, ववल्गुश्च mild sound of vibration.

text: शर्कराऽसवगन्धैश्च प्रकृत्या सुरभिः सुखः । तासां वदननिश्वासस्सिषेवे रावणं तदा ॥५-९-५७॥
translation: The sweet smell of wine emitted from their mouth and the natural fragrance of their breath was refreshing to Ravana as if it was serving him at that time.
word_meanings: तदा then, प्रकृत्या natural, शर्करासवगन्धैश्च the sweet smell of wine (made from sugarcane juice), सुरभिः fragrant, सुखः happy, तासाम् their, वदननिश्वासः breath from their mouth, रावणम् Ravana, सिषेवे served.

text: रावण आनन शन्काः च काश्चिद् रावण योषितः । मुखानि स्म सपत्नीनाम् उपाजिघ्रन् पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-५८॥
translation: Some women of Ravana (overcome by blind passion) smelt again and again the mouths of their cowives next to them assuming it to be Ravana's.
word_meanings: काश्चित् some, रावणयोषितः Ravana's wives, रावणाननशङ्काश्च assuming it to be Ravana's face, पुनः पुनः again and again, सपत्नीनाम् of their cowives, मुखानि mouths, उपाजिघ्रन् smelt.

text: अत्यर्थम् सक्त मनसो रावणे ता वर स्त्रियः । अस्वतन्त्राः सपत्नीनाम् प्रियम् एव आचरमः तदा ॥५-९-५९॥
translation: Even though the beautiful wives (should have been angry with their cowives for smelling their mouths) they behaved pleasingly, having no freedom to act with Ravana
word_meanings: रावणे at Ravana, अत्यर्थम् therefore, सक्तमनसः devoted to (Ravana), वरस्त्रियः beautiful women, अस्वतन्त्राः having no freedom, तदा then, सपत्नीनाम् of their cowives, प्रियमेव pleasing , आचरन् did.

text: बाहून् उपनिधाय अन्याः पारिहार्य विभूषिताः । अम्शुकानि च रम्याणि प्रमदाः तत्र शिश्यिरे ॥५-९-६०॥
translation: Some women slept pillowed on their arms, laying aside their adornments and others had their garment under the head as pillows and lay in sleep.
word_meanings: अन्याः others, प्रमदाः women, पारिहार्यविभूषितान् laying aside their adornments, बाहून् arms, रम्याणि beautiful, अंशुकानि garment, उपनिधाय placing, तत्र there, शिश्यिरे slept.

text: अन्या वक्षसि च अन्यस्याः तस्याः काचित् पुनर् भुजम् । अपरा त्व् अन्कम् अन्यस्याः तस्याः च अपि अपरा भुजौ ॥५-९-६१॥
translation: Some women lay placing their arms on the breasts of the other while their own arms were used as pillow by another. One woman placed her head on the lap of the other and slept.
word_meanings: अन्याः some women, अन्यस्याः on the other women's, वक्षसि on the chest, काचित् पुनः another again, तस्याः her, भुजम् arms अपरा तु another, अन्यस्याः on the others, अङ्कम् lap, अपरा another, तस्याः her, भुजौ on the arms.

text: ऊरुपार्श्वकटीपृष्ठमन्योन्यस्य समाश्रिताः । परस्परनिविष्टाङ्ग्यो मदस्नेहवशानुगाः ॥५-९-६२॥
translation: Given to intoxication and sex, the women slept touching one another's thighs, sides, hips, back and lap of the other, with their limbs intertwined.
word_meanings: मदस्नेहवशानुगाः given to intoxication and love, अन्योन्यस्य with one another, ऊरुपार्श्वकटीपृष्ठम् on thighs, side, hips and back on the lap of the other, समाश्रिताः had slept, परस्परनिविष्टाङ्ग्यः lay intertwined, one on the other.

text: अन्योन्यस्य अन्ग सम्स्पर्शात् प्रीयमाणाः सुमध्यमाः । एकी कृत भुजाः सर्वाः सुषुपुः तत्र योषितःअन्योन्य भुज सूत्रेण स्त्री माला ग्रथिता हि सा । माला इव ग्रथिता सूत्रे शुशुभे मत्त षट्पदा ॥५-९-६३॥
लतानाम् माधवे मासि फुल्लानाम् वायु सेवनात् । अन्योन्य माला ग्रथितम् सम्सक्त कुसुम उच्चयम् ॥५-९-६४॥
translation: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.
word_meanings: अन्योन्यमालाग्रथितम् linked to each other like a chain, संसक्तकुसुमोच्छयम् flowers in a string, व्यतिवेष्टितसुस्कन्धम् tangled together with strong joints, अन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम् with bees swarming, रावणस्य Ravana's, तत् that, स्त्रीवनम् a garden of women, माधवे मासि in the month of spring, वायुसंसेवनात् by the blowing of the wind, फुल्लानाम् of the blooms, लतानाम् of the creepers, अन्योन्यमालाग्रथितम् one to one linked like a garland, अन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम् like the swarm of bees, उद्धूतम् shaken, वनमिव like thickets, आसीत् appeared.

text: व्यतिवेष्टित सुस्कन्थम् अन्योन्य भ्रमर आकुलम् । आसीद् वनम् इव उद्धूतम् स्त्री वनम् रावणस्य तत् ॥५-९-६५॥
translation: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.
word_meanings: अन्योन्यमालाग्रथितम् linked to each other like a chain, संसक्तकुसुमोच्छयम् flowers in a string, व्यतिवेष्टितसुस्कन्धम् tangled together with strong joints, अन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम् with bees swarming, रावणस्य Ravana's, तत् that, स्त्रीवनम् a garden of women, माधवे मासि in the month of spring, वायुसंसेवनात् by the blowing of the wind, फुल्लानाम् of the blooms, लतानाम् of the creepers, अन्योन्यमालाग्रथितम् one to one linked like a garland, अन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम् like the swarm of bees, उद्धूतम् shaken, वनमिव like thickets, आसीत् appeared.

text: उचितेष्व् अपि सुव्यक्तम् न तासाम् योषिताम् तदा । विवेकः शक्य आधातुम् भूषण अन्ग अम्बर स्रजाम् ॥५-९-६६॥
translation: It was not possible to distinguish clearly between their jewels, limbs, garments and garlands and to place them in the right spots.
word_meanings: तदा then, तासां योषिताम् of those women, भूषणाङ्गाम्बरस्रजाम् of ornaments, garments, limbs and garlands, विवेकः to distinguish, सुव्यक्तम् clearly, आधातुम् to place, उचितेष्वपि in right spots, न शक्यः not possible.

text: रावणे सुख सम्विष्टे ताः स्त्रियो विविध प्रभाः । ज्वलन्तः कान्चना दीपाः प्रेक्षन्त अनिमिषा इव ॥५-९-६७॥
translation: When Ravana was happily asleep, the gods of light burning on the gold lampposts gazed without winking as it were, at the women, whom they dare not gaze for fear of waking Ravana.
word_meanings: रावणे when Ravana, सुखसंविष्टे was sleeping happily, विधप्रभाः gods of lights, ताः स्त्रियः those women, ज्वलन्तः glowing, काञ्चनाः दीपाः इव golden lampposts, अनिमिषाः without winking, प्रैक्षन्त इव gazed at him.

text: राजर्षिपितृदैत्यानां गन्धर्वाणां च योषितः । राक्षसानां च याः कन्यास्तस्य कामवशं गताः ॥५-९-६८॥
translation: The women halled from the families of royal sages, ancestral deities, daityas and demons who were infatuated with him.
word_meanings: राजर्षिपितृदैत्यानाम् of royal sages, ancestral gods and demons, गन्धर्वाणाम् of gandharvas, योषितः women, राक्षसानाम् of ogres, याः कन्याः those girls, तस्य his, कामवशम्गताः they were infatuated with him.

text: युद्धकामेन ताः सर्वा रावणेन हृताः स्त्रियः । समदा मदनेनैव मोहिताः काश्चिदागताः ॥५-९-६९॥
translation: Many were brought by Ravana as captives of war and some came on their own deluded by lust.
word_meanings: सर्वाः all, ताः स्त्रियः those women, युद्धकामेन on account of his love for war, रावणेन by Ravana, हृताः kidnapped, समदाः passionate ones, काश्चित् a few, मदनेन by lust, मोहिताः एव deluded, आगताः came.

text: न तत्र काचित् प्रमदा प्रसह्य । वीर्य उपपन्नेन गुणेन लब्धा । न च अन्य कामा अपि न च अन्य पूर्वा । विना वर अर्हाम् जनक आत्मजाम् तु ॥५-९-७०॥
translation: Except Sita no other woman among them had been taken there by force. They were won only on account of his valour and virtues. None loved any one earlier and none was married to others.
word_meanings: वरार्हाम् revered, ताम् her, जनकात्मजां विना except Sita, तत्र there, काचित् प्रमदा any women, वीर्योपपन्नेन on account of his valour, प्रसह्य लब्धा obtained forcibly, न not, गुणेन by virtues, अन्यकामापि not in love with others, न च and not, अन्यपूर्वा च married by others earlier, न not.

text: न च अकुलीना न च हीन रूपा । न अदक्षिणा न अनुपचार युक्ता । भार्या अभवत् तस्य न हीन सत्त्वा । न च अपि कान्तस्य न कामनीया ॥५-९-७१॥
translation: None among them was born of a lowly family, nor lacked beauty, kindness, skill, strength or brightness. No one was not lovable to Ravana.
word_meanings: तस्य his, भार्या wife, अकुलीना lowbred, न च अभवत् did not become, हीनरूपा च without beauty, न not, अदक्षिणा unkind, न not, अनुपचारयुक्ता discourteous, न not, हीनसत्त्वा without strength, न not, कान्तस्य for the lover, न कामनीया च not loveable, न none.

text: बभूव बुद्धिस्तु हरीश्वरस्य यदीदृशी राघवधर्मपत्नी । इमा यथा राक्षसराजभार्याः सुजातमस्येति हि साधुबुद्धेः ॥५-९-७२॥
translation: 'If the lawful wife of Rama born of a good family can be allowed to remain with Rama in the same way as the consorts of the lord of demons, how fortunate it would be, thought the wise lord of monkeys'.
word_meanings: इमाः these, राक्षसराजभार्याः wives of the demon lord, यथा as, राघवधर्मपत्नी Rama's lawful wife, ईदृशी such a lady, अस्य his, सुजातम् born of good family, इति thus, साधुबुद्धेः of the wise, हरीश्वरस्य Hanuman's, बुद्धिस्तु thought also, बभूव was.

text: पुनश्च सोऽचिन्तयादात्तरूपो ध्रुवं विशिष्टा गुणतो हि सीता । अथायमस्यां कृतवान्महात्मा लङ्केश्वरः कष्टमनार्यकर्म ॥५-९-७३॥
translation: Hanuman once again assuming his true form said to himself, 'Sita is surely a virtuous lady superior to and more distinguished than them all. Alas, this lord of Lanka committed an ignoble, act (by abducting her). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सः he, आत्तरूपः assuming his true form, पुनश्च once again, अचिन्तयत् he thought, सीता Sita, ध्रुवम् surely, गुणतः by her virtues, विशिष्टा distinguished one, अथ now, महात्मा great, अयं लङ्केश्वरः that lord of Lanka, अस्याम् in her case, अनार्यम् an unfit act not befitting a noble one, कृतवान् did, कष्टम् alas.

text: तत्र दिव्य उपमम् मुख्यम् स्फाटिकम् रत्न भूषितम् । अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयन आसनम् ॥५-१०-१॥
translation: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.
word_meanings: तत्र there, आवेक्षमाणः while looking around, हनुमान् Hanuman, दिव्योपमम् fine, heavenly मुख्यम् foremost, स्फाटिकम् made with crystals, रत्नभूषितम् encrusted with gems, दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैः inlaid with colourful ivory and gold, वैडूर्यैः with Vaidurya, महार्हास्तरणोपेतैः with exquisite coverings, महाधनैः rich, वरासनैः fine dais, उपेतम् endowed with, शयनासनम् couch, ददर्श observed.

text: दान्तकाञ्चनिचित्राङ्गेर्वैश्च वरासनैः । महार्हस्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नम् महाधनैः ॥५-१०-२॥
translation: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.

text: तस्य च एकतमे देशे सो अग्र्य माल्य विभूषितम् । ददर्श पाण्डुरम् चत्रम् तारा अधिपति सम्निभम् ॥५-१०-३॥
translation: Hanuman saw an umbrella in one spot decorated with the best of garlands. The white umbrella looked like the Moon, lord of stars.
word_meanings: सः that Hanuman, तस्य its, एकतमे in one, देशे spot, अग्य्रमालाविभूषितम् decorated with best of garlands, ताराधिपतिसन्निभम् like the Moon, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रम् umbrella, ददर्श saw.

text: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् । अशोकमालाविततम् ददर्श परमासनम् ॥५-१०-४॥
translation: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.
word_meanings: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् made of gold, चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् shining like the Sun, अशोकमालाविततम् decorated with Ashoka flowers, वालव्यजनहस्ताभिः women holding fans made of the hair of chamari deer, समन्ततः all over, वीज्यमानम् he was being, विविधैः several, गन्धैः with fragrants, जुष्टम् full of, वरधूपेन with excellent fragrants, धूपितम् smoky, परमास्तरणास्तीर्णम् spread with the best of bedspreads, आविकाजिनसंवृतम् covered with soft sheep skin, समन्तात् all over, वरमाल्यानाम् of beautiful garlands, दामभिः by strings, उपशोभितम् delightfullooking, परमासनम् exquisite couch, ददर्श saw.

text: वाल व्यजन हस्ताभिर् वीज्यमानम् समन्ततः । गन्धैः च विविधैर् जुष्टम् वर धूपेन धूपितम् ॥५-१०-५॥

text: तस्मिन् जीमूत सम्काशम् प्रदीप्त उत्तम कुण्डलम् । लोहित अक्षम् महा बाहुम् महा रजत वाससम् ॥५-१०-७॥
translation: Hanuman saw the mightyarmed, heroic lord of demons, sleeping with huge bloodshot eyes looking like a cloud, he was adorned with flashing earrings, and clad in robes of silver texture. His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. He was handsome and could assume any form at will. He looked like Mandara mountain surrounded thickly with trees and wild bushes. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them

The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

text: ताभ्याम् स परिपूर्णाभ्याम् भुजाभ्याम् राक्षस अधिपः । शुशुभे अचल सम्काशः श्र्न्गाभ्याम् इव मन्दरः ॥५-१०-२२॥

text: मुक्ता मणि विचित्रेण कान्चनेन विराजता । मुकुटेन अपव्र्त्तेन कुण्डल उज्ज्वलित आननम् ॥५-१०-२५॥

His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
