word_meanings: अहम् I, वैदेह्याः for Vaidehi, अर्थसिद्धिं तु fulfilment, उपस्थिताम् approaching, पश्यामि I can see, राक्षसेन्द्रविनाशं च the destruction of the demon king, राघवस्य for Raghava, विजयं च success.

text: निमित्तभूतमेत्तु श्रोतुमस्या महत् प्रियम् ॥५-२७-४८॥
translation: "This dream indeed served as an augery for good news about her. Look, her (left) eye which is large like a lotus petal is throbbing.
word_meanings: अस्याः her, महत् great, प्रियम् good news, श्रोतुम् to hear, निमित्तभूतम् has served as an augery, स्पुरत् throbbing, एतत् this, पद्मपत्रमिव like lotus petals, आयतम् large, चक्षुः eyes, दृश्यते is seen.

text: दृश्यते च स्फुरच्चक्षुः पद्मपत्रमिवायतम् । ईषच्च हृषितो वा ऽस्या दक्षिणाया ह्यदक्षिणः ॥५-२७-४९॥
अकस्मादेव वैदेह्या बाहुरेकः प्रकम्पते । करेणुहस्तप्रतिमः सव्यश्चोरुरनुत्तमः । वेपमानः सूचयति राघवं पुरतः स्थितम् ॥५-२७-५०॥
translation: "Her excellent left thigh, comparable to a female elephant's trunk is trembling, as though indicating that Rama is standing in her presence.
word_meanings: करेणुहस्तप्रतिमः comparable to a female elephant's trunk, अनुत्तमः excellent, सव्यः the left one, ऊरुः thigh, वेपमानः while trembling, राघवम् Ragahva, पुरतः city, स्थितम् standing, सूचयति as though indicating.

text: पक्षी च शाखानिलयः प्रहृष्टः पुनः पुनश्चोत्तमसान्त्ववादी । सुस्वागतां वाचमुदीरयानः पुनः पुनश्चोदयतीव हृष्टः ॥५-२७-५१॥
translation: "One can see the bird which utters excellent sweet notes indicating happy tidings, entering again and again the foliage of the tree, a delightful bird, as if prompting Sita again and again to rejoice. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: पक्षी च a bird, शाखानिलयम् on the branches, प्रविष्टः entered, पुनः once again, पुनश्च again and again, उत्तमसान्त्वादी the bird which utters excellent sweet notes, सुस्वागतम् वाचम् a happy tiding, उदीरयानः while expressing, हृष्टः joyous, पुनः पुनः again and again, चोदयतीव is as though prompting.

text: सा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वचो निशम्य तद्रावणस्याप्रियमप्रियार्ता । सीता वितत्रास यथा वनान्ते सिंहाभिपन्ना गजराजकन्या ॥५-२८-१॥
translation: After hearing the unpleasant words spoken by the king of demons, which caused restlessness and sorrow to Sita, she was terrified like the young calf of a lordly elephant fallen into the clutches of a lion in the midst of the forest.
word_meanings: सा सीता that Sita, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, रावणस्य Ravana's, अप्रियम् unpleasant news, तत् that, वचः word, निशम्य after hearing, अप्रियार्ता restless, वनान्ते in the midst of the forest, सिंहाभिपन्ना caught by the lion, गजराजकन्या यथा like young calf of a lordly elephant, वितत्रास frightened.

text: सा राक्षसीमध्यगता च भीरुर्वाग्भिर्भृशं रावणतर्जिता च । कान्तारमध्ये विजने विसृष्टा बालेव कन्या विललाप सीता ॥५-२८-२॥
translation: Encircled by the demonesses, Sita was repeatedly humiliated by Ravana's cruel words.She wept like a young girl deserted in a desolate forest.
word_meanings: राक्षसीमध्यगता encircled by the shedemons, भीरुः soft natured, भृशम् excessively, वाग्भि: with words, रावणतर्जिता च threatened by Ravana, सा that, सीता Sita, विजने desolate, कान्तारमध्ये in the midst of the forest, विसृष्टा deserted, बाला young, कन्या इव like a girl, विललाप wept.

text: सत्यं बतेदं प्रवदन्ति लोके नाकालमृत्युर्भवतीति सन्तः । यत्राहमेवं परिभर्त्स्यमाना जीवामि किंचित्क्षणमप्यपुण्या ॥५-२८-३॥
translation: "Even though I am threatened like this, I am living pitiably because of lack of merit. Indeed I regret my survival due to my bad luck. Elders say that death will not ocurr before its time. It seems to be true.
word_meanings: लोके in the world, अकालमृत्युः untimely death, न भवति does not occur, इति like this, इदम् thus, सत्यम् true, सन्तः elders, प्रवदन्ति say, यत्र wherever, एवम् this way, परिभर्त्स्यमाना being threatened, अपुण्या who lacks merits, अहम् I am, दीना pitiable, क्षणमपि even a second also, जीवामि I live, बत alas.

text: सुखाद्विहीनं बहुदुःखपूर्णमिदं तु नूनं हृदयं स्थिरं मे । विशीर्यते यन्न सहस्रधा ऽद्य वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य ॥५-२८-४॥
translation: "Even though I am devoid of joy, and living in deep agony, my heart bursts not into a thousand pieces like the summit of a mountain hit by thunderbolt (lightning).
word_meanings: सुखात् of joy, विहीनम् devoid, बहुदुःखपूर्णम् filled with agony, इदम् this, मे my, हृदयम् heart, नूनम् surely, स्थिरम् hard, यत् such, वज्राहतम् hit by a thunderbolt, अचलस्य of a mountain, शृङ्गमिव like the top, सहस्रधा into a thousand pieces, अद्य now, न विशीर्यते it is not breaking.

text: नैवास्ति दोषं मम नूनमत्र वध्या ऽहमस्याप्रियदर्शनस्य । भावं न चास्याहमनुप्रदातुमलं द्विजो मन्त्रमिवाद्विजाय ॥५-२८-५॥
translation: "I will not be blamed if I commit suicide now.I stand condemned to death in the hands of this ugly Ravana. I cannot bestow my affection on him or surender to his desire like a brahmin would not like to impart Vedic knowledge to a nonbrahmin. (Better die of my own accord than be killed by a sinful ogre).
word_meanings: अत्र मम here my, दोषः fault, नैवास्ति is not there, अहम् I am, अप्रियदर्शनस्य ugly, अस्य his, वध्या to be killed, अस्मि I am, अहम् I, अस्य his, भावम् (surrender) my heart, द्विजः brahmin, अद्विजाय to a nonbrahmin, मन्त्रमिव like the veda mantra, अनुप्रदातुम् to impart, न अलम् not proper.

text: नूनं ममाङ्गान्यचिरादनार्यः शस्त्रैः शितैश्छेत्स्यति राक्षसेन्द्रः । तस्मिन्ननागच्छति लोकनाथे गर्भस्थजन्तोरिव शल्यकृन्तः ॥५-२८-६॥
translation: "If the lord of the world does not come here before that (time fixed by Ravana) the vile lord of demons will cut me into pieces with weapons just as a barber would cut to pieces the foetus with a sharp knife (in order to save a pregnant woman).
word_meanings: लोकनाथे the lord of the world, तस्मिन् he, अनागच्छति before he comes here, अनार्यः vile lord, राक्षसेन्द्रः lord of demons, शल्यकृन्तः barber, गर्भस्थजन्तोरिव like the foetus from the womb, मम my, अङ्गानि limbs, नूनम् surely, शितैः with sharp, शत्रै: with weapons, छेत्स्यति will cut into pieces.

text: दुःखं बतेदं मम दुःखिताया मासौ चिरायाधिगमिष्यतो द्वौ । बद्धस्य वध्यस्य तथा निशान्ते राजापराधादिव तस्करस्य ॥५-२८-७॥
translation: "Alas, two months is too long a time to wait in grief. I am like a thief captured for offending a king and waiting overnight for execution at day-break.
word_meanings: राजापराधात् due to offending the king, बद्धस्य captured, निशान्ते by daybreak, वध्यस्य for execution, तस्करस्य इव like that of a thief, दुःखितायाः of a sorrowful, मम to me, द्वौ two, मासौ months, चिराय is a long duration, अधिगमिष्यतः will be spent, इदम् this, दुःखम् grief, बत alas.

text: हा राम हा लक्ष्मण हा सुमित्रे हा राममातः सह मे जनन्या । एषा विपद्याम्यहमल्पभाग्या माहार्णवे नौरिव मूढवाता ॥५-२८-८॥
translation: "Alas! Rama, Alas! Lakshmana, Alas! Sumitra, Alas! my mother, Alas! Rama's mother, I am an ill-starred woman going to perish in this way like a light boat capsized in the midst of an ocean when the whirl-wind blows.
word_meanings: हा राम Alas! Rama, हा लक्ष्मण Alas! Lakshmana, हा सुमित्रे Alas! Sumitra!, मे my, जनन्या सह own mother, हा राममातः Alas! Rama's mother, अल्पभाग्या an ill-starred woman, एषा here, अहम् I, महार्णवे in an ocean, मूढवाता by a whirl-wind, नौरिव like a boat, विपद्यामि I am perished.

text: तरस्विनौ धारयता मृगस्य सत्त्वेन रूपं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ । नूनं विशस्तौ मम कारणात् तौ सिंहर्षभौ द्वाविव वैद्यतेन ॥५-२८-९॥
translation: "Just like two mighty lions are killed by a bolt of lightning, the two princes must have been killed by a creature in the guise of a deer on my account.
word_meanings: मृगस्य deer's, रूपम् form, धारयता by taking, सत्त्वेन by a creature, तरस्विनौ these pair of , तौ two, मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ princes, वैद्युतेन by bolt of lightning, द्वौ two, सिंहर्षभौ इव two mighty lions, मम कारणात् on my account, नूनम् verily, विशस्तौ are slain.

text: नूनं स कालो मृगरूपधारी मामल्पभाग्यां लुलुभे तदानीम् । यत्रार्यपुत्रं विससर्ज मूढा रामानुजं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजं च ॥५-२८-१०॥
translation: "Verily, it is the spirit of the time that assumed the form of deer and tempted this unfortunate soul. It was foolish of me to send away, the sons of a noble king, Lakshmana and his elder brother.
word_meanings: नूनम् verily, सः such, कालः the spirit of time, मृगरूपधारी in the guise of a deer, तदानीम् then, अल्पभाग्याम् an unfortunate woman, माम् me, लुलुभे tempted, यत्र wherever, मूढा foolish, रामानुजम् Rama's brother, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजम् Lakshmana's elder brother, आर्यपुत्रं च son of a noble king, विससर्ज sent away.

text: हा राम सत्यव्रत दीर्घबाहो हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्र । रा जीवलोकस्य हितः प्रियश्च वध्यां न मां वेत्सि हि राक्षसानाम् ॥५-२८-११॥
translation: "Alas, O long-armed one unfailing in vows, whose face shines like the full moon. Alas, beloved of all the worlds! you are dear to every one. How is it that you are not aware that I am going to be killed by the demons?
word_meanings: सत्यव्रत O unfailing in vows, दीर्घबाहो O long-armed one, हा राम Alas! Rama, हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्त्र alas! one whose face is like the full moon, हा alas, जीवलोकस्य for all the worlds, हितः benefactor, प्रियश्च dear one, माम् me, राक्षसानाम् for demons, वध्याम् to be killed, न वेत्सि you are not aware.

text: अनन्यदेवत्वमियं क्षमा च भूमौ च शय्या नियमश्च धर्मे । पतिव्रतात्वं विफलं ममेदं कृतं कृतघ्नेष्विव मानुषाणाम् ॥५-२८-१२॥
translation: "I am devoted to you and to no other god. My hardship in sleeping on the ground, my righteousness, my discipline and chastity have all proved futile like the devotion of an ungrateful person.
word_meanings: अनन्यदैवत्वम् no god other than you, इयम् this, क्षमा च and tolerance, भूमौ on earth, शय्या sleep, धर्मे in righteousness, नियमश्च discipline, पतिव्रतात्वम् my chastity, मम my, इदम् this, कृतघ्नेषु in case of ungrateful man, मानुषाणाम् of human beings, कृतमिव like the help done, विफलम् is futile.

text: मोघो हि धर्मश्चरितो मया ऽयं तथैकपत्नीत्वमिदं निरर्थम् । या त्वां न पश्यामि कृशा विवर्णा हीना त्वया सङ्गमने निराशा ॥५-२८-१३॥
translation: "This righteousnes practised by me is in vain like my devotion to you, as I am unable to see you. I am a separated, emaciated, pale with no hope of reuniting with you.
word_meanings: या I who, त्वाम् you, न पश्यामि I do not see, त्वया by you, हीना deprived, सङ्गमने in reuniting, निराशा no hope, कृशा shrunk, विवर्णा pale, मया by me, चरितः followed, अयम् this, धर्मः righteousness, मोघः हि is in vain, तथा likewise, इदम् this, एकपन्तीत्वम् devotion to you alone, निरर्थम् meaningless.

text: पितुर्निदेशं नियमेन कृत्वा वनान्निवृत्तश्चरितव्रतश्च । स्त्रीभिस्तु मन्ये विपुलेक्षणाभिस्त्वं रंस्यसे वीतभयः कृतार्थः ॥५-२८-१४॥
translation: "Having truly fulfilled your pledge given to your father, you will return from the forest to Ayodhya, rid of all fear, as an accomplished person, will and revel in the company of largeeyed damsels, I think.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, पितुः father's, निदेशम् command, नियमेन truly, कृत्वा following, चरितव्रतश्च after the completion of the pledge, वनात् from the forest, निवृत्तः you return, वीतभयः rid of fear, कृतार्थः an accomplished one, विपुलेक्षणाभिः largeeyed, स्त्रीभिः with damsels, रंस्यसे be revelling, मन्ये I think.

text: अहं तु राम त्वयि जातकामा चिरं विनाशाय निबद्धभावा । मोघं चरित्वा ऽथ तपोव्रतं च त्यक्ष्यामि धिग् जीवितमल्पभाग्या ॥५-२८-१५॥
translation: "O RamaI loved you and concentrated all my love on you for a long time only for my doom. I have observed vows and austerities in vain. I cannot continue it for long. Here I am giving up my life. Fie upon this luckless one (me).
word_meanings: राम Rama, त्वयि at you, जातकामा I loved, अहं तु I am also, विनाशाय for my doom, चिरम् for long, निबद्धभावा with my feeling of love fixed on you, तपः austerities, व्रतं च and vows, मोघम् in vain, चरित्वाथ after practising, जीवितम् life, त्यक्ष्यामि will be giving up, अल्पभाग्याम् I am unfortunate one, धिक् what a pity

text: सा जीवितं क्षिप्रमहं त्यजेयं विषेण शस्त्रेण शितेन वापि । विषस्य दाता नहि मे ऽस्ति कश्चिच्छस्त्रस्य वा वेश्मनि राक्षसस्य ॥५-२८-१६॥
translation: "I will end my life at once by taking poison or else by a sharp weapon. Alas There is none to give get me poison or a weapon at this demon's residence".
word_meanings: सा अहम् that I, क्षिप्रम् at once, जीवितम् life, विषेण by poisoning, शितेन by a sharp one, शस्त्रेण by a weapon, वापि or else, त्यजेयम् I give up, राक्षसस्य demon's, वेश्मनि at his residence, मे to me, विषस्य of poison, शस्त्रस्य वा or of weapon, दाता donor, कश्चित् any one, नास्ति is not found.

text: इतीव देवी बहुधा विलप्य सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती । प्रवेपमाना परिशुष्कवक्त्रा नगोत्तमं पुष्पितमाससाद ॥५-२८-१७॥
translation: Queen Sita was wailing in many ways, constantly remembering Rama, the soul of all. Shivering, her face pales as she approached the great Simsupa tree in bloom.
word_meanings: देवी queen, इतीव in that way, बहुधा in many ways, विलप्य wailing, सर्वात्मना self of all, रामम् Rama, अनुस्मरन्ती constantly remembering, प्रवेपमाना shivering, परिशुष्कवक्त्रा pale face, पुष्पितम् in bloom, नगोत्तमम् great tree, आससाद approached.

text: शोकाभितप्ता बहुधा विचिन्त्य सीता ऽथ वेण्युद्ग्रथनं गृहीत्वा । उद्बध्य वेण्युद्ग्रथनेन शीघ्रमहं गमिष्यामि यमस्य मूलम् ॥५-२८-१८॥
translation: "Burning in grief, worrying in many ways, Sita took hold of her braid and said", by tying myself with this braid I shall quickly reach the presence of the lord of death".
word_meanings: शोकाभितप्ता burning with grief, सीता Sita, बहुधा in many ways, विचिन्त्य after worrying, अथ then, वेण्युद्ग्रथनम् braid of her hair, गृहीत्वा holding, अहम् I, वेण्युद्ग्रथनेन by the braid, उद्बुध्य tie, शीघ्रम् quickly, यमस्य lord of death's, मूलम् presence, गमिष्यामि I will reach.

text: उपस्थिता सा मृदुसर्वगात्रा शाखां गृहीत्वा ऽथ नगस्य तस्य ॥५-२८-१९॥
तस्यास्तु रामं प्रविचिन्तयन्त्या रामानुजं स्वं च कुलं शुभाङ्ग्याः । शोकानिमित्तानि तथा बहूनि धैर्यार्जितानि प्रवराणि लोके । प्रादुर्निमित्तानि तदा बभूवुः पुरापि सिद्धान्युपलक्षितानि ॥५-२८-२०॥
translation: Sita of delicate limbs approached the Simsupa tree and held on to a branch and stood. While she was thinking of Rama and Lakshmana and their noble family many omens of proven results appeared on her auspicious charming body. These omens were dispellers of grief, and harbingers of courage in the world as declared from ancient times. (Now) they manifested themselves. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeigth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: अथ and then, मृदसर्वगात्री lady of delicate limbs, सा she, तस्य of that, नगस्य tree's, शाखाम् branch, गृहीत्वा holding, उपस्थिता stood, रामम् Rama, रामानुजम् Rama's brother, स्वं कुलं च and their family, प्रविचिन्तयन्त्या: was thinking, शुभाङ्ग्याः of charming body, तस्याः तु her, तदा then, शोकानिमित्तानि dispellers of sorrow, धैर्यार्जितानि harbingers of courage, लोके in the world, प्रवराणि foremost, तथा similarly, पुरापि ancient times also, सिद्धानि results, उपलक्षितानि been proven, बहूनि many, निमित्तानि omens, प्रादुर्भभूवुः manifested.

text: तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यपेतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम् । शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपजीविनः ॥५-२९-१॥
translation: Like wellwishers flocking round a person on whom fortune is smiling, omens foretelling auspicious happenings in near future appeared to Sita. She was unimpeachable. She was in agony, distressed in mind, bereft of all joy (now) standing under that Simsupa tree.
word_meanings: तथागताम् as expected, व्यथिताम् agonized lady, अनिन्दिताम् faultless, व्यपेतहर्षाम् bereft of all joy, परिदीनमानसाम् distressed in mind, शुभाम् auspicious, ताम् her, श्रिया with benign favour of fortune, जुष्टम् pleased, नरम् man, उपजीविनः इव like well wishing, शुभानि auspicious, निमित्तानि for the sake, भेजिरे wealthy man.

text: तस्याः शुभं वाममरालपक्ष्मराजीवृतं कृष्णविशालशुक्लम् । प्रास्पन्दतैकं नयनं सुकेश्यामीनाहतं पद्ममिवाभिताम्रम् ॥५-२९-२॥
translation: Her left eye with a row of curved eyelashes, the black pupils of the eye in white throbbed in an auspicious manner. The lady with her long tresses, and throbbing eye appeared like a red lotus gently struck by a fish.
word_meanings: सुकेश्याः of the lady with beautiful hair, तस्याः her, शुभम् auspicious, अरालपक्ष्मराजीवृतम् surrounded by a row of curved eye lashes, कृष्णविशालशुक्लम् broad black pupils in white, वामनयनम् left eye, मीनाहतम् struck by fish, अभिताम्रम् reddish ring, एकम् one, पद्ममिव like lotus, प्रास्पन्दत throbbed.

text: भुजश्च चार्वञ्चितपीनवृत्तः परार्ध्यकालागरुचन्दनार्हः । अनुत्तमेनाध्युषितः प्रियेण चिरेण वामः समवेपताशु ॥५-२९-३॥
translation: Her stout left arm curved beautifully, fit for excellent agaru and sandal paste once the pillow by her beloved lord for long, throbbed suddenly.
word_meanings: चार्वञ्चितपीनवृत्तः beautifuly curved round and stout, परार्थ्यकालागरुचन्दनार्हः deserving the application of excellent black agaru and sandal paste, अनुत्तमेन by the best, प्रियेण by the beloved, चिरेण for long, अध्युषितः used to rest the head, वामः भुजश्च by the left arm, आशु suddenly, समवेपत throbbed.

text: गजेन्द्रहस्तप्रतिमश्च पीनस्तयोर्द्वयोः संहतयोः सुजातः । प्रस्पन्दमानः पुनरूरुरस्या रामं पुरस्तात् स्थितमाचचक्षे ॥५-२९-४॥
translation: Again her roundshaped left thigh resembling an elephant's trunk started throbbing, presaging union with Rama.
word_meanings: संहतयोः close to each other, तयोः द्वयोः of those two, गजेन्द्रहस्तप्रतिमः resembling an elephant's trunk, पीनः stout, सुजातः well shaped, अस्याः ऊरुः her thigh, प्रस्पन्दमानः throbbing, रामम् Rama, पुरस्तात् in front, स्थितम् stood, आचचक्षे indicated.

text: शुभं पुनर्हेमसमानवर्णमीषद्रजोध्वस्तमिवामलाक्ष्याः । वासः स्थितायाः शिखराग्रदत्याः किंचित् परिस्रंसत चारुगात्र्याः ॥५-२९-५॥
translation: Her eyes were pristine, teeth wellshaped. The goldhued auspicious sari on her charming limbs was now a little soiled on account of dust. It slipped slightly as she stood up. This augured well for her.
word_meanings: पुनः again, अमलाक्ष्याः lady with pristine eyes, शिखराग्रदन्त्याः with round edged teeth, चारुगात्य्राः of the lady of beautiful limbs, स्थितायाः standing, शुभम् auspicious, हेमसमानवर्णम् of the colour of gold, ईषत् slightly, रजोध्वस्तमिव slightly dull on account of dust, वासः clothes, किञ्चित् a little, परिस्रंसत slipped.

text: एतैर्निमित्तैरपरैश्च सुभ्रूः संबोधिता प्रागपि साधु सिद्धैः । वातातपक्लान्तमिव प्रनष्टं वर्षेण बीजं प्रतिसंजहर्ष ॥५-२९-६॥
translation: Reassured by such omens which augured well as tested by time, Sita, with beautiful eyebrows, and deep foresight experienced great joy, like a seed blighted by the wind and the Sun comes back to joyful life through a pleasing shower. (A foreteller is addressed as siddha in sanskrit dramas)
word_meanings: प्रागपि in the past also, साधु well, सिद्धैः by seers, एतैः by these, निमित्तै: by the presence of omens, अपरैश्च and by others, सम्बोधिता addressed, सुभ्रूः a lady with lovely eyebrows, वातप्रक्लान्तम् blighted by wind and heat, प्रणष्टम् dried, बीजम् seed, वर्षेण इव with rain, प्रतिसञ्जहर्ष felt happy.

text: तस्याः पुनर्बिम्बफलाधरोष्ठं स्वक्षिभ्रु केशान्तमरालपक्ष्म । वक्त्रं बभासे सितशुक्लदंष्ट्रं राहोर्मुखाच्चन्द्र इव प्रमुक्तः ॥५-२९-७॥
translation: Her face shining with beautiful red lips like bimba fruit, sparkling teeth, and curved eyelashes with lovely brows extending up to her hair, she appeared like a Moon released from the mouth of Rahu.
word_meanings: पुनः again, तस्याः her, बिम्बफलाधरोष्ठम् with lips like bimba fruit, स्वक्षिभ्रुकेशान्तम् beautiful eye brows, अरालपक्ष्म curved eyelashes extending up to her hair, सितचारुदन्तम् white and lovely teeth, वक्त्रम् mouth, राहोः from planet Rahu, मुखात् from face, प्रमुक्तः set free, चन्द्रः इव like the Moon, बभासे shone.

text: सा वीतशोका व्यपनीततन्द्री शान्तज्वरा हर्षविवृद्धसत्त्वा । अशोभतार्या वदनेन शुक्ले शीतांशुना रात्रिरिवोदितेन ॥५-२९-८॥
translation: Revered Sita, completely relieved of grief, exhaustion gone, fears allayed, mind illumined with joy, looked charming with her countenance as a night with the Moon fully risen during the bright fortnight. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic compsed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: आर्या revered lady, सा she, वीतशोका relieved from grief, व्यपनीततन्द्री a lady relieved from exhaustion, शान्तज्वरा fears allyed, हर्षविबुद्धसत्त्वा a lady with her mind illumined by joy, वदनेन with her countenance, शुक्ले in the bright fortnight, उदितेन risen, शीतांशुना with cool Moon, रात्रिरिव like the night, अशोभत shone.

text: हनुमानपि विश्रान्तः सर्वं शुश्राव तत्त्वतः । सीतायास्त्रिजटायाश्च राक्षसीनां च तर्जनम् ॥५-३०-१॥
translation: The valiant hero Hanuman heard everything including the lamentation of Sita and the dream of Trijata and the threats of the demonesses.
word_meanings: विक्रान्तः valiant hero, हनुमानपि Hanuman also, सीतायाश्च Sita's, त्रिजटायाश्च Trijata's, सर्वम् everything, राक्षसीनाम् shedemons, तर्जनम् threatening, तत्त्वतः in principle, शुश्राव heard.

text: अवेक्षमाणस्तां देवीं देवतामिव नन्दने । ततो बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-३०-२॥
translation: The sight of Sita who seemed a deity in the Nandana garden of Indra, set a chain of reflections in his mind :
word_meanings: ततः then, वानरः vanara, नन्दने in the Nandana garden, देवतामिव like the goddess, तां देवीम् to that deitylike Sita, अवेक्षमाणः looking, बहुविधाम् many ways, चिन्ताम् चिन्तयामास reflected.

text: यां कपीनां सहस्राणि सुबहून्ययुतानि च । दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सेयमासादिता मया ॥५-३०-३॥
translation: "This is Sita whom thousands of vanaras are searching in all directions.
word_meanings: कपीनाम् of vanaras, सुबहूनि many, सहस्राणि thousands, अयुतानि च 10,000 soldiers सर्वासु all over, दिक्षु in directions, याम् whom, मार्गन्ते are searching, सा इयम् that Sita here, मया by myself, आसादिता she is found.

text: चारेण तु सुयुक्तेन शत्रोः शक्तिमवेक्षता । गूढेन चरता तावदवेक्षितमिदं मया ॥५-३०-४॥
translation: "Roaming everywhere incognito to ascertain carefully the strength of the enemy, I have seen everything.
word_meanings: सुयुक्तेन very carefully, शत्रोः enemy's, शक्तिमवेक्षता while seeing the strength, गूढेन in disguise, चरता roaming, चारेण a spy, मया by myself, इदम् this place, अवेक्षितं तावत् seen everything.

text: राक्षसानां विशेषश्च पुरी चेयमवेक्षिता । राक्षसाधिपतेरस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च ॥५-३०-५॥
translation: "I have seen the ability of the demons and the citadel of Lanka. I have seen the power of Ravana the demon king.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् of the demons, विशेषश्च ability, इयम् this, पुरी च citadel also, अवेक्षिता had been seen, अस्य its, राक्षसाधिपतेः of the lord of demons, रावणस्य Ravana's, प्रभावश्च power also.

text: युक्तं तस्याप्रमेयस्य सर्वसत्त्वदयावतः । समाश्वासयितुं भार्यां पतिदर्शनकांक्षिणीम् ॥५-३०-६॥
translation: "It is the opportune time for me to comfort Sita eagerly waiting to see her husband who is of immeasurable prowess and who is compassionate to all beings.
word_meanings: सर्वसत्त्वदयावतः who is compassionate to all, अप्रमेयस्य man of immeasureable prowess, तस्य his, पतिदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणीम् longing to see her husband, भार्याम् wife, समाश्वासयितुम् to console युक्तम् is the right action.

text: अहमाश्वासयाम्येनां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् । अदृष्टदुःखां दुःखार्तां दुःखस्यान्तमगच्छतीम् ॥५-३०-७॥
translation: "The moonfaced Sita had never experienced sorrow before. She sees no end to her sorrow and suffering. I will console her.
word_meanings: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् who has the countenance of a fullmoon, अदृष्टदुःखाम् who has never seen suffering, दुःखार्ताम् experiencing sorrow, दुःखस्य from sorrrow, अन्तम् end, अगच्छतीम् not approaching, एनाम् her, अहम् I, आश्वासयामि will console.

text: यद्यप्यहमिमां देवीं शोकोपहतचेतनाम् । अनाश्वास्य गमिष्यामि दोषवद् गमनं भवेत् ॥५-३०-८॥
translation: "If I should return to Kishkindha without reassuring Sita, whose understanding has been clouded in grief I would be blamed.
word_meanings: शोकोपहतचेतना whose mind is overwhelmed with grief, इमां देवीम् this Sita, अहम् I, अनाश्वस्य without reassuring, यदि गमिष्यामि if I go, गमनम् destination (Kishkinda), दोषवत् is blameworthy, भवेत् would be.

text: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशस्विनी । परित्राणमविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत् ॥५-३०-९॥
translation: "If I so back, this illustrious princess, Janaki will give up her life, finding no means of deliverance (from this tragic situation).
word_meanings: मयि when me, तत्र there, गते I go, यशस्विनी renowned, राजपुत्री princess, जानकी Janaki, परित्राणम् deliverance, अविन्दन्ती without getting, जीवितम् life, त्यजेत् she will give up.

text: मया च स महाबाहुः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः । समाश्वासयितुं न्याय्यः सीतादर्शनलालसः ॥५-३०-१०॥
translation: "I should provide some comfort to the strongarmed Rama with a face like the fullmoon yearning to see Sita.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः strongarmed hero, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः face like the fullmoon, सीतादर्शनलालसः yearning to see Sita, सः that Rama, मया by me, समाश्वसयितुम् to provide comfort, न्याय्यः it is proper.

text: निशाचरीणां प्रत्यक्षमनर्हं चापि भाषणम् । कथं तु खलु कर्तव्यमिदं कृच्छ्रगतो ह्यहम् ॥५-३०-११॥
translation: "I cannot talk to her in the presence of these nightroamers. How can I discharge my duty in this predicament?
word_meanings: निशाचरीणाम् of nightrangers, प्रत्यक्षम् in their presence, अभिभाषितम् talking, अनर्हम् is not proper, इदम् this, कथम् how, कर्तव्यं खलु नु should be fulfilled, अहम् I, कृच्छ्रगतो हि I am in a predicament.

text: अनेन रात्रिशेषेण यदि नाश्वास्यते मया । सर्वथा नास्ति सन्देहः परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम् ॥५-३०-१२॥
translation: "If I do not comfort her before the remaining part of the night ends, she will give up her life. There is no doubt about it.
word_meanings: अनेन by this, रात्रिशेषेण when a part of the night is still left, मया by me, नाश्वास्यते यदि if I do not comfort her, जीवितम् life, परित्यक्ष्यति she will give up, सर्वथा by all means, सन्देहः doubt, नास्ति not.

text: रामश्च यदि पृच्छेन्मां किं मां सीता ऽब्रवीद्वचः । किमहं दं प्रतिब्रूयामसम्भाष्य सुमध्यमाम् ॥५-३०-१३॥
translation: "If Rama enquires about the message of Sita, this lady of beautiful waist, what can I speak without meeting and talking to her?
word_meanings: सीता Sita, माम् to me, किम् what, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke, रामश्च Rama also , माम् I am, पृच्छेद्यदि if he enquires, सुमध्यमाम् lady with beautiful waist, असंभाष्य without talking, अहम् I, तं प्रति to him, किम् what, ब्रूयाम् I can say.

text: सीतासन्देशरहितं मामितस्त्वरया गतम् । निर्दहेदपि काकुत्स्थः क्रुद्धस्तीव्रेण चक्षुषा ॥५-३०-१४॥
translation: "If I leave this place without any message from Sita, Rama will burn me with his eyes full of great anger.
word_meanings: सीतासन्देशरहितम् without any message from Sita, इतः from here, त्वरया at once, गतम् gone, माम् me, काकुत्थ्सः Rama, क्रुद्धः angry, तीव्रेण with a sharp, चक्षुषा with eyes, निर्दहेदपि will burn me.

text: यदि चोद्योजयिष्यामि भर्तारं रामकारणात् । व्यर्थमागमनं तस्य ससैन्यस्य भविष्यति ॥५-३०-१५॥
translation: "If I get the lord of vanaras and his army for the cause of Rama (without talking to Sita), their arrival will be useless (if Sita would have given up her life by then).
word_meanings: रामकारणात् for the cause of Rama, भर्तारम् lord of vanaras, यदि च उद्योजयिष्यामि if i motivate him, ससैन्यस्य of him along with his army, तस्य his, आगमनम् coming, व्यर्थम् useless, भविष्यति will become.

text: अन्तरं त्वहमासाद्य राक्षसीनामिह स्थितः । शनैराश्वासयिष्यामि सन्तापबहुलामिमाम् ॥५-३०-१६॥
translation: "I shall wait and speak to her slowly and console this deeply distressed lady when I get a chance to speak to her (when these ogresses are asleep).
word_meanings: अहम् I, इह here, स्थितः waiting, राक्षसीनाम् of the demonesses, अन्तरम् some chance, आसाद्य after finding, सन्तापबहुलाम् deeply distressed, इमाम् this lady, शनैः slowly, आश्वासयिष्यामि will comfort her.

text: अहं त्वति तनुश्चैव वानरश्च विशेषतः । वाचं चोदाहरिष्यामि मानुषीमिह संस्कृताम् ॥५-३०-१७॥
translation: I am indeed of small size and that too a monkey. Nevertheless I shall speak in Sanskrit, a language of the common people. (as the she-demons cannot understand that language).
word_meanings: अहं तु I too, अतितनुश्च small body, विशेषतः more so, वानरश्च a vanara, इह here, सम्स्कृताम् sanskrit language, मानुषीम् of human, वाचं च and talk in, उदाहरिष्यामि I will adopt.

text: यदि वाचं प्रदास्यामि द्विजातिरिव संस्कृताम् । रावणं मन्यमाना मां सीता भीता भविष्यति । वानरस्य विशेषेण कथं स्यादभिभाषणम् ॥५-३०-१८॥
translation: "If I speak like a brahmin in sanskrit language she would be frightened thinking that I am Ravana and how would a vanara speak?
word_meanings: द्विजातिरिव like a brahmin, संस्कृताम् sanskrit, वाचम् language, यदि if I प्रदास्यामि will speak, सीता Sita, माम् me, रावणम् Ravana, मन्यमाना thinking, भीता भविष्यति will become scared, विशेषेण specially, वानरस्य vanara's, अभिभाषणम् talking, कथम् how, स्यात् would be.

text: अवश्यमेव वक्तव्यं मानुषं वाक्यमर्थवत् । मया सान्त्वयितुं शक्या नान्यथेयमनिन्दिता ॥५-३०-१९॥
translation: "I will certainly speak to her meaningfully in the language of the people. Otherwise it is not possible to pacify the sinless Sita.
word_meanings: अवश्यमेव certainly, मया by myself, अर्थवत् for that reason, मानुषम् common man's, वाक्यम् language, वक्तव्यम् should speak, अनिन्दिता siness lady, इयम् this, अन्यथा otherwise, सान्त्वयितुम् to pacify her, शक्या possible.

text: सेयमालोक्य मे रूपं जानकी भाषितं तथा । रक्षोभिस्त्रासिता पूर्वं भूयस्त्रासं गमिष्यति ॥५-३०-२०॥
translation: "Since Janaki has already been frightened by the demons, she will be even more terrified seeing me in this form and hearing me speaking this way.
word_meanings: पूर्वम् earlier, रक्षोभिः by the demons, त्रासिता frightened, सा इयम् this, जानकी Janaki, मे my, रूपम् form, तथा this way, भाषितम् speaking, आलोक्य on seeing, भूयः again, त्रासम् fear, गमिष्यति will experience.

text: ततो जातपरित्रासा शब्दं कुर्यान्मनस्विनी । जानमाना विशालाक्षी रावणं कामरूपिणम् ॥५-३०-२१॥
translation: By seeing me in this form, sensitive largeeyed Sita will scream loudly thinking that I am Ravana who can assume any form at his free will.
word_meanings: ततः then, मनस्विनी sensitive woman, विशालाक्षी largeeyed, माम् me, कामरूपिणम् who can change form at will, रावणम् to Ravana, जानमाना she may think, जातपरित्रासा frightened, शब्दम् sound, कुर्यात् may make.

text: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसीगणः । नानाप्रहरणो घोरः समेयादन्तकोपमः ॥५-३०-२२॥
translation: "If Sita screams, the horde of terrific ogresses will at once gather, armed with dreadful weapons like Yama, the god of death.
word_meanings: सीतया by Sita's, शब्दे when sound, कृते is made, सहसा at once, नानाप्रहरण: holding different kinds of weapons, घोर: terrific ones, अन्तकोपम: comparable to the lord of death, राक्षसीगण: horde of ogresses, समेयात् would gather.

text: ततो मां संपरिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृताननाः । वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युर्यत्नं यथाबलम् ॥५-३०-२३॥
translation: "Then all these hideous ogresses will swarm round me and make efforts to capture me with all their strength and kill me.
word_meanings: ततः then, विकृताननाः women with hideous faces, माम् at me, सर्वतः from all directions, सम्परिक्षिप्य throwing down, वधे च to kill, ग्रहणे चैव and to capture me, यथाबलम् according to their strength, यत्नम् effort, कुर्युः will make.

text: गृह्य शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम् । दृष्ट्वा विपरिधावन्तं भवेयुर्भयशङ्किताः ॥५-३०-२४॥
translation: "Seeing me holding big and small branches of large trees and leaping from one place to the other, the ogresses will get scared.
word_meanings: उत्तमशाखिनाम् of good trees, शाखाः branches, प्रशाखाश्च and side branches, स्कन्धांश्च and trunks, गृह्य by holding, विपरिधावन्तम् running away, दृष्ट्वा seeing, भयशङ्किताः get scared, भवेयुः will be.

text: मम रूपं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वने विचरतो महत् । राक्षस्यो भयवित्रस्ता भवेयुर्विकृताननाः ॥५-३०-२५॥
translation: "These ogresses with their hideous faces will be frightened on looking at my huge form moving in this grove.
word_meanings: विकृताननाः with hideous faces, राक्षस्यः ogresses, वने in the grove, विचरतः roaming, मम me, महत् great, रूपम् form, सम्प्रेक्ष्य glancing, भयवित्रस्ताः very scared, भवेयुः will be.

text: ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि । राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने ॥५-३०-२६॥
translation: "Thereafter the ogresses will draw the attention of demon guards engaged by the king of demons at his residence towards me.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, राक्षस्यः ogresses, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने in the residence of the king of demons, राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानाम् engaged by the demon king to guard, रक्षसाम् अपि of the demons also, समाह्वानम् drawing their attention, कुर्युः they will do.

text: ते शूलशक्तिनिस्त्रिंशविविधायुधपाणयः । आपतेयुर्विमर्दे ऽस्मिन् वेगेनोद्विग्नकारिणः ॥५-३०-२७॥
translation: "Those ogresses due to fear will come speedily, armed with spears, tridents, swords and different kinds of weapons for a combat.
word_meanings: ते those, तस्मिन् in that, विमर्दे in war, शूलशक्तिनिस्त्रिंशविविधायुधपाणयः holding different kinds of weapons such as spears, tridents and swords, उद्वेगकारणात् due to fear, वेगेन speedily, आपतेयुः will collect.

text: संरुद्धस्तैस्तु परितो विधमन् रक्षसां बलम् । शक्नुयां न तु संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः ॥५-३०-२८॥
translation: "With them around me, I may not be able to reach the other end of the ocean (my strength spent in the combat.)
word_meanings: तैः by them, परितः around me, समृद्धः filled, रक्षसाम् of demons, बलम् power, विधमन् while subduing, महोदधेः great sea, परं पारम् to the other side, सम्प्राप्तुम् to reach, न शक्नुयाम् not be possib.le

text: मां वा गृह्णीयुराप्लुत्य बहवः शीघ्रकारिणः । स्यादियं चागृहीतार्था मम च ग्रहणं भवेत् ॥५-३०-२९॥
translation: "The ogres who are in large numbers, here are very prompt to act. They will jump into the sky and bind me. Sita will not receive the message and I will be taken into custody by the demons.
word_meanings: शीघ्रकारिणः prompt, बहवः a large number, आप्लुत्य jumping into the sky, माम् me, गृह्णीयुः वा may catch me, इयं च this lady, अगृहीतार्था may not receive the message, स्यात् may be, मम my, ग्रहणं च arrest, भवेत् will be done.

text: हिंसाभिरुचयो हिंस्युरिमां वा जनकात्मजाम् । विपन्नं स्यात्ततः कार्यं रामसुग्रीवयोरिदम् ॥५-३०-३०॥
translation: "These demons who are keen on indulging in violence will harm Janaka's daughter. Then the mission of Rama and Sugriva will also fail.
word_meanings: वा or, हिंसाभिरुचयः keen on indulging in violence, इमाम् this lady, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, हिंस्युः harm her, ततः then, रामसुग्रीवयोः of Rama and Sugriva, इदम् this, कार्यम् mission, विपन्नं स्यात् will fail.

text: उद्देशे नष्टमार्गे ऽस्मिन् राक्षसैः परिवारिते । सागरेण परिक्षिप्ते गुप्त वसति जानकी ॥५-३०-३१॥
translation: "Janaki is staying in this untraceable location surrounded by demons. And this location is a secret place surrounded by the ocean .
word_meanings: जानकी Janaki, नष्टमार्गे in a hidden location, राक्षसैः by the ogres, परिवारिते surrounded, सागरेण by the ocean, परिक्षिप्ते surrounded allover, गुप्ते in a secret place, अस्मिन् in this, उद्धेशे in this, वसति staying.

text: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे । नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य साहाय्यं कार्यसाधने ॥५-३०-३२॥
translation: "If I am killed in the combat or captured by the demons, I do not see another person who can help in accomplishing this task.
word_meanings: मयि me, संयुगे in a battle, रक्षोभिः by ogres, विशस्ते वा if I am killed, गृहीते वा or captured, रामस्य of Rama, कार्यसाधने to accomplish the task, अन्यम् another, सहायम् help, न पश्यामि I do not see.

text: विमृशंश्च न पश्यामि यो हते मयि वानरः । शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं लङ्गयेत महोदधिम् ॥५-३०-३३॥
translation: "When I am killed here, I cannot see any other vanara who can leap over a hundred yojanas of the ocean (to reach this place).
word_meanings: मयि when I am, हते killed, यः whosoever, वानरः vanara, शतयोजनविस्तीर्णम् extended over a distance of hundred yojanas, महोदधिम् the ocean, लङ्घयेत् can leap over, विमृशन् च even while reflecting carefully, न पश्यामि I cannot see.

text: कामं हन्तुं समर्थो ऽस्मि सहस्राण्यपि रक्षसाम् । नतु शक्ष्यामि संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः ॥५-३०-३४॥
translation: "I may be capable of killing even thousands of demons but thereafter (thoroughly exhausted) reach the other side of the ocean.
word_meanings: रक्षसाम् of demons, सहस्राण्यपि even thousands of them, हन्तुम् to kill, समर्थः capable, अस्मि कामम् I am surely, तु also, महोदधेः of the ocean, परं पारम् to cross over, सम्प्राप्तुम् to reach, न शक्ष्यामि it may not be possible.

text: असत्यानि च युद्धानि संशयो मे न रोचते । कश्च निस्संशयं कार्यं कुर्यात् प्राज्ञः ससंशयम् ॥५-३०-३५॥
translation: "Battles, no doubt, are unpredictable. Which wise man with a sound intellect will take up a doubtful work unhesitatingly?
word_meanings: युद्धानि battles, असत्यानि च not true, संशयः doubtful, मे I, न रोचते it does not please me, कः who, प्राज्ञः wise man, निःसंशयम् without any doubt, कार्यम् task, ससंशयम् without any doubt, कुर्यात् will take up.

text: प्राणत्यागश्च वैदेह्या भवेदनभिभाषणे । एष दोषो महान् हि स्यान्मम सीताभिभाषणे ॥५-३०-३६॥
translation: "If I talk to Vaidehi it will be a great mistake on my part.If I do not speak to Vaidehi she may give up her life.
word_meanings: अनभिभाषणे if I do not speak, वैदेह्याः of Vaidehi, प्राणत्यागश्च abandonement of life, भवेत् may be, सीताभिभाषणे on talking to Sita, मम to me, एषः such, महान् great, दोषः drawback, स्यात् will be.

text: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः । विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ॥५-३०-३७॥
translation: "Even well planned diplomatic missions fail like darkness dispelled at Sunrise if the messenger is confused and if the place and time are not propitious for them.
word_meanings: विक्लबम् a confused person, दूतम् messenger, आसाद्य by appointing, भूताः even sure ones, अर्थाः missions, देशकालविरोधिताः if place and time are not propitious, सूर्योदये at Sunrise, तमः यथा like the darkness, विनश्यन्ति will be destroyed.

text: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चिता ऽपि न शोभते । घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः ॥५-३०-३८॥
translation: "Swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity is not proper. Messengers who assume that they are scholars (blinded by ego) destroy their mission.
word_meanings: अर्थानर्थान्तरे swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity, बुद्धि intelligence, निश्चितापि though decided, न शोभते not proper, पण्डितमानिनः selfstyled scholars, दूताः messengers, कार्याणि their missions, घातयन्ति हि will be destroyed.

text: न विनश्येत् कथं कार्यं वैक्लव्यं न कथं भवेत् । लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत् ॥५-३०-३९॥
translation: "How can the mission succeed? How can failure of mission be avoided? How can the crossing of the great ocean be not wasted?"
word_meanings: कार्यम् task, कथम् how, न विनश्येत् may not be spoilt, वैक्लब्यम् failure, कथम् how, न भवेत् not be allowed to take place, समुद्रस्य ocean's, लङ्घनं च crossing, कथं नु how indeed, वृथा wasteful, न भवेत् not to be.

text: कथं नु खलु वाक्यं मे श्रुणुयान्नोद्विजेत वा । इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांश्चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ॥५-३०-४०॥
translation: Wise Hanuman came to a decision after reflecting in his mind about how not to create fear in Sita (while communicating with her.)
word_meanings: मे वाक्यम् my words, कथं नु how to, शृणुयायात् she may listen, न उद्विजेत वा and not get agitated, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य reflecting, मतिमान् wise, हनुमान् Hanuman, मतिम् in his mind, चकार exercised.

text: राममक्लिष्टकर्माणं स्वबन्धुमनुकीर्तयन् । नैनामुद्वेजयिष्यामि तद्बन्धुगतमानसाम् ॥५-३०-४१॥
translation: "By praising Rama who is very dear, who is judicious in action and in whom her mind is absorbed, I will not create fear.
word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्माणम् one who is judicious in action, सुबन्धुम् very dear to her, रामम् Rama, अनुकीर्तयन् by praising him, तद्बन्धुगतमानसाम् since her mind is absorbed in him, एनाम् her, नोद्वेजयिष्यामि I will not create fear.

text: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः । शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन् ॥५-३०-४२॥
translation: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.
word_meanings: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् in Ikshvaku race, वरिष्ठस्य of the esteemed person, विदितात्मनः of the knower of the self, रामस्य Rama's, शुभानि auspicious, वचनानि words, समर्पयन् by offering, मधुराम् sweet, गिरम् word, प्रब्रुवन् while uttering, सर्वाणि everything, श्रावयिष्यामि will make her listen, इयम् this, यथा as, श्रद्धास्यति will trust me, सर्वम् everything, समाददे I will present.

text: श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम् । श्रद्धास्यति यथा हीयं तथा सर्वं समादधे ॥५-३०-४३॥
translation: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.
word_meanings: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् in Ikshvaku race, वरिष्ठस्य of the esteemed person, विदितात्मनः of the knower of the self, रामस्य Rama's, शुभानि auspicious, वचनानि words, समर्पयन् by offering, मधुराम् sweet, गिरम् word, प्रब्रुवन् while uttering, सर्वाणि everything, श्रावयिष्यामि will make her listen, इयम् this, यथा as, श्रद्धास्यति will trust me, सर्वम् everything, समाददे I will present.

text: इति स बहुविधं महानुभावो जगतिपतेः प्रमदामवेक्षमाणः । मधुरमवितथं जगाद वाक्यं द्रुमविटपान्तरमास्थितो हनूमान् ॥५-३०-४४॥
translation: Highsouled Hanuman seated on the branch of the tree without being seen began to speak faithfully in praise of the lord of the universe in many ways while looking at her. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महानुभावः magnanimous, सः हनूमान् that Hanuman, द्रुमविटपान्तरम् behind the branch of the tree, आस्थितः seated, जगतिपतेः of the lord of the universe, प्रमदाम् wife, अवेक्षमाणः seeing, बहुविधम् in many ways, अवितथम् faithful, वाक्यम् words, इति thus, जगाद spoke

text: एवं बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयित्वा महाकपिः । संश्रवे मधुरं वाक्यं वैदेह्या व्याजहार ह ॥५-३१-१॥
translation: After deliberating in several ways the great Hanuman spoke these sweet words to Vaidehi:
word_meanings: महाकपिः great vanara, एवम् thus, बहुविधाम् in several ways, चिन्ताम् thought, चिन्तयित्वा deliberating in his mind, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, संश्रवे hearing, मधुरम् sweet, वाक्यम् words, व्याजहार ह spoke.

text: राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान् । पुण्यशीलो महाकीर्तिर्ऋजुरासीन्महायशाः ॥५-३१-२॥
translation: "There was an illustrious king called Dasaratha in Ikshvaku race, a master of chariots, elephants and horses. He was highly meritorious and renowned.
word_meanings: रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान् with chariots, elephants and horses, पुण्यशीलः foremost in merits, महाकीर्तिः renowned, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् in Ikshvaku race, महायशाः illustrious, दशरथो नाम called Dasaratha, राजा king.

text: राजर्षीणां गुणश्रेष्टस्तपसा चर्षिभिः समः । चक्रवर्तिकुले जातः पुरन्दरसमो बले ॥५-३१-३॥
translation: "He was the most virtuous among royal sages, equal to sages in austerity, born in the race of emperors and equal to Indra in might.
word_meanings: राजर्षीणाम् among sagelike kings, गुणश्रेष्ठः most virtuous one, तपसा in austerity, ऋषिभिः with sages, समः equal, चक्रवर्तिकुले in a dynasty of emperors, जातः born, बले in might, पुरन्दरसमः crusher of citadels like Indra.

text: अहिसारतिरक्षुद्रौ घृणी सत्यपराक्रमः । मुख्यश्चेक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य लक्ष्मीवाँल्लक्ष्मिवर्धनः ॥५-३१-४॥
translation: "He was committed to nonviolence, magnanimous, compassionate and one whose strength was truth. He was not only a prosperous king of Ikshvaku family but also a promoter of prosperity of others too.
word_meanings: अहिंसारतिः committed to nonviolence, अक्षुद्रः magnanimous, घृणी compassionate, सत्यपराक्रमः one whose strength truth, इक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य of Ikshvaku family, मुख्यश्च chief, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, लक्ष्मिवर्धनः increaser of riches.

text: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनैर्युक्तः पृथुश्रीः पार्थिवर्षभः । पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां विश्रुतः सुखदः सुखी ॥५-३१-५॥
translation: "Endowed with signs of kingship and vast wealth, he was a bull among rulers of the vast earth, surrounded by the sea. A happy king himself, he was wellknown as a provider of happiness.
word_meanings: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनैः with signs of kingship, युक्तः endowed, पृथुश्रीः with vast wealth, पार्थिवर्षभः a bull among rulers, चतुरन्तायाम् surrounded by the sea, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, विश्रुतः well known, सुखदः provider of happiness (to people), सुखी happy man.

text: तस्य पुत्रः प्रियो ज्येष्ठस्ताराधिपनिभाननः । रामो नाम विशेषज्ञः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ॥५-३१-६॥
translation: "His beloved eldest son Rama, whose countenance is like the full moon, is a scholar of all branches of knowledge and is foremost among the bowmen on earth.
word_meanings: तस्य his, प्रियः beloved, ताराधिपनिभाननः of Moon like face, विशेषज्ञः scholar of all knowledge, सर्वधनुष्मताम् among all those wielders of bow, श्रेष्ठः foremost, रामो नाम called Rama, ज्येष्ठः पुत्रः eldest son.

text: रक्षिता स्वस्य धर्मस्य स्वजनस्य च रक्षिता । रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य च परन्तपः ॥५-३१-७॥
translation: "The scourage of enemies, he is a protector of righteousness and of his kins and all living creatures. He is an embodiment of righteousness.
word_meanings: परन्तपः scourage of foes, स्वस्य his, धर्मस्य of righteousness, रक्षिता a protector, स्वजनस्य of his kins, रक्षिता a protector, जीवलोकस्य of all living creatures, धर्मस्य च and of righteousness, रक्षिता protector.

text: तस्य सत्याभिसन्धस्य वृद्धस्य वचनात् पितुः । सभार्यः सह च भ्रात्रा वीरः प्रव्राजितो वनम् ॥५-३१-८॥
translation: "Honouring the word of his aged father who was ever steadfast in truth, Rama left for the forest along with his wife and brother.
word_meanings: सत्याभिसन्धस्य ever steadfast in truth, वृद्धस्य of the aged, पितुः father, तस्य his, वचनात् honouring the word, वीरः hero, सभार्यः along with wife, सह च भ्रात्रा and accompanied by his brother, वनम् forest, प्रव्राजितः went as a wanderer.

text: तेन तत्र महारण्ये मृगयां परिधावता । राक्षसा निहताः शूरा बहवः कामरूपिणः ॥५-३१-९॥
translation: "In the deep forest he went round hunting animals and killing the demon warriors who assumed any form at their free will.
word_meanings: तत्र there, महारण्ये in the thick forest, मृगयाम् hunting, परिधावता while chasing, तेन by him, शूराः warriors, कामरूपिणः those who can assume any form at their will, बहवः many, राक्षसाः demons, निहताः killed.

text: जनस्थानवधं श्रुत्वा हतौ च खरदूषणौ । ततस्त्वमर्षापहृता जानकी रावणेन तु । वञ्जयित्वा वने रामं मृगरूपेण मायया ॥५-३१-१०॥
translation: "Ravana having heard about the killing of all demons at Janasthana including Khara and Dooshana in the forest, deceived Rama in the guise of a deer and abducted Janaki in anger.
word_meanings: ततः then, जनस्थानवधम् killing at Janasthana, हतौ killed, खरदूषणौ च Khara and Dooshana, श्रुत्वा having heard, वने in the forest, रामम् Rama, मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, मायया by creating illusion, वञ्चयित्वा having deceived, रावणेन by Ravana, जानकी Janaki, अमर्षापहृता abducted out of anger.

text: स मार्गमाणस्तां देवीं रामः सीतामनिन्दिताम् । आससाद वने मित्रं सुग्रीवं नाम वानरम् ॥५-३१-११॥
translation: "While looking for the goddesslike lady, the sinless Sita in the forest, Rama met a monkey called Sugriva and made friendship with him
word_meanings: सः रामः that Rama, अनिन्दिताम् sinless, देवीम् goddesslike lady, तां सीताम् that Sita, मार्गमाणः looking for, वने in the forest, सुग्रीवं नाम called Sugriva, वानरम् monkey, मित्रम् friendship, आससाद met.

text: ततः स वालिनं हत्वा रामः परपुरञ्जयः । प्रायच्छत् कपिराज्यं तत् सुग्रीवाय महाबलः ॥५-३१-१२॥
translation: "Rama, a powerful king, who can win enemy forts killed Vali and offered the monkey kingdom to Sugriva.
word_meanings: ततः then, परपुरञ्जयः one who can win over enemy forts, महाबलः powerful, सः रामः that Rama, वालिनम् that Vali, हत्वा having killed, तत् that, कपिराज्यम् kingdom of the monkeys, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, प्रायच्छत् offered.

text: सुग्रीवेणापि सन्दिष्टा हरयः कामरूपिणः । दिक्षु सर्वासु तां देवीं विचिन्वन्ति सहस्रशः ॥५-३१-१३॥
translation: "Having received Sugriva's orders thousands of monkeys who can assume any form went searching for that divine queen in all directions.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, सन्दिष्टाः received orders, कामरूपिणः those who can assume any form, कपयः monkeys, सहस्रशः in thousands, सर्वासु all over, दिक्षु in directions, तां देवीम् that divine queen, विचिन्वन्ति are searching.

text: अहं संपातिवचनाच्छतयोजनमायतम् । अस्या हेतोर्विशालाक्ष्याः सागरं वेगवान् प्लुतः ॥५-३१-१४॥
translation: "On hearing the words of Sampati I leaped the wide ocean swiftly crossing a hundred yojanas in quest of the largeeyed Sita.
word_meanings: अहम् I am, सम्पातिवचनात् by the words of Sampati, वेगवान् swiftly, अस्याः for her, विशालाक्ष्याः largeeyed, हेतोः for the cause, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, आयतम् wide, सागरम् ocean, प्लुतः leaped.

text: यथारूपां यथावर्णां यथालक्ष्मीं च निश्चिताम् । अश्रौषं राघवस्याहं सेयमासादिता मया ॥५-३१-१५॥
translation: "Surely I have seen here a lady of similar body, of similar complexion, of similar glow and beauty as described by Rama".
word_meanings: अहम् I, राघवस्य Raghava's, ताम् her, यथारूपाम् of a similar form, यथावर्णाम् of the same complexion, यथालक्ष्मी of similar glow, अश्रौषम् I heard, सा she, इयम् the same one, मया by me, आसादिता has been found.

text: विररामैव मुक्त्वा ऽसौ वाचं वानरपुङ्गवः । जानकी चापि तच्छृत्वा विस्मयं परमं गता ॥५-३१-१६॥
translation: Having spoken thus, the great vanara stopped speaking after that. Janaki was wonderstruck by the words of the vanara.
word_meanings: असौ he, वानरपुङ्गवः chief of the vanaras, एवम् in that way, वाचम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, विरराम stopped, जानकी चापि even Janaki, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, परम् great, विस्मयम् wonder, आगता felt.

text: ततः सा वक्रकेशान्ता सुकेशी केशसंवृतम् । उन्नम्य वदनं भीरुः शिंशुपावृक्षमैक्षत ॥५-३१-१७॥
translation: Then Sita looked up at the Simsupa tree timidly, her face covered with beautiful curly hair.
word_meanings: ततः then, वक्रकेशान्ता one who had hair curled up at the ends, भीरुः (timid) lady, क्लेशसंवृतम् covered with hanging hair, सा she, वदनम् face, उन्नम्य by raising, शिंशुपावृक्षम् Simsupa tree, ऐक्षत looked up.

text: निशम्य सीता वचनं कपेश्च दिशश्च सर्वाः प्रदिशश्च वीक्ष्य । स्वयं प्रहर्षं परमं जगाम सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती ॥५-३१-१८॥
translation: On hearing Hanuman's words Sita looked at all directions and quarters while quietly contemplating on Rama, the self of all and experienced supreme joy.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, कपेः Hanuman's, वचनम् word, निशम्य after hearing, सर्वाः all, दिशश्च directions, प्रदिशश्च and quarters, वीक्ष्य after observing, स्वयम् herself, सर्वात्मना self of all, रामम् Rama, अनुस्मरन्ती contemplating on, परमम् supreme, प्रहर्षम् joy, जगाम experienced.

text: सा तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च तथाप्यधस्तान्निरीक्षमाणा तमचिन्त्यबुद्धिम् । ददर्श पिङ्गाधिपतेरमात्यं वातात्मजं सूर्यमिवोदयस्थम् ॥५-३१-१९॥
translation: She looked obliquely, up, and down and saw Hanuman of unimaginable intelligence, the minister of the monkey lord, son of the Windgod, who looked like the rising Sun. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सा she, तिर्यक् obliquely, ऊर्ध्वं च vertically, तथापि so also, अथस्तात् downward, निरीक्षमाणा observing, अचिन्त्यबुद्धिम् of unimaginable intelligence, पिङ्गाधिपतेः of king of monkeys, अमात्यम् minister, उदयस्थम् rising, सूर्यमिव like Sun, तं वातात्मजम् that son of the Windgod, ददर्श saw.

text: ततः शाखान्तरे लीनं दृष्ट्वा चलितमानसा । वेष्टितार्जुनवस्त्रं तं विद्युत्सङ्घातपिङ्गलम् ॥५-३२-१॥
translation: Sita got perplexed on seeing him (Hanuman), who was tawny in complexion and looked like a cluster of lightnings, clad in white and hidden in between the branches.
word_meanings: ततः then, शाखान्तरे in between the branches, लीनम् hidden, वेष्टितार्जुनवस्त्रम् clad in white, विद्युत्सङ्घातपिङ्गलम् of tawny complexion like a cluster of lightnings, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा seeing, चलितमानसा got perplexed.

text: सा ददर्श कपिं तत्र प्रश्रितं प्रियवादिनम् । फुल्लाशोकोत्कराभासं तप्तचामीकरेक्षणम् ॥५-३२-२॥
translation: There (on the tree) she noticed a monkey like a cluster of fully blossomed Ashoka flower, shining bright, whose eyes were glowing like pure molten gold, speaking softly and pleasingly.
word_meanings: सा she, तत्र there, फुल्लाशोकोत्कराभासम् bright like fullyblossomed Ashoka flower, तप्तचामीकरेक्षणम् whose eyes are bright like molten gold, प्रश्रितम् was readily approaching, प्रियवादिनम् one who spoke softly and pleasingly, कपिम् monkey, ददर्श saw.

text: मैथिली चिन्तयामास विस्मयं परमं गता । अहो भीममिदं रूपं वानरस्य दुरासदम् । दुर्निरीक्ष्यमिति ज्ञात्वा पुनरेव मुमोह सा ॥५-३२-३॥
translation: Astonisted Mythili began thinking. 'Oh this vanara's appearance is frightening. He is terrible to look at. He is inaccessible'. Thinking over this again and again, she fainted.
word_meanings: मैथिली Mythili, परमम् supreme, विस्मयम् astonishment, गता felt, चिन्तयामास began thinking, अहो Oh, वानरस्य vanara's, दुरासदम् inaccessible, इदम् this, रूपम् appearance, भीमम् frightening, दुर्निरीक्षम् impossible to look at, इति thus, ज्ञात्वा thinking, सा she, पुनरेव once again, मुमोह fainted.

text: विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं भयमोहिता । रामरामेति दुःखार्ता लक्ष्मणेति च भामिनी ॥५-३२-४॥
translation: Overcome with sorrow and fear, noble Sita sobbed pitiably muttering repeatedly. 'O Rama, O Rama, O Lakshmana'.
word_meanings: भामिनी a noble lady, सीता Sita, भयमोहिता overcome with fear, दुःखार्ता sorrowful, रामरामेति saying Rama, Rama, लक्ष्मणेति च and Lakshmana also, भृशम् repeatedly, करुणम् pitiably, विललाप cried, सीता Sita, मन्दस्वरा सती in low voice, बहुधा many ways, रुरोद cried.

text: रुरोद बहुधा सीता मन्दं मन्दस्वरा सती ॥५-३२-५॥
translation: Overcome with sorrow and fear, noble Sita sobbed pitiably muttering repeatedly. 'O Rama, O Rama, O Lakshmana'.
word_meanings: भामिनी a noble lady, सीता Sita, भयमोहिता overcome with fear, दुःखार्ता sorrowful, रामरामेति saying Rama, Rama, लक्ष्मणेति च and Lakshmana also, भृशम् repeatedly, करुणम् pitiably, विललाप cried, सीता Sita, मन्दस्वरा सती in low voice, बहुधा many ways, रुरोद cried.

text: सा तं दृष्ट्वा हरिश्रेष्ठं विनीतबदुपस्थितम् । मैथिली चिन्तयामास स्वप्नो ऽयमिति भामिनी ॥५-३२-६॥
translation: Noble Sita, seeing the best of vanaras who stood near humbly, began reflecting 'Is this a dream'?
word_meanings: भामिनी noble lady, सा मैथिली that Maithili, विनीतवत् humbly, उपस्थितम् stood near, तम् him, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of vanaras, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अयम् this, स्वप्नः dream, इति thus, चिन्तयामास began thinking.

text: सा वीक्षमाणा पृथुभुग्नवक्त्रं शाखामृगेन्द्रस्य यथोक्तकारम् । ददर्श पिङ्गधिपतेरमात्यं वातात्मजं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् ॥५-३२-७॥
translation: Looking here and there, she saw a monkey with a large, curved face, an obedient servant and a minister of the monkeylord, the foremost among the intelligentia and the son of the Windgod.
word_meanings: सा she, वीक्षमाणा was looking here and there, पृथुभुग्नवक्त्रम् with a large curved face, शाखामृगेन्द्रस्य of the lord of monkeys, यथोक्तकारम् obedient servant, पिङ्गाधिपते of the king of monkeys, अमात्यम् minister, बुद्धिमताम् among the intelligent, वरिष्ठम् foremost, वातात्मजम् son of the windgod, ददर्श saw.

text: सा तं समीक्ष्यैव भृशं विसंज्ञा गतासुकल्पेव बभूव सीता । चिरेण संज्ञा प्रतिलभ्य भूयो विचिन्तयामास विशालनेत्रा ॥५-३२-८॥
translation: The largeeyed Sita lost her senses looking at him. She got back her senses after a long time and started thinking again:
word_meanings: सा सीता that Sita, तम् him, समीक्ष्यैव after looking at, भृशम् greatly, विसंज्ञा lost senses, गतासुकल्पेव as if she was almost dead, बभूव remained, विशालनेत्रा largeeyed, चिरेण after a long time, संज्ञाम् senses, प्रतिलभ्य after getting back, भूयः again, विचिन्तयामास started thinking

text: स्वप्ने मया ऽयं विकृतो ऽद्य दृष्टः शाखामृगः शास्त्रगणैर्निषिद्धः । स्वस्त्यस्तु रामाय सलक्ष्मणाय तथा पितुर्मे जनकस्य राज्ञः ॥५-३२-९॥
translation: 'Today I saw an ugly monkey in my dream. Its sight in a dream is inauspicious according to sastras. Let it be auspicious for Lakshmana and Rama for the sake of my father Janaka.
word_meanings: अद्य today, मया by me, विकृतः an ugly form, शास्त्रगणैः by sastras, निषिद्धः prohibited, शाखामृगः monkey, स्वप्ने in a dream, दृष्टः is seen, सलक्ष्मणाय for Lakshmana, रामाय for Rama, तथा so also, मे पितुः my father, जनकस्य राज्ञः of the king Janaka, स्वस्ति auspicious, अस्तु be

text: स्वप्नो ऽपि नायं नहि मे ऽस्ति निद्रा शोकेन दुःखेन च पीडितायाः । सुखं हि मे नास्ति यतो ऽस्मि हीना तेनेन्दुपूर्णप्रतिमाननेन ॥५-३२-१०॥
translation: "But no, it was not a dream for tormented by grief and sorrow I cannot have a dream. When separated from the moonfaced Rama I have no sleep or pleasure, how can I have dream?
word_meanings: अयम् this, स्वप्नोऽपि even in a dream, न not, शोकेन with grief, दुःखेन च and with sorrow, पीडितायाः a tormented woman, मे to me, निद्रा sleep, नास्ति हि not there, मे to me, सुखम् pleasure, नास्ति हि not there, यतः therefore, इन्दुपूर्णप्रतिमाननेन whose face is like a fullmoon, तेन with him, हीना devoid, अस्मि I am

text: रामेति रामेति सदैव बुद्ध्या विचिन्त्य वाचा ब्रुवती तमेव । तस्यानुरूपां च कथां तमर्तमेव प्रपश्यामि तथा श्रृणोमि ॥५-३२-११॥
translation: "I am always meditating upon Rama and thinking of him alone. I am talking about things related to him. Because of that I see him and hear him.
word_meanings: रामेति रामेति only Rama Rama, सदा ऐव always, बुद्ध्या with my brain, विचिन्त्य after thinking, तमेव him alone, ब्रुवती thinking of, तस्य his, अनुरूपाम् favourable, तदर्थम् for his sake, कथाम् talk, एवम् in this way, प्रपश्यामि I am seeing, तथा so also, शृणोमि I am hearing.

text: अहं हि तस्याद्य मनोभवेन संपीडिता तद्गतसर्वभावा । विचिन्तयन्ती सततं तमेव तथैव पश्यामि तथा शृणोमि ॥५-३२-१२॥
translation: "I am tormented by intense love for Rama, with all my thoughts immersed in him. Since I am constantly thinking of him I see him and hear words about him. (She thinks it is all hallucination.)
word_meanings: अद्य now, अहम् I, तस्य his, मनोभवेन by love for him, सम्पीडिता tormented, तद्गतसर्वभावा all my thoughts immersed in him, सततम् always, तमेव about him only, विचिन्तयन्ती while I am thinking of, तथैव in a similar manner, पश्यामि I am seeing, तथैव only in such a way, शृणोमि I am listening.

text: मनोरथः स्यादिति चिन्तयामि तथापि बुद्ध्या च वितर्कयामि । किं कारणं तस्य हि नास्ति रूपं सुव्यक्तरूपश्च वदत्ययं माम् ॥५-३२-१३॥
translation: "I feel it is only the desire in my mind. Desire has no form. But the one who is addressing me has a form. I cannot understand this.
word_meanings: मनोरथः desire, स्यात् may be, इति thus, चिन्तयामि I think, बुद्ध्या च thinking, तथा like that, वितर्कयामि I am deliberating, तस्य its, रूपम् form, नास्ति हि is not seen, अयम् this, सुव्यक्तरूपः seen in a manifested form, माम् by me, वदति speaks, कारणम् cause, किम् what?

text: नमो ऽस्तु वाचस्पतये सवज्रिणे स्वयम्भुवे चैव हुताशनाय च । अनेन चोक्तं यदिदं ममाग्रतो वनौकसा तच्च तथा ऽस्तु नान्यथा ॥५-३२-१४॥
translation: "My salutations to Indra, Brihaspati, Brahma the creator and also to the firegod. Let all those words spoken by the vanara here in front of me be true and not other than that." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सवज्रिणे along with Indra, वाचस्पतये for Brihaspati, स्वयंभुवे चैव even for the creator Brahma, हुताशनाय for god of fire, च also, नमः salutations, अस्तु may be, अनेन by him, वनौकसा by the resident of the forest, मम अग्रतः in front of me, यत् whatever, इदम् this, उक्तम् spoken, तत् that, तथा true, अस्तु may be, अन्यथा other than that, न not be.

text: सो ऽवतीर्य द्रुमात्तस्माद्विद्रुमप्रतिमाननः । विनीतवेषः कृपणः प्रणिपत्योपसृत्य च ॥५-३३-१॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod whose face shone like coral, dressed in a sober manner climbed down the tree, went close to Sita, offered salutations with his palms on his head and spoke in sweet words:
word_meanings: विद्रुमप्रतिमानन: whose face was like the colour of a coral, महातेजाः shining, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्मात् from that, द्रुमात् from the tree, अवतीर्य having climbed down, विनीतवेषः dressed in a sober manner, कृपणः piteous, प्रणिपत्य having offered salutations, उपसृत्य went near her, शिरसि on his head, अञ्चलिम् having folded palms, आधाय placed, तां सीताम् her, Sita, मधुरया in sweet, गिरा words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: तामब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय सीतां मधुरया गिरा ॥५-३३-२॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod whose face shone like coral, dressed in a sober manner climbed down the tree, went close to Sita, offered salutations with his palms on his head and spoke in sweet words:
word_meanings: विद्रुमप्रतिमानन: whose face was like the colour of a coral, महातेजाः shining, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्मात् from that, द्रुमात् from the tree, अवतीर्य having climbed down, विनीतवेषः dressed in a sober manner, कृपणः piteous, प्रणिपत्य having offered salutations, उपसृत्य went near her, शिरसि on his head, अञ्चलिम् having folded palms, आधाय placed, तां सीताम् her, Sita, मधुरया in sweet, गिरा words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: कानु पद्मपलाशाक्षि क्लिष्टकौशेयवासिनि । द्रुमस्य शाखामालम्ब्य तिष्ठसि त्वमनिन्दिते ॥५-३३-३॥
translation: "O blameless lady with eyes like lotus petals, in crumpled silk, holding a branch, and standing, who are you?
word_meanings: पद्मपलाशाक्षि O one with eyes like lotus petals, क्लिष्टकौशेयवासिनि robed in crumpled silk, अनिन्दिते blameless lady, द्रुमस्य of the tree, शाखाम् branch, आलम्ब्य by holding, तिष्ठसि you are standing, का नु who are you?

text: किमर्थं तव नेत्राभ्यां वारि स्रवति शोकजम् । पुण्डरीकपलाशाभ्यां विप्रकीर्णमिवोदकम् ॥५-३३-४॥
translation: "Why are tears of grief flowing from your eyes like water trickling down a pair of petals of white lotuses?
word_meanings: पुण्डरीकपलाशाभ्याम् from two petals of white lotus, विप्रकीर्णम् trickled, उदकम् इव like water, तव your, नेत्राभ्याम् from your eyes, शोकजम् tears of grief, वारि water, किमर्थम् for what reason, स्रवति is flowing.

text: सुराणामसुराणां वा नागगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् । यक्षाणां किन्नराणां वा का त्वं भवसि शोभने ॥५-३३-५॥
translation: "O noble lady, are you a goddess or a demoness, a naga, a gandharva, a rakshasa, a yaksha or a kinnera?
word_meanings: शोभने O auspicious one, त्वम् you, सुराणाम् among gods, असुराणां वा or demons, नागगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् of nagas, gandharvas, rakshasas, यक्षाणाम् of yakshas, किन्नराणां वा or kinneras, का who, भवसि you are.

text: का त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां वा वरानने । वसूनां वा वरारोहे देवता प्रतिभासे मे ॥५-३३-६॥
translation: "O beautiful lady Do you belong to the race of Rudras, or Marutas, or Vasus?. O noble lady, you appear a goddess to me.
word_meanings: वरानने O beautiful lady, त्वम् you, रुद्राणाम् of the Rudras, मरुतां वा or even Marutas, वसूनाम् of Vasus, का who, भवसि you are, वरारोहे O fine woman, देवता goddess, मे to me, प्रतिभासि you appear

text: किन्नु चन्द्रमसा हीना पतिता विबुधालयात् । रोहिणी ज्योतिषां श्रेष्ठा श्रेष्ठसर्वगुणान्विता ॥५-३३-७॥
translation: "are you Rohini, embellished with best virtues among the constellations? Have you come down from the abode of the luminaries separated from the Moon, her lord?
word_meanings: चन्द्रमसा from the Moon, हीना separated, विबुधालयात् from the abode of the gods, पतिता fallen down, ज्योतिषाम् among the luminaries, श्रेष्ठा best one, श्रेष्ठसर्वगुणान्विता who has all best qualities, रोहिणी Rohini किं नु you may be

text: का त्वं भवसि कल्याणि कत्वमनिन्दितलोचने ॥५-३३-८॥
कोपाद्वा यदि वा मोहाद्भर्तारमसितेक्षणे । वसिष्ठं कोपयित्वा त्वं नासिकल्याण्यरुन्धती ॥५-३३-९॥
translation: "O lady of lovely black eyes who are you? Have you by any chance offended your husband out of anger or out of delusion? Are you the auspicious Arundhati dislodged for making your lord Vasistha angry?
word_meanings: असितेक्षणे O lady of lovely black eyes, त्वम् you, कोपाद्वा or out of anger, यदि वा or else, मोहात् out of delusion, भर्तारम् husband, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, कोपयित्वा making him angry, कल्याणि O auspicious lady, अरुन्धती Arundhati, नासि are you not

text: को नु पुत्रः पिता भ्राता भर्ता वा ते सुमध्यमे । अस्माल्लोकादमुं लोकं गतं त्वमनुशोचसि ॥५-३३-१०॥
translation: "O woman of beautiful waist from which world have you come here? For whom are you worrying? Who is your son, father, brother or husband? Are you worrying about some one dead?.
word_meanings: सुमध्यमे O woman of beautiful waist, अस्मात् from this, लोकात् from the world, अमुं लोकम् to this world, गतम् dead, त्वम् your, अनुशोचसि worrying about, ते your, पुत्रः son, पिता father, भ्राता brother, भर्ता वा or is it husband, को नु is he?

text: रोदनादतिनिःश्वासाद्भूतमिसंस्पर्शनादपि । न त्वां देवीमहं मन्ये राज्ञः संज्ञावधारणात् ॥५-३३-११॥
translation: "From your weeping, your sighing and your touching the earth (gods do not touch the earth) and your signs of sovereignty, I do not think you are a goddess (meaning otherwise she posessed divine grace).
word_meanings: रोदनात् from your weeping, अतिनिश्श्वासात् breathing heavily, भूमिसंस्पर्शनादपि your touching the ground, राज्ञः royal, संज्ञावधारणात् having signs of sovereignty, त्वाम् you, देवीम् O goddess, अहम् I, न मन्ये I do not think.

text: व्यञ्जनानि च ते यानि लक्षणामनि च लक्षये । महिषी भूमिपालस्य राजकन्या ऽसि मे मता ॥५-३३-१२॥
translation: "On the basis of your royal signs and other qualities I infer that you are the daughter of a king or his consort.
word_meanings: ते your, यानि those, व्यञ्जनानि signs, लक्षणानि च also qualities, लक्षये I see, भूमिपालस्य king's, महिषी consort, राजकन्या च and a princess, मे to me, मता it is felt.

text: रावणेन जनस्थानाद् बलादपहृता यदि । सीता त्वमसि भद्रं ते तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥५-३३-१३॥
translation: "If you are Sita, who was forcefully borne away by Ravana from Janasthana you may kindly reveal to me freely. May god bless you.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, रावणेन by Ravana, बलात् forcibly, अपहृता borne away, सीता Sita, असि यदि if you are, तत् that, पृच्छतः enquiring, मम to me, आचक्ष्व you tell, ते भद्रम् wish you well.

text: यथा हि तव वै दैन्यं रूपं चाप्यतिमानुषम् । तपसा चान्वितो वेषस्त्वं राममहिषी ध्रुवम् ॥५-३३-१४॥
translation: "Indeed your plight, the superhuman beauty and your robes marked with asceticism, surely tell me that you are Rama's queen."
word_meanings: तव your, दैन्यम् plight, अतिमानुषम् superhuman, रूपं च and your form, तपसा with austerity, अन्वितः endowed, वेषः your dress, यथा as much, त्वम् you are, ध्रुवम् surely, राममहिषी Rama's queen.

text: सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा रामकीर्तनहर्षिता । उवाच वाक्यं वैदेही हनुमन्तं द्रुमाश्रितम् ॥५-३३-१५॥
translation: Happy to have heard words of praise of Rama, Vaidehi spoke this to Hanuman, who got up the tree:
word_meanings: सा वैदेही that Vaidehi, तस्य his, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामकीर्तनहर्षिता happy to hear words of praise of Rama, द्रुमाश्रितम् on the tree, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

text: पृथिव्यां राजसिहानां मुख्यस्य विदितात्मनः । स्नुषा दशरथस्याहं शत्रुसैन्यप्रतापिनः ॥५-३३-१६॥
translation: "I am daughterinlaw of king Dasaratha, knower of the self, the foremost among kings on earth and a slayer of enemy army.
word_meanings: अहम् I am, पृथिव्याम् on earth, राजसिंहानाम् among great kings, मुख्यस्य foremost, विदितात्मनः of the knower of self, शत्रुसैन्यप्रतापिनः of the slayer of enemy army, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, स्नुषा daughterinlaw.

text: दुहिता जनकस्याहं वैदेहस्य महात्मनः । सीता च नाम नाम्ना ऽहं भार्या रामस्य धीमतः ॥५-३३-१७॥
translation: "I am daughter of the great soul, Janaka, king of Videha, known as Sita. I am the wife of that sagacious Rama.
word_meanings: अहम् I am, वैदेहस्य Videha's, महात्मनः great soul, जनकस्य Janaka's, दुहिता daughter, नाम्ना सीतेति नाम Sita by name, अहम् I am, धीमतः of the sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, भार्या wife.

text: समा द्वादश तत्राहं राघवस्य निवेशने । भुञ्जाना मानुषान् भोगान् सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी ॥५-३३-१८॥
translation: "I enjoyed worldly pleasures in abundance for twelve years at Rama's abode.
word_meanings: अहम् I am, तत्र there, राघवस्य Rama's, निवेशने the abode, मानुषान् mortal, भोगान् pleasures, भुञ्जाना experiencing, सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी all kinds of pleasures provided, द्वादश twelve, समाः years.

text: तत्र त्रयोदशे वर्षे राज्येनेक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम् । अभिषेचयितुं राजा सोपाध्यायः प्रचक्रमे ॥५-३३-१९॥
translation: "Then in the thirteenth year king Dasaratha along with the royal preceptor arranged to coronate Rama, delight of the Ikshvaku family, in the kingdom.
word_meanings: ततः then, त्रयोदशे in the thirteenth, वर्षे in the year, सोपाध्यायः with his preceptor, राजा the king, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम् delight of the Ikshvakus, राज्येन in the kingdom, अभिषेचयितुम् to coronate, प्रचक्रमे arranged.

text: तस्मिन् संभ्रियमाणे तु राघवस्याभिषेचने । कैकेयी नाम भर्तारं देवी वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-३३-२०॥
translation: "While preparations for the coronation were on, queen Kaikeyi said to her husband:
word_meanings: तस्मिन् in that, राघवस्य Rama's, अभिषेचने in the coronation, सम्भ्रियमाणे while preparations were being made, कैकेयी नाम called Kaikeyi, देवी queen, भर्तारम् to her husband, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: न पिबेयं न खादेयं प्रत्यहं मम भोजनम् । एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते ॥५-३३-२१॥
translation: 'I shall not drink or eat food, if Rama is coronated. I shall end my life this moment.
word_meanings: न पिबेयम् I shall not drink, प्रत्यहम् daily, भोजनम् food, न खादेयम् I will not eat, रामः Rama, यदि if, अभिषिच्यते is coronated, एषः this is, मे my, जीवितस्य life's, अन्तः end.

text: यत्तदुक्तं त्वया वाक्यं प्रीत्या नृपतिसत्तम । तच्चेन्न वितथं कार्यं वनं गच्छतु राघवः ॥५-३३-२२॥
translation: 'O Dasaratha, the foremost among kings if the promise lovingly made by you earlier is not going to be false, Rama should go to the forest'.
word_meanings: नृपतिसत्तम the foremost among kings, त्वया by you, प्रीत्या lovingly, यत् such, तत् वाक्यम् words, उक्तम् spoken, तत् the same, वितथम् false, न कार्यं that promise, यदि if you please, राघवः Rama, वनम् to the forest, गच्छतु go.

text: स राजा सत्यवाग् देव्या वरदानमनुस्मरन् । मुमोह वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्याः क्रूरमप्रियम् ॥५-३३-२३॥
translation: "Remembering the boons the ever truthful king had granted to Kaikeyi, he fainted after hearing her cruel and harsh words.
word_meanings: सत्यवाक् ever truthful, सः राजा that king, देव्याः to the queen, वरदानम् boons, अनुस्मरन् remembering, कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi, क्रूरम् cruel, अप्रियम् unpleasant, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुमोह fainted.

text: ततस्तु स्थविरो राजा सत्ये धर्मे व्यवस्थितः । ज्येष्ठं यशस्विनं पुत्रं रुदन् राज्यमयाचत ॥५-३३-२४॥
translation: "The aged king who held on to truthfulness and righteousness begged his famed eldest son Rama to return the kingdom.
word_meanings: ततः then, सत्ये by truth, धर्मे by rigteousness, व्यवस्थितः one who held, स्थविरः aged, राजा king, रुदन् while crying, यशस्विनम् glorious one, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, पुत्रम् son, राज्यम् kingdom, अयाचत begged.

text: स पितुर्वचनं श्रीमानभिषेकात् परं प्रियम् । मनसा पूर्वमासाद्य वाचा प्रतिगृहीतवान् ॥५-३३-२५॥
translation: "The illustrious Rama who valued his father's word more than sovereignty, bowed to the command of the father.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् illustrious one, सः he, पितुः father's, वचनम् word, अभिषेकात् more than coronation, परम् supreme, प्रियम् dear, मनसा by his mind, पूर्वम् first, आसाद्य having accepted, वाचा by word, प्रतिगृहीतवान् accepted

text: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न ब्रूयात् किंचिदप्रियम् । अपि जीवितहेतोर्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ॥५-३३-२६॥
translation: "Rama, whose strength was his truthfulness, gave whatever others sought but would not accept anything in return. He would not speak a harsh word.
word_meanings: सत्यपराक्रमः one whose truthfulness was his strength, रामः Rama, दद्यात् he give,न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् he will not take, जीवितहेतोर्वा even for his life, किञ्चित् even a little, अप्रियम् harsh, न ब्रूयात् he will not speak .

text: स विहायोत्तरीयाणि महार्हाणि महायशाः । विसृज्य मनसा राज्यं जनन्यै मां समादिशत् ॥५-३३-२७॥
translation: "Having given up the kingdom voluntarily, Rama, a highly renowned king cast off his luxurious upper garments and asked me to take care of his mother.
word_meanings: महायशाः a highly renowned, सः he, महार्हाणि luxurious, उत्तरीयाणि upper garments, विहाय cast off, मनसा whole heartedly, राज्यम् kingdom, विसृज्य having given up, माम् me, जनन्यै to his mother, समादिशत् entrusted.

text: सा ऽहं तस्याग्रतस्तूर्णं प्रस्थिता वनचारिणी । न हि मे तेन हीनाया वासः स्वर्गे ऽपि रोचते ॥५-३३-२८॥
translation: "I, however resolved to live in the forest, marched ahead of him quickly as I did not prefer even heaven without him.
word_meanings: सा अहम् I myself, वनचारिणी a forestdweller, तूर्णम् quickly, तस्य his, अग्रतः ahead of him, प्रस्थिता started, तेन by him, हीनायाः separated, मे me, स्वर्गेऽपि न रोचते did not prefer even heaven.

text: प्रागेव तु महाभागः सौमित्रिर्मित्रनन्दनः । पूर्वजस्यानुयात्रार्थे द्रुमचीररैलङ्कृतः ॥५-३३-२९॥
translation: Already the noble Saumitri, delight of his friends, clad in bark garments, had set out to follow his elder brother.
word_meanings: महाभागः a noble one, मित्रनन्दनः a delight to friends, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, प्रागेव already, पूर्वजस्य eldest brother's, अनुयात्रार्थे to follow him, द्रुमचीरैः an bark, अलङ्कृतः dressed.

text: त वयं भर्तुरादेशं बहुमान्य दृढव्रताः । प्रविष्टाः स्म पुरा ऽदृष्टं वन गम्भीरदर्शनम् ॥५-३३-३०॥
translation: "Respecting the king's order and determined firmly, we entered the impenetrable forest.
word_meanings: ते then वयम् we, भर्तुः king's, आदेशम् order, बहुमान्य respecting, दृढव्रताः resolved firmly, पुरा in the past, अदृष्टम् not seen, गम्भीरदर्शनम् impenetrable, वनम् forest, प्रविष्टाः स्मः we entered.

text: वसतो दणऽडकारण्ये तस्याहममितौजसः । रक्षसा ऽपहृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥५-३३-३१॥
translation: "While the most valiant Rama was living in the Dandaka forest, I, his wife was borne away by the evilminded Ravana.
word_meanings: दण्डकारण्ये in the Dandaka forest, वसतः while living, अमितौजसः the most valiant, तस्य his, भार्या wife, अहम् am, दुरात्मना by evilminded, रावणेन by Ravana, अपहृता was abducted.

text: द्वौ मासौ तेन मे कालो जीवितानुग्रहः कृतः । ऊर्ध्वं द्वाभ्यां तु मासाभ्यां ततस्त्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम् ॥५-३३-३२॥
translation: "He has allowed me two months time to live. After two months I will have to give up my life." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तेन by him, द्वौ two, मासौ months, मे to me, जीवितानुग्रहः grant of time to live, कृतः given, ततः then, द्वाभ्याम् after the two, मासाभ्याम् months, ऊर्ध्वम् after that, जीवितम् life, त्यक्ष्यामि I will give up.

text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् हरियूथपः । दुःखाद्दुःखाभिभूतायाः सान्त्वमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ॥५-३४-१॥
translation: Hearing the words of Sita who was overwhelmed with grief, the monkey leader Hanuman felt sad and thus spoke comforting her:
word_meanings: हरिपुङ्गवः monkey leader, हनुमान् Hanuman, दुःखात् with sadness, दुःखाभिभूतायाः overwhelmed with grief, तस्याः to her, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सान्त्वम् comforting, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: अहं रामस्य सन्देशाद्देवि दूतस्तवागतः । वैदेहि कुशली रामस्त्वां च कौशलमब्रवीत् ॥५-३४-२॥
translation: "By the command of Rama I am here as a messenger. He is keeping well. He is well and wishes you well.
word_meanings: देवि O queen, वैदेहि Vaidehi, अहम् I am, रामस्य Rama's, सन्देशात् by order, तव your, दूतः messenger, आगतः reached, कुशली is well, रामः Rama, त्वां च and you, कुशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् wished you.

text: यो ब्राह्ममस्त्रं वेदांश्च वेद वेदविदां वरः । स त्वां दाशरथी रामो देवि कौशलमब्रवीत् ॥५-३४-३॥
translation: "O godlike lady Rama, son of Dasaratha, master of the Vedas, wielder of Brahmastra wishes you well.
word_meanings: देवि O godlike lady, वेदविदाम् mastered the Vedas, वरः choicest, यः he is, ब्रह्मम् अस्त्रम् weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra), वेदांश्च and Vedas, वेद knows, सः he, दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, त्वाम् you, कौशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् conveyed.

text: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा भर्तुस्ते ऽनुचरः प्रियः । कृतवाञ्छोकसन्तप्तः शिरसा ते ऽभिवादनम् ॥५-३४-४॥
translation: "The mighty Lakshmana too, a dear brother and follower of your husband is immersed in grief, and sends salutations to you."
word_meanings: महातेजाः very mighty, ते भर्तुः your husband, प्रियः dear, अनुचरः follower, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, शोकसन्तप्तः immersed in grief, शिरसा with his head in obeisance, ते to you, अभिवादनम् offers salutations, कृतवान् has done.

text: सा तयोः कुशलं देवी निशम्य नरसिंहयोः । प्रीतिसंहृष्टसर्वाङ्गी हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीत् ॥५-३४-५॥
translation: On hearing the wellbeing of Rama and Lakshman, lions among men, Sita experienced thrill all over her body. She then spoke to Hanuman:
word_meanings: सा देवी that queen, तयोः of both of them, नरसिंहयोः of lions among men, कुशलम् wellbeing, निशम्य on hearing, प्रीतिसंहृष्टसर्वाङ्गी overtaken by joy experienced in all her limbs, अथ then, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: कल्याणी बत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा । एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि ॥५-३४-६॥
translation: "The adage that 'joy comes to a living being even though it be at the end of a hundred years' is popular. It appears true in my case".
word_meanings: जीवन्तम् who lives, नरम् human being, वर्षशतादपि a hundred years, आनन्दः happiness, एति comes, इयम् this, लौकिकी popular, गाथा adage, कल्याणी is auspicious, मा to me, प्रतिभाति appears.

text: तया समागते तस्मिन् प्रीतिरुत्पादिता ऽद्भुता । परस्परेण चालापं विश्वस्तौ तौ प्रचक्रतुः ॥५-३४-७॥
translation: Hanuman thus created a sense of wonderful joy in her as they came together. Both of them started to converse restoring confidence in each other.
word_meanings: समागते when the meeting took place, तस्मिन् in him, तथा like that, अद्भुता wonderful, प्रीतिः pleasure, उत्पादिता was created, तौ in both, विश्वस्तौ confiding in the other, परस्परेण each to the other, आलापं च converse, चक्रतुः started.

text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् हरियूथपः । सीतायाः शोकदीनायाः समीपमुपचक्रमे ॥५-३४-८॥
translation: Hearing the reply of Sita, who was crying piteously, stricken with grief, the monkey leader, Hanuman moved close to her.
word_meanings: हरियूथपः leader of the monkey troops, हनुमान् Hanuman, शोकदीनायाः of the piteous lady stricken with grief, तस्याः her, सीतायाः Sita's, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा after hearing, समीपम् close by, उपचक्रमे moved.

text: यथा यथा समीपं स हनुमानुपसर्पति । तथा तथा रावणं सा तं सीता परिशङ्कते ॥५-३४-९॥
translation: As Hanuman started slowly drawing close, Sita suspected he might be Ravana.
word_meanings: सः हनुमान् Hanuman, यथा यथा slowly that way, समीपम् near, उपसर्पति started moving, तथा तथा in the same way, सा सीता that Sita, तम् him, रावणम् Ravana, परिशङ्कते suspected.

text: अहो धिग् दुष्कृतमिदं कथितं हि यदस्य मे । रूपान्तरमुपागम्य स एवायं हि रावणः ॥५-३४-१०॥
translation: "Ohshame on me. I have told him my story which should not have been said. This is verily Ravana come in a disguise".
word_meanings: अहो Oh, धिक् fie upon, मे to myself, इदम् this, अस्य to him, कथितम् story, दुष्कृतम् that which should not have been said, अयम् he, रूपान्तरम् in cognito, उपागम्य has come, सः रावणः हि verily he is Ravana.

text: तामशोकस्य शाखां सा विमुक्ता शोककर्शिता । तस्यामेवानवद्याङ्गी धरण्यां समुपाविशत् ॥५-३४-११॥
translation: So saying Sita of flawless limbs, emaciated with grief, left the branch of Ashoka tree held by her and squatted on the ground.
word_meanings: अनवद्याङ्गी who has flawless limbs, सा she, अशोकस्य Ashoka tree's, ताम् that, शाखाम् branch, विमुक्त्वा later leaving, शोककर्शिता emaciated out of sorrow, तस्याम् on that, धरण्यामेव on the ground, समुपाविशत् sat near.

text: हमुमानपि दुःखार्तां तां दृष्ट्वा भयमोहिताम् । अवन्दत महाबाहुस्ततस्तां जनकात्मजाम् । सा चैनं भयवित्रस्ता भूयो नैवाभ्युदैक्षत ॥५-३४-१२॥
