translation: "O Sita I swear in the name of mountains like Malaya, Vindhya, Meru, and Dardura (the abodes of monkeys and bears) and by the roots and fruits as well (which are the food of vanaras). you will soon behold Rama with beautiful eyes, red lips like bimba fruit, lovely earrings and a countenance resembling the full moon.
word_meanings: देवि O Sita, मलयेन च by Malaya mountain, विन्ध्येन by Vindhya, मेरुणा by Meru, दर्दुरेण by Dardura, मूलफलेन by roots and fruits, ते to you, शपे I swear, यथा as, सुनयनम् with beautiful eyes, वल्गु बिम्बोष्ठम् lips like bimba fruit, चारु कुण्डलम् with lovely earrings, उदितम् risen, पूर्णचन्द्रमिव like the fullmoon, रामस्य Rama's, मुखम् face, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यासि वैदेहि रामं प्रस्रवणे गिरौ । शतक्रतुमिवासीनं नाकपृष्ठस्य मूर्धनि ॥५-३६-४०॥
translation: "O Vaidehi, you will soon see Rama seated on the Prasravana mountain just as Indra (who performed a hundred sacrifices) seated on the back of the king of elephants.
word_meanings: वैदेहि Vaidehi, प्रस्रवणे गिरौ on mount Prasravana, रामम् Rama, नागराजस्य elephant's, मूर्धनि on the back, आसीनम् seated, शतक्रतुम् इव like Indra who has performed a hundred sacrifices, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: न मांसं राघवो भुङ्क्ते न चापि मधु सेवते । वन्यं सुविहितं नित्यं भक्तमश्नाति पञ्चमम् ॥५-३६-४१॥
translation: "Rama is not eating meat, nor drinking wine. He takes only the one fifth of a meal (sanctioned for an ascetic) available in the forest.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, मांसम् meat, न भुङक्ते not eating, मधुचापि even wine, न सेवते he is not taking, नित्यम् always, पञ्चमम् fifth meal, सुविहितम् prescribed for, वन्यम् available in the forest, भुक्तम् food, अश्नाति eats.

text: नैव दंशान्न मशकान् न कीटान्न सरीसृपान् । राघवो ऽपनयेद्गात्रात् त्वद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ॥५-३६-४२॥
translation: "Since you left, Rama has been always thinking sincerely of you, no longer drives away flies or mosquitoes nor insects or serpents from his body (his mind entirely fixed on you).
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, त्वद्गतेन thinking of you, अन्तरात्मना with heart, गात्रात् from his limbs, दंशान् flies, नैव अपनयेत् will not drive away, मशकान् mosquitoes, न not, कीटान् insects, न not, सरीसृपान् serpents, न not.

text: नित्यं ध्यानपरो रामो नित्यं शोकपरायणः । नान्यच्चिन्तयते किञ्चित् स तु कामवशं गतः ॥५-३६-४३॥
translation: "Rama is always lost in thought. He is totally given to grief. Absorbed in love for you, he thinks of none else৷৷
word_meanings: रामः Rama, नित्यम् ever, ध्यानपरः reflecting on you, नित्यम् ever, शोकपरायणः totally given to grief, सः he, कामवशं गतः absorbed in love for you, अन्यत् no other thoughts, न चिन्तयते he is not thinking.

text: अनिद्रः सततं रामः सुप्तो ऽपि च नरोत्तमः । सीतेति मधुरां वाणीं व्याहरन् प्रतिबुद्ध्यते ॥५-३६-४४॥
translation: "Rama, the best of men never goes to sleep and even if he drops off to sleep he mutters 'Sita, Sita' in a sweet voice in his sleep.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, सततम् always, अनिद्रः he does not sleep, नरोत्तमः best of men, सुप्तोऽपि even if he sleeps, सीतेति calling out 'Sita', मधुराम् sweet, वाणीम् voice, व्याहरन् uttering, प्रतिबुध्यते he wakes up.

text: दृष्ट्वा फलं वा पुष्पं वा यद्वा ऽन्यत् सुमनोहरम् । बहुशो हा प्रियेत्येवं श्वसंस्त्वामभिभाषते ॥५-३६-४५॥
translation: "Sighing deeply whenever Rama sees a fruit or a flower or any such delightful thing, he remembers you and calls you out again and again, saying, 'alas, my darling '
word_meanings: फलं वा fruit or, पुष्पं वा or flowers, यद्वा such similar, सुमनोहरम् delightful, अन्यत् any other thing, दृष्ट्वा seeing, श्वसन् while, हा प्रियेत्येवम् alas, darling, त्वाम् you, बहुशः in many, अभिभाषते speaks.

text: स देवि नित्यं परितप्यमानस्त्वामेव सीतेत्यभिभाषमाणः । दृढव्रतो राजसुतो महात्मा तवैव लाभाय कृतप्रयत्नः ॥५-३६-४६॥
translation: "O divine lady prince Rama is ceaselessly suffering. He keeps talking to you in air. The determined Rama is only thinking of your recovery ".
word_meanings: देवि godlike lady, महात्मा great self, सः Rama, राजसुतः son of a king, नित्यम् always, परितप्यमानः suffering, सीतेति saying Sita, त्वामेव you only, अभिभाषमाणः keeps talking in the air, धृतव्रतः firm in his decision, तव your, लाभाय to secure you only, कृतप्रयत्नः makes efforts.

text: सा रामसङ्कीर्तनवीतशोका रामस्य शोकेन समानशोका । शरन्मुखे साम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा निशेव वैदेहसुता बभूव ॥५-३६-४७॥
translation: Her sorrow was mitigated by references made by Hanuman about Rama.She felt equally sad when she heard about Rama's agony. The princess from Videha appeared like a night at the advent of autumn, with the Moon looking partly muffled by clouds and partly bright. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: रामस्य Rama's, शोकेन because of his sorrow, समानशोका equally sad, रामसङ्कीर्तनवीतशोका devoid of sorrow on hearing about Rama, सा she, वैदेहसुता the daughter of Videha, शरन्मुखे at the advent of autumn, साम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा Moon muffled by clouds, निशेव like the night, बभूव appeared.

text: सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना । हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः ॥५-३७-१॥
translation: To the righteous words (about Rama's grief) of Hanuman, Sita with a face like the full moon replied.
word_meanings: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना face like the full moon, सीता Sita, तद्वचनम् that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदम् this, धर्मार्थसहितम् full of righteousness, वचः word, उवाच spoke.

text: अमृतं विषसंसृष्टं त्वया वानरभाषितम् । यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः ॥५-३७-२॥
translation: "O vanara you have told me that Rama has his mind always fixed on me, not on others and you have also said that he is sad. It is like offering me poison mixed with nectar.
word_meanings: वानर O vanara, रामः Rama, अन्यमनाः न not thinking of others, इति यत् that way, इति च यत् and this way also (that he is sad), त्वया by you, भाषितम् spoken, विषसंसृष्टम् mixed with poison, अमृतम् nectar.

text: ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे । रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति ॥५-३७-३॥
translation: "Death snatches a man tied with a cord, whether he is rolling in luxury or sinking in adversity.
word_meanings: कृतान्तः death, पुरुषम् a man, रज्ज्वा with a cord, बद्ध्वा इव like tying, सुविस्त्रीर्णे in the great, ऐश्वर्ये वा in fortune, सुदारुणे deeply sunk, व्यसने वा in adversity, परिकर्षति will snatch.

text: विधिर्नूनमसंहार्थः प्राणिनां प्लवगोत्तम । सौमित्रिं मां च रामं च व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितान् ॥५-३७-४॥
translation: "O best of vanaras surely it is not possible for living beings to overcome destiny. You see how Sri Rama, Saumitri, and my own self are all afflicted with grief.
word_meanings: प्लवगोत्तम O best of vanaras, प्राणिनाम् for living beings, नूनम् surely, विधिः destiny, असंहार्यः it cannot be overcome, व्यसनैः with sorrows, मोहितान् afflicted, सौमित्रिम् Saumitri, मां च me too, रामं च Rama also, पश्य you see.

text: शोकस्यास्य कदा पारं राघवो ऽधिगमिष्यति । प्लवमानः परिश्रान्तो हतनौः सागरे यथा ॥५-३७-५॥
translation: "When will Raghava reach the shore of this ocean of grief? He is like a man who has suffered a ship wreck, trying to swim?
word_meanings: सागरे in the ocean, हतनौः in shipwreck, प्लवमानः while getting drowned, परिश्रान्तः यथा who has suffered, राघवः Rama, अस्य of this, शोकस्य from grief, पारम् the shore, कदा when, अधिगमिष्यति will he reach.

text: राक्षसानां वधं कृत्वा सूदयित्वा च रावणम् । लङ्कामुन्मूलितां कृत्वा कदा द्रक्ष्यति मां पतिः ॥५-३७-६॥
translation: "When will my husband see me after killing the demons including Ravana and uprooting Lanka?
word_meanings: पतिः husband, राक्षसानाम् of all the demons, वधम् killing, कृत्वा after doing, रावणं च and Ravana, सूदयित्वा after killing, लङ्काम् Lanka, उन्मूलिताम् uprooting, कृत्वा after doing, माम् कदा when me, द्रक्ष्यति he will see.

text: स वाच्यः सन्त्वरस्वेति यावदेव न पूर्यते । अयं संवत्सरः कालस्तावद्धि मम जीवितम् ॥५-३७-७॥
translation: "One year's time has been given (by Ravana) to me. Rama should be informed to be quick in reaching before the completion of the time limit and that I will survive till then only.
word_meanings: अयम् this, संवत्सरः कालः one year's time, यावदेव until then, न पूर्यते before it is completed, संत्वरस्वेति you may be quick, सः he, वाच्यः he should be informed, मम I, जीवितम् life, तावद्धि till then only.

text: वर्तते दशमो मासो द्वौ तु शेषौ प्लवङ्गम । रावणेन नृशंसेन समयो यः कृतो मम ॥५-३७-८॥
translation: "O vanara this is the end of the tenth month. Only two more months are left. This is the condition laid by the wicked Ravana in my case.
word_meanings: प्लवङ्गम O vanara, नृशंसेन रावणेन by the wicked Ravana, मम to me, यः such, समयः time, कृतः given, दशमः tenth, मासः month, वर्तते is running, द्वौ तु two only, शेषौ remain.

text: विभीषणेन च भ्रात्रा मम निर्यातनं प्रति । अनुनीतः प्रयत्नेन न च तत् कुरुते मतिम् ॥५-३७-९॥
translation: "Vibhisana made efforts to advise Ravana for my restoration. But Ravana has not agreed to that.
word_meanings: भ्रात्रा by the brother, विभीषणेन by Vibhisana, मम my, निर्यातनं प्रति for my restoration, प्रयत्नेन made efforts, अनुनीतः he was advised gently, तत् such, मतिम् thought, न कुरुते he has not agreed.

text: मम प्रतिप्रदानं हि रावणस्य न रोचते । रावणं मार्गते सङ्ख्ये मृत्युः कालवशं गतम् ॥५-३७-१०॥
translation: "Ravana did not like to return me having fallen into the death trap. Death lies in wait for him in battle.
word_meanings: मम my, प्रतिप्रदानम् returning, रावणस्य to Ravana, न रोचते is not liked, कालवशं गतम् fallen into the trap of time, रावणम् Ravana, संख्ये in a battle, मृत्युः death, मार्गते is searching.

text: ज्येष्टा कन्या ऽनला नाम विभीषणसुता कपे । तया ममेदमाख्यातं मात्रा प्रहितया स्वयम् ॥५-३७-११॥
translation: "O vanara Nala the eldest daughter of Vibhisana sent by her mother came here personally and reported this to me.
word_meanings: कपे O vanara, नला Nala, ज्येष्ठा eldest daughter, विभीषणसुता daughter of Vibhisana, मात्रा प्रहितया sent by her mother, तया by her, स्वयम् personally, इदम् here, मम to me, आख्यातम् reported.

text: असंशयं हरिश्रेष्ठ क्षिप्रं मां प्राप्स्यते पतिः । अन्तरात्मा हि मे शुद्धस्तस्मिंश्च बहवो गुणाः ॥५-३७-१२॥
translation: "O eminent vanara no doubt my lord will soon reach this place. My pure conscience tells me that Rama has many virtues.
word_meanings: हरिश्रेष्ठ O eminent vanara, पतिः my lord, क्षिप्रम् soon, माम् me, असंशयम् no doubt, प्राप्स्यति he will reach, मे my, अन्तरात्मा च inner self also, शुद्धः pure, तस्मिंश्च in that, बहवः many, गुणाः are virtues.

text: उत्साहः पौरुषं सत्त्वमानृशंस्यं कृतज्ञता । विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च सन्ति वानर राघवे ॥५-३७-१३॥
translation: "O vanara Rama is endowed with perseverance, manliness, prowess, kindness, gratitude, competence and power.
word_meanings: वानरvanara, राघवे in Rama, उत्साहः perseverance, पौरुषम् manliness, सत्त्वम् prowess, अनृशंस्यम् kindness, कृतज्ञता gratitude, विक्रमश्च competence, प्रभावश्च power, सन्ति endowed.

text: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः । जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत् ॥५-३७-१४॥
translation: "At Janasthana without the help of his brother also he slew fourteen thousand demons. Which enemy will not tremble before him?
word_meanings: यः whoever, जनस्थाने in Janasthana, विना भ्रात्रा without his brother also, राक्षसानाम् demons, चतुर्दशसहस्राणि fourteen thousand, जघान slew, तस्य his, कः who, शत्रुः enemy, नोद्विजेत् will not tremble.

text: न स शक्यस्तुलयितुं व्यसनैः पुरुषर्षभः । अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञाशक्रस्येव पुलोमजा ॥५-३७-१५॥
translation: "O bull among men he will not be shaken by calamities. Just as Sachi, the daughter of Puloma knows Indra's might I know Rama's.
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, सः he, व्यसनैः in calamities, तुलयितुम् shaken, न शक्यः not possible, पुलोमजा daughter of Puloma, शक्रस्येव just as Indra, अहम् I, तस्य his, प्रभावज्ञा know his might.

text: शरजालांशुमाञ्छूरः कपे रामदिवाकरः । शत्रुरक्षोमयं तोयमुपशोषं नयिष्यति ॥५-३७-१६॥
translation: "O monkey the valiant Rama is like the Sungod shoofing a dazzling volley of arrows which will dry up the sea of enemy forces."
word_meanings: कपे O monkey, शूरः valiant, रामदिवाकर: Rama the Sun, शरजालांशुमान् with his volley of dazzling arrows, शत्रुरक्षोमयम् enemy forces of the demons, तोयम् water, उपशोषम् will dry up, नयिष्यति will effect.

text: इति संजल्पमानां तां रामार्थे शोककर्शिताम् । अश्रुसम्पूर्णनयनामुवाच वचनं कपिः ॥५-३७-१७॥
translation: While Sita, tormented with grief on account of Rama was thus speaking, her eyes filled with tears, the monkey said:
word_meanings: इति thus, सञ्जल्पमानाम् while she was speaking freely, रामार्थे on account of Rama, शोककर्शिताम् emaciated with sorrow, अश्रु सम्पूर्णनयनाम् her eyes filled with tears, ताम् her, कपिः vanara, वचनम् word, उवाच spoke.

text: कृत्वैव तु वयो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः । चमूं प्रकर्षन् महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम् ॥५-३७-१८॥
translation: "On hearing me Rama will reach soon with a huge army of vanaras and bears.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, श्रुत्वैव तु after hearing this, वचः word, मह्यं by me, क्षिप्रम् soon, ऐष्यति he will reach, चमूं an army, प्रकर्षन् while leading, महतीं huge, हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम् with an army of vanaras and bears.

text: अथवा मोचयिष्यामि त्वामद्यैव वरानने । अस्माद्दुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते ॥५-३७-१९॥
translation: "O beautiful lady, if you please, I shall redeem you today itself from grief. You may ride on my back, O blameless lady.
word_meanings: अथवा or, वरानने O lady with a beautiful face, त्वाम् you, अद्यैव now itself, अस्मात् from this, दुःखात् from grief, मोचयिष्यामि I shall redeem you, अनिन्दिते O blameles one, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, उपारोह you may ascend.

text: त्वां तु पृष्ठगतां कृत्वा सन्तरिष्यामि सागरम् । शक्तिरस्ति हि मे वोढुं लङ्कामपि सरावणाम् ॥५-३७-२०॥
translation: "Placing you on my back I shall cross the ocean. Indeed, I have the capacity to carry the entire city of Lanka along with Ravana.
word_meanings: त्वाम् you, पृष्ठगताम् placing you on my back, कृत्वा on doing so, सागरम् ocean, सन्तरिष्यामि I can cross over, सरावणाम् along with Ravana, लङ्कामपि even Lanka, वोढुम् to carry, मे to me, शक्ति capacity, अस्ति हि indeed I have.

text: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव वैदेहि राघवं सह लक्ष्मणम् । व्यवसायसमायुक्तं विष्णुं दैत्यवदे यथा ॥५-३७-२१॥
translation: "O Vaidehi you will see Rama and Lakshmana making all out efforts like Lord Visnu to kill the demons.
word_meanings: वैदेहि Vaidehi, दैत्यवधे in the killing of demons, व्यवसायसमायुक्तम् making all out efforts, विष्णुं यथा like Visnu, सहलक्ष्मणम् together with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, अद्यैव right now, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहमाश्रमस्थं महाबलम् । पुरन्दरमिवासीनं नाकराजस्य मूर्धनि ॥५-३७-२२॥
translation: Mighty Rama staying in asram ill be enthused to see you seated on my back like Lord Purandara (Indra) seated on the back of the lord of elephants (Airavata)
word_meanings: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहम् enthused in seeing you, आश्रमस्थम् staying in his asram, महाबलम् mighty, नागराजस्य of the king of elephants Airavatam, मूर्धनि on the back, आसीनम् seated, पुरन्दरमिव like the destroyer of citadels (Indra).

text: पृष्ठमारोह मे देवि मा विकाङ्क्षस्व शोभने । योगमन्विच्छ रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी ॥५-३७-२३॥
translation: "O god like lady climb up my back. Do not be reluctant. Join Rama just as Rohini unites with the Moon, O beautiful one
word_meanings: देवि O god like lady, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, आरोह climb up, शोभने O beautiful one, मा विकाङ्क्षस्व do not be reluctant, रोहिणी Rohini, शशाङ्केनेव like joining with the Moon, रामेण with Rama, योगम् union, अन्विच्छ you may become.

text: कथयन्तीव चन्द्रेण सूर्येण च महार्चिषा । मत्पृष्टमधिरुह्य त्वं तराकाशमहार्णवौ ॥५-३७-२४॥
translation: "Climb on my back and cross the ocean through space in the flaming light, conversing with Moon and Sun.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, मत्पृष्ठम् my back, अधिरुह्य after climbing up, चन्द्रेण with the Moon, महार्चिषा flaming light, सूर्येण with the Sun, कथयन्तीव conversing, आकाशमहार्णवौ sky and ocean, तर cross.

text: न हि मे संप्रयातस्य त्वामितो नयतो ऽङ्गने । अनुगन्तुं गतिं शक्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः ॥५-३७-२५॥
translation: "O beautiful lady it is not possible for all the inhabitants of Lanka together to follow me while I carry you from this place.
word_meanings: अङ्गने O beautiful lady, त्वाम् you, इतः from the place, नयतः while carrying, सम्प्रयातस्य joined together, मे my, गतिम् speed, अनुगन्तुम् to follow me, सर्वे all, लङ्कानिवासिनः the inhabitants of Lanka, न शक्ताः not possible for any one.

text: यथैवाहमिह प्राप्तस्तथैवाहमसंशयः । यास्यामि पश्य वैदेहि त्वामुद्यम्य विहायसम् ॥५-३७-२६॥
translation: "O Vaidehi just as I reached here I shall beyond doubt take you on my back in the same way across the sky without any difficulty. See.
word_meanings: वैदेहि Vaidehi, यथैवाहमिह just as I reached here, प्राप्तस्तथैव in the same way I reached, अहम I, त्वामुद्यम्य taking you on my back, यास्यामि will go, विहायसम् across the sky, नसंशयः no doubt, पश्य you may see.

text: मैथिली तु हरिश्रेष्ठात् श्रुत्वा वचनमद्भुतम् । हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीत् ॥५-३७-२७॥
translation: When Mythili heard the wonderful proposal from Hanuman, the best of vanaras, she experienced immense joy in every limb of her body and said:
word_meanings: मैथिली तु Mythili also, हरिश्रेष्ठात् from the best of vanaras, अद्भुतम् wonderful, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी experienced immense joy in every limb of her body, अथ then, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, अब्रवीत् said.

text: हनुमन् दूरमध्वानं कथं मां वोढुमिच्छसि । तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप ॥५-३७-२८॥
translation: "Hanuman how do you intend to carry me to such a distant place? Indeed, it is your monkey nature, I suppose.
word_meanings: हनुमन् Hanuman, दूरम् distant, अध्वानम् path, माम् me, वोढुम् carry, कथम् how, इच्छसि you intend, हरियूथप O leader of vanaras, ते you, कपित्वम् monkey nature, तदेव खलु indeed that is, मन्ये I think.

text: कथं वा ऽल्पशरीरस्त्वं मामितो नेतुमिच्छसि । सकाशं मानवेन्द्रस्य भर्तुर्मे प्लवगर्षभ ॥५-३७-२९॥
translation: "O bull among monkeys you have such a small body. How can you intend to carry me from here to my husband, the lord of men"?
word_meanings: प्लवगर्षभ O bull among monkeys, अल्पशरीरः small body, त्वम् you, इतः from here, मे my, भर्तुः to my husband, मानवेन्द्रस्य lord of men, सकाशम् presence of, नेतुम् to carry, कथं वा how is it, इच्छसि you intend.

text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । चिन्तयामास लक्ष्मीवान् नवं परिभवं कृतम् ॥५-३७-३०॥
translation: On hearing Sita's new belittling statement about him, Hanuman, the illustrious son of the Windgod reflected:
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, लक्ष्मीवान् illustrious one, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, नवम् new, परिभवम् कृतम् insult hurled, चिन्तयामास he thought.

text: न मे जानाति सत्त्वं वा प्रभावं वा ऽसितेक्षणा । तस्मात् पश्यतु वैदही यद्रूपं मम कामतः ॥५-३७-३१॥
translation: 'Blackeyed Sita is not aware of my strength or my power. Therefore let her see the real (huge) form that I can assume at my free will'.
word_meanings: असितेक्षणा blackeyed, वैदेही Vaidehi, मे my, सत्त्वं वा strength, प्रभावं वा my power, न जानाति she is not aware, तस्मात् therefore, कामतः freely, मम my, यत् that real, रूपम् form, पश्यतु see.

text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः । दर्शयामास वैदेह्याः स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः ॥५-३७-३२॥
translation: Thinking thus, Hanuman, the noble monkey, crusher of enemies, started revealing his real form to Vaidehi.
word_meanings: प्लवगसत्तमः the noble monkey, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies,हनुमान् Hanuman, इति in that way, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking that way, तदा then, स्वरूपम् his real form, वैदेह्याः to Vaidehi, दर्शयामास he revealed.

text: स तस्मात् पादपाद्धीमानाप्लुत्य प्लवगर्षभः । ततो वर्धितुमारेभे सीताप्रत्ययकारणात् ॥५-३७-३३॥
translation: The wise bull among monkeys, jumped down from the tree and started growing in size in order to instil confidence in Sita.
word_meanings: धीमान् wise, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, सः he, तस्मात् पादपात् from the tree, अप्लुत्य jumping down, ततः from there, सीताप्रत्ययकारणात् in order to instil confidence in Sita, वर्धितुम् to grow in size, आरेभे started.

text: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशो बभौ दीप्तानलप्रभः । अग्रतो व्यवतस्थे च सीताया वानरोत्तमः ॥५-३७-३४॥
translation: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras resembling mount Meru or Mandara stood there glowing like blazing fire in front of Sita.
word_meanings: वानरोत्तमः foremost among vanaras, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशः like mount Meru or Mandara, दीप्तानलप्रभः glowing like blazing fire, बभौ appeared, सीतायाः Sita's, अग्रतः in front, व्यवतस्थे च and stood there.

text: हरिः पर्वतसङ्काशस्ताम्रवक्त्रो महाबलः । वज्रदंष्ट्रनखो भीमो वैदेहीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥५-३७-३५॥
translation: Resembling a mountain in size, with a red face, with teeth and nails strong like diamond, the vanara in dreadful form said to Vaidehi:
word_meanings: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling a mountain, ताम्रवक्त्रः one who has a red face, महाबलः very strong, वज्रदंष्ट्रनखः teeth and nails as strong as diamonds, भीम: dreadful, हरिः vanara, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

text: सपर्वतवनोद्देशां साट्टप्रकारतोरणाम् । लङ्कामिमां सनाथां व नयितुं शक्तिरस्ति मे ॥५-३७-३६॥
translation: "I have the capacity to carry away this entire Lanka uprooted with its mountains, gardens, forts, ramparts and gateways along with the king.
word_meanings: सपर्वतवनोद्देशाम् filled with mountains and gardens, साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् forts, ramparts and gateways, सनाथाम् along with its king, इमाम् this, लङ्कां वा Lanka itself, नयितुम् carried away, मे my, शक्ति: capacity, अस्ति is there.

text: तदवस्थाप्यतां बुद्धिरलं देवि विकाङ्क्षया । विशोकं कुरु वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम् ॥५-३७-३७॥
translation: "O queen it is enough. Give up this unworthy attitude. Be stable. O Vaidehi, rid Lakshmana and Rama of grief".
word_meanings: देवि queen, तत् so, विकाङ्क्ष्या with unworthy attitude, अलम् enough, बुद्धि: intellect, अवस्थाप्यताम् be stable, वैदेहि Vaidehi, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, विशोकम् rid of sorrow, कुरु do.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसङ्काशमुवाच जनकात्मजा । पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी मारुतस्यौरसं सुतम् ॥५-३७-३८॥
translation: Seeing the son of Maruta in dreadful form, the broad lotus petaleyed daughter of Janaka with eyes as large as lotus petals replied :
word_meanings: पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी with eyes large like lotus petals, जनकात्मा daughter of Janaka, भीमसङ्काशम् dreadful to viewers, मारुतस्य Maruta's, औरसं सुतम् own son, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, उवाच said.

text: तव सत्त्वं बलं चैव विजानामि महाकपे । वायोरिव गतिं चापि तेजश्चाग्नेरिवाद्भुतम् ॥५-३७-३९॥
translation: "O great monkey I have understood your strength and power. Your speed is like the Windgod's and your power is astonishing and splendid.
word_meanings: महाकपे O great monkey, तव your, सत्त्वम् strength, बलं चैव and power, वायोरिव like the Windgod's, गतिम् speed, आग्नेरिव like fire's, अद्भुतम् astonishing, तेजश्च splendour, विजानामि I have understood

text: प्राकृतो ऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति । उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरपुङ्गव ॥५-३७-४०॥
translation: "O chief of vanaras how could an ordinary person be capable of reaching this land on far off shore of the immeasurable ocean?
word_meanings: वानरपुङ्गव O chief of vanaras, प्राकृतः an ordinary one, अन्यः other, अप्रमेयस्य of an immeasurable one, उदधेः ocean's, पारम् far off shore, इमाम् this, भूमिम् this land, आगन्तुम् reach, कथम् how, अर्हति fit.

text: जानामि गमने शक्तिं नयने चापि ते मम । अवश्यं संप्रधार्याशु कार्यसिद्धिर्महात्मनः ॥५-३७-४१॥
translation: "I know you are capable of carrying me on your journey. I am sure about the quick success of your mission which has been carried out after careful planning.
word_meanings: गमने in making the journey, मम me, नयने in taking, शक्तिम् power, जानामि I know, महात्मनः of the great soul, कार्यसिददि success of the mission, अवश्यम् surely, आशु immediately, सम्प्रधार्या after planning properly

text: अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मम गन्तुं त्वया ऽनघ । वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव ॥५-३७-४२॥
translation: "O sinless and foremost monkey going with you is not proper for me. Your windlike speed will render me unconscious.
word_meanings: अनघ sinless one, कपिश्रेष्ठ foremost monkey, त्वया by you, मम my, गन्तुम् to go with, अयुक्तम् not proper, वायुवेगसवेगस्य of a person with the speed of the wind, तव your, वेगः speed, माम् me, मोहयेत् will render me unconscious.

text: अहमाकाशमापन्ना ह्युपर्युपरि सागरम् । प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयाद् वेगेन गच्छतः ॥५-३७-४३॥
translation: "When you fly over the ocean in the sky speedily I may tumble down from your back by your speed out of fear.
word_meanings: सागरम् उपर्युपरि above the ocean, आकाशम् sky, अहम् I, वेगेन speedily, गच्छतः when you go, ते your, पृष्ठात् from the back, भयात् out of fear, आपन्ना when I reach, प्रपतेयम् I may tumble down.

text: पतिता सागरे चाहं तिमिनक्रझषाकुले । भवेयमाशु विवशा यादसामन्नमुत्तमम् ॥५-३७-४४॥
translation: Fallen into the ocean teeming with whales, crocodiles and fish, I should at once become, helpless, excellent food for the aquatic creatures.
word_meanings: तिमिनक्रझषाकुले filled with whales, crocodiles and fish, सागरे in the ocean, पतिता fallen in, अहम् I, विवशा helpless, आशु immediately, यादसाम् of aquatic animals, उत्तमम् very good, अन्नम् food, भवेयम् I will be.

text: न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन । कलत्रवति सन्देहस्त्वय्यपि स्यादसंशयः ॥५-३७-४५॥
translation: "O destroyer of foes, it is not possible for me to go with you. Further, when you are burdened with a woman you will also fall into danger (because of me), no doubt.
word_meanings: शत्रुविनाशन O destroyer of foes, त्वया सार्थम् along with you, गन्तुम् to go, न शक्ष्ये च I have no power, कलत्रवति when burdened with a woman, त्वय्यपि with you also, संदेहः doubt, स्यात् may be, असंशयः there is no doubt.

text: ह्रियमाणं तु मां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः । अनुगच्छेयुरादिष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥५-३७-४६॥
translation: "When I am seen (while being carried away) by the demons of fearsome valour they will pursue you, ordered by the wicked Ravana.
word_meanings: ह्रियमाणाम् while I am, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, भीमविक्रमाः of fearsome valour, राक्षसाः demons, दुरात्मना by evilminded, रावणेन by Ravana, आदिष्टाः ordered, अनुगच्छेयुः they will pursue

text: तैस्त्वं परिवृतः शूरैः शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः । भवेस्त्वं संशयं प्राप्तो मया वीर कलत्रवान् ॥५-३७-४७॥
translation: "O heroic monkey as the warriors armed with spears and maces surround you and attack, your life will be in danger, because of me.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः by those wielding spears and mace, तैः by them, शूरैः by warriors, परिवृतः surrounded, वीर O hero, मया by me, कलत्रवान् one who has a wife, त्वम् you, संशयम् doubt, प्राप्तः have been, भवेः you.

text: सायुधा बहवो व्योम्नि राक्षसास्त्वं निरायुधः । कथं शक्ष्यसि संयातुं मां चैव परिरक्षितुम् ॥५-३७-४८॥
translation: "The demons are in large number and they will be armed with weapons. You are unarmed. How can you fight and protect me?
word_meanings: व्योम्नि in the sky, सायुधाः will be armed with weapons, राक्षसाः demons, बहवः many, त्वम् you, निरायुधः unarmed, संयातुम् to fight, माम् me, परिरक्षितुं च and safeguard, कथम् how, शक्ष्यसि you will be capable?

text: युद्ध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्तव तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः । प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद् भयार्ता कपिसत्तम ॥५-३७-४९॥
translation: "O noble monkey while you are engaged in fighting with those demons of wicked deeds, I may drop down out of fear.
word_meanings: कपिसत्तम O noble monkey, तव your, क्रूरकर्मभिः by those of wicked deeds, तैः by them, रक्षोभिः by the demons, युध्यमानस्य for you while engaged in fighting, भयार्ता out of fear, ते your, पृष्ठात् from the back, प्रपतेयं हि I will drop down.

text: अथ रक्षांसि भीमानि महान्ति बलवन्ति च । कथंचित् साम्पराये त्वां जयेयुः कपिसत्तम ॥५-३७-५०॥
translation: "O noble monkey the massive, fearsome and powerful demons may defeat you in the fight in any way.
word_meanings: कपिसत्तम O noble monkey, अथ then, भीमानि fearsome, महान्ति massive, बलवन्ति च powerful, रक्षांसि demons, सांपराये in the fight, कथञ्चित् in any case, त्वाम् you, जयेयुः win over.

text: अथवा युद्ध्यमानस्य पतेयं विमुखस्य ते । पतितां च गृहीत्वा मां नयेयुः पापराक्षसाः ॥५-३७-५१॥
translation: "Or else, while you are engaged in fighting and turn your attention the other way I might fall down and the sinful ogres may bear me away.
word_meanings: अथवा or else, युध्यमानस्य for you while engaged in the fighting, ते for you, विमुखस्य while you turn your attention other way, पतेयम् I may fall down, पतिताम् when I have fallen down, माम् me, गृहीत्वा taking hold, पापराक्षसाः wretched rakshasas, नयेयुः may take me away.

text: मां वा हरेयुस्त्वद्धस्ताद् विशसेयुरथापि वा । अव्यवस्थौ हि दृश्येते युद्धे जयपराजयौ ॥५-३७-५२॥
translation: "They may snatch me away from your hands or cut me to pieces. Success or defeat is uncertain in a war.
word_meanings: त्वत् हस्तात् from your hand, माम् me, हरेयुः they may take one away, अथापि वा or rather, विशसेयुः may cut me, युद्धे in the fight, जयपराजयौ success or failure, अव्यवस्थौ not sure, दृश्येते हि they appear.

text: अहं वापि विपद्येयं रक्षोभिरभितर्जिता । त्वत्प्रयत्नो हरिश्रोष्ठ भवेन्निष्फल एव तु ॥५-३७-५३॥
translation: "In such a case, caught and intimidated by the demons I may die. Then your efforts will be wasted.
word_meanings: रक्षोभिः caught by the ogres, अभितर्जिता very much threatened, अहम् I, विपद्येयं वापि or else I may die, हरिश्रेष्ठ best of monkeys, त्वत्प्रयत्नः your effort, निष्फल एव will be wasteful, तु indeed, भवेत् may be.

text: कामं त्वमसि पर्याप्तौ निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान् । राघवस्य यशो हीयेत्त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः ॥५-३७-५४॥
translation: "It may be that you can kill all the demons but by such an act the fame of Rama will be diminished. (He cannot give his strength a trial)
word_meanings: त्वम् you, सर्वराक्षसान् all the ogres, निहन्तुम् to slay, पर्याप्तः अपि कामम् it may be you can do the task, त्वया by you, शस्तै by those killed, राक्षसैः by demons, राघवस्य Rama's, यशः fame, हीयेत् will diminish.

text: अथवा ऽ ऽदाय रक्षांसि न्यसेयुः संवृते हि माम् । यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवौ । आरम्भस्तु मदर्थो ऽयं ततस्तव निरर्थकः ॥५-३७-५५॥
translation: "Or else, the ogres will carry me and conceal me in a secret place which the vanaras or Rama and Lakshmana may not know.
word_meanings: अथवा or else, रक्षांसि the ogres, माम् me, आदाय after taking, यत्र where, ते हरयः those of you vanaras, राघवौ अपि and even Rama and Lakshmana, नाभिजानीयुः may not know, संवृते in a secret place, न्यसेयु: they may hide.

text: त्वया हि सह रामस्य महानागमने गुणः ॥५-३७-५६॥
translation: "All your effort for my sake would be futile. Hence Rama's arrival along with you will be of great benefit.
word_meanings: ततः then, मदर्थः for my sake, तव your, आरम्भस्तु effort, निरर्थकः futile, त्वया सह along with you, रामस्य Rama, आगमने coming here, महान् great, गुणः merit.

text: मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः । भ्रातऽणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च ॥५-३७-५७॥
translation: "O strongarmed Hanuman your life and the life of the great self Rama, of his brother, and relatives of your king is dependent upon my survival.
word_meanings: महाबाहो strongarmed one, महात्मनः of the great self, राघवस्य Rama's, भ्रात्रूणाम् of his brothers, तव your, राजकुलस्य of the relatives of your king, जीवितम् life, मयि in me, आयत्तम् is dependent.

text: तौ निराशौ मदर्थं तु शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ । सह सर्वर्क्षहरिभिस्त्यक्ष्यतः प्राणसंग्रहम् ॥५-३७-५८॥
translation: "Both Rama and Lakshmana who are emaciated with sorrow and suffering on account of me will give up their lives along with vanaras and bears.
word_meanings: मदर्थम् for my sake, शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ emaciated with sorrow and suffering, तौ they both, निराशौ with no hope of finding me, सर्वर्क्षहरिभिः सह along with all vanaras and bears, प्राणसङ्ग्रहम् the five elements of which life is made, त्यक्ष्यतः will give up.

text: भर्तृमक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर । न स्पृशामि शरीरं तु पुंसो वाररपुङ्गवः ॥५-३७-५९॥
translation: "O chief of vanaras I cherish my devotion towards Rama alone and not touch the body of any other man.
word_meanings: वानरपुङ्गव O chief of vanaras, वानर vanara, भर्तुः husband's, भक्तिम् devotion, पुरस्कृत्य after cherishing, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य other, पुंसः man's, शरीरं तु body, न स्पृशामि I do not touch.

text: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं रावणस्य बलाद्गता । अनीशा किं करिष्यामि विनाथा विवशा सती ॥५-३७-६०॥
translation: "I had no control over myself. I was helpless and my husband was not present when I had to bear the touch of Ravana's limbs. What can I do?
word_meanings: अहम् I, बलात् by force, रावणस्य Ravana's, गात्रसंस्पर्शम् touch of his body, गता यत् that I had to experience, अनीशा having no control over my self, विवशा सती a helpless woman, विनाथा without my husband, किं करिष्यामि what can I do?

text: यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्वा सबान्धवम् । मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ॥५-३७-६१॥
translation: "It will be proper if Rama comes here, kills Ravana along with all his relations and takes me away.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, सबान्धवम् along with his relations, दशग्रीवम् Ravana, इह here, हत्त्वा after killing, माम् me, इतः from here, गृह्य taking, गच्छेत यदि and if he goes, तत् then, तस्य his, सदृशम् proper, भवेत् it will be.

text: श्रुता हि दृष्टाश्च मया पराक्रमा महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः । न देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसा भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे ॥५-३७-६२॥
translation: "I have seen and heard about Rama's conquest of enemies and his valiant deeds in war. Indeed, gods gandharvas, nagas or even demons cannot match him in war.
word_meanings: रणावमर्दिनः of the crusher of enemies, महात्मनः great self, तस्य his, पराक्रमाः valiant deeds, मया by me, श्रुताः heard, दृष्टाश्च witnessed, संयुगे in war, देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसाः whether gods, gandharvas, nagas or demons, रामेण by Rama, समाः equal, नहि not indeed.

text: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकं महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम् । सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम् ॥५-३७-६३॥
translation: "After seeing Rama who is equal to lord Indra in valour. He is like blazing fire whipped by wind, wielding a wonderful bow, who can withstand the power of strong Rama accompanied by Lakshmana in war?
word_meanings: चित्रकार्मुकम् wielder of a powerful bow, महाबलम् endowed with great strength, वासवतुल्यविक्रमम् equal to Vasava in valour, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, अनिलेरितम् whipped by wind, दीप्तम् blazing, हुताशनमिव like the fire, तं राघवम् him, Rama, सयति in war, समीक्ष्य facing, कः who, विषहेतः can withstand.

text: सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम् । सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम् ॥५-३७-६४॥
translation: "O chief of vanaras who can withstand Rama accompanied by Lakshmana, the conqueror of enemies? His arrows resemble the rays of the Sun at the time of the deluge, steady like the elephants who support the quarters of the earth.
word_meanings: वानरमुख्य chief of vanaras, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, आजिमर्दनम् crusher of enemies in war, मत्तम् intoxicated, दिशागजमिव like the elephant supporting quarter of the earth, व्यवस्थितम् steady, शरार्चिषम् arrows of rays, युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमम् resembling the Sun at the at the time of the deluge, राघवम् Rama, संयुगे in a war, कः who, सहेत can withstand.

text: स मे हरिश्रेष्ठ सलक्ष्मणं पतिं सयूथपं क्षिप्रमिहोपपादय । चिराय रामं प्रति शोककर्शितां कुरुष्व मां वानरमुख्य हर्षिताम् ॥५-३७-६५॥
ततः सकपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः । सीतामुवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं वक्यविशारदः ॥५-३८-१॥
translation: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:
word_meanings: ततः then, वाक्यविशारदः eloquent in speech, सः कपिशार्दूलः tiger among monkeys, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तेन वाक्येन by those words, तोषितः contented with, सीताम् to Sita, उवाच said.

text: युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने । सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च ॥५-३८-२॥
translation: "O queen O lady of auspicious appearance your words are most appropriate to and characteristic of a modest virtuous woman.
word_meanings: शुभदर्शने whose appearance is auspicious, देवि queen, त्वया you, भाषितम् spoken, युक्तरूपम् is in accordance with your nature, स्त्रीस्वभावस्य of feminine nature, साध्वीनाम् of virtuous women, विनयस्य च and of the modesty, सदृशम् appropriate.

text: स्त्रीत्वं न तु समर्थं हि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम् । मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम् ॥५-३८-३॥
translation: "It may not be possible for a woman to cross on my back the vast ocean stretching over a hundred yojanas. It is not possible for a woman.
word_meanings: माम् me, अधिष्ठाय after climbing up, विस्तीर्णम् vast, शतयोजनम् of hundred yojanas, आयतम् wide, सागरम् the ocean, व्यतिवर्तितुम् to cross, स्त्रीत्वम् for a woman, न समर्थं हि is not possible.

text: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते । रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ॥५-३८-४॥
translation: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?
word_meanings: विनयान्विते O lady with humility etc., जानकि Janaki, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य of others, संस्पर्शम् touch, नार्हिमि I do not want, यत् that which, द्वितीयम् second, कारणम् reason, ब्रवीषि you said, एतत् that, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great soul, पत्न्याः of the wife, ते to you, सदृशम् appropriate, देवि O queen, त्वाम् your, ऋते excepting, अन्या other than, का who else, ईदृशम् such, वचनम् word, ब्रूयात् will speak.

text: एतत्ते देवि सदृशं पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः । का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम् ॥५-३८-५॥
translation: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?
word_meanings: विनयान्विते O lady with humility etc., जानकि Janaki, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य of others, संस्पर्शम् touch, नार्हिमि I do not want, यत् that which, द्वितीयम् second, कारणम् reason, ब्रवीषि you said, एतत् that, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great soul, पत्न्याः of the wife, ते to you, सदृशम् appropriate, देवि O queen, त्वाम् your, ऋते excepting, अन्या other than, का who else, ईदृशम् such, वचनम् word, ब्रूयात् will speak.

text: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थः सर्वं निरवशेषतः । चोष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः ॥५-३८-६॥
translation: "O queen Kakutstha Rama will hear from me fully all that has been said and done by you in my presence without any omission.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ: Rama the scion of the Kakutstha family, सर्वं all, देवि queen, त्वया your, यत् what ever, चेष्टितम् is done, मम my, अग्रतः presence, भाषितं च you have spoken, सर्वम् all, निरवशेषतः without omission, श्रोष्यते च will hear.

text: कारणैर्बहुभिर्देवि रामप्रियचिकीर्षया । स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा मयैतत् समुदीरितम् ॥५-३८-७॥
translation: "O queen my heart is drenched with love for Rama and desires to please him for many reasons. Therefore these words have been spoken by me.
word_meanings: देवि O queen, बहुभिः with many, कारणैः with reasons, रामप्रियचिकीर्षया desiring to please Rama, स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा mind is sprinkled with love, मया by me, एतत् this, समुदीरितम् uttered.

text: लङ्काया दुष्प्रवेशत्वाद् दुस्तरत्वान्महोदधेः । सामर्थ्यादात्मनश्चैव मयैतत् समुदीरितम् ॥५-३८-८॥
translation: "Crossing the ocean and entering Lanka are difficult. But I accomplished it. Hence my proposal.
word_meanings: लङ्कायाः of Lanka, दुष्प्रवेशत्वात् difficult to enter, महोदधेः of the ocean, दुस्तरत्वात् difficult to cross, आत्मनः of my self, सामर्थ्याश्चैव because of my capacity, मया by me, एतत् all this, समुदीरितम् pronounced.

text: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना । गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम् ॥५-३८-९॥
translation: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.
word_meanings: गुरुस्नेहेन out of love for my master, भक्त्या च and devotion, त्वाम् you, रघुबन्धुना with Rama, अद्यैव today itself, समानेतुम् to take, इच्छामि desirous of, एतत् all this, अन्यथा any other, न उदाहृतम् not mentioned otherwise.

text: यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्धमनिन्दिते । अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि तत् ॥५-३८-१०॥
translation: "O blameless lady If you wish not to accompany me you may give me a token of identification to let Rama know about my coming here and seeing you".
word_meanings: अनिन्दिते O blameless lady, मया सार्थम् along with me, यातुम् to go, नोत्सहसे यदि if not desiring, यत् that, राघवः Rama, जानीयात् coming and seeing you, अभिज्ञानम् to let him know, त्वम् you, प्रयच्छ you may give me a token of identity.

text: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा । उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम् ॥५-३८-११॥
translation: Having heard Hanuman, Sita, a child of god, said these words in a low tone. Choked with tears, 'Carry this token of identity to my dear husband':
word_meanings: हनुमता by Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्ता having been addressed, सुरसुतोपमा resembling a god's daughter, सीता Sita, बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम् words choked with tears, वचनम् word, मन्दम् in low tone, उवाच said, त्वं तु you also, मम my, प्रियम् dear, श्रेष्ठम् best, इदम् thus, अभिज्ञानम् token of identity, ब्रूयाः said.

text: इदं श्रेष्ठमभिज्ञानं ब्रूयास्त्वं तु मम प्रियम् । शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा ॥५-३८-१२॥
तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके । तस्मिन् सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या ह्यदूरतः ॥५-३८-१३॥
translation: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, चित्रकूटस्य शैलस्य on the mountain of Chitrakuta, पूर्वोत्तरे in the northeast, पादे on foot, प्राज्यमूलफलोदके with abundant roots fruits and water, तस्मिन् in that, सिद्धाश्रमे Siddhasrama, देशे in a region, मन्दाकिन्याध्यविदूरतः not far from Mandakini river, तस्य of him, नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु many kinds of fragrant flowers, उपवनषण्डेषु in gardens, सलिले in water, विहृत्य after sporting, क्लिन्नः wet, तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः hermitages of ascetics, मम me, अङ्के the body, समुपाविशः you were seated.

text: तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु । विहृत्य सलिलक्लिन्ना तवाङ्के समुपाविशम् ॥५-३८-१४॥
translation: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, चित्रकूटस्य शैलस्य on the mountain of Chitrakuta, पूर्वोत्तरे in the northeast, पादे on foot, प्राज्यमूलफलोदके with abundant roots fruits and water, तस्मिन् in that, सिद्धाश्रमे Siddhasrama, देशे in a region, मन्दाकिन्याध्यविदूरतः not far from Mandakini river, तस्य of him, नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु many kinds of fragrant flowers, उपवनषण्डेषु in gardens, सलिले in water, विहृत्य after sporting, क्लिन्नः wet, तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः hermitages of ascetics, मम me, अङ्के the body, समुपाविशः you were seated.

text: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत् । तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामि स्म वायसम् ॥५-३८-१५॥
translation: 'Then a crow greedy of flesh began to peck my bossom with its beak. I took a clod of earth and warded him off.
word_meanings: ततः then, मांससमायुक्तः it brought meat, वायसः crow, पर्यतुण्डयत् went round with its beak and pecked, अहम् I, लोष्टम् clod of earth, उद्यम्य by lifting, तम् him, वायसम् that crow, वारयामि स्म I presented him.

text: दारयन् स च मां काकस्तत्रैव परिलीयते । न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थी बलिभोजनः ॥५-३८-१६॥
translation: 'The crow was an eater of offerings, hungry for food began to peck me again and again for flesh.He did not stop.
word_meanings: सः काकः that crow, माम् me, दारयन् while pecking, तत्रैव there itself, परिलीयते waited, भक्षार्थि hungry for food, सः he, बलिभोजनः eater of offerings, मांसात् flesh, न उपारमच्चापि was not giving up.

text: उत्कर्षन्त्यां च रशनां क्रुद्धायां मयि पक्षिणि । स्रस्यमाने च वसने ततो दृष्टा त्वया ह्यहम् ॥५-३८-१७॥
translation: 'My upper cloth was slipping. I was trying to pull up my waist string angrily when you saw me.
word_meanings: मयि I, पक्षिणि by the crow, क्रुद्धायाम् when I was angry, वसने when the cloth, स्रस्यमाने च was slipping, रशनाम् waist string, उत्कर्षन्त्यां च as I was pulling up, ततः then, त्वया by you, अहम् I, दृष्टा seen.

text: त्वया ऽपहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा । भक्षगृध्रेन काकेन दारिता त्वामुपागता .३८.१७ ॥५-३८-१८॥
translation: 'Then you made fun of me, and I became angry. I was abashed. Torn by the voracious bird I sought your shelter.
word_meanings: तदा then, क्रुद्धा enraged, अहम् I, त्वया your, अपहसिता made fun of me, संलज्जिता embarassed, भक्षगृध्नेन by the voracious bird, काकेन by the crow, दारिता torn, त्वाम् you, उपागता sought.

text: आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम् । क्रुद्ध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वया ऽहं परिसान्त्विता ॥५-३८-१९॥
translation: 'Exhausted, I sat on your lap again. Seeing my angry face you pacified me. You were happy (to see me draw close).
word_meanings: श्रान्ता exhausted, आसीनस्य when you sat, ते your, उत्सङ्गम् lap, पुनः again, आविशम् settled again, क्रुध्यन्ती seeing me angry, अहम् I, प्रहृष्टेन happily, त्वया by you, परिसान्त्विता you pacified me.

text: बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती । लक्षिता ऽहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता ॥५-३८-२०॥
translation: 'O lord when I was angered by the crow and my face was filled with tears, you marked me wiping my eyes.
word_meanings: नाथ O lord, वायसेन by the crow, प्रकोपिता angered, बाष्पपूर्णमुखी face filled with tears, मन्दम् slowly, चक्षुषी eyes, परिमार्जती while wiping, अहम् I was, त्वया you, लक्षिता marked.

text: परिश्रमात् प्रसुप्ता च राघवाङ्के ऽप्यहं चिरम् । पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः । स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसः समुपागमत् ॥५-३८-२१॥
translation: 'Totally exhausted I slept on your lap for a long time, and in turn you slept on my lap later.
word_meanings: अहमपि I too, परिश्रमात् due to exhaustion, राघवाङ्के on Rama's lap, चिरम् for long time, प्रसुप्ता च I slept, पर्यायेण in turn, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, मम my, अङ्के on the lap, प्रसुप्तः slept.

text: ततः सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात् समुत्थिताम् । वायसः सहसा ऽ ऽगम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे ॥५-३८-२२॥
translation: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.
word_meanings: अथ and then, सः वायसः that crow, पुनरेव again, तत्र there, समुपागमत् came back, ततः then, सः he, वायसः crow, सहसा atonce, आगम्य having come, सुप्तप्रबुद्धाम् awakened from sleep, रामस्य Rama's, अङ्कात् from the lap, समुत्थिताम् risen, माम् myself, स्तनान्तरे between my breasts, विददार clawed, अथ and, पुनः again, उत्पत्य flying, माम् myself, भृशम् repeatedly, विददार clawed down.

text: पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम् । ततः समुक्षितो रामो मुक्तैः शोणितबिन्दुभिः ॥५-३८-२३॥
वायसेन ततस्तेन बलवत्क्लिश्यमानया । स मया बोधितः श्रीमान् सुखसुप्तः परन्तपः ॥५-३८-२४॥
translation: 'At the touch of the drops of blood dripping from my body, tormented by seeing me distressed with the dripping blood, you were awakened, you who were an illustrious scorcher of foes.
word_meanings: ततः then, रामः Rama, मुक्तै: dripping, शोणितबिन्दुभिः drops of blood, समुक्षितः seeing, ततः then, तेन वायसेन by that crow, बलवत् forcibly, क्लिश्यमानया tormented, मया by me, श्रीमान् illustrious, परन्तपः scorcher of foes, सुखसुप्तः happily sleeping, सः he, बोधितः he was awakened.

text: स मां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्वितुन्नां स्तनयोस्तदा । आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः श्वसन् वाक्यमभाषत ॥५-३८-२५॥
translation: 'O strongarmed Rama, seeing my torn breasts, you became angry like a hissing serpent and hissing said :
word_meanings: महाबाहुः strong armed, सः Rama, तदा then, स्तनयोः in the breasts, वितुन्नाम् wounded, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, क्रुद्धः angered, आशीविष इव like a (hissing) snake, श्वसन् breathing hard, वाक्यम् these words, अभाषत spoke.

text: केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम् । कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ॥५-३८-२६॥
translation: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?
word_meanings: नागनासोरु lady whose thighs look like elephant's trunk, सीता Sita, स्तनान्तरम् your breasts, केन by whom, विक्षतं वै wounded, सरोषेण with the angry, पञ्चवक्त्रेण fivehooded, भोगिना by the serpent, कः who, क्रीडति sporting.

text: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत । नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥५-३८-२७॥
translation: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीक्षमाणः while glancing, सरुधिरैः with blood stained, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp ones, नखैः with nails, मामेव me, अभिमुखम् facing me, स्थितम् standing, तं वायसम् that crow, समुदैक्षत वै he saw.

text: पुत्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः । धरान्तरगतः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ॥५-३८-२८॥
translation: 'This crow was the best of birds. He was surely Indra's son who had covered a long distance with great speed and his speed was like the Windgod's.
word_meanings: पतताम् of the birds, वरः eminent, सः वायसः that crow, शक्रस्य Indra's, पुत्रः किल it is said that he is the son, धरान्तरगतः he covered a long distance, शीघ्रम् in great speed, गतौ in movement, पवनस्य Windgod's, समः matching.

text: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः । वायसे कृतवान् क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः ॥५-३८-२९॥
translation: 'Then you, the strongarmed and best among the wise, your eyeballs rolling in fury, made up your mind about the cruel crow.
word_meanings: ततः then, मतिमताम् among the wise, वरः best, महाबाहुः strongarmed, कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः with eye balls rolling in anger, तस्मिन् him, वायसे at the crow, क्रूराम् cruel, मतिम् mind, कृतवान् made up.

text: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्राह्मेमास्त्रेण योजयत् । स दीप्त इव कालाग्रिर्जज्वलाभिमुखो द्विजम् ॥५-३८-३०॥
translation: 'Taking out a blade of darbha grass from your mat, you invoked the weapon of Brahma by reciting the mantra. Then you discharged it which blazed like the fire of death and went spearheading towards the crow.
word_meanings: सः he, Rama, संस्तरात् from his darbha mat, दर्भम् darbha grass, गृह्य took out, ब्राह्मेण अस्त्रेण invoked the weapon of Brahma into it by reciting the mantra, योजयत् discharged, सः that, दीप्तः blazed, कालाग्निरिव like the fire of death, द्विजम् the bird, अभिमुखः towards, जज्वाल glowed.

text: स तं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति । ततस्तं वायसं दर्भः सो ऽम्बरे ऽनुजगाम ह ॥५-३८-३१॥
translation: 'Then you threw the burning darbha grass at the crow and it chased him in the sky.
word_meanings: सः he, प्रदीप्तम् glowing, तं दर्भम् that darbha, तं वायसं प्रति him, the crow in turn, चिक्षेप threw, ततः then, सः दर्भः that darbha, तं वायसम् that crow, अम्बरे in the sky, अनुजगाम ह followed.

text: अनुसृप्तस्तदा काको जगाम विविधां गतिम् । लोककाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ॥५-३८-३२॥
translation: 'Then that crow flew to many places seeking asylum all over the universe chased by the blade of grass.
word_meanings: तदा then, काकः that crow, अनुसृष्टः one who was followed, विविधाम् many, गतिम् places, जगाम went, लोककामः the entire universe desiring safety, इमम् this, सर्वम् all, लोकम् worlds, विचचार ह went round.

text: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः । त्रील्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः ॥५-३८-३३॥
स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् । वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थः कृपया पर्यपालयत् ॥५-३८-३४॥
translation: 'Seeing the crow fallen on the ground, O Kakutstha, you who are a saviour of those who seek refuge saved him out of compassion, even though he deserved to be killed.
word_meanings: शरण्यः saviour, सः काकुत्स्थ: that Kakutstha, शरणागतम् one who sought refuge, भूमौ on the ground, निपतितम् fallen on the ground, तम् him, वधार्हमपि even though deserves to be killed, कृपया out of compassion, पर्यपालयत् saved.

text: न शर्म लब्ध्वा तमेव शरणं गतः ॥५-३८-३५॥
translation: 'Then the crow went round all the three worlds, having been rejected by his father Indra, including all the sages and gods. Refused by all he came back to Rama seeking shelter.
word_meanings: सः he, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, सम्परिक्रम्य having gone round, पित्रा च and to his father also, समहर्षिभिः including the sages, सुरैश्च by gods, परित्यक्तः rejected, तमेव him alone, शरणं गतः went seeking refuge.

text: परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स तमायान्तमब्रवीत् । मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम् ॥५-३८-३६॥
translation: 'Rama, you saw the crow in pain and despondency who returned to you and said that it is not possible to make Brahma's weapon ineffectual.You may tell now. (what should be done.)
word_meanings: सः Rama, परिद्यूनम् pained, विषण्णम् despondent, आयान्तम् he reached, तम् him, अब्रवीत् said, ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् Brahma weapon, मोघम् in vain, कर्तुम् to do, न शक्यं तु not possible, तत् that, उच्यताम् tell.

text: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सो ऽब्रवीत् । ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् । दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः ॥५-३८-३७॥
translation: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.
word_meanings: अथ and then, सः that, त्वच्छरः your arrow, दक्षिणाक्षि right eye, हिनस्तु may be blinded, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, ततः then, सः he, तस्य काकस्य that crow's, दक्षिणम् right, अक्षि eye, हिनस्ति स्म blinded by hitting, सः that, दक्षिणम् right, दत्त्वा having offered, प्राणेभ्यः from life, परिरक्षितः protected.

text: स रामाय नमस्कृत्वा राज्ञे दशरथाय च । विसृष्टस्तेन वीरेण प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् णम् ॥५-३८-३८॥
translation: 'That crow offered salutations to you Rama and king Dasaratha, thereafter took permission and went to his own dwelling.
word_meanings: सः that crow, रामाय to Rama, राज्ञे to the king, दशरथाय च and to Dasaratha, नमस्कृत्य having offered salutations, तेन by him, वीरेण by the warrior, विसृष्टः permitted to leave, स्वम् his own, आलयम् dwelling, प्रतिपेदे went reached.

text: मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम् । कर्माद्यो मां हरत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते ॥५-३८-३९॥
translation: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?
word_meanings: महीपते lord of the earth, मत्कृते for the sake of, काकमात्रे on a mere crow, ब्रह्मास्त्रम् weapon of Brahma, समुदीरितम् released, त्वत्तः from you, माम् me, यः he who, अहरत् abducted, तम् him, कस्मात् why, क्षमसे you excuse him.

text: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहः कृपां मयि नरर्षभ । त्वया नाथवती नाथ ह्यनाथा इव दृश्यते ॥५-३८-४०॥
translation: 'O bull among men you are so loving to me. I am like an orphan. Be kind to me. She who has found her lord in you stays without a protector.
word_meanings: नरर्षभ bull among men, सः Rama, महोत्साहः one with great love, मयि in me, कृपाम् compassion, कुरुष्व bestow, नाथ O lord, त्वया your, नाथवती I have been protected, अनाथा इव like an orphan, दृश्यते appears.

text: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्त्वत्त एव मया श्रुतः ॥५-३८-४१॥
translation: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.
word_meanings: अनृशंस्यम् kindness, परः supreme, धर्मः is righteous, मया by me, त्वत्तः एव from you alone,श्रुतः heard, त्वाम् you, महावीर्यम् heroic, महोत्साहम् vigour, महाबलम् mighty, अपारपारम् boundless, अक्षोभ्यम् never to be stirred, गाम्भीर्यात् with depth, सागरोपमम् like the ocean, ससमुद्रायाः inclusive of seas, धरण्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् lord, वासवोपमम् like Vasava, जानामि I know.

text: जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम् । अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात् सागरोपमम् । भर्तारं ससमुद्रायाधरण्या वासवोपमम् ॥५-३८-४२॥
translation: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.
word_meanings: अनृशंस्यम् kindness, परः supreme, धर्मः is righteous, मया by me, त्वत्तः एव from you alone,श्रुतः heard, त्वाम् you, महावीर्यम् heroic, महोत्साहम् vigour, महाबलम् mighty, अपारपारम् boundless, अक्षोभ्यम् never to be stirred, गाम्भीर्यात् with depth, सागरोपमम् like the ocean, ससमुद्रायाः inclusive of seas, धरण्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् lord, वासवोपमम् like Vasava, जानामि I know.

text: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्यवान् बलवानपि । किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ॥५-३८-४३॥
translation: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'
word_meanings: राघव Rama, एवम् in that way, अस्त्रविदाम् among the users of weapons, श्रेष्ठः expert, सत्यवान् truthful, बलवानपि even strong, रक्षस्सु demons, अस्त्रम् weapon, किमर्थम् why, न योजयसि you are not using?

text: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः । रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुम् ॥५-३८-४४॥
translation: (Now Sita turns to Hanuman and says) "In war serpents, gandharvas, demons or Marutas cannot withstand the speed of Rama's arrows and hit back.
word_meanings: समरे in war, रामस्य Rama's, वेगम् speed, प्रतिसमाधितुम् to hit back, नागाः serpents, न शक्ताः not able, गन्धर्वा अपि even gandharvas, न not, असुराः demons, न not, मरुद्गणाः marutas, न not.

text: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद् यद्यस्ति मयि संभ्रमः । किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षयं नयति राक्षसान् ॥५-३८-४५॥
translation: "Does Rama have a little anxiety about me? If he has, why does he, a disciplined hero, not put an end to the demons with his sharp arrows?
word_meanings: वीर्यवतः hero of great discipline, तस्य his, मयि in me, कश्चित् even a little, सम्भ्रमः hurry, अस्ति यदि if he has, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः with arrows, राक्षसान् at the demons, किमर्थम् why, क्षयम् destroy, न नयति not killing.

text: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः । कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः ॥५-३८-४६॥
translation: "Or, why does the mighty hero, Lakshmana, who is a scorcher of enemies, not come to my rescue taking the orders from his brother?
word_meanings: परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, महाबलः mighty, वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणो वा even Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother, आदेशम् order, आदाय after taking, कस्य हेतोः for what reason, माम् me, न परित्राति not rescue.

text: यदि तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ । सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ॥५-३८-४७॥
translation: "Both Rama and Lakshmana are tigers among men who resemble wind and fire in power and have the unassailability of the gods. Wherefore are they disregarding me?.
word_meanings: वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ resembling wind and fire in power, पुरुषव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, तौ they both, सुराणाम् even the gods, दुर्धर्षौ यदि अपि even though unassailable also, माम् me, किमर्थम् how is it, उपेक्षतः disregarding.

text: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः । समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षते परन्तपौ ॥५-३८-४८॥
translation: "Perhaps I must have committed an atrocious sin. There is no doubt. For although both of them are scorchers of enemies, they deliver me not."
word_meanings: ममैव mine alone, महत् atrocious, किञ्चित् some, दुष्कृतम् sin, अस्ति is committed, संशयः doubt, न no, यत् because, समर्थावपि although capable, परन्तपौ both scorchers of enemies, तौ both, माम् me, न आवेक्षेते not deliver.

text: वैदह्या वचनं श्रत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् । अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥५-३८-४९॥
translation: Hearing the piteous words of Vaidehi and beholding her eyes filled with tears, the Windgod's son, lustrous Hanuman replied thus:.
word_meanings: अथ and then, महातेजाः lustrous, मारुतात्मजः Windgod's son, हनुमान् Hanuman, वैदेह्या Vaidehi's, साश्रु with tears, करुणम् piteous, भाषितम् spoken, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अब्रवीत् said.

text: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन मे शपे । रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ॥५-३८-५०॥
translation: "O godlike lady Rama is not averse to your misery. On my word this is true. Rama is immersed in sorrow. Even Lakshmana wails.
word_meanings: देवि Devi, रामः Rama, त्वच्छोकविमुखः he is averse to your misery, सत्येन truly, ते your, शपे I vow, रामे when Rama, दुःखाभिपन्ने immersed in sorrow, लक्ष्मणः च even Lakshmana, परितप्यते wails.

text: कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् ॥५-३८-५१॥
इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानां द्रक्ष्यस्यन्तमनिन्दिते । तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ ॥५-३८-५२॥
translation: "I could find you with difficulty. This is not the time to wail. O blameless lady take it, your sorrow has come to an end at this moment.
word_meanings: कथञ्चित् with difficulty, भवती your self, दृष्टा could be found, परिदेवितुम् wailing, कालः time, न not, अनिन्दिते blameless lady, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, दुःखानाम् all sorrrow, अन्तम् end, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ॥५-३८-५३॥
translation: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka into ashes.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, महाबलौ mighty, त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ eager to see you, उभौ both, तौ राजपुत्रौ those two princes, लङ्काम् this Lanka, भस्मीकरिष्यतः will reduce to ashes.

text: हत्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम् । राघवस्त्वां विशालाक्षि नेष्यति स्वां पुरीं प्रति । ब्रूहि यद्राघवो वाच्यो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ॥५-३८-५४॥
translation: "O largeeyed lady cruel Ravana along with his relatives will be killed by Rama in war and Rama will return to his city with you.
word_meanings: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed lady, राघवः Rama, समरे in war, सहबान्धवम् along with relatives, क्रूरम् cruel, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, स्वां पुरीं प्रति towards his city, त्वाम् you, नेष्यति he will be taking you.

text: सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयो ऽपि समागताः । इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंश्च सीता सुरसुतोपमा । उवाच सोकसन्तप्ता हनुमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् ॥५-३८-५५॥
translation: "Hanuman having spoken this way, Sita, resembling a god's daughter, grieving, thus addressed Hanuman:
word_meanings: तस्मिन् when he, इति in that way, उक्तवति when he said, सुरसुतोपमा lady resembling a god's daughter, सीता Sita, शोकसन्तप्ता filled with grief, प्लवङ्गमम् to vanara, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, उवाच said

text: कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी । तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय ॥५-३८-५६॥
translation: "Bow to Rama and offer salutations on my behalf. Inquiries concerning his welfare should be addressed to Rama, whom virtuous Kausalya bore as a son.
word_meanings: लोकभर्तारम् lord of the world, यम् whom, मनस्विनी sensitive woman, कौसल्या Kausalya, सुषुवे bore, तम् him, मदर्थे on my behalf, सुखम् welfare, पृच्छ you may inquire into, शिरसा by bowing, अभिवादय च offer salutations.

text: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः । ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम् ॥५-३८-५७॥
translation: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.
word_meanings: येन by whom, सुमित्रा Sumitra, सुप्रजाः has attained the title of blessed mother, स्रजश्च garlands, सर्वरत्नानि all jewels, प्रियाः dear, याः those, वराङ्गनाः best of women, विशालायाम् in the vast, पृथिव्याम् in the whole earth, दुर्लभम् most difficult to attain, ऐश्वर्यं चापि prosperity also, पितरम् father, मातरं चापि even mother, सम्मान्य having respected, अभिप्रसाद्य pleased by adopting the life of an ascetic, च and, रामम् with Rama, अनुप्रव्रजितः accompanied.

text: पितरं मातरं चैव संमान्याभिप्रसाद्य च । अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः ॥५-३८-५८॥
translation: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.
word_meanings: येन by whom, सुमित्रा Sumitra, सुप्रजाः has attained the title of blessed mother, स्रजश्च garlands, सर्वरत्नानि all jewels, प्रियाः dear, याः those, वराङ्गनाः best of women, विशालायाम् in the vast, पृथिव्याम् in the whole earth, दुर्लभम् most difficult to attain, ऐश्वर्यं चापि prosperity also, पितरम् father, मातरं चापि even mother, सम्मान्य having respected, अभिप्रसाद्य pleased by adopting the life of an ascetic, च and, रामम् with Rama, अनुप्रव्रजितः accompanied.

text: आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम् । अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन् वने ॥५-३८-५९॥
translation: "Great, righteous Lakshmana had given up his pleasures and followed his brother Rama in his favour into the forest to be able to serve him.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous self, अनुत्तमम् great, सुखम् pleasures, त्यक्त्वा having given up, भ्रातरम् his brother, काकुत्स्थम् Kakustha Rama, वने to the forest, आनुकूल्येन in his favour, पालयन् while serving, अनुगच्छति followed.

text: संहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शनः । पितृवद्वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरन् ॥५-३८-६०॥
translation: "Lakshmana, who has lionshoulders and strong arms, who is handsome, who takes Rama as his father and treats me as his own mother.
word_meanings: सिंहस्कन्ध: lionshoulders, महाबाहुः strongarmed one, मनस्वी highsouled, प्रियदर्शनः a handsome person, माम् me, मातृवत् like his mother, समाचरन् while treating, रामे with Rama, पितृवत् as his father, वर्तते conducts.

text: ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः ॥५-३८-६१॥
वृद्दोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवान् शक्तो न बहु भाषिता । राजपुत्रः प्रियः श्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे ॥५-३८-६२॥
translation: "Heroic Lakshmana, did not know while I was borne away. He is prosperous, foremost in serving elders. He is energetic and reserved in his speech like my fatherinlaw. He is a prince dear (to his brother).
word_meanings: वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तदा then, माम् me, ह्रियमाणाम् while I was borne away, न वेद not know, वृद्धोपसेवी serving elders, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, शक्तः energetic, न बहुभाषिता limited in speech, मे my, श्वशुरस्य of my fatherinlaw, सदृशः resembles, प्रियः dear, श्रेष्ठः foremost, राजपुत्रः prince.

text: मम प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्ष्मणः । नियुक्तो धुरि यस्यां तु तामुद्वहति वीर्यवान् ॥५-३८-६३॥
translation: "Rama's brother Lakshmana is always dear to me. Heroic Lakshmana will discharge whichever responsibility is entrusted to him.
word_meanings: रामस्य Rama's, भ्राता brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, नित्यम् always, मम to me, प्रियतरः loving, वीर्यवान् heroic, यस्याम् in whichever, धुरि task, नियुक्तः he is entrusted, ताम् such a job, उद्वहति executes.

text: यं दृष्ट्वा राघवो नैव वृत्तमार्यमनुस्मरेत् । स ममार्थाय कुशलं वक्तव्यो वचनान्मम । मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः ॥५-३८-६४॥
translation: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.
word_meanings: यम् who, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, राघवः Rama, वृत्तम् support, आर्यम् noble, न अनुस्मरेत् not remembering, सः he, मम my, अर्थाय sake, मम on me, वचनात् words, कुशलम् welfare, वक्तव्यः that I have enquired.

text: यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत् । त्वमस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम ॥५-३८-६५॥
translation: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.
word_meanings: वानरश्रेष्ठः excellent vanara, हरिसत्तम: esteemed vanaras, मृदुः gentle, नित्यम् always, शुचिः pure, दक्षः competent, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियः beloved, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यथा as such, दुःखक्षयकरः who mitigates suffering, भवेत् will be, अस्मिन् in that, कार्यनिर्योगे in a task, त्वम् you, प्रमाणम् authority.

text: राघवस्त्वत्समारम्भान्मयि यत्नपरो भवेत् ॥५-३८-६६॥
translation: "By your efforts alone my husband will try for my release. You may tell these words to my heroic husband, Rama, again and again.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, त्वत्समारम्भात् by your efforts alone, मयि regarding me, यत्नपरः one who makes efforts, भवेत् will be, मे my, नाथम् husband, शूरम् powerful hero, रामम् Rama, पुनः पुनः again and again, इदम् this, ब्रूयाः may tell.

text: इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः । जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ॥५-३८-६७॥
ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते । रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्या पापकर्मणा ॥५-३८-६८॥
त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम् । ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम् । प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ ॥५-३८-६९॥
translation: Then Sita took out the exquisite and auspicious Chudamani worn on the head, untied from her clothes and gave it to Hanuman to be presented to Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, सीता Sita, वस्त्रगतम् tied up in clothes, शुभम् auspicious, दिव्यम् exquisite, चूडामणिम् Chudamani, an ornament worn on the head, मुक्त्वा took out, राघवाय to Rama, प्रदेयः to be given, इति thus, हनुमते to Hanuman, ददौ gave.

text: प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम् । अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्य प्राभवद्भुजः ॥५-३८-७०॥
translation: Then Hanuman, taking the extraordinary jewel and placed it on his finger as it was not fitting to his arm.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरः hero, अनुत्तमम् very great, मणिरत्नम् jewel, प्रतिगृह्य after taking, अङ्गुल्या on his finger, योजयामास placed अस्य to his, भुजः arm, न प्राभवत् हि was not fitting.

text: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवद्य च । सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्श्वतः स्थितः ॥५-३८-७१॥
translation: Having recieved the jewel from Sita and circumambulated her, Hanuman offered salutations to her and stood by her.
word_meanings: कपिवरः best of vanaras, मणिरत्नम् jewel, प्रतिगृह्य after taking, सीताम् from Sita, अभिवाद्य च having saluted, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा having circumambulated, प्रणतः humbly, पार्श्वतः by the side, स्थितः stood.

text: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः । हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः ॥५-३८-७२॥
translation: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.
word_meanings: सः he, सीतादर्शनजेन by seeing Sita, महता with a great, हर्षेण joy, युक्तः endowed, हृदयेन his mind, रामम् to Rama, गतः went, शरीरेण तु but body, विष्ठितः stood there.

text: मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात् । गिरिरिव पवनावधूत्मुक्तः सुखितमनाः प्रतिसंक्रमं प्रपेदे ॥५-३८-७३॥
translation: Having received the most precious jewel from the daughter of Janaka, Hanuman prepared to return like a mountain released from the impact of the wind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महार्हम् precious, जनकनृपात्मजया by Janaka's daughter, धृतम् borne, तं मणिवरम् that great jewel, उपगृह्य taking, प्रभावात् by its glow, पवनावधूतमुक्तः shaken by wind and released, गिरिरिव like a mountain, सुखितमनाः pleased, प्रतिसङ्क्रमम् to return, प्रपेदे prepared.

text: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीति । अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः ॥५-३९-१॥
translation: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".
word_meanings: सीता Sita, मणिं Jewel, दत्त्वा having given, ततः that way, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, अब्रवीत् said, एतत् this, रामस्य to Rama, अभिज्ञात known, तत्त्वतः truly, अभिज्ञानम् signet.

text: मणिं तु दृष्ट्वा रामो वै त्रयाणां संस्मरिष्यति । वीरो जनन्या मम च राज्ञो दशरथस्य च ॥५-३९-२॥
translation: "Seeing this jewel,Rama will recall three of us, my mother, myself and the king Dasaratha" (as this was given by her mother at her marriage.)
word_meanings: मणिम् jewel, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, रामः Rama, त्रयाणाम् of three of us, जनन्याः of the mother, मम च me and, राज्ञः king, दशरथस्य च Dasaratha and, संस्मरिष्यति will recall.

text: स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहे चोदितो हरिसत्तम । अस्मिन् कार्यसमारम्भे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम् ॥५-३९-३॥
translation: "Great Hanuman you are enthused now. You may think over the future course of action.
word_meanings: हरिसत्तम great Hanuman, सः such Rama, त्वम् you, भूयः again, समुत्साहचोदितः prompted by enthusiasm, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यसमारम्भे in this effort, यत् that, उत्तरम् now, प्रचिन्तय think over.

text: त्वमस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम । हनुमन् यत्नमास्थाय दुःखक्षयकरो भव । तस्य चिन्तयतो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत् ॥५-३९-४॥
translation: "O best of monkeys it is your responsibility to carry out this task. O Hanuman think carefully of that. Take the initiative to reduce my suffering. I am confident that you can do it."
word_meanings: हरिसत्तम O best of monkeys, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यनिर्योगे in carrying out this task, त्वम् you, प्रमाणम् are responsible, हनुमान् Hanuman, यत्नम् initiative, आस्थाय after making, दुःखक्षयकरः reducer of suffering, भव you are, तस्य for him, चिन्तयतः thinking, यत्नः effort, दुःखक्षयकरः reducer of grief, भवेत् become.

text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे ॥५-३९-५॥
translation: Hanuman possessed with fierce valour said to Vaidehi, 'so be it' and bowed his head, and offered salutations before he departed.
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमः possessed with fierceful valour, सः मारुतिः that Maruti, तथेति so be it, प्रतिज्ञाय promised, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, शिरसा with his head, वन्ध्य having offered salutation, गमनाय to depart, उपचक्रमे started.

text: ज्ञत्वा संप्रस्थितं देवी वानरं मारुतात्मजम् । बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-६॥
translation: The noble lady, Sita, having been fully convinced about Hanuman and realising that he is about to start, her voice was choked with tears. She said these words:
word_meanings: देवी noble lady, मैथिली Mythili, मारुतात्मजम् Maruti's son, वानरम् vanara, सम्प्रस्थितम् who had started, ज्ञात्वा having realised, बाष्पगद्गदया with voice choked with tears, वाचा with speech, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: कुशलं हनुमन् ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥५-३९-७॥
translation: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.
word_meanings: वानरश्रेष्ठः O great vanara, हनुमन् O Hanuman, सहितौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate, सहामात्यम् along with his ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, वृद्धान् elders, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, त्वम् you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous manner, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate

text: सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वाररान् । ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम् ॥५-३९-८॥
translation: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.
word_meanings: वानरश्रेष्ठः O great vanara, हनुमन् O Hanuman, सहितौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate, सहामात्यम् along with his ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, वृद्धान् elders, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, त्वम् you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous manner, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate

text: यथा स च महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः । अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ॥५-३९-९॥
translation: "You must pacify the strongarmed Rama in a manner by which he will help me to cross the ocean of grief and rlieve me.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः strongarmed, सः राघवः that Rama, अस्मात् from this, दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात् relieve me from this ocean of grief, यथा that way, तारयति he helps me to cross, त्वम् you, समाधातुम् to pacify, अर्हसि you may.

text: जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान् । तत्तथा हनुमन् वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि ॥५-३९-१०॥
translation: "Let the illustrious Rama take me alive. Help me with your (persuasive) words and you will acquire merit.
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, कीर्तिमान् illustrious one, रामः Rama, माम् me, जीवन्तीम् while I am alove, यथा in such way, सम्भावयति will take me, तत् that, तथा that way, वाच्यम् words, वाचा tell, धर्मम् righteous, अवाप्नुहि you will acquire.

text: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचः श्रुत्वा त्वयेरिताः । वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये ॥५-३९-११॥
translation: "On hearing your ever spirited words his manliness to get me back will be charged.
word_meanings: त्वया you, ईरिताः spoken, उत्साहयुक्ताः full of determination for action, वाचः words, नित्यम् ever, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मदवाप्तये for acquiring me, दाशरथेः son of Dasaratha, पौरुषम् manliness, वर्धिष्यते will increase.

text: मत्सन्देशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तः श्रुत्वैव राघवः । पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत् संविधास्यति ॥५-३९-१२॥
translation: After hearing my message repeated from you, the heroic Rama will duly make his display of valour.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, राघवः Rama, त्वत्तः from you, मत्सन्देशयुताः with repetition of my message, वाचः words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, विधिवत् arrange duly, पराक्रमविधम् following his valour, संविधास्यति will make efforts.

text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-१३॥
translation: "Having heard Sita's words, Hanuman, son of Maruta, placed his folded palms over his head in reverence and replied:
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of Maruta, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after listening, शिरसि on his head, अञ्जलिम् folded palms, आधाय placed, उत्तरम् replied, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हर्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः । यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीन् शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति ॥५-३९-१४॥
translation: "Kakutstha Rama, accompanied by vanaras and bears will reach here soon and conquer the enemies in war and relieve your grief.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha, हर्यृक्षप्रवरैः with vanaras and bears, क्षिप्रम् at once, एष्यति he will hasten, यः he, युधि in war, अरीन् enemies, विजित्य winning over, ते your, शोकम् grief, व्यपनयिष्यति will relieve.

text: नहि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नासुरेषु सुरेषु वा । यस्तस्य क्षिपतो बाणान् स्थातुमुत्सहतो ऽग्रतः ॥५-३९-१५॥
translation: "I do not see any one among humans or demons or even among gods who can face his arrows when released.
word_meanings: यः when he, बाणान् arrows, क्षिपतः while he releases, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front, स्थातुम् to stand, उत्सहते will have, मर्त्येषु among humans, नासुरेषु or among demons, सुरेषु वा or among gods, न हि पश्यामि I do not see.

text: अप्यर्कमपि पर्जन्यमपि वैवस्वतं यमम् । सहि सोढुं रणे शक्तस्तव हेतोर्विशेषतः ॥५-३९-१६॥
translation: "Indeed, Rama is capable of conquering even the Sungod, or the raingod or Yama (the son of the Sun) specially for your sake.
word_meanings: सः he, रणे in war, अर्कमपि even the Sun, पर्जन्यमपि or the raingod, वैवस्वतम् son of the Sun, यमम् Yama the lord of death, सोढुम् to hear, शक्तः capable, तव हेतोः for you, विशेषतः specially.

text: स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं शासितुमीहते । त्वन्निमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि ॥५-३९-१७॥
translation: "Rama is fit to rule the entire earth surrounded by the ocean. O delight of Janaka he will succeed in serving your cause."
word_meanings: सः he, सागरपर्यन्ताम् surrounded by the entire ocean, महीम् earth, शासितुम् to rule, अर्हति हि is fit, जनकनन्दिनि O Janaka's delight, रामस्य Rama's, जयः victory, त्वन्निमित्तो हि for your sake only.

text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सत्यं सुभाषितम् । जानकी बहुमेने ऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-१८॥
translation: On hearing the truthful, proper, pleasing words by Hanuman whom she held in great esteem, Sita said this:
word_meanings: जानकी Janaki, तस्य his, सत्यम् truth, सम्यक् proper, सुभाषितम् good words, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, बहुमेने held in great esteem, अथ then, इदम् thus, वचनं च and the word, अब्रवीत् said.

text: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः । भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत् ॥५-३९-१९॥
translation: Sita again and again looked at Hanuman who was about to start. She made him understand her words conveying her love for Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, सीता Sita, प्रस्थितम् ready to start, तम् him, पुनः पुनः again and again, वीक्षमाणा looking at, भर्तृस्नेहान्वितम् conveying her love to Rama, वाक्यम् word, सौहार्दात् goodhearted, अनुमानयत् she made him understand.

text: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम । कस्मिंश्चित् संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ॥५-३९-२०॥
