translation: "O destroyer of enemies if you think of halting for a day you may do so in a solitary location and leave tomorrow.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies, वीर hero, मन्यसे यदि if you think so, कस्मिंश्चित् some where, संवृते in a closed space, देशे in location, एकाहम् for one day, वस you may stay, विश्रान्तः rest, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि you may go.

text: मम चेदल्पभाग्यायाः सान्निध्यात्तव वानर । अस्य शोकस्य महतो मुहूर्तं मोक्षणं भवेत् ॥५-३९-२१॥
translation: "Your presence will relieve me of my suffering, if you stay here for a while.
word_meanings: वानर vanara, तव your, सान्निध्यात् by the presence, अल्पभाग्यायाः of an unfortunate woman, मम to me, महतः great, अस्य शोकस्य from the suffering, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, मोक्षणम् relief, भवेत् चेत् will be.

text: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु । प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ॥५-३९-२२॥
translation: "O tiger among vanaras if you leave this place to come again, my life will be uncertain, (if your coming is uncertain). There is no doubt about it.
word_meanings: हरिशार्दूल O tiger among vanaras, पुनरागमनाय for your visit once again, गते when you go, मम for me, प्राणानामपि and for my life, सन्देहः doubt, स्यात् will be, अत्र here, सन्देहः doubt, न no.

text: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् । दुःखाद्दुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर ॥५-३९-२३॥
translation: "My agony would be increased further by not seeing you. It would be inflamming my agony and I would be even more pained.
word_meanings: वानर vanara, दुःखात् agonised, दुःखपरामृष्टाम् agony increased further, माम् me, तव your, अदर्शनजः not seeing you, शोकः sorrow, दीपयन्निव as if inflamming my agony, भूयः again, परितापयेत् it will trouble me.

text: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः । सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ॥५-३९-२४॥
translation: "O heroic chief of vanaras I am doubtful as to whether vanaras and bears can extend help?
word_meanings: वीर hero, हरीश्वर chief of vanaras, त्वत्सहायेषु your helpless, हर्यृक्षेषु among vanaras and bears, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सन्देहः doubtful, मम अग्रतः in front of me, तिष्ठतीव dwells in my mind.

text: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् । तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ॥५-३९-२५॥
translation: "How can the army of vanaras and bears, for that matter, princes Rama and Lakshmana negotiate the ocean, which is difficult to cross?
word_meanings: तानि those, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि army of vanaras and bears, तौ they both, Rama and Lakshmana, नरवरात्मजौ princes, दुष्पारम् difficult to cross, महोदधिम् ocean, कथं नु how indeed, तरिष्यन्ति they can cross.

text: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने । शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ॥५-३९-२६॥
translation: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.
word_meanings: अस्य of this, सागरस्य ocean's, लङ्घने to leap, वैनतेयस्य वा for Bainateya (Garuda) or, तव वा or you, मारुतस्य or Windgod वा or, त्रयाणाम् for these three, भूतानाम् living beings, शक्तिः energy, स्यात् have.

text: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे । किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः ॥५-३९-२७॥
translation: "What means do you, being the foremost hero among the three who are capable performing this difficult task, foresee?
word_meanings: वीर hero, तत् such, एवम् in that way, दुरतिक्रमे in a very difficult task, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यनिर्योगे the task, किम् what, समाधानम् means, पश्यसि you foresee, त्वम् you, कार्यविदाम् among those who are capable, वरः हि foremost.

text: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने । पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः ॥५-३९-२८॥
translation: "O slayer of enemy heroes if you alone can accomplish this task the fame of doing this will be yours.
word_meanings: परवीरघ्न slayer of enemy heroes, अस्य कार्यस्य this task, परिसाधने to accomplish, त्वम् you, एक एव alone are, पर्याप्तः कामम् are competent, ते to you, फलोदयः fruit, यशस्यः of the accomplishment.

text: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्यसंयुगे । विजयी स्वपुरीं यायात् तत्तु मे स्याद्यशस्करम् ॥५-३९-२९॥
translation: "It would be worthy of Rama if he with his entire army emerges victorious over Ravana in a battle and takes me to his city.
word_meanings: संयुगे in war, समग्रैः with the entire, बलैः with army, रावणम् Ravana, जित्य after winning, माम् me, विजयी victorious , स्वपुरम् his own city, यायात् यदि if he can reach, तत् that, तस्य his, सदृशम् worthy of him, भवेत् will be.

text: शरैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः । मां येद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ॥५-३९-३०॥
translation: "If Kakutstha (Rama), slayer of the enemy army fills the entire Lanka with his arrows and takes me, then his action will be worthy of him.
word_meanings: परबलार्दनः slayer of enemy army, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, लङ्काम् Lanka, शरैः with arrows, सङ्कुलाम् an agitated place, कृत्वा does, माम् me, नयेद्यदि if he takes, तत् that, तस्य his action, सदृशम् agreeable, भवेत् will be.

text: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः । भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ॥५-३९-३१॥
translation: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."
word_meanings: तत् that, महात्मनः of the great self, आहवशूरस्य of the hero in war, तस्य his, अनुरूपम् worthy of him, विक्रान्तम् victorious, यथा in such a way, भवेत् will be, तथा in that way, त्वम् you, उपपादय you may make arrangement.

text: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं सहितं हेतुसंहितम् । निशम्य हनुमान् शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-३२॥
translation: Having heard the meaningful, courteous and logical words of Sita, Hanuman replied:
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, अर्थोपहितम् meaningful, प्रश्रितम् courteous, हेतुसंहितम् logical, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य having heard, शेषम् the rest, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् said, उत्तरं in reply.

text: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः । सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ॥५-३९-३३॥
translation: "O Devi the lord of monkeys, Sugriva heads the army of vanaras and bears. He is richly endowed with satvaguna and is determined to accomplish your cause and free you from sorrow.
word_meanings: देवि Devi, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानाम् of the army of vanaras and bears, ईश्वरः lord, प्लवतां वरः foremost among monkeys, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with satvaguna, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तव अर्धे for your sake, कृतनिश्चयः detemined to accomplish.

text: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः । क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः ॥५-३९-३४॥
translation: "O Vaidehi Sugriva will reach this place with thousands of crores of vanaras very soon and would kill all the ogres.
word_meanings: वैदेहि Vaidehi, सः he, the Sugriva, वानरसहस्राणाम् of thousands of vanaras, कोटीभिः with crores of them, अभिसंवृतः is surrounded, राक्षसानाम् of all the ogres, निबर्हणः will destroy, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, एष्यति he will reach.

text: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः । मनस्सङ्कल्पसंपाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः ॥५-३९-३५॥
translation: "Valiant, virtuous and powerful vanaras who can leap with the speed of mind are awaiting orders (of Sugriva).
word_meanings: विक्रमसम्पन्नाः powerful, सत्त्ववन्तः virtuous, महाबलाः mighty, मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाताः who can leap with the speed of mind, हरयः vanaras, तस्य his, निदेशे at his command, स्थिताः awaiting.

text: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः । न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः ॥५-३९-३६॥
translation: "Their course cannot be impeded either upward, or downward or right or left. They are indeed very brilliant and would never fail in any task.
word_meanings: येषाम् for those monkeys, गतिः movement, उपरि upward, न सज्जते do not get impeded, अधस्तात् downward, न not, तिर्यक् horizontally, न not, अमिततेजसः very brilliant ones, महत्सु any kind, कर्मसु of task, न सीदन्ति do not care

text: असकृत् तैर्महोत्साहैः ससागरधराधरा । प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः ॥५-३९-३७॥
translation: "They have often circumambulated the earth including its oceans and mountains through the aerial path with great enthusiasm.
word_meanings: महोत्साहैः by the enthusiastic, वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः following aerial path, तैः by them, असकृत् repeatedly, ससागरधराधरा with the oceans and mountains, भूमिः earth, प्रदक्षिणीकृता has been circumambulated.

text: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः । मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ॥५-३९-३८॥
translation: "The vanaras under Sugriva who move in the forest are more powerful than me or equal to me. None is inferior to me.
word_meanings: तत्र there, मद्विशिष्टाश्च more powerful than me, तुल्याश्च those equal to me, वनौकसः vanaras who move in the forest, सन्ति are, मत्तः to me, प्रत्यवरः inferior, कश्चित् not even one, सुग्रीवसन्निधौ under Sugriva, नास्ति not there.

text: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः । नहि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ॥५-३९-३९॥
translation: "If I have managed to come here, why not the other powerful ones? The superior leaders are not sent (as messengers). Only ordinary ones like me are.
word_meanings: अहं तावत् I have, इह here, अनुप्राप्तः reached, महाबलाः very powerful, ते to you, किं पुनः why not others, प्रकृष्टाः the best ones, न प्रेष्यन्ते हि will not be sent, इतरे others, जनाः ordinary ones, प्रेष्यन्ते हि will be sent.

text: तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते । एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ॥५-३९-४०॥
translation: "O noble lady therefore, give up your agony. Enough of your lamentation. The monkey troops will reach this place in one stride.
word_meanings: देवि noble lady, तत् therefore, परितापेन with lamentation, अलम् enough, ते your, शोकः agony, व्यपैतु may be given up, ते those, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, एकोत्पातेन in one stride, लङ्काम् to Lanka, एष्यन्ति will reach.

text: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ । त्वत्सकाशं महासत्त्वौ नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ॥५-३९-४१॥
translation: "Both the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, lions among men, looking brilliant like Sun and Moon will come to you riding on my back.
word_meanings: महासत्त्वौ both great men, नृसिंहौ both lions among men, तौ च and both, मम my, पृष्ठगतौ on my back, उदितौ just risen, चन्द्रसूर्याविव like Sun and Moon, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, आगमिष्यतः will come.

text: तौ हि वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः ॥५-३९-४२॥
translation: "Both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana will come and blow up the city of Lanka with their unfailing arrows.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरौ two heroes, नरवरौ both the princes, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, सहितौ together, आगम्य on coming, लङ्कां नगरीम् to the city of Lanka, सायकैः with their arrows, विधमिष्यतः will blow away.

text: सगणं रावणं हत्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः । त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरं प्रतियास्यति ॥५-३९-४३॥
translation: "O beautiful lady Raghava, the delight of the Raghu race would kill Ravana and his kins and return with you to his city৷৷
word_meanings: वरारोहे O beautiful lady, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghu race, राघवः Rama, सगणम् along with his kins, रावणम् Ravana, हत्त्वा on killing, त्वाम् you, आदाय after taking you, स्वपुरीम् their city, प्रतियास्यति would go back.

text: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी । नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तिमिवानलम् ॥५-३९-४४॥
translation: "Therefore, count the days and rest assured. Let it be auspicious to you. You will shortly see Rama burning like fire.
word_meanings: तत् therefore, आश्वसिहि rest assured, ते भद्रम् let it be auspicious to you, त्वम् you, कालकाङ्क्षिणी count your time, भव be, प्रज्वलन्तम् burning, अनलम् इव like the fire, रामम् Rama, नचिरात् shortly, द्रक्ष्यसे would see.

text: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे ऽस्मिन् सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे । त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी ॥५-३९-४५॥
translation: "When Ravana is slain, with his sons, ministers and kith and kin, you will reunite with Rama as Rohini unites with the Moon.
word_meanings: सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे along with his sons, ministers and relatives, अस्मिन् when, राक्षसेन्द्रे the king of demons, निहते killed, त्वम् you, रोहिणी Rohini, शशाङ्केनेव like the Moon, रामेण with Rama, समेष्यसि you will reunite.

text: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि । रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसे ऽचिरात् ॥५-३९-४६॥
translation: "O queen Mythili you come to the end of your sorrow and will soon see Ravana killed by Rama".
word_meanings: देवि queen, मैथिलि Mythili, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् soon, शोकस्य grief, पारम् to the other shore, यास्यसि will go, अचिरात् very shortly, रामेण by Rama, रावणम् Ravana, निहतं slain, द्रक्ष्यसे चैव you will see.

text: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् ॥५-३९-४७॥
translation: Having thus consoled Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod resolved to depart. Once again he spoke to Vadehi:
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, एवम् in that manner, आश्वास्य having consoled, गमनाय to depart, मतिम् thought, कृत्वा after resolving, पुनः again, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, अब्रवीत् said.

text: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् । लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम्* ॥५-३९-४८॥
translation: "Very soon you would see the slayer of foes, who is an accomplished wielder of the bow (Rama) along with Lakshmana at the entrance of Lanka.
word_meanings: लङ्काद्वारम् at the entrance of Lanka, उपागतम् reached, अरिघ्नम् slayer of foes, कृतात्मानम् an accomplished man, तं राघवम् that Rama, धनुष्पाणिम् wielder of bow, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् very soon, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् । वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्र द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ॥५-३९-४९॥
translation: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.
word_meanings: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् whose nails and teeth are their weapons, वीरान् heroes, सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् resembling lion and tiger in valour, वारणेन्द्राभान् who resemble wellbred elephants, सङ्गतान् reach, वानरान् vanaras, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.

text: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु । नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामार्ये यूथान्यनेकशः ॥५-३९-५०॥
translation: "O respectable lady you would see many troops of vanara chiefs who resemble clouds hovering on the mountain peaks of Lankaroaring.
word_meanings: आर्ये respectable lady, शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् whose body is like clouds on mountain, नर्दताम् of the roaring, कपिमुख्यानाम् of the chiefs of vanaras, अनेकशः in many ways, यूधानि troops, लङ्कामलयसानुषु on the mountain of Lanka.

text: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा । न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः ॥५-३९-५१॥
translation: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.
word_meanings: सः रामः that Rama, घोरेण by the dreadful, मन्मथेषुणा arrows of god of love, मर्मणि pierced into vitals, ताडितः hit, सिंहार्दितः hit by a lion, द्विपः इव like an elephant, न शर्म लभते is not happy

text: मा रुदो देवि शोकेन मा भूत् ते मनसो ऽप्रियम् । शचीव पत्या शक्रेण भर्त्रा नाथवती ह्यसि ॥५-३९-५२॥
translation: "O devi weep no more.Entertain no unpleasant thoughts.You have a great husband, just as Sachi has her lord Indra.
word_meanings: देवि devi, शोकेन with sorrow, मा रुदः do not cry, ते your, मनसः in mind, अप्रियम् unpleasant, माभूत् no thought be entertained, पत्या with a husband शक्रेण to Indra, शचीव like Sachi, भर्त्रा by your husband, नाथवती you have a great husband, असि हि you are.

text: रामाद् विशिष्टः को ऽन्यो ऽस्ति कश्चित् सौमित्रिणा समः । अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ ॥५-३९-५३॥
translation: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.
word_meanings: रामात् than Rama, विशिष्टः more distinguished, अन्यः others, कः who is there, अस्ति is, सौमित्रिणा to Lakshmana, समः equal, कश्चित् who is there, अग्निमारुतकल्पौ equal to fire and wind, तौ भ्रातरौ both brothers, तव your, संश्रयौ they are your refuge.

text: नास्मिंश्चिरं वत्स्यसि देवि देशे रक्षोगणैरध्युषिते ऽतिरौद्रे । न ते चिरादागमनं प्रियस्य क्षमस्व मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम् ॥५-३९-५४॥
translation: "O noble lady You will not stay longer in this country, which is a strong hold of hosts of demons and a dreadful place It will not be very long before you unite with your beloved. Pray, have patience till then. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: देवि noble lady, रक्षोगणैः by the hosts of ogres, अध्युषिते in a stronghold, अतिरौद्रे in a dreadful place, अस्मिन् देशे country, चिरम् not very long, न वत्स्यसि will not stay, ते प्रियस्य with your beloved, आगमनम् coming, न चिरात् not very long, मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम् for this period, क्षमस्व pardon me.

text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायुसूनोर्महात्मनः । उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता सुरसुतोपमा ॥५-४०-१॥
translation: Sita who was like the daughter of the gods heard the son of the Windgod for her benefit and replied:
word_meanings: महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, वायुसूनोः son of the Windgod, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुरसुतोपमा like the daughter of gods, सीता Sita, आत्महितम् for her benefit, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

text: त्वां दृष्ट्वा प्रियवक्तारं संप्रहृष्यामि वानर । अर्धसञ्जातसस्येव वृष्टिं प्राप्य वसुन्धरा ॥५-४०-२॥
translation: "O vanara just as the earth feels happy when the half grown crops receive rain, I feel happy after seeing you. You have been speaking pleasing words
word_meanings: वानर vanara, प्रियवक्तारम् who has been speaking pleasing words, त्वाम् you दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अर्धसञ्जातसस्या as half grown, वसुन्धरा earth, वृष्टिम् rain, प्राप्येव as if begotten, सम्प्रहृष्यामि I feel happy.

text: यथा तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गात्रैः शोकाभिकर्शितैः । संस्पृशेयं सकामा ऽहं तथा कुरु दयां मयि ॥५-४०-३॥
translation: "Be kind to me and act in such a manner that I may embrace my lord passionately with my body emaciated with grief.
word_meanings: सकामम् a passionate lady, अहम् I, शोकाभिकर्शितैः emaciated with suffering, गात्रैः with limbs, तं पुरुषव्याघ्रम् him that tiger among men, यथा as, संस्पृशेयम् I may touch, तथा in that way, मयि in me, दयाम् kindness, कुरु do.

text: अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगणोत्तम । क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम् ॥५-४०-४॥
translation: "O best leader of vanaras remind Rama about the incident of the release of a blade of grass in anger blinding one of the eyes of the crow narrated to you.
word_meanings: हरिगणोत्तम best leader of the vanaras, कोपात् with anger, क्षिप्ताम् released, काकस्य crow's, एकाक्षिशातनीम् blinding one eye, इषीकाम् by a blade of grass, रामस्य to Rama, अभिज्ञानम् as a token, दद्याः give.

text: मनःशिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः । त्वया प्रनष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि ॥५-४०-५॥
translation: '(Further remind him), 'When my tilaka mark was erased, you painted tilaka with a stone (manassita pigment) nearby. O Rama you should remember that (incident).
word_meanings: तिलके when tilaka mark, प्रणष्टे got erased, त्वया by you, मनश्शिलायाः with a grind stone, तिलकः tilaka (mark on forehead), गण्डपार्श्वे stone near by, निवेशितः किल painted indeed, तम् that tilaka, स्मर्तुम् to remember, अर्हसि you will.

text: स वीर्यवान् कथं सीतां हृतां समनुमन्यसे । वसन्तीं रक्षसां मध्ये महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः ॥५-४०-६॥
translation: 'Rama you are like Indra and Varuna in valiance. How are you tolerating Sita seized, dwelling among the demons?
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant, महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः comparable to Varuna and Indra, सः Rama, हृताम् seized, रक्षसाम् of rakshasas, मध्ये in the midst of, वसन्तीम् dwelling, सीताम् Sita, कथम् how, समनुमन्यसे he will agree.

text: एष चूडामणिर्दिव्यो मया सुपरिरक्षितः । एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्यामि व्यसने त्वामिवानघ ॥५-४०-७॥
translation: "O sinless Rama this wonderful Chudamani of mine has been carefully safeguarded. Seeing this is like seeing you when I am in distress.
word_meanings: अनघ sinless, दिव्यः wonderful, एषः this, चूडामणिः Chudamani, मया of mine, सुपरिरक्षितः carefully safe guared, व्यसने in distress, एतम् this one, दृष्ट्वा seeing, त्वामिव like you here, प्रहृष्यामि look at it.

text: एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान् मया ते वारिसम्भवः । अतः परं न शक्ष्यामि जीवितुं शोकलालसा ॥५-४०-८॥
translation: "I am sending you this (Chudamani) born of the sea. O glorious Rama and now engrossed in grief it is not possible for me to live.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् glorious one, वारिसम्भवः born of the sea, एषः this, ते to you, निर्यातितः is returned, शोकलालसा engrossed in grief, अतः परम् beyond this, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि it is not possible for me.

text: असह्यानि न दुःखानि वाचश्च हृदयच्छिदः । राक्षसीनां सुघोराणां त्वत्कृते मर्षयाम्यहम् ॥५-४०-९॥
translation: "I am tolerating this unbearable grief, and the words of the dreadful ogresses piercing my heart. Only for you.
word_meanings: अहम् I, असह्यानि unbearable, दुःखानि grief, सुघोराणाम् of dreadful ones, राक्षसीनाम् of ogresses, हृदयच्छिदः piercing my heart, वाचश्च utterings, त्वत्कृते your sake, मर्षयामि I am enduring.

text: धारयिष्यामि मासं तु जीवितं शत्रुसूदन । मासादूर्ध्वं न जीविष्ये त्वया हीना नृपात्मज ॥५-४०-१०॥
translation: "O subduer of enemies O prince I will hold on to life only for a month. I will not survive beyond a month in your absence.
word_meanings: शत्रुसूदन O subduer of enemies, नृपात्मज O prince, मासं तु for one month only, जीवितम् life, धारयिष्यामि will survive, त्वया you, हीना separated, मासात् for one month only, ऊर्ध्वम् beyond that, न जीविष्ये will not live.

text: घोरो राक्षसराजो ऽयं दृष्टिश्च न सुखा मयि । त्वां च श्रुत्वा विषज्जनं न जीवेयमहं क्षणम् ॥५-४०-११॥
translation: "The demon king is frightful. He looks at me with immoral (lusty) eyes. I do not wish to live even for a moment after hearing about the adversities (you have faced)."
word_meanings: अयम् this, राक्षसराजः demon king, घोरः fearsome, मयि at me, दृष्टिः look, सुखा moral, न no, त्वाम् you, विपद्यन्तम् facing calamities, श्रुत्वा hearing, अहम् I, क्षणम् even a moment, न जीवेयम् I will not survive.

text: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् । तथा ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४०-१२॥
translation: Hearing the words of Sita who was weeping piteously, brilliant Hanuman said this:
word_meanings: अथ then, महातेजाः a brilliant one, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, साश्रु weeping, भाषितम् words spoken, करुणम् piteously, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अब्रवीत् said.

text: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे । रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ॥५-४०-१३॥
translation: "O irreproachable lady I swear by you that Rama has grown averse to everything out of grief of separation from you. When Rama is in grief even Lakshmana gets immersed in sorrow.
word_meanings: देवि O irreproachable lady, रामः Rama, त्वच्छोकविमुखः out of grief he is not showing any interest in life, सत्येन truly, ते to you, शपे I promise, रामे when Rama, दुःखाभिभूते he is in grief, लक्ष्मणः च even Lakshmana, परितप्यते is immersed in sorrow.

text: कथंचिद् भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् । इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यामि भामिनि ॥५-४०-१४॥
translation: "O beautiful lady somehow I could meet you. This is not the time to worry about. You will see the end of suffering at this very moment.
word_meanings: कथञ्चित् somehow, भवती you, दृष्टा seen, परिशोचितम् to worry, कालः time, न not, भामिनि a beautiful lady, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, दुःखानाम् for grief, अन्तम् end, द्रक्ष्यसि you can see.

text: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रावरिन्दमौ । त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ॥५-४०-१५॥
translation: "Both the princes are tigers among men and crushers of enemies. They are determined to see you, and will reduce Lanka to ashes.
word_meanings: पुरुषव्याघ्रौ tigers among men, अरिन्दमौ crusher of enemies, त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ very determined to see you, उभौ both, तौ राजपुत्रौ both the princes, लङ्काम् Lanka, भस्मीकरिष्यतः will reduce to ashes.

text: हत्वा तु समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम् । राघवौ त्वां विशालाक्षि स्वां पुरीं प्रापयिष्यतः ॥५-४०-१६॥
translation: "O largeeyed lady Killing in war the vile Ravana, the demon king and all his relatives, Rama would take you back to his own city৷৷
word_meanings: विशालाक्षि largeeyed one, राघवः Rama, समरे in war, सहबान्धवम् along with relatives, क्रूरम् vile, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, स्वां पुरीं प्रति to his own city, त्वाम् you, प्रापयिष्यतः will take you back.

text: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते । प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य भूयस्त्वं दातुमर्हसि ॥५-४०-१७॥
translation: "O unimpeachable lady give one more identification which would make him more happy".
word_meanings: अनिन्दिते blameless lady, रामः Rama, यत् that which, अभिज्ञानम् knows, विजानीयात् to identify you, तस्य your, प्रीतिसञ्जननम् that which makes him more happy, भूयः one more, त्वम् you, दातुम् may give, अर्हसि is proper.

text: सा ऽब्रवीद्दत्तमेवेति मया ऽभिज्ञानमुत्तमम् । एतदेव हि रामस्य दृष्ट्वा मत्केशभूषणम् । श्रद्धेयं हनुमन् वाक्यं तव वीर भविष्यति ॥५-४०-१८॥
translation: "I have already given the best identification. When you hand this jewel used on my hair to him, he will believe what you tell him".
word_meanings: मया mine, उत्तमम् best, अभिज्ञानम् identification, दत्तमेव already given, इति this, सा she, अब्रवीत् said, वीर hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, एतत् all this, मत्केशभूषणम् my jewel for the hair, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तव his, वाक्यम् words, रामस्य Rama's, श्रद्धेयम् what you tell, भविष्यति will believe.

text: स तं मणिवरं गृह्य श्रीमान् प्लवगसत्तमः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं गमनायोपचक्रमे ॥५-४०-१९॥
translation: The illustrious vanara held the ornament, prostrated to Sita and prepared to depart.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् illustrious one, सः he, प्लवगसत्तमः best of vanaras, मणिवरम् best jewel, गृह्य holding, देवीम् to Sita, शिरसा by his head, प्रणम्य prostrated, गमनाय to depart, उपचक्रमे started.

text: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरिपुङ्गवम् । वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा ॥५-४०-२०॥
translation: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.
word_meanings: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, उत्पातकृतोत्साहम् risen up eager to leap, वर्धमानम् enlarging, महावेगम् very swiftly, तं हरिपुङ्गवम् him the chief of vanaras, आवेक्ष्य looking at him, अश्रुपूर्णमुखी her face filled with tears, दीना pitiably, बाष्पगद्गदया throat choked with tears, गिरा with these words, उवाच spoke.

text: अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ॥५-४०-२१॥
translation: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.
word_meanings: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, उत्पातकृतोत्साहम् risen up eager to leap, वर्धमानम् enlarging, महावेगम् very swiftly, तं हरिपुङ्गवम् him the chief of vanaras, आवेक्ष्य looking at him, अश्रुपूर्णमुखी her face filled with tears, दीना pitiably, बाष्पगद्गदया throat choked with tears, गिरा with these words, उवाच spoke.

text: हनुमन् सिंहसङ्काशौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । सुग्रीवं च सहामात्वं सर्वान् ब्रूया ह्यनामयम् ॥५-४०-२२॥
translation: "O Hanuman to the lionlike brothers Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva including his ministers and to every one convey my good wishes.
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, भ्रातरौ brothers, सिंहसङ्काशौ both comparable to lion, रामलक्ष्मणौ to Rama and Lakshmana, सहामात्यम् along with ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, सर्वान् to all, अनामयम् wellbeing, ब्रूयाः convey.

text: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः । अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात् त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ॥५-४०-२३॥
translation: "You should make efforts in such a manner that the mightyarmed Rama will help me in crossing the cean of sorrow.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, सः राघवः that Rama, अस्मात् from this, दुःखाम्बुसंशेधात् from this ocean of sorrow, यथा in such a way, तारयति will help to cross, त्वम् you, समाधातुम् to make efforts, अर्हसि it is proper.

text: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च । ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ॥५-४०-२४॥
translation: "Foremost vanara tell Rama about my intense grief as well as the threats of the demons. May your journey be happy.
word_meanings: हरिप्रवीर foremost vanara, रामस्य to Rama, समीपम् near, गतः after going, मम my, इमम् this, तीव्रम् intense, शोकवेगम् of grief, एभिः by these, रक्षोभिः by the rakshasas, परिभर्त्सनं च threats also, ब्रूयाः you nararte, ते to you, अध्वा journey, शिवः happy, अस्तु let it be.

text: स राजपुत्र्या प्रतिवेदितार्थः कपिः कृतार्थः परिहृष्टचेताः । अल्पावशेषं प्रसमीक्ष्य कार्यं दिशं ह्युदिचीं मनसा जगाम ॥५-४०-२५॥
translation: Hanuman understood the message of princess Sita and felt delighted at heart at his accomplishment. Considering the small task yet to be accomplished he reached the northern shore mentally (He thought of Rama who waited in Kishkinda which is in the northern direction). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सः that, कपिः vanara, राजपुत्र्या by the princess, प्रतिवेदितार्थः understood the message, कृतार्थः accomplished, परिहृष्टचेताः delighted at heart, कार्यम् task, अल्पावशेषम् a small left over, प्रसमीक्ष्य after considering, उदीचीम् north, दिशम् direction, मनसा mentally, जगम reached.

text: स च वाग्भिः प्रशन्ताभिर्गमिष्यन् पूजितस्तया । तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-४१-१॥
translation: Having been honoured and praised by Sita's words, Hanuman prepared to depart from Sita's presence.
word_meanings: गमिष्यन् to depart, सः वानरः that vanara, तया by her, प्रशस्ताभिः with choicest, वाग्भिः with words, पूजितः honoured, तस्मात् from that, देशात् from location, अपक्रम्य moved, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

text: अल्पशेषमिदं कार्यं दृष्टेयमसितेक्षणा । त्रीनुपायानतिक्रम्य चतुर्थ इह दृश्यते ॥५-४१-२॥
translation: This task is all but finished now that this dark-eyed lady has been found; having passed over the first three expedients, here the fourth—punishment—remains.
word_meanings: इदं कार्यम् this work, अल्पशेषम् little more remains, इयम् this, असितेक्षणा blackeyed lady, दृष्टा seen, त्रीन् three expedientsnegotiation, presentation and, dissension (Sama, Dana, Bheda), उपायान् strategies, अतिक्रम्य crossing, इह here, चतुर्थ fourth (expedient) punishment (Danda), विद्यते remains.

text: न साम रक्षस्सु गुणाय कल्पते न दानमर्थोपचितेषु युज्यते । न भेदसाध्या बलदर्पिता जनाः पराक्रमस्त्वेव ममेह रोचते ॥५-४१-३॥
translation: 'With demons, negotiation is of no use. They are wealthy, they need no gifts. Proud of their stregth, the demons will not yield to dissension. I think only by using power it can be done.
word_meanings: रक्षस्सु with demons, साम negotiation, गुणाय for any merit, न कल्पते does not lead, अर्थोपचितेषु being wealthy, दानम् gifts, न युज्यते not proper, बलदर्पिताः proud of their strength, जनाः people, भेदसाध्याः will not yield by sowing seeds of dissension, न not, इह here, मम my, पराक्रमस्त्वेव only by valour, रोचते pleases me.

text: न चास्य कार्यस्य पराक्रमादृते विनिश्चयः कश्चिदिहोपपद्यते । हतप्रवीरा हि रणे राक्षसाः कथंचिदीयुर्यदिहाद्य मार्दवम् ॥५-४१-४॥
translation: 'Other than power, there is no way to accomplish the task of ascertaining their strength. If I slay a few strong ogres somehow they may soften a little and yield.
word_meanings: इह here, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, पराक्रमात् ऋते other than power, विनिश्चयः a decision, कश्चित् even one, इह here, न उपपद्यते not hold good, यत् that, रणे in fight, हतप्रवीराः slay a few heroes, राक्षसाः ogres, अद्य to day, इह here, कथञ्चित् somehow, मार्दवम् soften, ईयुः will yield.

text: कार्ये कर्मणि निर्दिष्टे यो बहून्यपि साधयेत् । पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन स कार्यं कर्तुमर्हति ॥५-४१-५॥
translation: 'He, who can perform tasks in addition to the objective accomplished without affecting it, is really worthy.
word_meanings: कार्ये in a work to be accomplished, कर्मणि in a work, निर्दिष्टे when the work is entrusted, यः he who, पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन without affecting the earlier work, बहून्यपि many, साधयेत् will achieve, सः he, कार्यम् task, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति is fit.

text: न ह्येकः साधको हेतुः स्वल्पस्यापीह कर्मणः । यो ह्यर्थं बहुधा वेद स समर्थो ऽर्थसाधने ॥५-४१-६॥
translation: 'There are ways more than one even to perform a small work. And the capable know it.
word_meanings: इह here, स्वल्पस्य of a trivial task, अपि also, कर्मणः of the task, साधकः effective, हेतुः cause, एकः one, न हि is not, यः he who, अर्थम् as an object, बहुधा in many ways (means of doing), वेद knows, सः he, अर्थसाधने in achieving the task, समर्थः capable.

text: इहैव तावत् कृतनिश्चयो ह्याहं यदि व्रजेयं प्लवगेश्वरालयम् । परात्मसंमर्दविशेषतत्त्ववित् ततः कृतं स्यान्मम भर्तृशासनम् ॥५-४१-७॥
translation: 'If I ascertain the difference in the strength of enemies and vanaras in war here itself and return to Kishkinda, the abode of vanaras, then I would have executed the orders of my lord properly.
word_meanings: अहम् I, इहैव here itself, तावत् therefore, परात्मसम्मर्दविशेषतत्त्ववित् by understanding the difference between the strength of enemy forces and our strength in war, प्लवगेश्वरालयम् abode of vanaras, व्रजेयं यदि if I go, ततः then, मम my, भर्तृशासनम् the orders of my lord, कृतम् executed, स्यात् well.

text: कथं नु खल्वद्य भवेत् सुखागतं प्रसह्य युद्धं मम राक्षसैः सह । तथैव खल्वात्मबलं च सारवत् संमानयेन्मां च रणे दशाननः ॥५-४१-८॥
translation: 'How can I have enduring war with the ogres today? How will my visit to this place end in happy return? Only in a combat this tenheaded Ravana will guage his strength and mine
word_meanings: अद्य today, मम for me, राक्षसैः सह with ogres, प्रसह्य enduring, युद्धम् war, कथं नु how to, सुखागतम् happy coming, भवेत् may be, तथैव in that way, आत्मबलं च our strength, सारवत् substantial, सः he, दशाननः च tenheaded Ravana's, माम् me, रणे in fight, मानयेत् measure.

text: ततः समासाद्य रणे दशाननं समन्त्रिवर्गं सबलप्रयायिनम् । हृदि स्थितं तस्य मतं बलं च वै सुखेन मत्वा ऽहमितः पुनर्व्रजे ॥५-४१-९॥
translation: 'I can return happily only after I gauge the tenheaded Ravana's army in war, his strength, his companions including the ministers and his mind.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, समन्त्रिवर्गम् along with the ministers, सबलप्रयायिनम् and army chiefs marching forward, दशाननम् tenheaded Ravana, रणे in war, समासाद्य after finding out, तस्य his, हृदि in his mind, स्थितम् established, मतम् feeling, बलं च वै strength, मत्त्वा knowing, अहम् I, इतः from here, सुखेन happily, पुनः again, व्रजे can go.

text: इदमस्य नृशंसस्य नन्दनोपममुत्तमम् । वनं नेत्रमनःकान्तं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् ॥५-४१-१०॥
translation: 'This Ashoka garden of Ravana filled with different kinds of trees and creepers is a feast to the eyes and mind. It is an excellent garden like the Nandana garden of Indra.
word_meanings: नृशंसस्य wicked Ravana's, अस्य his, इदम् this (Ashoka garden), नेत्रमनःकान्तम् feast to the eyes and mind, नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् filled with different kinds of trees and creepers, उत्तमम् excellent, वनम् garden, नन्दनोपमम् like the Nandana garden of Indra.

text: इदं विध्वंसयिष्यामि शुष्कं वनमिवानलः । अस्मिन् भग्ने ततः कोपं करिष्यति दशाननः ॥५-४१-११॥
translation: 'I will devastate this garden, just as fire destroys a dried up forest. This will enrage Ravana.
word_meanings: शुष्कम् dried up, वनम् forest, अनलः इव like fire, इदम् this, विध्वंसयिष्यामि will destroy, अस्मिन् when this, भग्ने devastate, ततः then, दशाननः Ravana, कोपम् anger, करिष्यति will exhibit.

text: ततो महत् साश्वमहारथद्विपं बलं समादेक्ष्यति राक्षसाधिपः । त्रिशूलकालायसपट्टसायुधं ततो महद्युद्धमिदं भविष्यति ॥५-४१-१२॥
translation: 'Then the demon king will order the horses, chariots and elephants and army equipped with tridents and spears to march against me. A great war will take place.
word_meanings: ततः then, राक्षसाधिपः king of ogres, साश्वमहारथद्विपम् with horses, chariots and elephants, महत् great, त्रिशूलकालायसपट्टिसायुधम् armed with tridents, black iron spears, बलम् army, समादेक्ष्यति will order, ततः then, इदम् this, महत् great, युद्धम् war, भविष्यति will take place.

text: अहं तु तैः संयति चण्डविक्रमैः समेत्य रक्षोभिरसह्यविक्रमः । निहत्य तद्रावणचोदितं बलं सुखं गमिष्यामि कपीश्वरालयम् ॥५-४१-१३॥
translation: 'I will fight with the ogres sent by Ravana, endowed with fierce strength and irresistible valour. After destroying their army I will go to the abode of vanaras happily'.
word_meanings: अहं तु I on my part, चण्डविक्रमैः with those endowed with fierce strength, तैः with them, रक्षोभिः by demons, संयति in fight, समेत्य colliding, असह्यविक्रमः irresistible valour, रावणचोदितम् sent by Ravana, तत् that, बलम् army, निहत्य after destroying, सुखम् happily, कपीश्वरालयम् to the abode of vanaras, गमिष्यामि I will go.

text: ततो मारुतवत् क्रुद्धो मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः । उरुवेगेन महता द्रुमान् क्षेप्तुमथारभत् ॥५-४१-१४॥
translation: Furious Maruti endowed with fierce valour started uprooting the trees with the speed sprung from his thighs like the Windgod.
word_meanings: ततः then, भीमविक्रमः a vanara of fierce valour, मारुतिः Maruti, क्रुद्धः furious one, अथ and then, महता with great, ऊरुवेगेन with speed sprung from his thighs, मारुतवत् like the Windgod, द्रुमान् trees, क्षेप्तुम् to uproot, आरभत् started.

text: ततस्तु हनुमान् वीरो बभञ्च प्रमदावनम् । मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् ॥५-४१-१५॥
translation: Then Hanuman felled a variety of trees and vines inhabited by intoxicated birds in the beautiful garden meant for womenfolk.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरः hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टम् filled with intoxicated birds, नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् with variety of trees and vines, प्रमदावनम् garden grown for women folk, बभञ्ज felled.

text: तद्वनं मथितैर्वृक्षैर्भिन्नैश्च सलिलाशयैः । चूर्णितैः पर्वताग्रैश्च बभूवाप्रियदर्शनम् ॥५-४१-१६॥
translation: That garden looked ugly with uprooted trees, breached ponds and powdered mountain peaks.
word_meanings: तत् वनम् that garden, मथितैः with destroyed, वृक्षैः trees, भिन्नैः with breached, सलिलाशयैः ponds, चूर्णितैः powdered, पर्वताग्रैश्च mountain peaks, अप्रियदर्शनम् unpleasant appearance, बभूव remained.

text: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैः सलिलाशयैः । ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तैः क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् । न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा ॥५-४१-१७॥
translation: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.
word_meanings: कलान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् with wilted vines and trees, तत् वनम् that garden, नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः with birds shrieking with different kinds of sounds, प्रभिन्नैः with smashed, सलिलाशयैः with ponds of water, क्लान्तै: withered, ताम्रैः with red ones only, किसलयैः with tender shoots, दावानलहतंरणाः like burntin forest fire, ताः लताः those climbers, विह्वलाः इव like women with their robes disarrayed, रेजुः trembling in fear.

text: व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः किसलयैः क्लान्तैः क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् ॥५-४१-१८॥
लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्च नाशितैर्महोरगैर्व्यालमृगैश्च निर्धुतैः । शिलागृहैरुन्मथितैस्तथा गृहैः प्रनष्टरूपं तदभून्महद्वनम् ॥५-४१-१९॥
translation: The great garden lay disfigured, with the arbours and the picture galleries ruined, huge serpents and wild animals scattered, with stone houses and sheds destroyed.
word_meanings: महत् great, तत् वनम् that garden, नाशितैः ruined, लतागृहैः arbours, चित्रगृहैः picture galleries, निर्धुतैः destroyed, महोरगैः huge serpents, व्यालमृगैश्च and even with wild animals, तथा in the same manner, उन्मथितैः scattered, शिलागृहैः stone houses, गृहैः with houses, प्रणष्टरूपम् disfigured, अभूत् became.

text: सा विह्वला ऽशोकलताप्रताना वनस्थली शोकलताप्रताना । जाता दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य कपेर्बलाद्धि प्रमदावनस्य ॥५-४१-२०॥
translation: The pleasuregarden of Ravana appeared as though it was spreading the creepers of sorrow, since it was totally destroyed by the monkey who had set out to protect a woman. प्रमदावनस्य of the pleasure garden, प्रमदाअवनस्य of the hero who came to protect a lady.
word_meanings: दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य of that pleasure garden of the tenheaded Ravana, प्रमदावनस्य कपेः with the strength of the monkey who had set out to protect a lady (Sita), सा वनस्थली that garden, बलात् by force, विह्वला destroyed, शोकलताप्रताना was spreading out creepers of sorrow, जाता appeared.

text: स तस्य कृत्वा ऽर्थपतेर्महाकपिर्महद्व्यलीकं मनसो महात्मनः । युयुत्सुरेको बहुभिर्महाबलैः श्रिया ज्वलंस्तोरणमास्थितः कपिः ॥५-४१-२१॥
translation: The great vanara having perpetrated mischief, rousing anger in the mind of the great lord of wealth, stood at the exit doorway ready to combat singlehanded with many warriors in that mighty army blazing in glory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, अर्थपतेः of the lord of wealth, मनसः in mind, महत् great, व्यलीकम् unpleasantness, कृत्वा having caused, महाबलैः mighty, बहुभिः many, एकः singlehanded, युयुत्सुः ready to fight, श्रिया blazing, ज्वलन् glowing, तोरणम् exit doorway, आस्थितः stood.

text: ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च । बभूवुस्त्राससंभ्रान्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः ॥५-४२-१॥
translation: The residents of Lanka panicked at the shrieking sounds of birds and cracking sounds of trees.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, पक्षिनिनादेन by the sounds of birds, वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन by the cracking sound of trees, सर्वे all, लङ्कानिवासिनः the residents of Lanka, त्राससम्भ्रान्ताः were panicked, बभूवुः became.

text: विद्रुताश्च भयत्रस्ता विनेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः । रक्षसां च निमित्तानि क्रूराणि प्रतिपेदिरे ॥५-४२-२॥
translation: The frightened beasts and birds ran and flew, screeching in all directions. Fierce portents appeared to the demons.
word_meanings: मृगपक्षिणः beasts and birds, विद्रुता: ran and flown away, भयत्रस्ताः became scared, विनेदुः screeching in all directions, रक्षसां च for the ogres, क्रूराणि fierce, निमित्तानि portents, प्रतिपेदिरे appeared.

text: ततो गतायां निद्रायां राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः । तद्वनं ददृशुर्भग्नं तं च वीरं महाकपिम् ॥५-४२-३॥
translation: Hideouslooking ogresses, awakened from sleep, saw the garden devastated by the heroic Vanara.
word_meanings: ततः then, विकृताननाः women of hideous faces, राक्षस्यः ogressses, निद्रायाम् in sleep, गतायाम् was awakened, भग्नम् devastated, तत् that, वनम् garden, वीरम् hero, तं महाकपिं च that great vanara, ददृशुः saw.

text: स ता दृष्ट्वा महाबाहूर्महासत्त्वो महाबलः । चकार सुमहद्रूपं राक्षसीनां भयावहम् ॥५-४२-४॥
translation: When the powerful, mighty and strongarmed Hanuman saw the ogresses he assumed a very huge form in order to strike terror in them.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः strong armed one, महासत्त्वः a great hero, महाबलः mighty, सः he, Hanuman, ताः the women, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राक्षसीनाम् for the ogresses, भयावहम् to create fear, सुमहत् very huge, रूपम् form, चकार assumed.

text: ततस्तं गिरिसङ्काशमतिकायं महाबलम् । राक्षस्यो वानरं दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छुर्जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-४२-५॥
translation: Then, seeing the huge body of the mighty vanara resembling a mountain the ogresses questioned Janaki about him.
word_meanings: ततः then, गिरिसङ्काशम् looking like a mountain, अतिकायम् of huge body, महाबलम् mighty, तं वानरम् that vanara, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, राक्षस्यः ogresses, जनकात्मजाम् Janaki, पप्रच्छुः questioned.

text: को ऽयं कस्य कुतो वा ऽयं किंनिमित्तमिहागतः । कथं त्वया सहानेन संवादः कृत इत्युत ॥५-४२-६॥
translation: "Who is he? By whom has he been sent? From where and why did he come here? What dialogue did you have with him?
word_meanings: अयम् this person, कः who, कस्य whose, अयम् he, कुतः from where, किं निमित्तम् for what purpose, इह here, आगतः he has come, उत or, अनेन by him, त्वया सह with you, संवादः talk, कृतः made.

text: आचक्ष्व नो विशालाक्षि मा भूत्ते सुभगे भयम् । संवादमसितापाङ्गे त्वया किं कृतवानयम् ॥५-४२-७॥
translation: "O lovely, largeeyed lady O auspicious one have no fear. What conversation did he have with you? Tell us".
word_meanings: विशालाक्षि largeeyed lady, नः to us, आचक्ष्व O you may tell, सुभगे O auspicious one, ते to you, भयम् fear, मा भूत् let there be none, असितापाङ्गे O lady with dark sideglances, अयम् this, त्वया with you, किम् what, संवादम् dialogue, कृतवान् he had.

text: अथाब्रवीत्तदा साध्वी सीता सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी । रक्षसां भीमरूपाणां विज्ञाने मम का गतिः ॥५-४२-८॥
translation: Chaste and beautiful Sita said, "How do I know about the ogresses who assume many fierce forms?"
word_meanings: अथ then, महासाध्वी a chaste lady, सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी a lady of beautiful limbs, सीता Sita, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said, भीमरूपाणाम् of fierce form, रक्षसाम् of ogresses, विज्ञाने in knowing, गतिः direction, मम to me, का what?

text: यूयमेवाभिजानीत यो ऽयं यद्वा करिष्यति । अहिरेव ह्यहेः पादान् विजानाति न संशयः ॥५-४२-९॥
translation: "You alone can know about who he is and what he is about. A serpent alone knows the movement (footprints) of another serpent. There is no doubt about it.
word_meanings: अयम् this, यः whoever, यद्वा what, करिष्यति he is about, यूयमेव you alone, अभिजानीत you may find out, अहेः of a serpent, पादान् feet, अहिरेव a serpent alone, विजानाति knows, संशयः doubt, न no.

text: अहमप्यस्य भीता ऽस्मि नैनं जानामि कोन्वयम् । वेद्मि राक्षसमेवैनं कामरूपिणमागतम् ॥५-४२-१०॥
translation: "I am also scared of him. I do not know who he is. I think he is a demon, who came here assuming a form of his choice.
word_meanings: अहमपि I am also, अस्य at him, भीता अस्मि I am scared of, एनम् him, को नु who he is, अयम् this person, न जानामि I do not know, एनम् him, आगतम् came, कामरूपिणम् who has assumed his desired form in various ways, राक्षसमेव demon only, वेद्मि I think.

text: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यो विद्रुता दिशः । स्थिताः काश्चिद्गताः काश्चिद्रावणाय निवेदितुम् ॥५-४२-११॥
translation: LIstening to Vaidehi's words the ogresses divided themselves and fled in all directions. While some stood there, others went to report to Ravana.
word_meanings: वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after listening to, राक्षस्यः ogresses, दिशः in all directions, विद्रुताः ran, काश्चित् some, स्थिताः stood there, काश्चित् some, रावणाय to Ravana, निवेदितुम् to report, गताः fled.

text: रावणस्य समीपे तु राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः । विरूपं वानरं भीममाख्यातुमुपचक्रमुः ॥५-४२-१२॥
translation: The uglyfaced ogresses went to the presence of Ravana and reported about the frightening form of the vanara.
word_meanings: विकृताननाः uglyfaced, राक्षस्यः shedemons, रावणस्य to Ravana, समीपे presence, विरूपम् disfigured, भीमम् frightening, वानरम् vanara, आख्यातुम् to report, उपचक्रमुः started.

text: अशोकवनिकामध्ये राजन् भीमवपुः कपिः । सीतया कृतसंवादस्तदिष्ठत्यमितविक्रमः ॥५-४२-१३॥
translation: "Your majesty an extremely powerful and frightening Vanara had a dialogue with Sita. He is stationed in the midst of Ashoka garden.
word_meanings: राजन् O king, सीतया with Sita, कृतसंवादः had a dialogue, भीमवपुः fearsome figure, अमितविक्रमः very powerful, कपिः vanara, अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the midst of Ashoka garden, तिष्ठति is stationed.

text: न च तं जानकी सीता हरिं हरिणलोचना । अस्माभिर्बहुधा पृष्टा निवेदयितुमिच्छिति ॥५-४२-१४॥
translation: "The deereyed Sita is not willing to disclose to us his identity even when we questioned her.
word_meanings: हरिणलोचना deereyed, जानकी Janaki, सीता Sita, अस्माभिः by us, पृष्टा questioned, तम् about him, निवेदयितुम् to disclose, न इच्छति not willing.

text: वासवस्य भवेद्दूतो दूतो वैश्रवणस्य वा । प्रेषितो वा ऽपि रामेण सीतान्वेषणकाङ्क्षया ॥५-४२-१५॥
translation: "He may be an envoy of Indra or Kubera or of Rama sent with an intent to trace Sita.
word_meanings: वासवस्य Vasava's, दूतः envoy, वैश्रवणस्य Vaisravana's, दूतो वा is he an envoy, सीतान्वेषणकाङ्क्षया or one who has come to trace Sita, रामेण by Rama, प्रेषितो वापि or sent, भवेत् may be.

text: तेन त्वद्भुतरूपेण यत्तत्तव मनोहरम् । नानामृगगणाकीर्णं प्रमृष्टं प्रमदावनम् ॥५-४२-१६॥
translation: "Your beautiful pleasure garden filled with a variety of beasts has been ruined by this wonderful figure.
word_meanings: अद्भुतरूपेण by a person of wonderful form, तेन by him, मनोहरम् delightful, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various kinds of animals, यत् such, तव your, प्रमदावनम् beautiful pleasure garden, प्रमृष्टम् ruined.

text: न तत्र कश्चिदुद्देशो यस्तेन न विनाशितः । यत्र सा जानकी सीता स तेन न विनाशितः ॥५-४२-१७॥
translation: There is not a single place that has not been ruined by him there. Only the place where Janaka's daughter, Sita is resting has not been touched.
word_meanings: तेन by him, यः whichever, न विनाशितः not ruined, उद्देशः place, तत्र there, कश्चित् even one, न not, सा that, जानकी Janaki, सीता Sita, यत्र wherever, सः that place, तेन by him, न विनाशितः not ruined.

text: जानकीरक्षणार्थं वा श्रमाद्वा नोपलभ्यते । अथवा कः श्रमस्तस्य सैव तेनाभिरक्षिता ॥५-४२-१८॥
translation: "It is not clear whether he spared that place for protecting Janakai or he stopped due to exhaustion. What is fatigue for him? It must be to save her that she is spared by him.
word_meanings: जानकीरक्षणार्थं वा is it to protect Janaki, श्रमाद्वा or is it because he was tired, नोपलभ्यते we are not able to understand, अथवा or else, तस्य his, श्रमः tiresomeness, कः what, तेन by him, सैव she alone, अभिरक्षिता is spared.

text: चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यं यं सीता स्वयमास्थिता । प्रवृद्धः शिंशुपावृक्षः स च तेनाभिरक्षितः ॥५-४२-१९॥
translation: "He has spared the simsupa tree with lovely, tender leaves and flowers which is a chosen resort by Sita.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यम् a tree with lovely tender leaves and flowers, यम् whom, स्वयम् personally, आस्थिता she resorted, सः that, प्रवृद्धः large, शिंशुपावृक्षः simsupa tree, तेन by him, अभिरक्षितः is saved from destruction.

text: तस्योग्ररूपस्योग्र त्वं दण्डमाज्ञातुमर्हसि । सीता संभाषिता येन तद्वनं च विनाशितम् ॥५-४२-२०॥
translation: "Your highness should take severe action on that person of fierce appearance with whom Sita dared to speak, and by whom the garden is ruined.
word_meanings: येन whomsoever, सीता Sita, सम्भाषिता had dialogue, तत् वनं च that garden also, विनाशितम् has been ruined, तस्य his, उग्ररूपस्य of a fierce form, त्वम् you, उग्रम् severe, दण्डम् punishment, आज्ञातुम् to order, अर्हसि is proper

text: मनःपरिगृहीतां तां तव रक्षोगणेश्वर । कः सीतामभिभाषेत यो न स्यात्त्यक्तजीवितः ॥५-४२-२१॥
translation: "O lord of the demon clan Who dares to talk to Sita if he has not given up all hope of life, since she is desired by you".
word_meanings: रक्षोगणेश्वर O lord of the demon clan, मनः परिगृहीताम् one who is desired by you, तां सीताम् that Sita, यः whoever, त्यक्तजीवितः given up hope of life, न स्यात् if not, कः who, अभिभाषेत he will dare to talk.

text: राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । हुताग्निरिव जज्वाल कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः ॥५-४२-२२॥
translation: On listening to the report of the ogresses, Ravana, the lord of demons flared up like blazing flame of a sacrificial fire, his eyeballs rolling in rage.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः lord of ogres, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसीनाम् shedemons, वचः words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः his eyeballs rolling in anger, हुताग्निरिव like sacrificial fire into which offering is made,जज्वाल flared.

text: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नास्रबिन्दवः । दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः ॥५-४२-२३॥
translation: From his angry eyes fell down drops of tears just as burning drops of oil drip from two burning lamps.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धस्य of the angry, तस्य his, नेत्राभ्याम् from both the eyes, दीप्ताभ्याम् burning ones, दीपाभ्याम् from two lamps, सार्चिषः with flames, स्नेहबिन्दवः इव like drops of oil, अस्रबिन्दवः drops of tears, प्रापतन् fell down.

text: आत्मनः सदृशाञ्छूरान् किङ्करान्नाम राक्षसान् । व्यादिदेश महातेजा निग्रहार्थं हनूमतः ॥५-४२-२४॥
translation: Then powerful Ravana commanded heroic demons called kinkaras who vied in strength to catch Hanuman.
word_meanings: महातेजाः powerful, हनूमतः Hanuman's, निग्रहार्थम् to catch, आत्मनः his, सदृशान् equals, शूरान् heroes, किङ्करान्नाम called kinkaras, राक्षसान् demons, व्यादिदेश commanded.

text: तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं किङ्कराणां तरस्विनाम् ॥५-४२-२५॥
translation: Eighty thousand powerful kinkaras (a clan of demons), largebellied, with large teeth and of dreadful appearance, swift in action, armed with hammers and clubs marched from there, resolved to capture Hanuman.
word_meanings: तरस्विनाम् of swiftmoving ones, तेषां किङ्कराणाम् of the kinkaras, अशीतिसाहस्रम् eighty thousand, महोदराः largebellied, महादंष्ट्राः largetoothed, घोररूपाः dreadfullooking, महाबलाः powerful, युद्धाभिमनसः ready to fight in war, सर्वे all, कूटमुद्गरपाणयः hammers and clubs, हनुमद्ग्रहणोद्यताः resolved to capture Hanuman, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् building, निर्ययुः came out.

text: निर्ययुर्भवनात् तस्मात्कूटमुद्गरपाणयः । महोदरा महादंष्ट्रा घोररूपा महाबलाः । युद्धाभिमनसः सर्वे हनुमद्ग्रहणोन्मुखाः ॥५-४२-२६॥
translation: Eighty thousand powerful kinkaras (a clan of demons), largebellied, with large teeth and of dreadful appearance, swift in action, armed with hammers and clubs marched from there, resolved to capture Hanuman.
word_meanings: तरस्विनाम् of swiftmoving ones, तेषां किङ्कराणाम् of the kinkaras, अशीतिसाहस्रम् eighty thousand, महोदराः largebellied, महादंष्ट्राः largetoothed, घोररूपाः dreadfullooking, महाबलाः powerful, युद्धाभिमनसः ready to fight in war, सर्वे all, कूटमुद्गरपाणयः hammers and clubs, हनुमद्ग्रहणोद्यताः resolved to capture Hanuman, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् building, निर्ययुः came out.

text: ते कपीन्द्रं समासाद्य तोरणस्थमवस्थितम् । अभिपेतुर्महावेगाः पतङ्गा इव पावकम् ॥५-४२-२७॥
translation: The kinkaras rushed towards the leader of vanaras who stood near the archway like the moths rushing towards the flame.
word_meanings: ते they, तोरणस्थम् near the archway, अवस्थितम् stood ready, कपीन्द्रम् leader of vanaras, समासाद्य having approached, महावेगाः swift ones, पतङ्गाः moths, पावकम् इव like rushing into the flame, अभिपेतुः rushed.

text: ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः । आजघ्नुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं शरैश्चादित्यसन्निभैः ॥५-४२-२८॥
translation: They assailed Hanuman with iron maces, crowbars edged with gold and shining arrows resembling the Sun.
word_meanings: ते they, विचित्राभिः with wonderful ones, गदाभिः with iron maces, काञ्चनाङ्गदैः edged with gold, परिघैः with crowbars, आदित्यसन्निभैः resembling the Sun, शरैश्च with arrows, वानरश्रेष्ठम् best of vanaras, आजघ्नुः assailed.

text: मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः प्रासतोमरशक्तिभिः । परिवार्य हनूमन्तं सहसा तस्थुरग्रतः ॥५-४२-२९॥
translation: They quickly surrounded Hanuman and stood with hammers, sharpedged spears, tridents, barbed missiles and powerful javelins.
word_meanings: मुद्गरैः with hammers, पट्टि with sharpedged spears, शूलैः with tridents, प्रासतोमरशक्तिभिः with barbed missiles and powerful javelins, सहसा at once, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, परिवार्य surrounded, अग्रतः in front of him, तस्थुः stood.

text: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी श्रीमान् पर्वतसन्निभिः । क्षितावाविध्य लांगूलं ननाद च महास्वनम् ॥५-४२-३०॥
translation: Gigantic Hanuman, illustrious and brilliant, roared and waved his tail striking it with force on the ground causing loud sound.
word_meanings: तेजस्वी brilliant, श्रीमान् illustrious one, पर्वतसन्निभः resembling a mountain, हनुमानपि Hanuman also, लाङ्गूलम् tail, क्षितौ on the ground, आविध्य waved, महास्वनम् causing loud sound, ननाद च roared.

text: स भूत्वा सुमहाकायो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । धृष्टमास्फोटयामास लङ्कां शब्देन पूरयन् ॥५-४२-३१॥
translation: Hanuman, son of Maruti, enlarged his body to a huge size and patted himself wildly making loud noise that echoed the entire Lanka.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः Maruti's son, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, सुमहाकायः with a huge body, भूत्वा assuming, शब्देन by the sound, लङ्काम् entire Lanka, पूरयन् echoed, धृष्टम् wildly, अस्फोटयामास patted.

text: तस्यास्फोटितशब्देन महता सानुनादिना । पेतुर्विहङ्गा गगनादुच्चैश्चेदमघोषयत् ॥५-४२-३२॥
translation: By the highly frightening sound caused by Hanuman patting, the birds from the sky fell down making a loud noise and Hanuman proclaimed in a loud voice as follows:
word_meanings: सानुनादिना by the frightening echoing sound, महता with great, तस्य his, अस्फोटितशब्देन by the sound of the patting, विहङ्गाः birds, गगनात् from the sky, पेतुः fell down, उच्चैः with a loud noise, इदम् thus, अघोषयत् च proclaimed.

text: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ॥५-४२-३३॥
translation: "Victory to Rama, the mighty and powerful, Victory to Lakshmana. Victory to king Sugriva who is ruled by Rama."
word_meanings: अतिबलः mighty, रामः Rama, जयति is victorious, महाबलः powerful, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः ruled, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति is victorious.

text: दासो ऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । हनुमान् शत्रुसैन्यानां निहन्ता मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४२-३४॥
translation: "I, son of the Windgod, destroyer of hostile armies, am a servant of Rama, the lord of Kosala kingdom, a man of unwearied action.
word_meanings: शत्रुसैन्यानाम् of the enemy army, निहन्ता killer, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, अहम् I am, कोसलेन्द्रस्य of the lord of Kosala kingdom, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः a man of unwearied action, रामस्य Rama's, दासः servant.

text: न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत् । शिलाभिस्तु प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः ॥५-४२-३५॥
translation: Even a thousand Ravanas will not match me in strength when I pound stones and trees in a thousand ways.
word_meanings: सहस्रशः a thousand ways, शिलाभिः with stones, पादपैश्च with even trees, प्रहरतः while I pound, मे to me, युद्धे in war, रावणसहस्रम् a thousand Ravanas, प्रतिबलम् match in strength, न भवेत् will not.

text: अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम् । समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥५-४२-३६॥
translation: "I shall destroy the city of Lanka and pay my respects to Mythili right under the nose of all demons. I will return with my purpose accomplished.
word_meanings: सर्वरक्षसाम् all ogres, मिषताम् as they gaze, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, अर्दयित्वा shall destroy, मैथिलीम् to Mythili, अभिवाद्य च and pay respects, समृद्धार्थः having accomplished my purpose, गमिष्यामि I will return.

text: तस्य सन्नादशब्देन ते ऽभवन् भयशङ्किताः । ददृशुश्च हनूमन्तं सन्ध्यामेघमिवोन्नतम् ॥५-४२-३७॥
translation: Terrified on hearing the roar, the kinkaras looked at the towering Hanuman who seemed like a cloud in twilight (red in colour).
word_meanings: ते they, तस्य his, सन्नादशब्देन with the sound of hearing, भयशङ्किता: errified, अभवन् seemed, सन्ध्यामेघमिव like a cloud in twilight, उन्नतम् towering, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, ददृशुश्च saw.

text: स्वामिसन्देशनिश्शङ्कास्ततस्ते राक्षसाः कपिम् । चित्रैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः ॥५-४२-३८॥
translation: Obeying their king's commnad, putting aside their fear, the kinkaras freely attacked the vanara from all directions with dreadful weapons.
word_meanings: ततः then, ते they, राक्षसाः demons, स्वामिसन्देशनिःशङ्का: on account the king's command putting aside their fear, चित्रैः with dreadful, प्रहरणैः with weapons, कपिम् the vanara, अभिपेतुः attacked him.

text: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः सर्वतः स महाबलः । आससादायसं भीमं परिघं तोरणाश्रितम् । स तं परिघमादय जघान रजनीचरान् ॥५-४२-३९॥
translation: Extremely powerful Hanuman surrounded by heroes all over, on his part went to the archway and picked up a terrific iron beam.
word_meanings: सुमहाबलः exceesively powerful one, सः he, Hanuman, शूरैः with heroes, तैः with those, सर्वतः all over, परिवृतः surrounded, तोरणाश्रितम् near the archway, भीमम् terrific, आयसम् a weapon made of iron, परिघम् iron beam, आससाद picked up.

text: स पन्नगमिवादाय स्फुरन्तं विनतासुतः । विचचाराम्बरे वीरः परिगृह्य च मारुतिः ॥५-४२-४०॥
translation: Hanuman, the mighty hero, seized the iron beam and struck the kinkaras, just as Garuda, the son of Vinata shoots up a struggling serpent and starts taking strides in the sky with the weapon in his hand (like Indra with his thunderbolt did with demons).
word_meanings: सः he, तं परिघम् that iron beam, आदाय took hold, रजनीचरान् nightrangers, जघान struck them, वीरः hero, सः मारुतिः that Maruti, विनतासुतः just as Vinatha's son, स्फुरन्तम् shoots, पन्नगम् serpent, आदाय seized, परिगृह्य took hold, अम्बरे in the sky, विचचार started moving.

text: स हत्वा राक्षसान् वीरान् किङ्करान् मारुतात्मजः । युद्धाकाङ्क्षी पुनर्वीरस्तोरणं समुपाश्रितः ॥५-४२-४१॥
translation: The great Windgod's son killed the kinkaras, and returned to the archway desiring further combat.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, सः मारुतात्मजः that Windgod's son, वीरान् heroes, किङ्करान् kinkaras, राक्षसान् ogres, हत्वा having killed, पुनः again, युद्धाकाङ्क्षी desiring further combat, तोरणम् archway, समुपाश्रितः reached.

text: ततस्तस्माद्भयान्मुक्ताः कतिचित्तत्र राक्षसाः । निहतान् किङ्करान् सर्वान् रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ॥५-४२-४२॥
translation: Then a few surviving ogres took to their heels after getting over that shock and reported to Ravana of the destruction of the kinkaras in the combat
word_meanings: ततः then, तत्र that, तस्मात् from fear, भयात् out of fear, मुक्ताः relieved, कतिचित् some, राक्षसाः ogres, सर्वान् all, किङ्करान् kinkaras, निहतान् killed, रावणाय to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् reported.

text: स राक्षसानां निहतं महद्बलं निशम्य राजा परिवृत्तलोचनः । समादिदेशाप्रतिमं पराक्रमे प्रहस्त पुत्रं समरे सुदुर्जयम् ॥५-४२-४३॥
translation: The mighty demon king having heard about the killing of the formidable army of ogres, his eyes rolling in rage, commanded the son of Prahasta, who is difficult to conquer and matchless in war. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: स he, राजा king, राक्षसानाम् of ogres, महत् mighty, बलम् army, निहतम् killed, निशम्य after hearing, परिवृत्तलोचनः with his eyes rolling, पराक्रमे in valour, अप्रतिमम् matchless, समरे in war, सुदुर्जयम् difficult to conquer, प्रहस्तपुत्रम् son of Prahasta, समादिदेश commanded.

text: वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रसादो न विनाशितः । तस्मात् प्रासादमप्येव भीमं विध्वंसयाम्यहम् । इति ऽञ्चिन्त्य मनसा हनुमान् दर्शयन् बलम् ॥५-४३-१॥
translation: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his strength and jumped on to the top of the palatial building that appeared like the peak of mount Meru.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, किङ्करान् kinkaras, हत्त्वा having slain, ध्यानम् reflected, आस्थितः resumed, मया by me, वनम् garden, भग्नम् destroyed, चैत्यप्रासादः the Chaitya palace, न विनाशितः not ruined, तस्मात् therefore, अद्य now, अहम् I, भीमम् fearsome, प्रासादम् building, एवम् in this way, विध्वंसयामि I will destroy, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, मनसा in his mind, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, बलम् strength, दर्शयन् showed, मेरुशृङ्गमिव like the peak of mount Meru, उन्नतम् tall, चैत्यप्रासादम् Chaitya palace, उत्ल्पुत्य jumped, आरुरोह climbed

text: चैत्यप्रासादमाप्लुत्य मेरुशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । आरुरोह हरिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४३-२॥
translation: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his strength and jumped on to the top of the palatial building that appeared like the peak of mount Meru.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, किङ्करान् kinkaras, हत्त्वा having slain, ध्यानम् reflected, आस्थितः resumed, मया by me, वनम् garden, भग्नम् destroyed, चैत्यप्रासादः the Chaitya palace, न विनाशितः not ruined, तस्मात् therefore, अद्य now, अहम् I, भीमम् fearsome, प्रासादम् building, एवम् in this way, विध्वंसयामि I will destroy, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, मनसा in his mind, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, बलम् strength, दर्शयन् showed, मेरुशृङ्गमिव like the peak of mount Meru, उन्नतम् tall, चैत्यप्रासादम् Chaitya palace, उत्ल्पुत्य jumped, आरुरोह climbed

text: आरुह्य गिरिसङ्काशं प्रासादं हरियूथपः । बभौ स सुमहातेजाः प्रतिसूर्य इवोदितः ॥५-४३-३॥
translation: The powerful vanara leader climbed the tall, palatial building which resembled a mountain. He looked like another Sun, just risen.
word_meanings: हरियूथपः vanara leader, सुमहातेजाः brilliant, सः he, गिरिसङ्काशम् resembling a mountain, प्रासादम् palace, आरुह्य after climbing, उदितः rising, प्रतिसूर्यः इव like another Sun, बभौ looked

text: संप्रधृष्य च दुर्धर्षं चैत्यप्रासादमुत्तमम् । हनुमान् प्रज्वलन् लक्ष्म्या पारियात्रोपमो ऽभवत् ॥५-४३-४॥
translation: Having destroyed the fine palace building, the indomitable Hanuman was blazing with glory like the mountain Pariyatra. (one of the seven Kula mountains viz., Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shuktiman, Riksha, Vindhya and Pariyatra)
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, दुर्धर्षम् indomitable, उत्तमम् fine, चैत्यप्रासादम् palace building, सम्प्रधृष्य च having surrounded लक्ष्म्या with glory, प्रज्वलन् blazing, पारियात्रोपमः like mountain Pariyatra, अभवत् appeared

text: स भूत्वा सुमहाकायः प्रभावान्मारुतात्मजः । धृष्टमास्फोटयामास लङ्कां शब्देन पूरयन् ॥५-४३-५॥
translation: Hanuman heaved his body huge with his prowess and patted his arms loudly filling the city of Lanka with that terrible sound.
word_meanings: सः मारुतात्मजः that son of the Wind god, प्रभावात् by his prowess, सुमहाकायः of a huge body, भूत्वा being, शब्देन by the sound, लङ्काम् Lanka, पूरयन् while filling, धृष्टम् roughly, अस्फोटयामास started patting (his arms)

text: तस्यास्फोटितशब्देन महता श्रोत्रघातिना । पेतुर्विहङ्गमास्तत्र चैत्यपालाश्च मोहिताः ॥५-४३-६॥
translation: By the deafening sound caused by the patting, the birds fell down and the guards of the palace lost consciousness.
word_meanings: तस्य by the, श्रोत्रघातिना by the deafening sound, महता with a loud, अस्फोटितशब्देन with the sound of patting, तत्र there, विहङ्गमाः birds, पेतुः fell down, चैत्यपालाश्च guards of the palace, मोहिताः lost consciousness.

text: अस्त्रविज्जयतां रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ॥५-४३-७॥
translation: 'May Sri Rama, unsurpassed in the use of missiles be victorious May his brother, mighty Lakshmana, a matchless warrior be victorious. May King Sugriva ruled by Rama be victorious.'
word_meanings: अस्त्रवित् knowledgeable about all missiles, रामः Rama, जयताम् be victorious, महाबलः matchless warrior, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः ruled, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति be victorious.

text: दासो ऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । हनुमान् शत्रुसैन्यानां निहन्ता मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४३-८॥
translation: 'I am the son of the Windgod, destroyer of enemy army. I am a servant of Rama, the king of Kosala who can accomplish any task with ease.
word_meanings: शत्रुसैन्यानाम् of enemy army, निहन्ता killer, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, अहम् I, कोसलेन्द्रस्य king of Kosala's, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः one who can acomplish any task with ease, रामस्य Rama's, दासः servant.

text: न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत् । शिलाभिस्तु प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः ॥५-४३-९॥
translation: 'Not even a thousand Ravanas can stand my might in combat as I start assailing them with thousands of rocks or even trees.
word_meanings: सहस्रशः in a thousand ways, शिलाभिः with rocks, पादपैश्च or even with trees, प्रहरतः hurling, मे to me, युद्धे in war, रावणसहस्रम् a thousand Ravanas, प्रतिबलम् match in might, तु also, न भवेत् not be.

text: अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम् । समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥५-४३-१०॥
translation: 'I shall return only after accomplishing the destruction of the city of Lanka and offering obeisance to Sita, while all demons keep looking at me'.
word_meanings: सर्वरक्षसाम् of all ogres, मिषताम् they keep looking, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, अर्थयित्वा destroying, मैथिलीम् Mythili, अभिवाद्य च offering obeisance, समृद्धार्थः having accomplished the task, गमिष्यामि return to.

text: एमुक्त्वा विमानस्थश्चैत्यस्थान् हरियूथपः । ननाद भीमनिर्ह्रादो रक्षसां जनयन् भयम् ॥५-४३-११॥
translation: Having made proclamations that way from the top of the Vimana (palace) the monkey leader roared making terrific sound frightening the ogres.
word_meanings: हरियूथपः monkey leader, विमानस्थः standing on the vimana, चैत्यस्थान् of the palace, एवम् that way, उक्त्वा having said, भीमनिर्ह्रादः making terrific sound, रक्षसाम् to the ogres, भयम् fear, जनयन् while creating, ननाद roared.

text: तेन शब्देन महता चैत्यपालाः शतं ययुः । गृहीत्वा विविधानस्त्रान् प्रासान् खड्गान् परश्वधान् । विसृजन्तो महाकाया मारुतिं प्रर्यवारयन् ॥५-४३-१२॥
translation: Hearing the terrific sound, a hundred gigantic guards of the palace set forth, holding different kinds of weapons like darts, swords and axes and hurled at Maruti surrounding him.
word_meanings: महता with terrific, तेन शब्देन by that sound, शतम् hundred, चैत्यपालाः guards of the palace, विविधान् many, अस्त्रान् weapons, प्रासान् darts, खङ्गान् swords, परश्वथान् axes, गृहीत्वा after picking, ययुः marked, महाकायाः those of huge bodies, विसृजन्तः hurling, मारुतिम् Maruti, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

text: ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः । आजघ्नुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं बाणैश्चादित्यसन्निभैः ॥५-४३-१३॥
translation: Holding astonishing maces decorated with gold, iron crowbars and sharp arrows resembling the rays of the Sun the ogres hit Hanuman, the foremost of vanaras.
word_meanings: ते they, विचित्राभिः with astonishing, गदाभिः with maces, काञ्चनाङ्गदैः maces decorated with gold, परिघैः with crowbars, आदित्यसन्निभैः sharp like the Sun's rays, बाणैश्च with arrows, वानरश्रेष्ठम् foremost of vanaras, अजघ्नुः hit.

text: आवर्त इव गङ्गायास्तोयस्य विपुलो महान् । परिक्षिप्य हरिश्रेष्ठं स बभौ रक्षसां गणः ॥५-४३-१४॥
translation: The demons surrounding the great monkey looked like a big whirlpool of the water of the river Ganga.
word_meanings: सः that, रक्षसां गणः horde of ogres, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of vanaras, परिक्षिप्य having surrounded, गङ्गायाः of the river Ganga, तोयस्य of the water, महान् huge, विपुलः big, आवर्त इव like a whirlpool, बभौ looked.

text: ततो वातात्मजः क्रुद्धो भीमरूपं समास्थितः ॥५-४३-१५॥
प्रासादस्य महान्तस्य स्तम्भं हेमपरिष्कृतम् । उत्पाटयित्वा वेगेन हनुमान् पवनात्मजः । ततस्तं भ्रामयामास शताधारं महाबलः ॥५-४३-१६॥
translation: Thereupon the infuriated son of the Windgod, assumed a fearsome form, uprooted a pillar of the palace decked with gold and holding that hundred edged pillar whirled it round swiftly.
word_meanings: ततः then, वातात्मज son of the Windgod, क्रुद्धः infuriated, भीमम् fearsome, रूपम् form, समास्थितः assumed, महान् great, पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, महाबलः mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य प्रासादस्य of that palace, हेमपरिष्कृतम् decked with gold, स्तम्भं pillar, उत्पाटयित्वा uprooted, ततः then, शतधारम् holding a hundred edged, तम् that, वेगेन swiftly, भ्रामयामास whirled round.

text: तत्र चाग्निः समभवत् प्रासादश्चाप्यदह्यत टयित्वा वेगेन हनुमान् पवनात्मजः ॥५-४३-१७॥
दह्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रासादं हरियूथपः । स राक्षसशतं हत्वा वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान् । अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५-४३-१८॥
translation: Thereafter fire was generated (through friction) and with if the palace blazed. Hanuman saw the palace burning. He killed a hundred demons there as Indra killed demons with his thunderbolt. (The whirling pillar that generated fire apeared like a thunderbolt) Later he stood in the air and proclaimed this:
word_meanings: तत्र thereafter, अग्नि: च and fire, समभवत् was created, प्रासादश्च the palace, अपि also, अदह्यत was burnt, ततः then, सः हरियूथपः Hanuman, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, इन्द्रः Indra, वज्रेण with a thunderbolt, असुरानिव like the ogres, राक्षसशतम् a hundred ogres, हत्त्वा having killed, श्रीमान् illustrous, अन्तरिक्षे in the aerial region, स्थितः stood, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् proclaimed.

text: मादृशानां सहस्राणि विसृष्टानि महात्मनाम् । बलिनां वानरेन्द्राणां सुग्रीववशवर्तिनाम् ॥५-४३-१९॥
अटन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः ॥५-४३-२०॥
translation: "Thousands of huge and mighty monkeys, equal to me, loyal to king Sugriva, are coming under the orders and have been recruited from the entire earth. They are the best among monkeys.
word_meanings: महात्मनाम् huge, बलिनाम् of mighty, सुग्रीववशवर्तिनाम् of those loyal to Sugriva, मादृशानाम् of people like me, वानरेन्द्राणाम् of the best of vanara leaders, सहस्राणि in thousands, विसृष्टानि are despatched, वयम् we, अन्ये others, वानराश्च and vanaras, कृत्स्नाम् entire, वसुधाम् the earth, अटन्ति we are wandering.

text: दशनागबलाः केचित् केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः । केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः ॥५-४३-२१॥
translation: "Of them some have the strength equal to ten elephants, others are ten times stronger, and still others have a thousand elephants' strength.
word_meanings: केचित् some, दशनागबलाः have ten elephants strength, केचित् some, दशगुणोत्तराः ten hundred elephants strength, केचित् some, नागसहस्रस्य thousand elephants strength, तुल्यविक्रमाः equal in power, बभूवुः will be.

text: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित् केचिद्वायुबलोपमाः । अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन् हरियूथपाः ॥५-४३-२२॥
translation: "Some have the strength of flood waters, some are powerful as wind and yet others have strength beyond measure.
word_meanings: केचित् some, ओघबलाः strong as flood, सन्ति there are, केचित् some, वायुबलोपमाः have the power of wind, तत्र there, अन्ये others, हरियूथपाः leaders of monkeys, अप्रमेयबलाश्च of immeasureable strength, आसन् there are.

text: ईदृग्विधैस्तु हरिभिर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः । शतैः शतसहस्रैश्च कोटीभिरयुतैरपि । आगमिष्यति सुग्रीवः सर्वेषां वो निषूदनः ॥५-४३-२३॥
translation: "Sugriva will come here with hundreds of thousands of crores of vanaras who would be fighting with their teeth and nails as weapons.
word_meanings: ईद्दृग्विधैः endowed with such warriors, दन्त अपितु नखायुधै: by those using teeth and nails as weapons, शतैः in hundreds, अयुतैः in ayuta (ten thousand), शतसहस्रैः a hundred thousand, कोटीभिः in crores, हरिभिः with vanaras also, वृतः surrounded, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सर्वेषाम् of all of them, वः you, निषूदनः killer, आगमिष्यति would come here.

text: नेयमस्ति पुरी लङ्का न यूयं न च रावणः । यस्मादिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन बद्धं वैरं महात्मना ॥५-४३-२४॥
translation: "You have established great enmity with the noble lord of Ikshvaku dynasty. Neither this Lanka will endure nor you, nor even Ravana will be traced. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिचत्वारिशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: यस्मात् since, महात्मना with great self, इक्ष्वाकुनाथेन with the lord of Ikshvaku dynasty, वैरम् enmity, बद्धम् is bound, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी city of Lanka, नास्ति will not be found, यूयम् even you, न not, रावणः च and Ravana, न also.

text: सन्दिष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रहस्तस्य सुतो बली । जम्बुमाली महादंष्ट्रो निर्जगाम धनुर्धरः ॥५-४४-१॥
translation: Commanded by the demon king, Jambumali the invincible son of Prahasta, who had large teeth in front, big rolling eyes, red flower garland, red robes and a chaplet with beautiful earrings. He went round twanging his producing thunderous sound. His arrows were huge, shining and beautiful.
word_meanings: महादंष्ट्रः one with big front teeth, धनुर्धरः bow in hand, रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः adorned with a garland of red flowers and red clothes, स्रग्वी wearing a chaplet, रुचिरकुण्डलः with beautiful earrings, महान् great, विवृत्तनयनः who had big round eyes, चण्डः fierce, समरदुर्जयः invincible in war, बली mighty, प्रहस्तस्य सुतः son of Prahasta,जम्बुमाली Jambumali,राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, सन्दिष्टः commanded, महत् huge, रुचिरसायकम् who had radiant arrows, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् making sounds like thunderbolt, शक्रधनुःप्रख्यम् like Indra's splendid bow (a rainbow), धनुः bow, वेगेन very swiftly, विष्फारयाणः as if thundering, निर्जगाम went out.

text: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः स्रग्वी रुचिरगुण्डलः । महान् विवृत्तनयनश्चण्डः समरदुर्जयः ॥५-४४-२॥
translation: Commanded by the demon king, Jambumali the invincible son of Prahasta, who had large teeth in front, big rolling eyes, red flower garland, red robes and a chaplet with beautiful earrings. He went round twanging his producing thunderous sound. His arrows were huge, shining and beautiful.
word_meanings: महादंष्ट्रः one with big front teeth, धनुर्धरः bow in hand, रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः adorned with a garland of red flowers and red clothes, स्रग्वी wearing a chaplet, रुचिरकुण्डलः with beautiful earrings, महान् great, विवृत्तनयनः who had big round eyes, चण्डः fierce, समरदुर्जयः invincible in war, बली mighty, प्रहस्तस्य सुतः son of Prahasta,जम्बुमाली Jambumali,राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, सन्दिष्टः commanded, महत् huge, रुचिरसायकम् who had radiant arrows, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् making sounds like thunderbolt, शक्रधनुःप्रख्यम् like Indra's splendid bow (a rainbow), धनुः bow, वेगेन very swiftly, विष्फारयाणः as if thundering, निर्जगाम went out.

text: धनुः शक्रधनुः प्रख्यं महद्रुचिरसायकम् । विस्फारयानो वेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् ॥५-४४-३॥
translation: Commanded by the demon king, Jambumali the invincible son of Prahasta, who had large teeth in front, big rolling eyes, red flower garland, red robes and a chaplet with beautiful earrings. He went round twanging his producing thunderous sound. His arrows were huge, shining and beautiful.
word_meanings: महादंष्ट्रः one with big front teeth, धनुर्धरः bow in hand, रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः adorned with a garland of red flowers and red clothes, स्रग्वी wearing a chaplet, रुचिरकुण्डलः with beautiful earrings, महान् great, विवृत्तनयनः who had big round eyes, चण्डः fierce, समरदुर्जयः invincible in war, बली mighty, प्रहस्तस्य सुतः son of Prahasta,जम्बुमाली Jambumali,राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, सन्दिष्टः commanded, महत् huge, रुचिरसायकम् who had radiant arrows, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् making sounds like thunderbolt, शक्रधनुःप्रख्यम् like Indra's splendid bow (a rainbow), धनुः bow, वेगेन very swiftly, विष्फारयाणः as if thundering, निर्जगाम went out.

text: तस्य विस्फारघोषेण धनुषो महता दिशः । प्रदिशश्च नभश्चैव सहसा समपूर्यत ॥५-४४-४॥
translation: All directions including the intermediate directions and the sky were filled with that loud sound produced by his twang.
word_meanings: तस्य his, धनुषः bow's, महता by the huge, विष्फारघोषेण by the twang, दिशः all directions, प्रदिशश्चैव and intermediate directions, नभश्चैव heavens also, सहसा at once, समपूर्यत were filled.

text: रथेन खरयुक्तेन तमागतमुदीक्ष्य सः । हनुमान् वेगसम्पन्नौ जहर्ष च ननाद च ॥५-४४-५॥
translation: Seeing him coming in a chariot drawn by donkeys, Hanuman who was swift to act was glad (to have an opportunity to fight) and made a loud noise.
word_meanings: खरयुक्तेन drawn by donkeys, रथेन by the chariot, आगतम् reached, तम् him, उदीक्षय after seeing, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, वेगसम्पन्नः who was endowed with speed, जहर्ष च felt glad, ननाद च and made a loud noise.

text: तं तोरणविटङ्कस्थं हनुमन्तं महाकिपम् । जम्बुमाली महाबाहुर्विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ॥५-४४-६॥
translation: Strongarmed Jambumali with his sharp arrows hit great Hanuman who stood on top of the exit archway.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः strongarmed one, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, तोरणविटङ्कस्थम् who stood on top of the exit archway, महाकपिम् great monkey, तं हनुमन्तम् that Hanuman, निशितैः with sharp, शरैः with arrows, विव्याध hit hard.

text: अर्धचन्द्रेण वदने शिरस्येकेन कर्णिना । बाह्वोर्विव्याध नाराचैर्दशभिस्तं कपीश्वरम् ॥५-४४-७॥
translation: Jambumali released a crescentshaped arrow on the face, one earshaped (barbed) arrow on the head and ten iron arrows into the arms of the lord of monkeys.
word_meanings: अर्धचन्द्रेण with a crescentshaped arrow, वदने on the face, एकेन with one, कर्णिना ear shaped arrow, शिरसि on the head, दशभिः ten, नाराचैः iron arrows, बाह्वोः into the arms, तं कपीश्वरम् that lord of monkeys, विव्याध hit.

text: तस्य तच्छुशुभे ताम्रं शरेणाभिहतं मुखम् । शरदीवाम्बुजं फुल्लं विद्धं भास्कररश्मिना ॥५-४४-८॥
translation: His red face struck by an arrow appeared like a fullblown lotus in autumn season hit by the rays of the Sun.
word_meanings: शरेण by an arrow, अभिहतम् struck, ताम्रम् reddish, तत् his, मुखम् face, शरदि in autumn, भास्करश्मिना with Sun's radiance, विद्धम् hit, फुल्लम् blown, अम्बुजमिव like a lotus, शुशुभे appeared.

text: तत्तस्य रक्तं रक्तेन ऽञ्जितं शुशुभे मुखम् । यथा ऽ ऽकाशे महापद्मं सिक्तं चन्दनबिन्दुभिः ॥५-४४-९॥
