translation: His red face stained with blood was glowing bright like red lotus in the sky sprinkled with drops of red sandal.
word_meanings: रक्तेन by blood, रञ्जितम् glowing, रक्तम् red, तस्य his, तत् that, मुखम् face, चन्दनबिन्दुभिः with sandal drops, सिक्तम् sprinkled, आकाशे in the sky, महापद्मं यथा like a great lotus, शुशुभे looked bright.

text: चुकोप बाणाभिहतो राक्षसस्य महाकपिः ॥५-४४-१०॥
translation: Struck by the shafts of the ogre, the great monkey was enraged and happened to see a huge, heavy rock lying beside him on the ground.
word_meanings: बाणाभिहतः struck by the shafts, महाकपिः great monkey, राक्षसस्य of the demon, चुकोप enraged, ततः then, पार्श्वे lying beside, अतिविपुलाम् huge, महतीम् on the ground, शिलाम् rock, ददर्श he saw.

text: ततः पार्श्वे ऽतिविपुला ददर्श महतीं शिलाम् । तरसा तां समुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप बलवद्बली । तां शरैर्दशभिः क्रुद्धस्ताडयामास राक्षसः ॥५-४४-११॥
translation: Powerful Hanuman with all vehemence lifted the rock and hurled it at the giant which he angrily smashed with ten arrows.
word_meanings: बली a powerful one, ताम् that boulder, तरसा with vehemence, समुत्पाट्य having lifted, बलवत् with his strength, चिक्षेप hurled, राक्षसः giant, क्रुद्धः angrily, ताम् that rock, दशभिः with ten, शरैः with arrows, ताडयामास smashed.

text: विपन्नं कर्म तद् दृष्ट्वा हनुमांश्चण्डविक्रमः । सालं विपुलमुत्पाट्य भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान् ॥५-४४-१२॥
translation: Hanuman, a strong, powerful and fierce warrior pulled out a sala tree and whirled it. Seeing that his attempt has failed.
word_meanings: चण्डविक्रमः who had fierce power, वीर्यवान् a warrior, हनुमान् Hanuman, तत् that कर्म action, विपन्नम् failed, दृष्ट्वा seeing, विपुलम् huge, सालम् sala tree, उत्पाट्य pulled out, भ्रामयामास whirled.

text: भ्रामयन्तं कपिं दृष्ट्वा सालवृक्षं महाबलम् । चिक्षेप सुबहून् बाणान् जम्बुमाली महाबलः ॥५-४४-१३॥
translation: Gigantic Jambumali seeing the mighty Hanuman whirling the sala tree fired many arrows at him.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, सालवृक्षम् sala tree, भ्रामयन्तम् after whirling, महाबलम् mighty, कपिम् monkey, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, सुबहून् many, बाणान् arrows, चिक्षेप fired.

text: सालं चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद वानरं पञ्चभिर्भुजे । उरस्येकेन बाणेन दशभिस्तु स्तनान्तरे ॥५-४४-१४॥
translation: He struck the sala tree with four arows, the arm of Hanuman with five arrows, chest with one, the hollow of the chest with ten more arrows.
word_meanings: सालम् sala tree, चतुर्भिः with four, चिच्छेद cut off, वानरम् vanara, पञ्चभिः with five, भुजे on his arm, उरसि on his chest, एकेन बाणेन with one arrow, स्तनान्तरे in the hollow of the chest, दशभिः with ten.

text: स शरैः पूरिततनुः क्रोधेन महता वृतः । तमेव परिघं गृह्य भ्रामयामास वेगतः ॥५-४४-१५॥
translation: Hanuman filled with arrows all over his body, seized an iron spear (which he made use of in the initial battle) and impetuously spun it in intense anger.
word_meanings: शरैः arrows, पूरिततनु: the body was filled, सः that, महता intense, क्रोधेन with anger, वृतः endowed, वेगितः speedily, तं परिघमेव the same iron spear, गृह्य seized, भ्रामयामास started whirling.

text: अतिवेगो ऽतिवेगेन भ्रामयित्वा बलोत्कटः । परिघं पातयामास जम्बुमालेर्महोरसि ॥५-४४-१६॥
translation: Hanuman of immeasurable strength hurled the iron spear after turning it round and round at high speed on the broad chest of Jambumali.
word_meanings: बलोत्कटः of immeasurable strength, अतिवेगः a hero of great speed, परिघम् iron spear, अतिवेगेन with great speed, भ्रामयित्वा after turning round and round, जम्बुमालेः on Jambumali, महोरसि on the broad chest, पातयामास hurled.

text: तस्य चैव शिरो नास्ति न बाहू न च जानुनी । न धनुर्न रथो नाश्वास्तत्रादृश्यन्त नेषवः ॥५-४४-१७॥
translation: Neither his head could be discerned nor his arms, knees, nor bow, chariot nor donkeys. Nothing was seen.
word_meanings: तत्र there, तस्य his, शिरः चैव even head, नास्ति not there, बाहू shoulders, न not, जानुनी knees, न not, धनुः bow, न not, रथः chariot, न not, अश्वाः donkeys, horses, नादृश्यन्तः not there to discern, इषवः न nothing was seen.

text: स हतस्तरसा तेन जम्बुमाली महाबलः । पपात निहतो भूमौ चूर्णिताङ्गविभूषणः ॥५-४४-१८॥
translation: Mighty Jambumali killed by that blow dropped down dead at once with his ornaments reduced to powder.
word_meanings: तेन by that blow, हतः killed, महाबलः mighty, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, सहसा inconsiderately, निहतः having been killed, चूर्णिताङ्गविभूषणः with his ornaments reduced to powder, भूमौ on the floor, पपात fell down.

text: जम्बुमालिं च निहतं किङ्करांश्च महाबलान् । चुक्रोध रावणः श्रुत्वा कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ॥५-४४-१९॥
translation: Ravana's eyes became bloodshot in anger when he heard about the death of Jambumali and of the strong army of kinkaras.
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, जम्बुमालिं च even Jambumali, निहतम् being klled, महाबलान् of great strength, किंकरांश्च and kinkaras also, श्रुत्वा hearing, कोपसंरक्तलोचनः bloodshot eyes, चुक्रोध got enraged.

text: स रोषसंवर्तितताम्रलोचनः प्रहस्तपुत्रे निहते महाबले । अमात्यपुत्रानतिवीर्यविक्रमान् समादिदेशाशु निशाचरेश्वरः ॥५-४४-२०॥
translation: When the mighty son of Prahasta was killed, infuriated Ravana, his eyes red and rolling, commanded the highly valiant sons of ministers. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महाबले who had great strength, प्रहस्तपुत्त्रे Prahasta's son, निहते killed, सः निशाचरेश्वरः demon king, रोषसंवर्तितताम्रलोचनः his eyes red and rolling in anger, आशु quickly, अतिवीर्यविक्रमान् highly valiant wariors, अमात्यपुत्रान् sons of ministers, समादिदेश commanded.

text: ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणः सुताः । निर्युयुर्भवनात्तस्मात् सप्त सप्तार्चिवर्चसः ॥५-४५-१॥
translation: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
word_meanings: ततः then, सप्तार्चिवर्चसः energetic like fire, महाबलपरीवाराः endowed with great army, धनुष्मन्तः experts in archery, महाबलाः mighty, कृतास्त्राः अस्त्रविदाम् distinguished wielders of weapons, श्रेष्ठाः foremost, परस्परजयैषिणः wished to conquer each other, अमितविक्रमाः very valiant, सप्त seven, ते they, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सुताः sons, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of ogres, चोदिताः directed, संहृष्टाः gladly, तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि decked with shining gold, चापानि bows, विष्फारयन्तः by sporting, तटित्वन्तः shining with lightning, अम्बुदाः इव like storm clouds, हेमजलपरिक्षिप्तैः decked with golden mesh, ध्वजवद्भिः bearing staffs, पताकिभिः with flags,तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैः making sounds like stormy clouds, वाजियुक्तै: yoked to horses,महारथैः with great chariots, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् from the palace, निर्ययुः departed.

text: महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः । कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः ॥५-४५-२॥
translation: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
word_meanings: ततः then, सप्तार्चिवर्चसः energetic like fire, महाबलपरीवाराः endowed with great army, धनुष्मन्तः experts in archery, महाबलाः mighty, कृतास्त्राः अस्त्रविदाम् distinguished wielders of weapons, श्रेष्ठाः foremost, परस्परजयैषिणः wished to conquer each other, अमितविक्रमाः very valiant, सप्त seven, ते they, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सुताः sons, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of ogres, चोदिताः directed, संहृष्टाः gladly, तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि decked with shining gold, चापानि bows, विष्फारयन्तः by sporting, तटित्वन्तः shining with lightning, अम्बुदाः इव like storm clouds, हेमजलपरिक्षिप्तैः decked with golden mesh, ध्वजवद्भिः bearing staffs, पताकिभिः with flags,तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैः making sounds like stormy clouds, वाजियुक्तै: yoked to horses,महारथैः with great chariots, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् from the palace, निर्ययुः departed.

text: हेमजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्ध्वजवद्भिः पताकिभिः । तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैर्वाजियुक्तैर्महारथैः ॥५-४५-३॥
translation: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
word_meanings: ततः then, सप्तार्चिवर्चसः energetic like fire, महाबलपरीवाराः endowed with great army, धनुष्मन्तः experts in archery, महाबलाः mighty, कृतास्त्राः अस्त्रविदाम् distinguished wielders of weapons, श्रेष्ठाः foremost, परस्परजयैषिणः wished to conquer each other, अमितविक्रमाः very valiant, सप्त seven, ते they, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सुताः sons, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of ogres, चोदिताः directed, संहृष्टाः gladly, तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि decked with shining gold, चापानि bows, विष्फारयन्तः by sporting, तटित्वन्तः shining with lightning, अम्बुदाः इव like storm clouds, हेमजलपरिक्षिप्तैः decked with golden mesh, ध्वजवद्भिः bearing staffs, पताकिभिः with flags,तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैः making sounds like stormy clouds, वाजियुक्तै: yoked to horses,महारथैः with great chariots, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् from the palace, निर्ययुः departed.

text: तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि चापान्यमितविक्रमाः । विस्फारयन्तः संहृष्टास्तडित्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः ॥५-४५-४॥
translation: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.
word_meanings: ततः then, सप्तार्चिवर्चसः energetic like fire, महाबलपरीवाराः endowed with great army, धनुष्मन्तः experts in archery, महाबलाः mighty, कृतास्त्राः अस्त्रविदाम् distinguished wielders of weapons, श्रेष्ठाः foremost, परस्परजयैषिणः wished to conquer each other, अमितविक्रमाः very valiant, सप्त seven, ते they, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सुताः sons, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of ogres, चोदिताः directed, संहृष्टाः gladly, तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि decked with shining gold, चापानि bows, विष्फारयन्तः by sporting, तटित्वन्तः shining with lightning, अम्बुदाः इव like storm clouds, हेमजलपरिक्षिप्तैः decked with golden mesh, ध्वजवद्भिः bearing staffs, पताकिभिः with flags,तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैः making sounds like stormy clouds, वाजियुक्तै: yoked to horses,महारथैः with great chariots, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् from the palace, निर्ययुः departed.

text: जनन्यस्तु ततस्तेषां विदित्वा किङ्करान् हतान् । बभूवुः शोकसम्भ्रान्ताः सबान्धवसुहृज्जनाः ॥५-४५-५॥
translation: Their mothers and relatives and their friends were struck with grief when they learnt about the kinkaras killed.
word_meanings: ततः then, तेषाम् their, सबान्धवसुहृज्जनाः with friends and relatives, जनन्यस्तु mothers, किंकरान् kinkaras, हतान् killed, विदित्वा having known, कसम्भ्रान्ताः were agitated with grief, बभूवुः became.

text: ते परस्परसङ्घर्षात्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः । अभिपेतुर्हनूमन्तं तोरणस्थमवस्थितम् ॥५-४५-६॥
translation: The barnished golden ornaments worn by them were shining as they brushed shoulders with one another (eager to fight first) to attack Hanuman who stood waiting at the main archway.
word_meanings: तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः barnished ornaments of gold, ते they, परस्परसङ्घर्षात् by dashing against each other, तोरणस्थम् at the main archway, अवस्थितम् stood, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अभिपेतुः attacked.

text: सृजन्तो बाणवृष्टिं ते रथगर्जितनिःस्वनाः । वृष्टिमन्त इवाम्भोदा विचेरुर्नैर्ऋताम्बुदाः ॥५-४५-७॥
translation: They went roaring with their chariots rattling, sending forth torrents of arrows like the stormy clouds thundering.
word_meanings: रथगर्जितनिस्वनाः the rattling of the chariots mixed with the roaring of the warriors, ते they, नैऋताम्बुदाः the clouds of demons, बाणवृष्टिम् torrent of arrows, सृजन्तः sent forth, वृष्टिमन्तः thundering, अम्भोदाः इव like the storm clouds, विचेरुः went about.

text: अवकीर्णस्ततस्ताभिर्हनुमाञ्छरवृष्टिभिः । अभवत् संवृताकारः शैलराडिव वृष्टिभिः ॥५-४५-८॥
translation: Later, Hanuman covered with showers of arrows scattered all over appeared like the king of mountains shot with showers of rain.
word_meanings: ततः then, ताभिः by them, शरवृष्टिभिः by the shower of arrows, अवकीर्णः scattered all over, हनुमान् Hanuman, वृष्टिभिः with shower of rain, संवृताकारः covered, शैलराडिव like the king of mountains, अभवत् appeared.

text: स शरान् मोघयामास तेषामाशुचरः कपिः । रथवेगं च वीराणां विचरन् विमले ऽम्बरे ॥५-४५-९॥
translation: Then the monkey moving fast in the clear sky rendered the arrows of the giant heroes and speeding chariots futile.
word_meanings: आशुचरः moving fast, सः कपिः that monkey, विमले in the clear, अम्बरे sky, विचरन् moving, तेषां वीराणाम् of the heroes, शरान् by the arrows, रथवेगं च and the speed of their chariot, मोघयामास rendered futile.

text: स तैः क्रीडन् धनुष्मद्भिर्व्योम्नि वीरः प्रकाशते । धनुष्मद्भिर्यथा मेघैर्मारुतः प्रभुरम्बरे ॥५-४५-१०॥
translation: Sporting in the sky with the giants who held bows in their hands, Hanuman shone like the powerful Windgod sporting in the sky surrrounded by rambling dark clouds.
word_meanings: व्योम्नि in the sky, धनुष्मद्भिः with those bows in their hands, तैः by them, क्रीडन् while sporting, सः वीरः that hero, अम्बरे in the sky, धनुष्मद्भिः armed with rainbow, मेघैः by the clouds, प्रभुः god, मारुतः यथा like the wind, प्रकाशते shining.

text: स कृत्वा निनदं घोरं त्रासयंस्तां महाचमूम् । चकार हनुमान् वेगं तेषु रक्षस्सु वीर्यवान् ॥५-४५-११॥
translation: Valiant Hanuman making terrific sound and frightening the army of ogres marched swiftly.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant one, सः he, घोरम् terrific, निनदम् sound, कृत्वा making, ताम् that, महाचमूम् great army, त्रासयन् frightening, तेषु रक्षस्सु those ogres, वेगम् speed, चकार created.

text: तलेनाभ्यहनत् कांश्चित् पादैः कांश्चित् परन्तपः । मुष्टिना ऽभ्यहनत् कांश्चिन्नखैः कांश्चिद् व्यदारयत् ॥५-४५-१२॥
translation: The scorcher of enemies, Hanuman hit some ogres with his palm, some with his feet and some with his fist and pierced some with his nails.
word_meanings: परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, कांश्चित् some, तलेन with palm, अभ्यहनत् hit, कांश्चित् some, पादैः with feet, कांश्चित् some, मुष्टिना with fist, अभ्यहनत् struck, कांश्चित् some, नखैः with nails, व्यदारयत् pierced .

text: प्रममाथोरसा कांश्चिदूरुभ्यामपरान् कपिः । केचित्तस्य निनादेन तत्रैव पतिता भुवि ॥५-४५-१३॥
translation: The monkey strangled some with his chest and some between his thighs. A few fell down dead on the ground hearing his roaring noise.
word_meanings: कपिः monkey, कांश्चित् some, उरसा with his chest, अपरान् and others, ऊरुभ्याम् with his thighs, प्रममाथ strangled, केचित् a few, तस्य his, निनादेन by the roar, तत्रैव there itself, भुवि on the ground, पतिताः fell down.

text: ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु भूमौ निपतितेषु च । तत्सैन्यमगमत्सर्वं दिशो भयार्दितम् ॥५-४५-१४॥
translation: Struck by fear on seeing Hanuman, the seven sons of ministers dropped down dead on the ground, and their army fled in all the ten directions.
word_meanings: तेषु when they (sons of minister), अवसन्नेषु were annexed, भूमौ on the ground, निपतितेषु च when fallen dead on the ground, ततः then, सर्वम् all, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, भयार्दितम् struck with fear, दश दिशः in all ten directions, अगमत् fled.

text: विनेदुर्विस्वरं नागा निपेतुर्भुवि वाजिनः । भग्ननीडध्वजच्छत्त्रैर्भूश्च कीर्णा ऽभवद्रथैः ॥५-४५-१५॥
translation: The elephants trumpeted discordantly out of fear, the horses fell down on the ground and even the chariots with seats, parasols and flag staffs broken were strewn all over the ground.
word_meanings: नागाः elephants, विस्वरम् discordantly, विनेदुः trumpeted in fear, वाजिनः horses, भुवि on ground, निपेतुः fell down, भूश्च the earth also, भग्ननीडध्वजच्छत्रैः with broken seats, parasols, flag staffs, रथैः by chariots, कीर्णा अभवत् strewn all over.

text: स्रवता रुधिरेणाथस्रवन्त्यो दर्शिताः पथि । विविधैश्च स्वरैर्लङ्का ननाद विकृतं तदा ॥५-४५-१६॥
translation: Streams of blood flowed and Lanka was filled with many kinds of horrifying sounds of cries.
word_meanings: अथ then, स्रवता flowing, रुधिरेण by blood, पथि way, स्रवन्त्यः flowed, दर्शिताः seen, तदा then, लङ्का Lanka, विविधैः with many, स्वरैः with sounds, विकृतम् horrifying cries, ननाद roared.

text: स तान् प्रवृद्धान् विनिहत्य राक्षसान् महाबलश्चण्डपराक्रमः कपिः । युयुत्सुरन्यैः पुनरेव राक्षसैस्तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणम् ॥५-४५-१७॥
translation: Having killed the ogres who were old and strong, the valiant and mighty Hanuman, wishing to slay the other ogres advanced towards the archway. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, महाबलः mighty one, चण्डपराक्रमः whose valiance was fierce, सः कपिः that Hanuman, प्रवृद्धान् the ogres who were old and grew stronger, तान् राक्षसान् those gaints, विनिहृत्य slayed, अन्यैः others, राक्षसैः by ogres, युयुत्सुः desiring to wage war, पुनरेव once again, तम् that, तोरणमेव archway, अभिजगाम went forth.

text: हतान् मन्त्रिसुतान् बुद्ध्वा वानरेण महात्मना । रावणः संवृताकारश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम् ॥५-४६-१॥
translation: Coming to know that the seven sons of the ministers were slain by the great vanara, Ravana, who had concealed his feelings of agony thought of a good plan.
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, महात्मना the great, वानरेण by the vanara, मन्त्रिसुतान् sons of the ministers, हतान् killed, बुद्द्वा knowing, संवृताकारः who had concealed his agony, उत्तमाम् good, मतिम् thought, चकार formulated.

text: स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धरं चैव राक्षसम् । प्रघसं भारकर्णं च पञ्च सेनाग्रनायकान् ॥५-४६-२॥
translation: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.
word_meanings: सः दशग्रीवः the tenheaded Ravana, वीरान् warriors, नयविशारदान् skilled in statecraft, हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान् eager to capture Hanuman, युथि in battle, वायुवेगसमान् equal to wind in speed, विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ Virupaksha and Yupaksha, दुर्धरम् Durdhara, राक्षसं चैव also a giant, प्रघसम् Praghasa, भासकर्णं च Bhaskarna and, सेनाग्रनायकान् army Generals पञ्च five,सन्दिदेश commanded.

text: सन्दिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान्नयविशारदान् । हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान् वायुवेगसमान् युधि ॥५-४६-३॥
translation: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.
word_meanings: सः दशग्रीवः the tenheaded Ravana, वीरान् warriors, नयविशारदान् skilled in statecraft, हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान् eager to capture Hanuman, युथि in battle, वायुवेगसमान् equal to wind in speed, विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ Virupaksha and Yupaksha, दुर्धरम् Durdhara, राक्षसं चैव also a giant, प्रघसम् Praghasa, भासकर्णं च Bhaskarna and, सेनाग्रनायकान् army Generals पञ्च five,सन्दिदेश commanded.

text: यात सेनाग्रगाः सर्वे महाबलपरिग्रहाः । सवाजिरथमातङ्गाः स कपिः शास्यतामिति ॥५-४६-४॥
translation: "O Army generals march with a large, strong army with horses, chariots and elephants and punish the vanara.
word_meanings: सेनाग्रगाः O Army generals, सर्वे all, महाबलपरिग्रहाः accompanied by large, strong army, सवाजिरथमातङ्गाः along with horses, chariots and elphants, यात march, सः कपिः that vanara, शास्यताम् punish, इति thus.

text: यत्तैश्च खलु भाव्यं स्यात्तमासाद्य वनालयम् । कर्म चापि समाधेयं देशकालविरोधिनम् ॥५-४६-५॥
translation: "Go to that forestdweller and make all efforts to impose on him punishment appropriate to time and place (keeping in view the harm he has done).
word_meanings: तम् him, वनालयम् a forestdweller, आसाद्य after reaching, यत्नैः च with all efforts, भाव्यम् should be engaged, देशकालाविरोधिनम् that which is not against time and space, कर्म चापि even action, समाधेयम् should be done.

text: न ह्यहं तं कपिं मन्ये कर्मणा प्रतितर्कयन् । सर्वथा तन्महद्भूतं महाबलपरिग्रहम् । भवेदिन्द्रेण वा सृष्टमस्मदर्थं तपोबलात् ॥५-४६-६॥
translation: "Judging again and again from all actions, I do not think he is an ordinary monkey. He is a being endowed with great strength.
word_meanings: अहम् I, कर्मणा by his actions, प्रतितर्कयन् judging again and again,तम् him, कपिम् monkey, न मन्ये I do not think, सर्वथा by all its actions, तत् that, महाबलपरिग्रहम् endowed with great strength, महत् great, भूतम् a being.

text: सनागयक्षगन्धर्वा देवासुरमहर्षयः । युष्माभिः सहितैः सर्वैर्मया सह विनिर्जिताः ॥५-४६-७॥
translation: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.
word_meanings: अस्मदर्धम् it seems to me, तपोबलात् by ascetic power, इन्द्रेण by Indra, सृष्टं वा may be created, भवेत् may be, सहितैः along with, सर्वैः by all, युष्माभिः of you, मया by me, सनागयक्षगन्धर्वाः nagas, yakshas, gandharvas,देवासुरमहर्षयः gods, demons and ascetics, विनिर्जिताः subdued, तैः by them, नः us, किञ्चिदेव even a little, व्यलीकम् harm, अवश्यम् certainly, विधातव्यम् should be done, तदेव this is same reaction, अत्र in this case, सन्देहः doubt, न no, प्रसह्य with force, परिगृह्यताम् he may be captured, धीरपराक्रमः a warrior of heroic strength, हरिः monkey, भवद्भि by you also, नावमान्यः should not be insulted.

text: तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किंचिदेव नः । तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम् ॥५-४६-८॥
translation: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.
word_meanings: अस्मदर्धम् it seems to me, तपोबलात् by ascetic power, इन्द्रेण by Indra, सृष्टं वा may be created, भवेत् may be, सहितैः along with, सर्वैः by all, युष्माभिः of you, मया by me, सनागयक्षगन्धर्वाः nagas, yakshas, gandharvas,देवासुरमहर्षयः gods, demons and ascetics, विनिर्जिताः subdued, तैः by them, नः us, किञ्चिदेव even a little, व्यलीकम् harm, अवश्यम् certainly, विधातव्यम् should be done, तदेव this is same reaction, अत्र in this case, सन्देहः doubt, न no, प्रसह्य with force, परिगृह्यताम् he may be captured, धीरपराक्रमः a warrior of heroic strength, हरिः monkey, भवद्भि by you also, नावमान्यः should not be insulted.

text: नावमान्यो भवद्भिश्च हरिर्धीरपराक्रमः । दृष्टा हि हरयः पूर्वं मया विपुलविक्रमाः ॥५-४६-९॥
वाली च सहसुग्रीवो जाम्बवांश्च महाबलः । नीलः सेनापतिश्चैव ये चान्ये द्विविदादयः ॥५-४६-१०॥
translation: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.
word_meanings: पूर्वम् earlier, मया by me, विपुलविक्रमाः of immense prowess, हरयः monkeys, सहसुग्रीवः with Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, महाबलः mighty, जाम्बवांश्च and Jambavan, सेनापतिः army chief, नीलः Nila, द्विविदादयः Dvivida and others, अन्ये च and others, ये those, दृष्टाः हि have seen, तेषाम् for them, गतिः movement, एवम् that way, भीमा tremendous, न not, तेजः splendour, पराक्रमः valour, न not, मतिः intellect, न not, बलोत्साहौ strength and energy, रूपपरिकल्पनम् ability to change form at will.

text: नैवं तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः । न मतिर्न बलोत्साहौ न रूपपरिकल्पनम् ॥५-४६-११॥
translation: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.
word_meanings: पूर्वम् earlier, मया by me, विपुलविक्रमाः of immense prowess, हरयः monkeys, सहसुग्रीवः with Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, महाबलः mighty, जाम्बवांश्च and Jambavan, सेनापतिः army chief, नीलः Nila, द्विविदादयः Dvivida and others, अन्ये च and others, ये those, दृष्टाः हि have seen, तेषाम् for them, गतिः movement, एवम् that way, भीमा tremendous, न not, तेजः splendour, पराक्रमः valour, न not, मतिः intellect, न not, बलोत्साहौ strength and energy, रूपपरिकल्पनम् ability to change form at will.

text: महत्सत्त्वमिदं ज्ञेयं कपिरूपं व्यवस्थितम् । प्रयत्नं महदास्थाय क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः ॥५-४६-१२॥
translation: "It should be understood that he has taken the form of a monkey. You have to put in extraordinary effort to capture him by acting in a suitable manner.
word_meanings: इदम् this, कपिरूपम् a monkey form, व्यवस्थितम् concluded, महत् great, सत्त्वम् being, ज्ञेयम् It should be understood, महत् extraordinary, प्रयत्नम् effort, आस्थाय by putting up, अस्य his, निग्रहः capture, क्रियताम् do.

text: कामं लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः ससुरासुरमानवाः । भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे ॥५-४६-१३॥
translation: "Even Indra, suras, asuras and humans and the three worlds together are incompetent to stand before you in a battlefield.
word_meanings: सेन्द्राः including Indra, ससुरासुरमानवाः suras, asuras and humans together, त्रयः all the three, लोकाः worlds, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, भवताम् your, अग्रतः in front, स्थातुम् to stand, न पर्याप्ताः not competent, कामम् indeed.

text: तथापि तु नयज्ञेन जयमाकाङ्क्षता रणे । आत्मा रक्ष्यः प्रयत्नेन युद्धसिद्धिर्हि चञ्चला ॥५-४६-१४॥
translation: "Even then, you should safeguard yourself with great effort adopting warstrategies in an intelligent manner to be victorious, for success in war is uncertain.
word_meanings: तथापि तु even then, रणे in a war, जयम् victory, आकाङ्क्षता while desiring, नयज्ञेन by carefully adopting war strategies in an intelligent manner, प्रयत्नेन making effort, आत्मा your own self, रक्ष्यः should be protected, युद्धसिद्धिः victory in war, चञ्चला हि is uncertain.

text: ते स्वामिवचनं सर्वे प्रतिगृह्य महौजसः । समुत्पेतुर्महावेगा हुताशसमतेजसः ॥५-४६-१५॥
translation: Taking King's order, the strong and swift warriors, resplendent as the flame of sacrificial fire sallied forth with their army on chariots, on the back of rutting elephants, some on swift horses equipped with sharp weapons of many kinds.
word_meanings: महौजसः very strong, हुताशसमतेजसः resplendant as sacrificial fire, ते सर्वे all of them, स्वामिवचनम् king's words, प्रतिगृह्य accepting, महावेगाः who were swift, रथैः with chariots, मत्तै intoxicated, मातङ्गै: with elephants, महाजवैः of great speed, वाजिभिश्च with horses, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, विविधैः many kinds, शस्त्रै: with weapons, सर्वे all, बलैः strong army, उपचिताः collecting,समुत्पेतुः sallied forth together

text: रथैर्मत्तैश्च मातङ्गैर्वाजिभिश्च महाजवैः । श्स्त्रैश्च विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः सर्वैश्चोपचिता बलैः ॥५-४६-१६॥
translation: Taking King's order, the strong and swift warriors, resplendent as the flame of sacrificial fire sallied forth with their army on chariots, on the back of rutting elephants, some on swift horses equipped with sharp weapons of many kinds.
word_meanings: महौजसः very strong, हुताशसमतेजसः resplendant as sacrificial fire, ते सर्वे all of them, स्वामिवचनम् king's words, प्रतिगृह्य accepting, महावेगाः who were swift, रथैः with chariots, मत्तै intoxicated, मातङ्गै: with elephants, महाजवैः of great speed, वाजिभिश्च with horses, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, विविधैः many kinds, शस्त्रै: with weapons, सर्वे all, बलैः strong army, उपचिताः collecting,समुत्पेतुः sallied forth together

text: ततस्तं ददृशुर्वीरा दीप्यमानं महाकपिम् । रश्मिमन्तमिवोद्यन्तं स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम् ॥५-४६-१७॥
translation: The heroic giants caught sight of the vanara, who was blazing encircled as though he was by the rays of his own glory, looking like the rising Sun. He was endowed with extraordinary agility, intelligence, and tremendous strength standing, waiting at the archway.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीराः heroes, स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम् shining like the Sungod with his own effulgence, उद्यन्तम् a rising one, रश्मिमन्तमिव like the Sun, दीप्यमानम् shining, तोरणस्थम् standing at the archway, महोत्साहम् extraordinary agility, महासत्त्वम् intelligent,महाबलम् endowed with tremendous strength, तं महाकपिम् him the vanara, ददृशुः saw.

text: तोरणस्थं महोत्साहं महासत्त्वं महाबलम् । महामतिं महावेगं महाकायं महाबलम् ॥५-४६-१८॥
तं समीक्ष्यैव ते सर्वे दिक्षु सर्वास्ववस्थिताः । तैस्तैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः ॥५-४६-१९॥
translation: Having observed the tremendous strength, intelligence and swiftness in action of Hanuman, the generals of the army positioned at all directions and assailed him with dreadful weapons.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, महामतिम् highly intelligent, महावेगम् very swift, महाकायम् having a huge body, महाबलम् tremendous strength, तम् him, समीक्ष्यैव having observed, सर्वासु in all, दिक्षु directions, अवस्थिताः positioned, ततस्ततः here and there, भीमैः with dreadful, स्तैस्तै: with different, प्रहरणैः with weapons, अभिपेतुः attacked.

text: तस्य पञ्चायसास्तीक्ष्णाः शिताः पीतमुखाः शराः । शिरस्युत्पलपत्राभा दुर्धरेण निपातिताः ॥५-४६-२०॥
translation: Durdhara pierced into the head of Hanuman with five sharp arrows and polished steel shafts with yellow tips (gold) shining like red lotus petals. They were like petals of lilies thrown on the head of Hanuman (causing no pain).
word_meanings: तीक्ष्णाः sharp, शिताः sharp, पीतमुखाः steel shafts with polished yellow tips (of gold), उत्पलपत्राभाः shining like petals of lilies, आयसाः steel shafts made of iron, पञ्च five, शराः arrows, दुर्धरेण by Durdhara, तस्य his, शिरसि on his head, निपातिताः pierced.

text: स तैः पञ्चभिराविद्धः शरैः शिरसि वानरः । उत्पपात नदन् व्योम्नि दिशो दश विनादयन् ॥५-४६-२१॥
translation: With five arrows pierced in the head of the vanara, Hanuman leaped into the sky with terrible roar, which resounded in all the ten directions.
word_meanings: वानरः vanara, तैः them, पञ्चभिः by those five, शरैः with arrows, शिरसि on the head, अविद्धः pierced in, नदन् roared, दशदिशः the ten directions, विनादयन् making a loud noise, व्योम्नि in the sky, उत्पपात leaped.

text: ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरः सरथः सज्यकार्मुकः । किरन् शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिपेदे महाबलः ॥५-४६-२२॥
translation: Then the powerful, hero, Durdhara, mounted on his chariot, fastened his bowstring and hit Hanuman with hundreds of sharp arrows.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, महाबलः powerful, वीरः hero, दुर्धरः Durdhara, सरथः with his the chariot, सज्यकार्मुकः with his string fastened, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरशतैः hundreds of arrows, किरन् while hitting, अभिपेदे attacked.

text: स कपिर्वारयामास तं व्योम्नि शरवर्षिणम् । वृष्टिमन्तं पयोदान्ते पयोदमिव मारुतः ॥५-४६-२३॥
translation: The great monkey kept away the showering arrows like the wind prevents raincloud from showering rain drops at the end of monsoon.
word_meanings: सः कपिः that vanara, व्योम्नि in the sky, शरवर्षिणम् showering of arrows, तम् on him, पयोदान्ते at the end of the rainy season, वृष्टिमन्तम् showering rain drops, पयोदम् a cloud, मारुतः इव like the wind, वारयामास prevented.

text: अर्द्यमानस्ततस्तेन दुर्धरेणानिलात्मजः । चकार कदनं भूयो व्यवर्धत च वेगवान् ॥५-४६-२४॥
translation: When the son of the Windgod was attacked by Durdhara, he again grew in size
word_meanings: तेन by him, दुर्धरेण by Durdhara, अर्ध्यमानः attacked, अनिलात्मजः son of the Windgod, ततः then, कदनम् battle, चकार fought, वेगवान् swift hero, भूयः again, व्यवर्धत grew in size.

text: स दूरं सहसोत्पत्य दुर्धरस्य रथे हरिः । निपपात महवेगो विद्युद्राशिर्गिराविव ॥५-४६-२५॥
translation: Hanuman suddenly leaped far off into the air at high speed and fell on Durdhara's chariot just like a thunderous lightning falls on a mountain.
word_meanings: सः हरिः that vanara, दूरं far off, सहसा at once, उत्पत्य leaped, महावेगः in high speed, गिरौ on the mountain, विद्युद्राशिरिव like flashes of lightning, दुर्धरस्य Durdhara's, रथे on the chariot, निपपात fell on.

text: ततः स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम् । विहाय न्यपतद्भूमौ दुर्धरस्त्यक्तजीवितः ॥५-४६-२६॥
translation: Having lost his chariot, the horses yoked to it killed, its axle and pole broken to pieces, Durdhara fell down dead from the chariot.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः he, मथिताष्टाश्वम् eight horses killed, भग्नाक्षकूबरम् with its axle and wooden frame (to which the yoke is fixed) broken, रथम् chariot, विहाय left, त्यक्तजीवितः devoid of life, भूमौ on the ground, न्यपतत् fell.

text: तं विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि । सञ्जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेततुररिन्दमौ ॥५-४६-२७॥
translation: Seeing the body of Durdhara fallen on the ground, enraged Virupaksha and Yupaksha, the unassailable crushers of enemies leaped towards him.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षौ unassailable warriors, अरिन्दमौ crushers of enemies, विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ Virupaksha and Yupaksha, भुवि on the ground, निपतितम् fallen, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सञ्जातरोषौ enraged, उत्पेतुः leaped at him.

text: स ताभ्यां सहसोत्पत्य विष्ठितो विमले ऽम्बरे । मुद्गराभ्यां महाबाहुर्वक्षस्यभिहतः कपिः ॥५-४६-२८॥
translation: As the strongarmed vanara stood stationed in the clear white sky both the generals leaped into the sky and hit him all of a sudden with two iron hammers.
word_meanings: विमले in a clear white, अम्बरे in the sky, विष्ठितः stood, महाबाहुः greatarmed one, सः कपिः that vanara, ताभ्याम् by both of them, सहसा all of a sudden, उत्पत्य having leapt, मुद्गराभ्याम् with two iron hammers, वक्षसि on the chest, अभिहतः hit.

text: तयोर्वेगवतोर्वेगं विनिहत्य महाबलः । निपपात पुनर्भूमौ सुपर्णसमविक्रमः ॥५-४६-२९॥
translation: Powerful Hanuman, an equal to Garuda in valour fell down while resisting the swift generals.
word_meanings: महाबलः powerful, सुपर्णसमविक्रमः equal to Suparna (Garuda) in valour, वेगवतोः of those two who were swift in action, तयोः of both of them, वेगम् speed, विनिहत्य resisting, पुनः again, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात fell.

text: स सालवृक्षमासाद्य तमुत्पाट्य च वानरः । तावुभौ राक्षसौ वीरौ जघान पवनात्मजः ॥५-४६-३०॥
translation: Then the son of the Windgod seized a sala tree uprooted it, lifted it and smashed the two giant generals with it.
word_meanings: वानरः vanara, सः पवनात्मजः that son of the Windgod, सालवृक्षम् sala tree, आसाद्य seized, तम् that, उत्पाट्य च and uprooted, तौ उभौ both of them, वीरौ generals, राक्षसौ two giants,जघान slew.

text: ततस्तांस्त्रीन् हतान् ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना । अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम् ॥५-४६-३१॥
translation: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war
word_meanings: ततः then, तरस्विना by the swift, वानरेण by the vanara, तान् त्रीन् those three, हतान् killed, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, प्रघसः Praghasa, महावेगः endowed with swift action, प्रसह्य violently, अभिपेदे attacked, वीर्यवान् courageous, भासकर्णश्च with Bhasakarna, सङ्कृद्धः angry one, शूलम् trident, आदाय by lifting.

text: भासकर्णश्च संक्रुद्धः शूलमादाय वीर्यवान् । एकतः कपिशार्दूलं यशस्विनमवस्थितम् ॥५-४६-३२॥
पट्टिशेन शिताग्रेण प्रघसः प्रत्ययोधयत् । भासकर्णश्च शूलेन राक्षसः कपिसत्तमम् ॥५-४६-३३॥
translation: Praghasa fought back the glorious tiger among vanaras with a sharp crowbar on one side and Bhaskarana attacked with a spear from the other.
word_meanings: यशस्विनम् renowned, कपिशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, एकतः on one side, अवस्थितम् तम् stationed, प्रघसः Praghasa, शिताग्रेण with sharp weapon, पट्टिसेन iron crowbar, कपिसत्तमम् foremost of the monkeys, प्रत्ययोधयत् fought back, भासकर्णः Bhaskarna, राक्षसः giant, शूलेन with spear.

text: स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः । अभवद्वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः ॥५-४६-३४॥
translation: Attacked by both the generals, the fur on the vanara's body was smeared with blood from his wounded limbs, shining like the rising Sun smeared with blood became furious.
word_meanings: ताभ्याम् by both of them, विक्षतैः with wounded ones, गात्रैः with his limbs, असृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः his fur smeared with blood, सः वानरः that vanara, बालसूर्यसमप्रभः was shining like the rising Sun, क्रुद्धः angry, अभवत् became.

text: समुत्पाट्य गिरेः शृङ्गं समृगव्यालपादपम् । जघान हनुमान् वीरो राक्षसौ कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-४६-३५॥
translation: Hanuman, a courageous and mighty elephant among the monkeys uprooted a mountain peak along with its animals, serpents and trees and killed both the demon generals.
word_meanings: कपिकुञ्जरः a mighty elephant among the monkeys, वीरः courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, समृगव्यालपादपम् along with animals serpents and trees, गिरेः शृङ्गम् mountain peak, समुत्पाट्य having uprooted, राक्षसौ both the giants,जघान killed.

text: ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु सेनापतिषु पञ्चसु । बलं तदवशेषं च नाशयास वानरः ॥५-४६-३६॥
translation: When the five army chiefs were killed, Hanuman began to destoy the remaining army force.
word_meanings: ततः then, तेषु those, पञ्चसु all the five, सेनापतिषु army chiefs, अवसन्नेषु when they died, वानरः vanara, तत् that, अवशेषम् remaining, बलम् army, नाशयामास destroyed.

text: अश्वैरश्वान् गजैर्नागान् योधैर्योधान् रथै रथान् । स कपिर्नाशयामास सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान् ॥५-४६-३७॥
translation: The vanara pitted horses against horses, elephants against elephants, warriors against warriors and chariots against chariots as Indra destroyed demons.
word_meanings: सः कपिः that vanara,सहस्राक्षः thousandeyed Indra, असुरानिव as he did (destroyed) demons, अश्वैः with horses, अश्वान् horses, गजैः with elephants, नागान् elephants, योधैः with warriors, योधान् warriors, रथैः with chariots, रथान् chariots, नाशयामास destroyed.

text: हतैर्नागैश्च तुरगैर्भग्नाक्षैश्च महारथैः । हतैश्च राक्षसैर्भूमी रुद्धमार्गा समन्ततः ॥५-४६-३८॥
translation: There was no path (one could not move forward) with elephants, and horses killed and with broken axles of great chariots and smashed chariots spread all over the way.
word_meanings: हतैः with killed ones, नागैः with elephants, तुरगैः with horses, भग्नाक्षैः with broken axles, महारथैश्च by great chariots, हतैः with smashed ones, राक्षसैः with giants, भूमिः the ground, समन्ततः all over, रुद्धमार्गा the path was obstructed

text: ततः कपिस्तान् ध्वजिनीपतीन् रणे निहत्य वीरान् सबलान् सवाहनान् । समीक्ष्य वीरः परिगृह्य तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ॥५-४६-३९॥
translation: Then the heroic monkey having killed the army generals and their army and destroyed their vehicles in war came back to the archway after reviewing and stood like the timespirit bent upon the destruction of humanity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरः the hero, कपिः monkey, वीरान् the generals, सबलान् along with that army, सवाहनान् their vehicles, तान् those, ध्वजिनीपतीन् army chiefs, रणे in war, निहत्य having killed, समीक्ष्य after reviewing, तोरणम् archway, परिगृह्य after holding, प्रजाक्षये bent upon destruction of humanity, कालः इव like timespirit, कृतक्षणः celebrated.

text: सेनापतीन् पञ्च स तु प्रमापितान् हनूमता सानुचरान् सवाहनान् । समीक्ष्य राजा समरोद्धतोन्मुखं कुमारमक्षं प्रसमैक्षताग्रतः ॥५-४७-१॥
translation: Hearing the sad news of death of the five army generals including their followers and destruction of their vehicles, King (Ravana) gave a suggestive look at prince Aksha who was inclined to fight the war.
word_meanings: राजा the king, सानुचरान् with the followers,सवाहनान् and their vehicles, पञ्च five, सेनापतीन् generals of the army, हनुमता by Hanuman, प्रमापितान् killed, समीक्ष्य seeing, समरोद्धतोन्मुखम् inclined to fight the war, अग्रतः in front of him, कुमारम् the prince, अक्षम् Aksha, प्रसमैक्षत turned his attention to.

text: स तस्य दृष्ट्यर्पणसंप्रचोदितः प्रतापवान् काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः । समुत्पपाताथ सदस्युदीरितो द्विजातिमुख्यैर्हविषेव पावकः ॥५-४७-२॥
translation: Spurred by the mere glance of Ravana, the glorious Aksha with his wonderful bow inlaid with gold sprang up from the royal assembly just as flame rises from firesanctuary when oblations are poured in by reputed brahmins.
word_meanings: अथ and then, तस्य his, दृष्ट्यर्पणसम्प्रचोदितः spurred by the glance of the king, प्रतापवान् glorious, सः that, काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः holding a marvellous bow inlaid with gold, सदसि the royal assembly, द्विजातिमुख्यैः by the reputed brahmins, हविषा with oblations, उदीरितः kindled, पावकः इव like the firesanctuary, समुत्पपात sprang up.

text: ततो महद्बालदिवाकरप्रभं प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसंततम् । रतं समास्थाय ययौ स वीर्यवान् महाहरिं तं प्रति नैर्ऋतर्षभः ॥५-४७-३॥
translation: Ascending a glittering chariot inlaid with pure gold Aksha, the courageous bull among giants looking splendid like the rising Sun, marched forth towards the great vanara.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीर्यवान् courageous, सः नैरृतर्षभः that bull among giants, बालदिवाकरप्रभम् splendid like the rising Sun, प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसन्ततम् glittering like the stretch of pure gold, महत् great, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय having ascended, तम् him, महाहरिं प्रति towards the great vanara, ययौ marched.

text: तपस्सङ्ग्रहसञ्चयार्जितं तपोनुष्ठनसमूहसम्पादितम् ॥५-४७-४॥
सुरासुराधृष्यमसङ्गचारिणं रविप्रभं व्योमचरं समाहितम् । सतूणमष्टासिनिबद्धबन्धुरं यथाक्रमावेशितशक्तितोमरम् ॥५-४७-५॥
translation: (The chariot) was unassailable to suras or asuras.It moved without touching the ground, it could fly in air and had the splendour of the Sun. It was equipped readily with quivers, eight swords, javelins and clubs placed in right order.
word_meanings: सुरासुराधृष्यम् unassailable to suras and asuras, असङ्गचारिणम् moved without touching the ground, रविप्रभम् with the spledour of Sun,व्योमचरम् that which can fly in air, समाहितम् equipped readily, सतूणम् with quivers, अष्टासि निबद्धबन्धुरम् with eight swords (readily placed)fastened, यथाक्रमावेशितशक्तितोमरम् javelins and clubs placed in right place in order.

text: विराजमानं प्रतिपूर्णवस्तुना सहेमदाम्ना शशिसूर्यवर्चसा । दिवाकराभं रथमास्थितस्ततः स निर्जगामामरतुल्यविक्रमः ॥५-४७-६॥
translation: Prince Aksha, whose courage was equal to that of gods, shone like the Sun. He ascended the splendid chariot decked with golden garlands shining like Sun and Moon, equipped with all weapons, bows and shields etc, he went out.
word_meanings: ततः then, अमरतुल्यविक्रमः equal to gods in courage, सः he, सहेमदाम्ना with a golden garland, शशिसूर्यवर्चसा bright as Moon and Sun, प्रतिपूर्णवस्तुना equipped with all weapons, bows and shields etc, विराजमानम् glowing, दिवाकराभम् shining like the Sun, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः ascended, निर्जगाम went out.

text: स पूरयन् खं च महीं च साचलां तुरङ्गमातङ्गमहारथस्वनैः । बलैः समेतैः स हि तोरणस्थितं समर्थमासीनमुपागमत् कपिम् ॥५-४७-७॥
translation: Seated on the chariot he (Aksha) sallied forth along with the army filling the entire earth and mountains with the sounds of horses, elephants and rumblings of big chariots and reached the portal where the great vanara stood.
word_meanings: सः he, तुरङ्गमातङ्गमहारथस्वनैः with the sounds of horses, elephants and chariot, खं च and sky, साचलाम् including mountains, महीं च and earth, पूरयन् while filling, समेतैः together, बलैः सह with army, तोरणस्थितम् stood at the gate, समर्थम् efficient one, आसीनम् seated, महाकपिम् great vanara, उपागमत् reached.

text: स तं समासाद्य हरिं हरीक्षणो युगान्तकालाग्निमिव प्रजाक्षये । अवस्थितं विस्मितजातसंभ्रमः समैक्षताक्षो बहुमानचक्षुषा ॥५-४७-८॥
translation: The lioneyed Aksha saw the vanara who appeared like the cosmic fire at the time of dissolution of the universe. The prince was astonished and struck with awe (at the majestic form of the Vanara) and looked at him with great respect.
word_meanings: हरीक्षणः who had eyes like that of a lion, सः अक्षः that Aksha, प्रजाक्षये at the time of destruction of the universe, अवस्थितम् appeared, कालाग्निम् इव like the cosmic fire at the time of dissolution, तम् him, हरिम् vanara,, समासाद्य reached, विस्मितजातसम्भ्रमः astonished with awe, बहुमानचक्षुषा with great respect, समैक्षत saw.

text: स तस्य वेगं च कपेर्महात्मनः पराक्रमं चारिषु पार्थिवात्मजः । विधारयन् स्वं च बलं महाबलो हिमक्षये सूर्य इवाभिवर्धते ॥५-४७-९॥
translation: Aksha, the mighty prince judging the speed and prowess of the monkey with his own in confronting enemies and the strength of the monkey, began to swell up in spirit like the glow of the Sun at the end of winter.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, पार्थिवात्मजः prince, सः he, महात्मनः great self, तस्य कपेः of the monkey, वेगं च and speed, अरिषु at the enemies, पराक्रमं च prowess, स्वम् his, बलं च even strength, विचारयन् judging, हिमक्षये at the end of winter, सूर्य इव like the Sun, अभिवर्धते began to swell up in spirit

text: स जातमन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रमं स्थिरं स्थितः संयति दुर्निवारणम् । समाहितात्मा हनुमन्तमाहवे प्रचोदयामास शरैस्त्रिभिः शितैः ॥५-४७-१०॥
translation: Knowing that it is difficult to win Hanuman who was steady and of irresistible valour Aksha was angry. Remaining steady, with full attention, he provoked the vanara to fight and released three sharp arrows.
word_meanings: संयति in war, दुर्निवारणम् irresistible, स्थिरम् steady, विक्रमम् valour, प्रसमीक्ष्य recognising, सः that Aksha, जातमन्युः became angry, स्थिरः stable, समाहितात्मा with full attention, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, शितैः with sharp, त्रिभिः with three शरैः arrows, आहवे in the battle, प्रचोदयामास provoked

text: ततः कपिः तं प्रसमीभ्य गर्वितं जितश्रमं शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम् । अवैक्षताक्षः समुदीर्णमानसः स बाणपाणिः प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः ॥५-४७-११॥
translation: Then Aksha contempuously looked at Hanuman who had conquered his fatigue and was determined to defeat the enemy. Holding in his hands his bow and arrows proudly, he reflected.
word_meanings: तः then, सः अक्षः that Aksha, गर्वितम् with pride, शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम् who was intent to conquer the enemy, तं कपिम् him, that Hanuman, जितश्रमम् who conquered, प्रसमीक्ष्य considered, बाणपाणिः with bow and arrows in hand, प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः holding a bow, समुदीर्णमानसः reflected in his mind, अवैक्षत looked

text: स हेमनिष्काङ्गदचारुकुण्डलः समाससादाशुपराक्रमः कपिम् । तयोर्बभूवाप्रतिमः समागमः सुरासुराणामपि सम्भ्रमप्रदः ॥५-४७-१२॥
translation: Adorned with armlets studded with golden coins and lovely earrings Aksha advanced instantaneously to meet the monkey. Their matchless combat excuitement and enthusiasm even among gods and demons.
word_meanings: आशुपराक्रमः an energetic hero, हेमनिष्काङ्गदचारुकुण्डलः wearing golden armlets studded with gold coins and lovely earrings, सः that, कपिम् monkey, समाससाद reached, तयोः both of them, अप्रतिमः matchless, समागमः combat, सुरासुराणामपि even for suras and asuras, सम्भ्रमप्रद: creating enthusiasm, अभूत् became

text: ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमान् ववौ न वायुः प्रचचाल चाचलः । कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य संयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे ॥५-४७-१३॥
translation: Witnessing the fight between Hanuman and Prince Aksha, even the earth shrieked in agony, the Sun became dim, the wind stopped blowing, mountains were shaken, the sky thundered and even the ocean was agitated.
word_meanings: कपेः of Hanuman, कुमारस्य च and of the prince, संयुगम् in battle, वीक्ष्य after seeing, भूमिः earth, ररास shrieked in agony, भानुमान् even Sun, न तताप became dim, वायुः wind, न वनौ blew not, अचलः च mountains, प्रचचाल shaken, द्यौः sky, ननाद च thundered, उदधिश्च even the ocean, चुक्षुभे was agitated

text: ततः स वीरः सुमुखात् पतत्त्रिणः सुवर्णपुङ्खान् सविषानिवोरगान् । समाधिसंयोगविमोक्षतत्त्वविच्छरानथ त्रीन् कपिमूर्ध्न्यपातयत् ॥५-४७-१४॥
translation: Heroic Aksha, who was good at targeting correctly, with due concentration struck the vanara on his head with three goldenshafted, winged arrows with feathers smeared with poison which resembled serpents.
word_meanings: ततः then, अथ there, वीरः hero, समाधिसम्योगविमोक्षतत्त्ववित् good at targeting and releasing with due concentration, सः he, सुमुखान् of good looking, सुवर्णपुङ्खान् goldenshafted (touching the bowstring), पतत्रिणः winged arrows with feathers, सविषान् smeared with poison, उरगानिव like serpents, त्रीन् three, शरान् arrows, कपिमूर्ध्नि on the head of the vanara, अपातयत् struck

text: स तैः शरैर्मूर्ध्नि समं निपातितैः क्षरन्नसृग्दिग्धविवृत्तलोचनः । नवोदितादित्यनिभः शरांशुमान् व्यराजतादित्य इवांशुमालिकः ॥५-४७-१५॥
translation: With the three arrows shot on his forehead simultaneously his eyes were drenched with flowing blood and with arrows shining like rays he appeared like the rising Sun, garlanded by glowing rays.
word_meanings: समम् simultaneously, मूर्ध्नि on the head, निपातितैः shot at, तैः by those शरैः by arrows, क्षरन् flowing, असृग्दिग्धविवृत्तलोचनः eyes wetted with red blood flowing down, नवोदितादित्यनिभः glittering like the rising Sun, शरांशुमान् arrows appeared like rays, सः he, अंशुमालिकः garlanded by rays, आदित्य इव like the Sun, व्यराजत glowed

text: ततः स पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रसत्तमः समीक्ष्य तं राजवरात्मजं रणे । उदग्रचित्रायुधचित्रकार्मुकं जहर्ष चापूर्यत चाहवोन्मुखः ॥५-४७-१६॥
translation: Hanuman, the esteemed minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva observed the prince holding manifold splendid weapons. He rejoiced, grew in size ready to fight, making the necessary prepararions (taking the required position).
word_meanings: ततः then, सः he, Hanuman, पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रिसत्तमः esteemed minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva, उदग्रचित्रायुधचित्रकार्मुकम् holding manifold splendid weapons raised, तम् him, राजवरात्मजम् that prince, समीक्ष्य observed, जहर्ष rejoiced, आहवोन्मुखः became ready for the battle, अपूर्यत च made the necessary preparations

text: स मन्दराग्रस्थ इवांशुमालिको विवृद्धकोपो बलवीर्यसंयुतः । कुमारमक्षं सबलं सवाहनं ददाह नेत्राग्निमरीचिभिस्तदा ॥५-४७-१७॥
translation: Huge Hanuman, endowed with strength and valour looked like the rising Sun on the peak of mount Mandara. He looked at prince Aksha and his army as well as his vehicles as though he was burning them with the rays emerging from his fiery eyes.

text: ततः स बाणासनचित्रकार्मुकः शरप्रवर्षो युधि राक्षसाम्बुदः । शरान् मुमोचाशु हरीश्वराचले वलाहको वृष्टिमिवाचलोत्तमे ॥५-४७-१८॥

translation: Then Hanuman saw prince Aksha, endowed with excessive splendour, power and energy advancing in a fierce manner like a cloud in the battle. Then Hanuman happy (to see the heroic prince) roared like a clap of thunder.

text: स तान् शरांस्तस्य हरिर्विमोक्षयंश्चचार वीरः पथि वायुसेविते । शरान्तरे मारुतवद्विनिष्पतन् मनोजवः संयति चण्डविक्रमः ॥५-४७-२३॥

text: तमात्तबाणासनमाहवोन्मुखं खमास्तृणन्तं विशिखैः शरोत्तमैः । अवैक्षताक्षं बहुमानचक्षुषा जगाम चिन्तां च स मारुतात्मजः ॥५-४७-२४॥
translation: Admiring the young Aksha's appearance, his skill in holding the quiver and spreading the excellent arrows with missiles and facing the war, Hanuman became thoughtful (as to how to kill him).
word_meanings: सः मारुतात्मजः that son of the Windgod, आत्तबाणासनम् holding a quiver, अहवोन्मुखम् facing the battle, विशिखैः with arrows, शरोत्तमैः with the best of missiles, खम् sky, आस्तृणन्तम् spreading in the sky, तम् him, अक्षम् that Aksha, बहुमानचक्षुषा admiring looks, अवैक्षत saw, चिन्तां च and thought,जगाम arose.

text: ततः शरैर्भिन्नभुजान्तरः कपिः कुमारवीरेण महात्मना नदन् । महाभुजः कर्मविशेषतत्त्वविद्विचिन्तयामास रणे पराक्रमम् ॥५-४७-२५॥

word_meanings: ततः then, महाभुजः strongarmed one, कर्मविशेषतत्त्ववित् one who knew the propriety of special actions, कपिः monkey, महात्मना by the great self, कुमारवीरेण by the warrior prince, भिन्नभुजान्तरः with his arms wounded, नदन् roaring, रणे in battle, पराक्रमम् regarding his heroic advances, विचिन्तयामास started rethinking

text: अबालवद्बालदिवाकरप्रभः करोत्ययं कर्म महन्महाबलः । न चास्य सर्वाहवकर्मशोभिनः प्रमापणे मे मतिरत्र जायते ॥५-४७-२६॥
translation: 'He (Aksha) is like the radiant, rising Sun with extraordinary might. He is accomplishing great deeds unlike young warriors of his age and is exhibiting a magnificent feat. He knows all means of fighting. I do not feel like cutting him to size. My mind does not allow me to kill this boy.
word_meanings: बालदिवाकरप्रभः radiant as the rising Sun, महाबलः powerful, अयम् this hero, अबालवत् unlike an amateur, महत् magnificent, कर्म feat, करोति is doing, अत्र here, सर्वाहवकर्मशोभिनः of the hero who knows all means of fighting, अस्य his, प्रमापणे in cutting him to size, मे I, मतिः thinking, न च जायते do not want to win

text: अयं महात्मा च महांश्च वीर्यतः समाहितश्चातिसहश्च संयुगे । असंशयं कर्मगुणोदयादयं सनागयक्षेर्मुनिभिश्च पूजितः ॥५-४७-२७॥
translation: 'He is a great self. His valour is also admirable. He is focused in battle and highly tolerant. There is no doubt that on account of his excellence even nagas, yakshas and sages offer salutations to him.
word_meanings: अयम् this, महात्मा च great self and, वीर्यतः च even his valour, महान् admirable, समाहितः focused, संयुगे in fight, अतिसहः highly tolerant, अयम् this hero, असंशयम् no doubt, कर्मगुणोदयात् on account of his excellent actions, सनागयक्षैः by the nagas, yakshas, मुनिभिश्च even by sages, पूजितः saluted

text: पराक्रमोत्साहविवृद्धमानसः समीक्षते मां प्रमुखागतः स्थितः । पराक्रमो ह्यस्य मनांसि कम्पयेत् सुरासुराणामपि शीघ्रगामिनः ॥५-४७-२८॥

text: न खल्वयं नाभिभवेदुपेक्षितः पराक्रमो ह्यस्य रणे विवर्धते । प्रमापणं त्वेव ममास्य रोचते न वर्धमानो ऽग्निरुपेक्षितुं क्षमः ॥५-४७-२९॥

text: इति प्रवेगं तु परस्य तर्कयन् स्वकर्मयोगं च विधाय वीर्यवान् । चकार वेगं तु महाबलस्तदा मतिं च चक्रे ऽस्य वधे महाकपिः ॥५-४७-३०॥

text: स तस्य तानष्ट हयान् महाजवान् समाहितान् भारसहान् विवर्तने । जघान वीरः पथि वायुसेविते तलप्रहारैः पवनात्मजः कपिः ॥५-४७-३१॥

text: स तं परित्यज्य महारथो रथं सकार्मुकः खड्गधरः खमुत्पतन् । तपोभियोगादृषिरुग्रवीर्यवान् विहाय देहं मरुतामिवालयम् ॥५-४७-३३॥

text: स तं समाविध्य सहस्रशः कपिर्महोरगं गृह्य इवाण्डजेश्वरः । मुमोच वेगात् पितृतुल्यविक्रमो महीतले संयति वानरोत्तमः ॥५-४७-३५॥

text: स भग्नबाहूरुकटीशिरोधरः क्षसन्नसृङ्निर्मथितास्थिलोचनः । स भग्रसन्धिः प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः । महाकपिर्भूमितले निपीड्य तं चकार रक्षोधिपतेर्महद्भयम् ॥५-४७-३६॥
translation: Hit by Hanuman, the ogre's arms, thighs, hips and neck broken, bones rendered to fragments, eyes protruded, joints disjointed, tendons strewn he was thrown down on the earth dripping blood.

word_meanings: महाकपिः great vanara, तम् him, भूमितले on the earth, निपीड्य after smashing down, रक्षोधिपतेः of the king of demons, महत् great, भयम् fear, चकार developed, कुमारे when the prince was हते slain, सः कपिः that vanara, भृशजातविस्मयैः who were wonderstruck, चक्रचरैः those who take rounds, महाव्रतैः by those observants of great vows, महर्षिभिः great seers, सयक्षपन्नगैः including yakshas and pannagas, भूतैश्च all beings, सेन्द्रैः including Indra, सुरैश्च and by suras, समेत्य collecting together, निरीक्षितः seen with awe

text: निहत्य तं वज्रिसुतोपमप्रभं कुमारमक्षं क्षतजोपमेक्षणम् । तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ॥५-४७-३८॥
translation: Hanuman, the hero with bloodshot eyes having slain Aksha, shone resplendent like the son of Indra (Jayanta), and reached the portal, and waited looking like the god of death determined to destroy all beings. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, वज्रिसुतोपमप्रभम् radiant like the son of Indra, क्षतजोपमेक्षणम् who had bloodshot eyes, तम् him अक्षम् Aksha, निहत्य having slain, प्रजाक्षये in destruction of human beings, कृतक्षणः determined, कालः इव like god of death, तम् that, तोरणमेव at the portal, अभिजगाम reached

text: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा हनूमता ऽक्षे निहते कुमारे । मनः समाधाय तदेन्द्रकल्पं समादिदेशेन्द्रजितं सरोषम् ॥५-४८-१॥
translation: Thereafter the great demon king, mighty angry at the death of Aksha in the hands of Hanuman, controlled his feeling and ordered Indrajit who was like a godhead.
word_meanings: ततः then, महात्मा great, सः he,रक्षोधिपतिः demon king, हनूमता by Hanuman, कुमारे son, अक्षे Aksha, निहते was killed, सरोषः angry, मनः in mind, समाधाय controlled, देवकल्पम् was like a god, इन्द्रजितम् to Indrajit, समादिदेश ordered.

text: त्वमस्त्रविच्छस्त्रविदां वरिष्ठः सुरासुराणामपि शोकदाता । सुरेषु सेन्द्रेषु च दृष्टकर्मा पितामहाराधनऽञ्चितास्त्रः ॥५-४८-२॥
translation: "You are an expert in wielding astras (missiles) and foremost among the wielders of weapons. You are highly efficient. You have brought grief even to suras and asuras. You are a warrior of proven ability demonstrated in your war against the gods including Indra. By propitiating, (through penance), grandfather Brahma you have acquired many missiles.
word_meanings: त्वम् you are, अस्त्रवित् an expert in astras (missiles), शस्त्रविदाम् among the experts in the use of weapons, वरिष्ठः highly efficient, सुरासुराणामपि for suras and asuras also, शोकदाता brought grief, सेन्द्रेषु including Indra, सुरेषु among gods, दृष्टकर्मा a warrior of proven ability, पितामहाराधनसञ्चितास्त्रः propitiating grand father Brahma acquired many missiles.

text: तवास्त्रबलमासाद्य नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः । न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं सुरेश्वरसमाश्रिताः ॥५-४८-३॥
translation: "None could face you in war including Indra, Maruts and gods because of your skill and the power of your astras.
word_meanings: तव your, अस्त्रबलम् strength of astras,आसाद्य attained, ससुराः including suras, समरुद्गणाः including Maruts, सुरेश्वरसमाश्रिताः who are on Indra's side, समरे in war, स्थातुम् to stand before you, न शेकुः not have the capacity.

text: न कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु संयुगे नगतश्रमः । भुजवीर्याभिगुप्तश्च तपसा चाभिरक्षितः । देशकालविभागज्ञस्त्वमेव मतिसत्तमः ॥५-४८-४॥
translation: "Excepting you there is none who has not experienced fatigue in war in the three worlds. You alone are intelligent in fighting. You are protected by the strength of your arms and power of austerity. You are aware of the proper place and time of action.
word_meanings: संयुगेन in war, गतश्रमः not experienced fatigue, कश्चित् some one, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds,न not, मतिसत्तमः most intelligent, त्वमेव you alone, भुजवीर्याभिगुप्तश्च protected by the strength of your arms, तपसा with the power of austerity, अभिरक्षितः wellprotected, देशकालविभागज्ञः aware of the proper place and time of action.

text: न ते ऽस्त्यशक्यं समरेषु कर्मणा न ते ऽस्त्यकार्यं मतिपूर्वमन्त्रणे । न सो ऽस्ति कश्चित् त्रिषु संग्रहेषु वै न वेद यस्ते ऽस्त्रबलं बलं च ते ॥५-४८-५॥
translation: "Nothing is impossible for you in war. You do not consider with your wise judgment any action unfit for undertaking. There is none in all the three worlds who is unaware of the strength of your weapons and your power to recall through Mantra the weapon you have discharged.
word_meanings: समरेषु in war, कर्मणा by the task, ते to you, अशक्यम् not possible, नास्ति there is nothing, मतिपूर्वमन्त्रणे wise counsel, ते to you, अकार्यम् impossible act, नास्ति not, त्रिषु in the three, सङ्ग्रहेषु in making by mantra an astra return, यः such a person, ते to you, अस्त्रबलम् strength of your weapons, ते बलं च your own strength, न वेद does not know, सः he, कश्चित् none, नास्ति not.

text: ममानुरूपं तपसो बलं च ते पराक्रमश्चास्त्रबलं च संयुगे । न त्वां समासाद्य रणावमर्दे मनः श्रमं गच्छति निश्चितार्थम् ॥५-४८-६॥
translation: "The power of your penance, your valour and your ability to discharge astras in war is equal only to mine. I am not bothered about the consequences of war you wage because your victory is certain.
word_meanings: ते to you, तपसः of penance, बलम् power, मम अनुरूपम् equal to me, संयुगे in fight, पराक्रमश्च valiance, बलं च strength, रणावमर्थे in war, त्वाम् you, समासाद्य engaged, मनः mind, निश्चितार्थम् sure of action (victory), श्रमम् despair, न गच्छति does not experience.

text: निहताः किङ्कराः सर्वे जम्बुमाली च राक्षसः । अमात्यपुत्रा वीराश्च पञ्च सेनाग्रयायिनः ॥५-४८-७॥
translation: "All the kinkaras , Jambumali, the heroic demons, sons of the ministers and five army generals were slain. Battalions of well-equipped army including horses, elephants and chariots were also destroyed.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, किङ्कराः kinkaras, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, राक्षसश्च ogres also, वीराः heroes, अमात्यपुत्राः sons of ministers, पञ्च five, सेनाग्रयायिनः army generals, निहताः killed, सुसमृद्धानि well equipped, साश्वनागरथानि च including horses, elephants and chariots, बलानि च armies also.

text: बलानि सुसमृद्धानि साश्वनागरथानि च । सहोदरस्ते दयितः कुमारो ऽक्षश्च सूदितः ॥५-४८-८॥
न हि तेष्वेव मे सारो यस्त्वय्यरिनिषूदन ॥५-४८-९॥
translation: "Your dear young brother Aksha is killed. O scourage of enemies I do not have the faith in them as I have in you.
word_meanings: ते your, दयितः dear, सहोदरः brother, कुमारः अक्षश्च even young Aksha, सूदितः killed, अरिनिषूदन O scourge of enemies, मे to me, त्वयि in you, यः such, सारः real faith, तेष्वेव at them, न हि not there indeed.

text: इदं हि दृष्ट्वा मतिमन्महद्बलं कपेः प्रभावं च पराक्रमं च । त्वमात्मनश्चापि समीक्ष्य सारं कुरुष्व वेगं स्वबलानुरूपम् ॥५-४८-१०॥
translation: "O intelligent warrior measure the strength, power and valour of the monkey and your own strength carefully. Exercise your own strength and speed accordingly.
word_meanings: मतिमन् O Intelligent one, त्वम् you, कपेः monkey's, इदम् this, महत् great, बलम् strength, प्रभावं च power also, पराक्रमं च and valour, दृष्ट्वा observing, आत्मनः your own, सारं चापि strength also, समीक्ष्य considering, स्वबलानुरूपम् in keeping with your own strength, वेगम् quickly, कुरुष्व do.

text: बलावमर्दस्त्वयि सन्निकृष्टे यथा गते शाम्यति शान्तशत्रौ । तथा समीक्ष्यात्मबलं परं च समारभस्वास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठ ॥५-४८-११॥
translation: "O warrior of extraordinary merit among the wielders of astras asses your strength approach the enemy in a manner by which he is subdued without causing further destruction to our army. Carefully measure your own strength and your enemy's before you start fighting.
word_meanings: अस्त्रविदाम् among experts in archery, वरिष्ठ of extraordinary merit, त्वयि you, सन्निकृष्टे approaching, शान्तशत्रौ subduer of enemy, गते going there, बलावमर्थः judging the strength, यथा in a manner, शाम्यति without causing destruction, तथा that way, आत्मबलम् your own strength, परं च and enemy's, समीक्ष्य observing, समारभस्व start the battle.

text: न वीर सेना गणशोच्यवन्ति न वज्रमादाय विशालसारम् । न मारुतस्यास्य गतेः प्रमाणं न चाग्निकल्पः करणेन हन्तुम् ॥५-४८-१२॥
translation: "O hero take no large army as it is futile with this monkey endowed with extraordinary vigour. Even a thunderbolt can do nothing. He is like the wind and has no match in speed. He is like the sacrificial fire who cannot be destroyed by weapons.
word_meanings: वीर hero, गणश: large, सेनाः armies, च्यवन्ति न do not go, विशालसारम् having extraordinary vigour,वज्रम् thunderbolt, आदाय seizing, न not, अस्य his, गतेः of speed, मारुतस्य of Maruta's, न प्रमाणम् no match, अग्निकल्पः like sacrificial fire, करणेन any weapon, हन्तुम् to destroy, न not.

text: तमेवमर्थं प्रसमीक्ष्य सम्यक् स्वकर्मसाम्याद्धि समाहितात्मा । स्मरंश्च दिव्यं धनुषो ऽस्त्रवीर्यं व्रजाक्षतं कर्म समारभस्व ॥५-४८-१३॥
translation: "Assess the situation properly. You are a person of sound judgement. You are a master in weaponry. Recollect the strength of your bow and divine astras and march forward with a singleminded attention. Act in a manner that does not bring your doom.
word_meanings: तम् him, एवम् in that way, अर्थम् matter, सम्यक् properly, प्रसमीक्ष्य assess, स्वकर्मसाम्यात् person of good judgement, समाहितात्मा with singleminded attention, धनुषः of the bow, दिव्यम् divine, अस्त्रवीर्यम् strength of your astras, स्मरंश्च recollecting, व्रज move, कर्म the act, अक्षतम् without being destroyed in the middle, समारभस्व start.

text: न खल्वियं मतिः श्रेष्ठा यत्त्वां संप्रेषयाम्यहम् । इयं च राजधर्माणां क्षत्रस्य च मतिर्मता ॥५-४८-१४॥
translation: "I am reluctant to send you to war in the circumstances. But you are the best choice for me. However, certainly this is the duty of a kshatriya who follows the science of polity. Hence I am sending you.
word_meanings: अहम् I, त्वाम् you, सम्प्रेषयामि इति यत् this way sending you to war is not good, इयं मतिः this I think, श्रेष्ठा the best, न खलु not certainly, इयम् this, राजधर्माणाम् in accordance with state craft, क्षत्रियस्य for a kshatriya, मतिः thought, मता approved.

text: नानाशस्त्रैश्च संग्रामे वैशारद्यमरिन्दम् । अवश्यमेव बोद्धव्यं काम्यश्च विजयो रणे ॥५-४८-१५॥
translation: "O subduer of enemies you are capable of handling different kinds of weapons. Therefore, understand that I seek only your ultimate triumph in war.
word_meanings: अरिंदम subduer of foes, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, नानाशस्त्रेषु with many kinds of weapons, वैशारद्यम् efficient, अवश्यमेव ultimately, बोद्धव्यम् aware, रणे in war, विजयश्च only victory, काम्यः seek.

text: ततः पितुस्तद्वचनं निशम्य प्रदक्षिणं दक्षसुतप्रभावः । चकार भर्तारमदीनसत्त्वो रणाय वीरः प्रतिपन्नबुद्धिः ॥५-४८-१६॥
translation: Hearing the father's words (of exhortation), he, who is never distressed at the prospect of war decided to seek the battle as he was powerful like the son of Daksha, and went round his father with respect.
word_meanings: ततः then, दक्षसुतप्रभावः powerful like the son of Daksha, वीरः warrior, पितुः father's, तत् वचनम् those words, निशम्य having heard, अदीनसत्त्वः who is never distressed, रणाय in war, प्रतिपन्नबुद्धिः prepared his mind, भर्तारम् by the king, प्रदक्षिणं चकार went round with respect.

text: ततस्तैः स्वगणैरिष्टैरिन्द्रजत् प्रतिपूजितः । युद्धोद्धतः कृतोत्साहः सग्रामं प्रत्यद्यत ॥५-४८-१७॥
translation: Having been honoured by his own kith and kin who loved him, Indrajit rushed forth for war with martial vigour.
word_meanings: ततः then, यद्धोद्धतः rushed forth for war, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, इष्टैः by people who loved him, तैः स्वगणैः by his own kith and kin, प्रतिपूजितः was honoured with reverence, कृतोत्साहः became vigorous, सङ्ग्रामम् for war, प्रत्यपद्यत went ahead.

text: श्रीमान् पद्मपलाशाक्षो राक्षसाधिपतेः सुतः । निर्जगाम महातेजाः समुद्र इव पर्वसु ॥५-४८-१८॥
translation: When the illustrious son of Ravana, the highly Indrajit resplendent with eyes of lotus petals marched ahead he looked like the turbulent ocean on a fullmoon day.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् illustrious, पद्मपलाशाक्षः eyes of lotus petals, महातेजाः highly resplendent, राक्षसाधिपतेः सुतः son of the lord of demons, पर्वसु on a fullmoon day, समुद्रः इव like the turbulent ocean, निर्जगाम came out.

text: स पक्षिराजोपमतुल्यवेगैर्व्यालैश्चतुर्भिः सिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः । रथं समायुक्तमसङ्गवेगं समारुरोहेन्द्रजिदिन्द्रकल्पः ॥५-४८-१९॥
translation: Like Indra, Indrajit ascended the chariot (which had the standard of Indra as it was seized from him as a token of his having conquered Indra) yoked to four sharptoothed tigers. It moved in swiftness vying with Garuda, the king of birds in speed.
word_meanings: इन्द्रकल्पः like Indra, सः इन्द्रजित् that Indrajit, पक्षिराजोपमतुल्यवेगैः equal to Garuda the king of birds in speed, सिततीक्षणदंष्ट्रैः that had sharp big white teeth, चतुर्भिः four, व्याघै: with tigers, समायुक्तम् yoked, असहयवेगम् very high speed, रथम् chariot, समारुरोह ascended.

text: स रथी धन्विनीं श्रेष्ठः शस्त्रज्ञो ऽस्त्रविदां वरः । रथेनाभिययौ क्षिप्रं हनूमान् यत्र सो ऽभवत् ॥५-४८-२०॥
translation: Mounted on the chariot, Indrajit, the best in archery and an expert in weaponry went quickly to the place where that great Hanuman was stationed.
word_meanings: रथी charioteer, धन्विनाम् among wielders of bows, श्रेष्ठः best, शस्त्रज्ञः in the knowledge of archery, अस्त्रविदाम् among exports in weaponry, वरः great, सः that, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, यत्र whichever, अभवत् stationed, शीघ्रम् quickly, रथेन by his chariot, अभिययौ marched.

text: स तस्य रथनिर्घोषं ज्यास्वनं कार्मुकस्य च । निशम्य हरिवीरो ऽसौ संप्रहृष्टतरो ऽभवत् ॥५-४८-२१॥
translation: The leader of the monkey also became happier on hearing the rumbling (of the chariot) and the twang of Indrajit's bowstring.
word_meanings: सः असौ he also, हरिवीरः leader of monkeys, तस्य his, रधनिर्घोषम् rumbling of the chariot, कार्मुकस्य of his bow, ज्यास्वनं च sound of his bow, निशम्य after hearing, संप्रहृष्टः तर: more happy, अभवत् became.

text: सुमहच्चापमादाय शितशल्यांश्च सायकान् । हनुमन्तमभिप्रेत्य जगाम रणपण्डितः ॥५-४८-२२॥
translation: Indrajit who was an adept in warfare, picked his highly powerful bow and aimed his sharpedged arrow at Hanuman.
word_meanings: रणपण्डितः adept in warfare, सुमहत् highly powerful, चापम् bow, शितशल्यान् sharpedged ones, सायकान् arrows, आदाय picking, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, अभिप्रेत्य having aimed at, जगाम went forward

text: तस्मिंस्ततः संयति जातहर्षे रणाय निर्गच्छति बाणपाणौ । दिशश्च सर्वाः बभूवर्मृगाश्च रौद्रा बहुधा विनेदुः ॥५-४८-२३॥
translation: When he sallied forth happily holding a bow full of passion for war, darkness prevailed in all quarters and it became gloomy. Beasts began to howl in various frightful ways.

text: स रोचयामास परैश्च बन्धं प्रसह्य वीरैरभिनिग्रहं च । कौतूहलान्मां यदि राक्षसेन्द्रो द्रष्ठुं व्यवस्येदिति निश्चितार्थः ॥५-४८-४८॥
translation: Bound by the enemy warriors, Hanuman, decided to bear all humiliations, thinking, 'May be the demon king might come to see me out of curiosity if he is so disposed'.
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्रः demon king, माम् me, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, द्रष्टुम् to see, व्यवस्येद्यदि if he decides, इति this way, निश्चितार्थः decided, सः he परै: by the enemies, बन्धनम bondage, वीरैः by warriors, प्रसह्य by force, अभिनिग्रहं च even capture also, रोचयामास enjoyed

text: स बद्धस्तेन वल्केन विमुक्तो ऽस्त्रेण वीर्यवान् । अस्त्रबन्धः स चान्यं हि न बन्धमनुवर्तते ॥५-४८-४९॥
translation: On being bound by bark ropes Hanuman was set free from the bond of Brahmastra, since the bondage of Brahmastra does not tolerate another ordinary bondage.
word_meanings: तेन by that, वल्केन with bark, बद्धः tied, वीर्यवान् valiant, सः he, अस्त्रेण by (Brahm) astra, विमुक्तः set free, सः that, अस्त्रबन्धः bondage of astra, अन्यम् other, बन्धम् bondage, न अनुवर्तते हि not tolerate

text: अथेन्द्रजित्तुद्रुमचीरबद्धं विचार्य वीरः कपिसत्तमं तम् । विमुक्तमस्त्रेण जगाम चिन्तां नान्येन बद्धो ह्यनुवर्तते ऽस्त्रम् ॥५-४८-५०॥
translation: Then the heroic Indrajit coming to know that the foremost of the monkeys bound by bark ropes was released from the bondage of Brahmastra, thought, 'indeed the divine weapon does not tolerate other bonds, so the vanara is released'.
word_meanings: अथ and then, वीरः hero, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajit, द्रुमचीरबद्धम् bound by bark rope, तम् him, कपिसत्तमम् foremost of vanaras, अस्त्रेण by astra, विमुक्तम् released, विचार्य thinking, चिन्ताम् thought, जगाम started, अन्येन by other, बद्धः bound, अस्त्रम् astra, नानु वर्तते हि indeed does not follow.

text: अहो महत् कर्म कृतं निरर्थकं न राक्षसैर्मन्त्रगतिर्विमृष्टा । पुनश्च नास्त्रे विहते ऽस्त्रमन्यत् प्रवर्तते संशयिताः स्म सर्वे ॥५-४८-५१॥
translation: 'Alas! my achievement has been wasted. The ogres had not considered the impact of the mantra of astra . Once the Brahmastra is ineffective another astra cannot be operative again. We are all running a risk.'
word_meanings: अहो Alas, महत् great, कर्म action, निरर्थकम् wasted, कृतम् done, राक्षसैः by the ogres, मन्त्रगतिः impact of mantra, न विमृष्टाः is not considered, मन्त्रे when mantra, विहते is ineffective, अन्यत् other, अस्त्रम् astra, न प्रवर्तते works, सर्वे all, संशयिताः our lives will be at risk, स्म us

text: अस्त्रेण हनुमान् मुक्तो नात्मानमवबुध्यत । कृष्यमाणस्तु रक्षोभिस्तैश्च बन्धेर्निपीडितः ॥५-४८-५२॥
translation: Though binding and dragging by the ogres had hurt Hanuman, he on his part did not know that he had been released from Brahmastra.
word_meanings: अस्त्रेण by Astra, मुक्तः was released, हनुमान् Hanuman, तैः those, रक्षोभिः by the ogres, कृष्यमाणः dragged, बन्धै: was tied, निपीडितः hurting him, आत्मानम् himself, न अवबुध्यत he did not know

text: हन्यमानस्ततः क्रूरै राक्षसैः काष्ठमुष्टिभिः । समीपं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य प्रकृष्यत स वानरः ॥५-४८-५३॥
translation: The cruel ogres hit Hanuman with sticks and fists and dragged him to the presence of the demon lord.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः वानरः that vanara, क्रूरैः by the cruel ones, राक्षसैः by rakshasas, काष्ठमुष्टिभिः with sticks and fists, हन्यमानः beaten, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य to the lord of rakshasas, समीपम् near, प्राकृष्यत was dragged

text: अथेन्द्रजित्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य मुक्तमस्त्रेण बद्धं द्रुमचीरसूत्रैः । व्यदर्शयत्तत्र महाबलं हरिप्रवीरं सगणाय राज्ञे ॥५-४८-५४॥
translation: Then Indarjit, seeing the powerful Hanuman, the foremost of monkeys who was released from the Brahmastra, still bound by bark ropes, presented him to the ogres and their master in the royal assembly.
word_meanings: अथ and then, द्रुमचीरसूत्रैः with bark ropes, बद्धम् bound, तम् him, अस्त्रेण by the astra, मुक्तम् released, प्रसमीक्ष्य seeing, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, महाबलम् who had great power, तं हरिप्रवीरम् foremost monkey, तत्र there, सगणाय including the courtiers, राज्ञे king in the royal assembly, न्यदर्शयत् presented

text: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं बद्धं कपिवरोत्तमम् । राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ॥५-४८-५५॥
translation: The ogres presented the best of monkeys, Hanuman looking like an elephant in rut to Ravana, the demon king.
word_meanings: मत्तम् in rut, मातङ्गमिव elephant like, बद्धम् bound, कपिवरोत्तमम् best of monkeys, तम् him, राक्षसाः ogres, राक्षसेन्द्राय to the demon king, रावणाय to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् presented

text: को ऽयं कस्य कुतो वा ऽत्र किं कार्यं को व्यपाश्रयः । इति राक्षसवीराणां तत्र संजज्ञिरे कथाः ॥५-४८-५६॥
translation: "Who is he? Whose son is he? Why has he come here? Where has he come from? What business does he have here?" Thus the heroic demons talked among themselves.
word_meanings: अयम् this, कः who is, कस्य his, कुतो वा whose son is he, अत्र here, किम् why, कार्यम् task, व्यपाश्रयः to whom, कः what, इति this, तत्र there, राक्षसवीराणाम् heroic demons, कथाः talked about him, सञ्जज्ञिरे talked among themselves

text: हन्यतां दह्यतां वापि भक्ष्यतामिति चापरे । राक्षसास्तत्र संक्रुद्धाः परस्परमथाब्रुवन् ॥५-४८-५७॥
translation: Thereafter other ogres angrily said 'Let us kill him, burn him or otherwise devour him,' thus they spoke to one another.
word_meanings: अथ and then, अपरे others, राक्षसाः rakshasas, सङ्कृद्धाः very angry, हन्यताम् kill him, दह्यतां चापि he may be burnt also, भक्ष्यताम् devoure, इति this way, परस्परम् one another, अब्रुवन् spoke

text: अतीत्य मार्गं सहसा महात्मा स तत्र रक्षोधिपपादमूले । ददर्श राज्ञः परिचारवृद्धान् गृहं महारत्नविभूषितं च ॥५-४८-५८॥
translation: The great Hanuman moving quickly and crossing the path came near the feet of the king. He saw the aged and experienced ministers of the king and the palace of the king adorned with precious gems.
word_meanings: महात्मा great self, सः he, सहसा quickly, मार्गम् the path, अतीत्य after crossing, तत्र there, राज्ञः of the king, महारत्नविभूषितम् adorned with precious gems, गृहम् palace, रक्षोधिपपादमूले near the feet of the king, परिचारवृद्धान् the aged and experienced ministers of the king, ददर्श saw

text: स ददर्श महातेजा रावणः कपिसत्तमम् । रक्षोभिर्विकृताकारैः कृष्यमाणमितस्ततः ॥५-४८-५९॥
translation: Resplendent Ravana saw the ogres of ugly appearance dragging the foremost of the monkeys here and there.
word_meanings: महातेजाः resplendent one, सः रावणः that Ravana, विकृताकारैः by ugly looking ones, रक्षोभिः by the rakshasas, इतस्ततः here and there, कृष्यमाणम् being dragged, कपिसत्तमम् foremost monkey, ददर्श saw

text: राक्षसाधिपतिं चापि ददर्श कपिसत्तमः । तेजोबलसमायुक्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥५-४८-६०॥
translation: Hanuman the best of monkeys also saw the demon king who had both splendour and strength, radiating brilliance like the Sun.
word_meanings: कपिसत्तमः च and the best of monkeys, तेजोबलसमायुक्तम् one who had splendour and strength, तपन्तम् radiating brilliance, भास्करम् इव like the Sun, राक्षसाधिपतिम् king of demons, ददर्श saw

text: स रोषसंवर्तितताम्रदृष्टिर्दशाननस्तं कपिमन्ववेक्ष्य । अथोपविष्टान् कुलशीलवृद्धान् समादिशत्तं प्रति मन्त्रिमुख्यान् ॥५-४८-६१॥
translation: That tenheaded rakshasa king, rolling his red eyes rapidly in rage and observing the monkey unwinkingly ordered the noble and aged ministers of his clan to interrogate Hanuman.
word_meanings: सः दशाननः that tenheaded one, रोषसम्वर्तितताम्रदृष्टिः his red eyes rolling in rage, तं कपिम् him the monkey, अन्ववेक्ष्य observing unwinkingly, अथ and then, उपविष्टान् seated, कुलशीलवृद्धान् noble and aged members of his clan, मन्त्रिमुख्यान् important ministers, तं प्रति with regard to him, समादिशत् ordered

text: यथाक्रमं तैः स कपिर्विपृष्टः कार्यार्थमर्थस्य च मूलमादौ । निवेदयामास हरीश्वरस्य दूतः सकाशादहमागतो ऽस्मि ॥५-४८-६२॥
translation: At the very outset they questioned Hanuman manner in the usual about the place he came from and the purpose. Hanuman reported, 'I am Hanuman. I came as a messenger by the order of the king of monkeys'. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyeigth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तैः by those, यथाक्रमम् in a proper order, कार्यार्थम् purpose, अर्धस्य of the purpose, मूलम् origin, विपृष्टः questioned, सः कपिः that monkey, हरीश्वरस्य सकाशात् a messsenger of the king of monkeys, सकाशात from his place, आगतः अस्मि I came, निवेदयामास he reported

text: ततः स कर्मणा तस्य विस्मितो भीमविक्रमः । हनुमान् रोषताम्राक्षो रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत ॥५-४९-१॥
translation: The highly courageous Hanuman, astonished at the action (of binding and dragging him to the court) by the demon king looked at him with eyes turned red in anger.
word_meanings: ततः then, भीमविक्रमः of fierce valour, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, तस्य his, तेन कर्मणा by that act, विस्मितः astonished, रोषताम्राक्षः eyes red with anger, रक्षोधिपम् demon king, अवैक्षत beheld.

text: भ्राजमानं महार्हेण काञ्चनेन विराजता । मुक्ताजालावृतेनाथ मुकुटेन महाद्युतिम् ॥५-४९-२॥
translation: (Hanuman looked at Ravana) of innate splendour, who shone with a glittering crown of gold glowing, encircled with strings of pearls.
word_meanings: महार्हेण of innate splendour, काञ्चनेन with a golden, विराजता shining, अथ and, मुक्ताजालावृतेन covered with strings of pearls, मकुटेन with crown, भ्राजमानम् shining, महाद्युतिम् glittering.

text: वज्रसंयोगसंयुक्तैर्महार्हमणिविग्रहैः । हैमैराभरणैश्चित्रैर्मनसेव प्रकल्पितैः ॥५-४९-३॥
translation: He was decked with wonderful golden ornaments studded with diamonds and had small motifs of precious gems fixed to them. They were as though designed by imagination. (An ornament made with the hand connot be so fine and delicate.)
word_meanings: वज्रसंयोगसंयुक्तै: studded with diamonds, महार्हमणिविग्रहैः adorned with small motifs made of precious gems, मनसा by imagination, प्रकल्पितैरिव as if created, चित्रैः wonderful, हैमैः golden, आभरणैः with ornaments.
