word_meanings: ततः then, सिद्धसन्नाहाः got ready, चण्डविक्रमाः who had terrific courage, राक्षसाः demons, काष्ठमुष्टिभिः with firesticks and fists, निघ्नन्तः hit, बहुभिः many, पाशैः ropes, बद्धस्य tied, राक्षसैः by the demons, यन्त्रितस्य fastened, मे me, पुच्छम् tail, तदा then, अदह्यन्त set fire.

text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम् । अघोषयन् राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः ः । ततो ऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः ॥५-५८-१५२॥
राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः ॥५-५८-१५३॥
translation: "The brave demons took me round the city through the royal streets and announced loudly to let every one know that I am bound and that my tail has been set on fire.
word_meanings: ततः then, शूराः courageous, राक्षसाः by demons, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, आगताः took, बद्धम् bound, अग्निसंवृतम् set on fire, माम् me, राजमार्गे in the royal street, अघोषयन् announced loudly.

text: ः । विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः । आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम् । ततस्तन्नगरद्वारं वेगेनाप्लुतवानहम् ॥५-५८-१५४॥
translation: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).
word_meanings: ततः then, अहम् I, आत्मनः my own, सुमहत् very huge, रूपम् form, पुनः again, संक्षिप्य assumed small form, तं बन्धम् that bondage, विमोचयित्वा got rid off, पुनः again, प्रकृतिस्थः into my natural huge form, स्थितः stayed, आयसम् near by, परिघम् iron beam, गृह्य took up, तानि रक्षांसि that rakshasas, असूदयम् killed.

text: पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम् । दहाम्यहमसम्भ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः ॥५-५८-१५५॥
translation: "Then I leaped to the entrance gate of the city without being perplexed. With my burning tail I set fire to the boundaries and towering mansions which looked like the world at the end of dissolution.
word_meanings: ततः then, अहम् I, वेगेन quickly, तत् that, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, आप्लुतवान् leapt, अहम् I, असंभ्रान्तः not perplexed, युगान्ताग्निः fire at the end of the dissolution, प्रजाः इव like the world, साट्टप्राकारगोपुराम् boundaries and towering mansions, तां पुरीम् of the city, प्रदीप्तेन by fire, पुच्चेन by the tail, दहामि burnt away.

text: विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तं न ह्यदग्धः प्रदृश्यते । लङ्कायां कश्चिदुद्देशः सर्वा भस्मीकृता पुरी ॥५-५८-१५६॥
translation: Surely Janaki has perished, I feared, for not a spot in Lanka is seen unburnt and the whole city has been reduced to ashes.
word_meanings: व्यक्तम् after doing so, जानकी Janaki, विनष्टा may be burnt, लङ्कायाम् with Lanka, कश्चित् perhaps, उद्धेशः thinking so, अदग्धः rose up, न प्रदृश्यते हि not even one place was left unburnt, सर्वा completely, पुरी city, भस्मीकृता reduced to ashes

text: दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः । रामस्य हि महत् कार्यं मयेदं वितथीकृतम् ॥५-५८-१५७॥
translation: "Lanka has been burnt by me and Sita might have also been burnt. There is no doubt. The great purpose of Rama has been spoilt by me'.
word_meanings: लङ्काम् Lanka, दहता burnt, मया by me, सीता Sita, दग्धा has burnt, संशयः doubt, न not, मया to me, रामस्य of Rama, इदम् this, महत् great, कार्यम् purpose, वितथीकृतम् has been spoilt.

text: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः ॥५-५८-१५८॥
translation: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.
word_meanings: इति thus, शोकसमाविष्टः overtaken by sorrow, अहम् I, चिन्ताम् worry, उपागतः became, अथ and then, अहम् I, जानकी Janaki, न च दग्धा not been burn, इति this, विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम् wonderful utterances, चारणानाम् from charanas, शुभाक्षराम् propitious, वाचम् words, अश्रौषम् heard.

text: अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम् । जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिताम् ॥५-५८-१५९॥
translation: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.
word_meanings: इति thus, शोकसमाविष्टः overtaken by sorrow, अहम् I, चिन्ताम् worry, उपागतः became, अथ and then, अहम् I, जानकी Janaki, न च दग्धा not been burn, इति this, विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम् wonderful utterances, चारणानाम् from charanas, शुभाक्षराम् propitious, वाचम् words, अश्रौषम् heard.

text: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम् । अदग्द्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता ॥५-५८-१६०॥
translation: "It was amazing to hear the words of the charanas. On hearing that Jankai had not been burnt, I understood that it is on her account (that he is also not burnt although his tail was ignited.)
word_meanings: अद्भुताम् amazing, तां गिरम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, ततः then, जानकी Janaki, अदग्धा not been burnt, इत्येवम् this way, मे my, बुद्धिः knew, उत्पन्ना arose, निमित्तैश्च on account of her, उपलक्षिता I understood.

text: दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गूले न मां दहति पावकः । हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वाताः सुरभिगन्धिनः ॥५-५८-१६१॥
translation: "My tail was burning but I was not burnt by fire. There was joy in my heart. The wind carried sweet fragrance.
word_meanings: लाङ्गूले tail, दीप्यमाने was burning, पावकः by fire, माम् but I, न दहति was not burnt, मे my, हृदयं च from my heart, प्रहृष्टम् joy, वाताः wind, सुरभिगन्धिनः very sweet fragrance.

text: तैर्निमित्तैश्च दृष्टार्थैः कारणैश्च महागुणैः । ऋषिवाक्यैश्च सिद्धार्थैरभवं हृष्टमानसः ॥५-५८-१६२॥
translation: "For these two auspicious signs and the highly propitious words uttered by the sages I felt glad at heart.
word_meanings: दृष्टार्थैः by such signs, तैः those two, निमित्तै: reasons, महागुणैः great virtues, कारणैश्च and for these reasons, सिद्धार्थैः will accomplish, ऋषिवाक्यैश्च uttered by the words of sages, हृष्टमानसः felt very happy, अभवम् attained.

text: पुनर्दृष्ट्वा च वैदेहीं विसृष्टश्च तया पुनः ॥५-५८-१६३॥
ततः पर्वतमासाद्य तत्रारिष्टमहं पुनः । प्रतिप्लवनमारेभे युष्मद्दर्शनकाङ्क्षया ॥५-५८-१६४॥
translation: After seeing Vaidehi once more and being dismissed by her again, I reached Mount Arishta and, longing to see you all, leapt up to return.
word_meanings: वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, पुनः again, दृष्ट्वा च and to see, तया like that, पुनः again, विसृष्टः seeking permission, ततः then, अरिष्टपर्वतम् mountain Arishta, पुनः again, आसाद्य ascended, अहम् I, युष्मद्धर्शनकांक्षया to see you all, प्रतिप्लवनम् leapt again, आरेभे started.

text: ततः पवनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् । पन्थानमहमाक्रम्य भवतो दृष्टवानिह ॥५-५८-१६५॥
translation: "Passing along the path of the Windgod, the Moon, the Sun, the siddhas and the gandharvas I came to see you.
word_meanings: ततः then, अहम् I, पवनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् by Windgod, the Moon, the Sun, the siddhas and the gandharvas, पन्थानम् through the path travelled by, आश्रित्य came, इह here, भवतः to you, दृष्टवान् to see.

text: राघवस्य प्रभावेन भवतां चैव तेजसा । सुग्रीवस्य च कार्यार्थं मया सर्वमनुष्टितम् ॥५-५८-१६६॥
translation: "Everything was favourable to me by the power of Rama, by your goodwill and for the great purpose of Sugriva.
word_meanings: राघवस्य Rama's, प्रभावेण by the power, भवताम् your, तेजसा चैव grace, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, कार्यार्थं च on his account, मया for me, सर्वम् all, अनुष्ठितम् was favourable.

text: एतत्सर्वं मया तत्र यथावदुपपादितम् । अत्र यन्न कृतं शेषं तत्सर्वं क्रियतामिति ॥५-५८-१६७॥
translation: "Let all that could not be done there and still remains to be done, be accomplished by you. I have presented the entire thing". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: एतत् all that, सर्वम् entire, तत्र there, मया by me, यथावत् as it is, उपपादितम् presented, अत्र there, यत् whatever, न कृतम् not done, शेषम् remaining task, तत् that, सर्वम् everything, क्रियताम् will do.

text: एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । भूयः समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम् ॥५-५९-१॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, सर्वम् entire, तत् एतत् all that, आख्याय having narrated, भूयः whatever happened, उत्तरं वचनम् the good words, वक्तुम् told, समुपचक्राम again started telling.

text: सफलो राघवोद्योगः सुग्रीवस्य च संभ्रमः । शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्रवणं मनः ॥५-५९-२॥
translation: "It is due to Rama's exertions, Sugriva's endeavour and Sita's conduct that I have been successful. My devotion to Sita has further deepened.
word_meanings: राघवोद्योगः Rama's exertions, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, सम्भ्रमः enthusiasm, सीतायाः Sita's, शीलम् conduct, आसाद्य attained, सफलः successl, मम I am, मनश्च in my mind, प्रवणम् developed devotion.

text: तपसा धारयेल्लोकान् क्रुद्धो वा निर्दहेदपि । सर्वथा ऽतिप्रवृद्धो ऽसौ रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । तस्य तां स्पृशतो गात्रं तपसा न विनाशितम् ॥५-५९-३॥
translation: "The demon king is rich in asceticism. He can burn the whole world with the power of his penance. In spite of Sita's anger he was not burnt(Hanuman gives the reason for Ravana's survival).
word_meanings: सर्वधा ever, अतिप्रवृद्ध: rich in asceticism, असौ he is, राक्षसाधिपः demon king, तपसा his penance, लोकान् in the world, निर्दहेत् can burn, कुद्धो वापि even though angry, निर्दहेदपि not burnt

text: न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात् संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती । जनकस्यात्मजा कुर्याद्यत् क्रोधकलुषीकृता ॥५-५९-४॥
translation: "Sita can burn Ravana with the mere touch of her body but because of the power of his penance, he was not burnt even though he touched her hand. If enraged, Janaki can burn the whole world (by virtue of her chastity) in a way that even the flame of fire can not do. (But she desired that her husband should kill him.)
word_meanings: ताम् her, स्पृशतः with mere touch, तस्य of her, गात्रम् body, तपसा by penance, न विनाशितम् not destroyed, क्रोधकलुषीकृता if enraged (she) can destroy, जनकस्य Janaka's, आत्मजा daughter, यत् such, कुर्यात् she can do, तत् that, पाणिना by hand, संस्पृष्टासती touched with hand, अग्निशिखा like flame of fire, न कुर्यात् not done so.

text: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाहरीन् । अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते ॥५-५९-५॥
translation: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.
word_meanings: भवताम् to you, निवेदिते relating to you, अस्मिन् your, कार्ये task, एवं गते to go there, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् with Jambavan and other important people, महाहरीन् great vanara heroes, समनुज्ञाप्य with their permission, वैदेह्या सह along with Vaidehi, तौ both, पार्थिवात्मजौ king's sons, द्रष्टुम् to see, न्याय्यं स्म is proper.

text: न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ ॥५-५९-६॥
translation: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.
word_meanings: भवताम् to you, निवेदिते relating to you, अस्मिन् your, कार्ये task, एवं गते to go there, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् with Jambavan and other important people, महाहरीन् great vanara heroes, समनुज्ञाप्य with their permission, वैदेह्या सह along with Vaidehi, तौ both, पार्थिवात्मजौ king's sons, द्रष्टुम् to see, न्याय्यं स्म is proper.

text: अहमेको ऽपि पर्याप्तः सराक्षसगणां पुरीम् । तां लङ्कां तपसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम् ॥५-५९-७॥
translation: I alone am enough to destroy by force the city of Lanka with its demon hordes and the mighty Ravana.
word_meanings: अहम् I, एकोऽपि alone, सराक्षसगणाम् all the demon troops, तां लङ्कां पुरीम् and that city of Lanka, महाबलम् the great army, रावणं च and Ravana, तरसा quickly, हन्तुम् can kill, पर्याप्तः is enough.

text: किं पुनः सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः । कृतास्त्रैः प्लवगैः शूरैर्भवद्भिर्विजयैषिभिः ॥५-५९-८॥
translation: "When strong, wise and accomplished persons are there with me desiring victory why speak again?
word_meanings: बलवद्भिः strong, कृतात्मभिः wise, कृतास्त्रै: accomplished, शूरैः heroic, विजयैषिभिः those desiring victory, प्लवगैः monkeys, भवद्भिः are with you, सहितः together, किं पुनः why speak again?

text: अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरस्सरम् । सहपुत्रं वधिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि ॥५-५९-९॥
translation: "I can also kill all the army, his followers, sons and brothers of Ravana in war.
word_meanings: अहं तु I also, युद्धे in war, ससैन्यम् all the army, सपुरःसरम् his followers, सपुत्त्रम् his sons, सहोदरयुतम् his brothers, रावणम् of Ravana, युधि in war, वधिRष्यामि can kill.

text: ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारुणं तथा । यदि शक्रजितो ऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्षाणि संयुगे ॥५-५९-१०॥
translation: "Even if the missiles used by Indrajit are Brahmastra, Indrastra, Rudrastra, Vayavastra, Varunastra which are difficult to see. I will destroy them in war and kill them.
word_meanings: ब्राह्मम् Brahma's, ऐन्द्रं च even Indra's, रौद्रं च Rudra's, वायव्यम् or Windgod's, तथा similarly, वारुणम् Varuna's, शक्रजितः Indrajit, अस्त्राणि missiles, दुर्निरीक्षाणि though difficult to see, यदि such, तानि of them, संयुगे in war, वधिष्यामि will kill, राक्षसान् demon, हनिष्यामि च and destroy them.

text: तान्यहं विधामिष्यामि निहनिष्यामि राक्षसान् । भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणाद्धि तम् ॥५-५९-११॥
मया ऽतुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा । देवानपि रणे हन्यात् किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान् ॥५-५९-१२॥
translation: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?
word_meanings: भवताम् by you, अभ्यनुज्ञातः now permit me, मे I, विक्रमः with my valour, तम् them, रुणद्धि shattered,मया by me, विसृष्टा sent forth, अतुला matchless, निरन्तरा ceaseless, शैलवृष्टिः shower of rocks, रणे in war, देवानपि even gods, हन्यात् will die, तान् those, निशाचरान् nightrangers, किं पुनः what to say ?

text: सागरो ऽप्यतियाद्वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि । न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी ॥५-५९-१३॥
translation: "The ocean may exceed its limits, the mountain Mandara may be shaken from its position but no hostile army can move Jambavan in war.
word_meanings: सागरः ocean, वेलाम् shore, अतियादपि exceeds also, मन्दरः mountain Mandara, प्रचलेदपि may shake up, समरे in war, अरिवाहिनी flow of enemies, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, न कम्पयेत् not move.

text: सर्वराक्षससङ्घानां राक्षसा ये च पूर्वकाः । अलमेको विनाशाय वीरो वालिसुतः कपिः ॥५-५९-१४॥
translation: The heroic son of Vali, the monkey Angada, is alone enough to destroy all the hosts of demons and their forebears.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, वालिसुतः son of Vali, कपिः vanara, एकः alone, सर्वराक्षससङ्घानाम् all the demon hordes, पूर्वकाः led, ये by him, विनाशाय to destroy, अलम् enough.

text: पनसस्योरुवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः । मन्दरो ऽप्यवशीर्येत किं पुनर्युधि राक्षसाः ॥५-५९-१५॥
translation: "Even the mountain Mandara would be shattered by great Panasa or Nila by the speed of their thighs. What to say in a battle against ogres?
word_meanings: पनसस्य Panasa's, महात्मनः great soul, नीलस्य च even Nila, उरुवेगेन by the speed of his thighs, मन्दरोऽपि even Mandara mountain, अवशीर्येत would be shattered, युधि in battle, राक्षसाः demons, किं पुनः what to say again.

text: सदेवासुरयक्षेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु । मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा ॥५-५९-१६॥
translation: "Who among gods, yakshas, gandharvas, nagas and birds can contend Mainda or Dvivida in battle?Tell me.
word_meanings: सदेवासुरयक्षेषु gods, and yakshas, गन्दर्वोरगपक्षिषु gandharvas, nagas and birds, मैन्दस्य Mainda's, द्विविदस्य वा or Dvivida, प्रतियोद्दारम् who can oppose in battle, शंसत tell me.

text: अश्विपुत्रौ महाभागावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ । एतयोः प्रतियोद्धारं न पश्यामि रणाजिरे ॥५-५९-१७॥
translation: "The (two) sons of Aswini are outstanding and foremost fighters and proud of waging war. Who can oppose them? I do not see any one.
word_meanings: अश्विपुत्रौ sons of Aswini, एतौ so also, महाभागौ outstanding, प्लवगसत्तमौ foremost fighters, रणाजिरे proud of fighting war, एतयोः these people, प्रतियोद्दारम् to oppose, न पश्यामि I do not see any.

text: पितामहवरोत्सेकात् परमं दर्पमास्थितौ । अमृतप्राशिनावेतौ सर्ववानरसत्तमौ ॥५-५९-१८॥
translation: "By virtue of the boons received from Brahma, they are very proud. They have also consumed nectar of immortality and are foremost among vanaras.
word_meanings: पितामहवरोत्सेकात् by virtue of the boons received from Brahma, परमम् very, दर्पम् proud, आस्थितौ filled with, एतौ both of them that way, वानरसत्तमौ foremost of vanaras, अमृतप्राशिनौ have consumed nectar of immortality.

text: अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः । सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान् पुरा ॥५-५९-१९॥
translation: "Earlier Brahma, the grandsire of all worlds has given the Aswini sons immeasurable invulnerability to honour them.
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, सर्वलोकपितामहः Brahma the grandfather of all worlds, अश्विनोः for Aswini sons, माननार्थम् to honour, अनयोः given, अतुलम् immeasureable, सर्वावध्यत्वम् invulnerability, दत्तवान् given.

text: करोत्सेकेन मुक्तौ च प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम् । सुराणाममृतं वीरौ पीतवन्तौ प्लवङ्गमौ ॥५-५९-२०॥
translation: "The heroic monkeys, proud of their boons became intoxicated it and slaughtered vast army and drank the nectar of immortality.
word_meanings: वरोत्सेकेन armed with the pride of boons, मत्तौ च and intoxicated, वीरौ heroic, प्लवङ्गमौ monkeys, सुराणाम् of suras, महतीम् vast, चमूम् प्रमथ्य army slain, अमृतम् nectar of immortality, पीतवन्तौ drank.

text: एतावेव हि संक्रुद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् । लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः ॥५-५९-२१॥
translation: "If these two become angry they have the power to destroy Lanka, the cavalry, chariots and also the elephants even if the vanaras stay away.
word_meanings: सङ्कृद्धौ if they become angry, एतावेव these two, सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् the cavalry, chariots and elephants, लङ्काम् Lanka also, नाशयितुम् to destroy, शक्तौ have the power, सर्वे all, वानराः vanaras, तिष्ठन्तु even if they stay away.

text: मयैव निहता लङ्कां दग्धा भस्मीकृता पुनः । राजमार्गेषु सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया ॥५-५९-२२॥
translation: "I have burnt Lanka and have made my name popular even on the highways.
word_meanings: लङ्का Lanka, मयैव myself, निहता burn, राजमार्गेषु in the royal path, सर्वत्र everywhere, मया by me, नाम name, विश्रावितम् become popular.

text: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ॥५-५९-२३॥
translation: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.
word_meanings: अतिबलः mighty, रामः Rama, जयति will triumph, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः protected, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति will triumph, पवनसम्भवः son of the Windgod, अहम् I, कोसलराजस्य king of Kosala kingdom, दासः servant, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति this, मया by me, नाम name, विश्रावितम् announced.

text: अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः । हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया ॥५-५९-२४॥
translation: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.
word_meanings: अतिबलः mighty, रामः Rama, जयति will triumph, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः protected, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति will triumph, पवनसम्भवः son of the Windgod, अहम् I, कोसलराजस्य king of Kosala kingdom, दासः servant, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति this, मया by me, नाम name, विश्रावितम् announced.

text: अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । अधस्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता ॥५-५९-२५॥
translation: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.
word_meanings: दुरात्मनः wicked, रावणस्य Ravana's, अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the midst of Ashoka garden, शिंशुपावृक्षे Simsupa tree, अधस्तात् under, साध्वी noble lady, राक्षसीभिः by ogresses, परिवृता surrounded, शोकसन्तापकर्शिता tormented by tears, मेघलेखापरिवृता veiled by clouds, चन्द्रलेखेव like the Moonrays, निष्प्रभा without brightness, बलदर्पितम् glory, रावणम् Ravana, अचिन्तयन्ती not even thinking, वैदेही Vaidehi, करुणम् piteous, आस्थिता remained.

text: राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसन्तापकर्शिता । मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा । अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम् ॥५-५९-२६॥
translation: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.
word_meanings: दुरात्मनः wicked, रावणस्य Ravana's, अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the midst of Ashoka garden, शिंशुपावृक्षे Simsupa tree, अधस्तात् under, साध्वी noble lady, राक्षसीभिः by ogresses, परिवृता surrounded, शोकसन्तापकर्शिता tormented by tears, मेघलेखापरिवृता veiled by clouds, चन्द्रलेखेव like the Moonrays, निष्प्रभा without brightness, बलदर्पितम् glory, रावणम् Ravana, अचिन्तयन्ती not even thinking, वैदेही Vaidehi, करुणम् piteous, आस्थिता remained.

text: पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी ॥५-५९-२७॥
translation: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.
word_meanings: पतिव्रता chaste woman, सुश्रोणी who has beautiful hips, जानकी Janaki, अवष्टब्धा though bound, शुभा auspicious, वैदेही Vaidehi, सर्वात्मना all her self, रामम् Rama only, अनुरक्ता devoted, पुरन्दरे Indra, पौलोमीव like Sachi the wife of Indra, रामे only on Rama, अनन्यचित्ता always thinking.

text: वृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा । अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा । अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे ॥५-५९-२८॥
translation: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.
word_meanings: पतिव्रता chaste woman, सुश्रोणी who has beautiful hips, जानकी Janaki, अवष्टब्धा though bound, शुभा auspicious, वैदेही Vaidehi, सर्वात्मना all her self, रामम् Rama only, अनुरक्ता devoted, पुरन्दरे Indra, पौलोमीव like Sachi the wife of Indra, रामे only on Rama, अनन्यचित्ता always thinking.

text: तदेकवासः संवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च । शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी सीता भर्तृहिते रता ॥५-५९-२९॥
translation: "Wearing the same single cloth which she had worn before, filled with dust, Sita remained sorrowful and piteous wishing her husband's welfare.
word_meanings: तदेकवासस्संवीता wearing only one cloth, तथैव च with that only, रजोध्वस्ता filled with dust, शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी very sorrowful and piteous, सीता Sita, भर्तृहिते wishing the welfare of her husband, रता remained.

text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः । राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने ॥५-५९-३०॥
translation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.
word_meanings: विरूपाभिः uglylooking, राक्षसीभिः ogresses, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तर्ज्यमाना threatened, एकवेणीधरा with a single braid, दीना pathetic, भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा thinking of her husband all the time, अधः now, शय्या lying on floor, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनिव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी devoid of lustre, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था turned away, मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया decided to die, सा that she, मया by me, राक्षसीमध्ये in the midst of ogresses, प्रमदावने in the pleasure garden, दृष्टा saw her.

text: एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा । अधः शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे ॥५-५९-३१॥
translation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.
word_meanings: विरूपाभिः uglylooking, राक्षसीभिः ogresses, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तर्ज्यमाना threatened, एकवेणीधरा with a single braid, दीना pathetic, भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा thinking of her husband all the time, अधः now, शय्या lying on floor, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनिव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी devoid of lustre, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था turned away, मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया decided to die, सा that she, मया by me, राक्षसीमध्ये in the midst of ogresses, प्रमदावने in the pleasure garden, दृष्टा saw her.

text: रावणाद् विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया । कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता ॥५-५९-३२॥
ततः सम्भाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता । रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ॥५-५९-३३॥
translation: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.
word_meanings: मृगशाबाक्षी fawneyed woman, कथञ्चित् little, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता pacified, ततः then, संभाषिता चैव after conversing only, सर्वम् everything, अर्थं च with difficulty, दर्शिता presented, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रीतिम् happy, उपागता became.

text: नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा । यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं स महात्मा कृतागसम् । निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति ॥५-५९-३४॥
translation: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)
word_meanings: महात्मा great soul, सा that, कृतागसम् has done harm, दशग्रीवं to Ravana,न हन्ति not killed, इति यत् this being so, नियत: of good conduct, समुदाचारः chaste, भर्तरि towards husband, उत्तमा high, भक्तिः devotion

text: सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता । प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुतां गता ॥५-५९-३५॥
translation: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).
word_meanings: रामस्तु Rama also, तस्य his, वधे killing, निमित्तमात्रं instrumental, भविष्यति will be, प्रकृत्यैव naturally, तन्वङ्गी thin body, तद्वियोगात् by the separation from her husband, कर्शिता च and also emaciated, सा she, प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य just as a student on the new Moon day, विद्येव shrunken, तनुमताम् slender in body, गता has become.

text: एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा । यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपद्यताम् ॥५-५९-३६॥
translation: "Noble Sita is absorbed in grief. Let us do all that has to be done now." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महाभागा noble lady, सीता Sita, अस्ते being, एवम् in this way, शोकपरायणा absorbed in grief, अत्र there, यत् that, प्रतिकर्तव्यम् what is to be done, तत् that, सर्वम् all, उपपाद्यताम् you may do.

text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत ॥५-६०-१॥
अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः । समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥५-६०-२॥
translation: After hearing Hanuman, Vali's son said" O vanaras (Hanuman) having seen Sita it is not proper on our part to go without Sita to the great soul Rama.
word_meanings: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, अभाषत said this, वानराः O vanaras, दृष्टवद्भिः even after seeing, अस्माभिः her, देवीं विना without Sita, महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य to Rama, समीपम् near, गन्तुम् going, अयुक्तं तु not appropriate.

text: दृष्टा देवी न चानीता इति तत्र निवेदनम् । अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि भवद्भिः ख्यातविक्रमैः ॥५-६०-३॥
translation: "O vanaras, you are known for your valour. I think, to tell Rama that we have seen Sita but not brought her is not proper".
word_meanings: ख्यातविक्रमैः known for valour, भवद्भिः you too, देवी godlike lady, दृष्टा seeing, न आनीता च not brought her, इति this, तत्र there, निवेदनम् tell, अयुक्तमिव not proper, पश्यामि I think.

text: न हि नः प्लवने कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित्पराक्रमे । तुल्यः सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः ॥५-६०-४॥
translation: "O noble vanaras Indeed either among gods or among demons there is none who can match the vanaras in leaping and exhibiting valour.
word_meanings: हरिसत्तमाः noble vanaras, सामरदैत्येषु gods or demons, लोकेषु in the world, प्लवने in leaping, नः none, तुल्यः match, कश्चित् even few, न हि not indeed, पराक्रमेऽपि even in valour, कश्चित् are there, न no one.

text: तेष्वेवं हतवीरेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता । किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम् ॥५-६०-५॥
translation: "Hence, having killed the heroes among ogres what other task has Hanuman to do? Let us get Sita.
word_meanings: तेषु hence, राक्षसेषु among demons, हनूमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, हतवीरेषु dead heroes, अत्र there, किम् what, अन्यत् other, कर्तव्यम् action, जानकीम् Janaki, गृहीत्वा get, याम here.

text: तमेवं कृतसङ्कल्पं जाम्बवान् हरिसत्तमः । उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित् ॥५-६०-६॥
translation: "Jambavan, the noble vanara, skilled in the execution of tasks thus commanded in a determined manner:
word_meanings: अर्थवित् knower of ways of execution of tasks, हरिसत्तमः noble vanara, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, परमप्रीतः very pleased, एवम् in that way, कृतसंकल्पम् determined, तम् him, अर्थवत् commnading way, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

text: न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो यथा भवान् पश्यति राजपुत्र । यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा तथा भवान् पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धम् ॥५-६०-७॥
translation: "O prince what you think is acceptable to us also. Even though we are capable of achieving, knowing what is in Rama's mind, we should act only according to his command to accomplish the task. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramyana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: राजपुत्र O prince, भवान् you, यथा this way, पश्यति thought of, एषा also, मतिः to my mind, नः none, अक्षमा acceptable, न तावत् we are capable, तु you, रामस्य Rama's, मतिः mind, यथा this way, निविष्टा should act, तथा that way, भवान् you, कार्यसिद्धिम् to accomplish the work, पश्यतु do it.

text: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः । अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः ॥५-६१-१॥
translation: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.
word_meanings: ततः then, अङ्गदप्रमुखाः Angada and other leaders, वीराः heroes, वनौकसः wanderers of the forest, vanaras, महाकपिः great monkey, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, जाम्बवतः Jambavan's, वाक्यम् these words, अगृह्णन्त agreed upon.

text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः । महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः ॥५-६१-२॥
translation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः resembling Meru mountain, मत्ताः in rut, गजाः इव like elephants, आकाशम् sky, छादयन्तः इव as though covering the sky, महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः mighty, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among leaping monkeys, सर्वे all, महेन्द्राद्रिम् from the summit of Mahendra mountain, परित्यज्य left, प्रीतिमन्तः very happily, वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः led by the son of the Windgod, भूतैः all creatures, सभाज्यमानम् praised by, आत्मवन्तम् selfconfident, महाबलम् mighty, महावेगम् swift, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टिभिः seeing, वहन्तः इव like seeing without blinking, राघवे Rama's, अर्थनिर्ववृततिम् remaining in state of offering, परमम् supreme, यशः fame, कर्तुम् to do, समाधाय concentrating, समृद्धार्थाः better than others, कर्मसिद्धिभिः accomplished ones, उन्नताः eager, पुप्लुवुः jumping vanaras, सर्वे all, प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः pleasantly talking among themselves, सर्वे all, युद्धाभिनन्दिनः anxious to wage a war, मनस्स्विनः determined, सर्वे all, रामप्रतीकारे to please, निश्चितार्थाः determined.

text: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः । छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः ॥५-६१-३॥
translation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. text: यद्रक्षति महावीर्यः सदा दधिमुखः कपिः । मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ॥५-६१-९॥

translation: In their drunkenness they were using abusive language and with their strength they retaliated without fear. They invaded without considering their mistakes. They caught hold of Dadhimukha and pulled him.
word_meanings: तैर्मदात् in their drunkenness, अप्रतिवार्यवाक्यैः speaking in abusive language, तेन by them, बलात् by their strength, प्रतिवार्यमाणैः retaliated, त्यक्तभयैः devoid of fear, तैः those, प्रधर्षितः roared, सः that, दोषं च mistakes only, अनवेक्ष्य not seeing, सम्ये held, प्रकृष्यते च pulled.

text: नखैस्तुदन्तो दशनैर्दशन्तस्तलैश्च पादैश्च समापयन्तः । मदात् कपिं तं कपयः समग्रा महावनं निर्विषयं च चक्रुः ॥५-६१-२३॥
translation: In their drunkenness some monkeys scratched Dadhimukha violently with their nails, some bit him with their teeth and others slapped and kicked him with their palms and legs.Getting together they looted the garden completely. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकषष्टितम स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: समग्राः all of them together, कपयः that monkey, मदात् in their drunkenness, नखैः with nails, तुदन्तः scratched, दशनैः with teeth, दशन्तः bitten, तलैश्च with palms, पादैश्च legs, तं कपिम् the monkeys, समापयन्तः getting together, महावनम् great garden, निर्विषयम् completely, चक्रुः looted.

text: तानुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान् वानरर्षभः । अव्यग्रमनसो यूयं मधु सेवत वानराः । अहमावारयिष्यामि युष्माकं परिपन्थिनः ॥५-६२-१॥
translation: Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, bull among vanaras said, 'Enjoy the honey devoid of any fear. I shall prevent those who object to your action'.
word_meanings: हरिश्रेष्ठः foremost of the monkeys, वानरर्षभः bull among vanaras, हनुमान् Hanuman, तान् them, उवाच spoke, वानराः vanaras, यूयम् looking at, अव्यग्रमनसः devoid of any fear in your mind, मधु honey, सेवत take, अहम् I, युष्माकम् those, परिपन्थिनः who object to your action, अवायिष्यामि will prevent.

text: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं हरीणां प्रवरो ऽङ्गदः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पिबन्तु हरयो मधु ॥५-६२-२॥
translation: Pleased with Hanuman's words, the distinguished Angada permitted the monkeys to drink.
word_meanings: हनुमतः Hanuman, वाक्यम् these words, श्रुत्वा hearing, हरीणाम् to the monkeys, प्रवरः distinguished, अङ्गदः Angada, प्रसन्नात्मा very pleased, प्रत्युवाच replied, हरयः vanaras, पिबन्तु you may drink.

text: अवश्यं कृतकार्यस्य वाक्यं हनुमतो मया । अकार्यमपि कर्तव्यं किमङ्ग पुनरीदृशम् ॥५-६२-३॥
translation: Even if Hanuman, the achiever, forbids me to do something, I will do it. And now when he has permitted you, why hesitate ?
word_meanings: कृतकार्यस्य one who has accomplished the task, हनुमतः Hanuman, वाक्यम् these words, अकार्यमपि tells not to do, मया by me, अवश्यम् surely, कर्तव्यम् what is to be done, ईदृशं पुनः when he has spoken again, किमङ्ग what to say?

text: अङ्गदस्य मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं वानरर्षभाः । साधु साध्विति संहृष्टा वानराः प्रत्यपूजयन् ॥५-६२-४॥
translation: Having heard the words that came from Angada's mouth, the bulls among vanaras praised him for his generous approval.
word_meanings: वानरर्षभाः bulls among vanaras, वानराः vanaras, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, मुखात् from the mouth, वचः spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, संहृष्टाः very happy, साधु साध्विति good words, प्रत्यपूजयन् praised.

text: पूजयित्वा ऽङ्गदं सर्वे वानरा वानरर्षभम् । जग्मुर्मधुवनं यत्र नदीवेगा इव द्रुतम् ॥५-६२-५॥
translation: The vanaras praised Angada, the bull among vanaras and went to Madhuvanam swiftly like a fastflowing river going to uproot a tree.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, वानरा vanaras, वानरर्षभम् to bull among vanaras, अङ्गदम् to Angada, पूजयित्वा having praised, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, यत्र there, नदीवेगः fast flowing river, द्रुमम् इव like tree, जग्मुः went.

text: ते प्रविष्टा मधुवनं पालानाक्रम्य वीर्यतः ॥५-६२-६॥
translation: Overjoyed at the news of Mythili, being seen, the vanaras entered Madhuvanam and attacked the guards violently, drank the honey and ate the tasty fruits.
word_meanings: मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुत्वा heard, अतिसर्गाच्च overjoyed with success, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टाः entered, पालान् guards, वीर्यतः violently, आक्रम्य attacked, तदा then, मधु Madhu, पपुः drank, रसवत् tasty, फलम् fruits, आददु: ate.

text: अतिसर्गाच्च पटवो दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम् । पपुः सर्वे मधु तदा रसवत् फलमाददुः ॥५-६२-७॥
translation: Overjoyed at the news of Mythili, being seen, the vanaras entered Madhuvanam and attacked the guards violently, drank the honey and ate the tasty fruits.
word_meanings: मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुत्वा heard, अतिसर्गाच्च overjoyed with success, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टाः entered, पालान् guards, वीर्यतः violently, आक्रम्य attacked, तदा then, मधु Madhu, पपुः drank, रसवत् tasty, फलम् fruits, आददु: ate.

text: उत्पत्य च ततः सर्वे वनपालान् समागतान् । ताडयन्ति स्म शतशः सक्तान् मधुवने तदा ॥५-६२-८॥
translation: All the vanaras collected together, entered the Madhuvanam and attacked in many ways the guards protecting the garden.
word_meanings: तदा then, सर्वे all, मधुवने in Madhuvanam, शतशः in many ways, सक्तान् vanaras, समागतान् came together, वनपालान् guards protecting the garden, उत्पत्य risen up, ततः then, ताडयन्ति स्म struck.

text: मधूनि द्रोणमात्राणि बाहुभिः परिगृह्य ते । पिबन्ति सहिताः सर्वे निघ्नन्ति स्म तथा ऽपरे ॥५-६२-९॥
translation: All of them now gathered at one place and drank honey from large containers. Others were busy preventing the guards.
word_meanings: ते सर्वे all of them, बाहुभिः many, द्रोणमात्राणि of huge size (large containers made of leather, a drona is a measure of two litres), मधूनि honey, परिगृह्य took hold of, सहिताः together, पिबन्ति drinking, अपरे others, निघ्नन्ति स्म were preventing.

text: केचित्पीत्वा ऽपविध्यन्ति मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः । मधूच्छिष्टेन केचिच्च जघ्नुरन्योन्यमुत्कटाः ॥५-६२-१०॥
translation: The honeycoloured monkeys drank honey. Some threw large chunks of honey combs after drinking and some went about intoxicated.
word_meanings: मधुपिङ्गलाः honeycoloured, केचित् some, मधूनि honey, पीत्वा were drinking, प्रविध्यन्ति throwing, केचिच्च some, मधूच्छिष्ठेन chunks of honey combs, उत्कटाः intoxicated, अन्योन्यम् with each other, जग्मुः went about.

text: अपरे वृक्षमूले तु शाखां गृह्य व्यवस्थिताः । अत्यर्थं च मदग्लानाः पर्णान्यास्तीर्य शेरते ॥५-६२-११॥
translation: Some took branches of trees and rested at the root of trees. Some totally languid lay down spreading leaves due to drinking of sweet drinks.
word_meanings: अपरे some others, शाखाम् branches of trees, गृह्य taking, वृक्षमूले at the root of trees, व्यवस्थिताः stayed, अत्यर्थम् on account of drinking, मदग्लानाः sweet drinks, पर्णानि leaves, आस्तीर्य spreading, शेरते lay down.

text: उन्मत्तभूताः प्लवगा मधुमत्ताश्च हृष्टवत् । क्षिपन्ति च तदा ऽन्योन्यं स्खलन्ति च तथा ऽपरे ॥५-६२-१२॥
translation: Intoxicated with drink, some behaved like mad people, some pushed others senselessly and some were unsteady and shaky.
word_meanings: मधुमत्ताः by drinking of honey, प्लवगाः vanaras, उन्मत्तभूताः like mad people, हृष्टवत् joyfully, अन्योन्यम् each other, क्षिपन्ति pushing each other, अपरे others, स्खलन्ति च were shaking unsteady.

text: केचित् क्ष्वेलां प्रकुर्वन्ति केचित् कूजन्ति हृष्टवत् । हरयो मधुना मत्ताः केचित् सुप्ता महीतले ॥५-६२-१३॥
translation: Some roared, some warbled happily, some felt drowsy, drinking honey and some dropped off to sleep on the ground.
word_meanings: केचित् some, क्ष्वेलाम् प्रकुर्वन्ति roared, केचित् some, हृष्टवत् happy, कूजन्ति cooing like the birds, मधुना by the drinking of honey, मत्ताः drowsy, केचित् हरयः some vanaras, महीतले on the ground, सुप्ताः slept.

text: कृत्वा केचिद्धसन्त्यन्ये केचित् कुर्वन्ति चेतरत् । कृत्वा केचिद्वदन्त्यन्ये केचिद्बुद्ध्यन्ति चेतरत् ॥५-६२-१४॥
translation: Some made others laugh, some provoked others and some thought of doing something else having got over the intoxication.
word_meanings: केचित् some, कृत्वा having done, हसन्ति laughing, अन्ये others, केचित् some, इतरत् different, कुर्वन्ति doing, केचित् some, कृत्वा having done, वदन्ति were telling others, अन्ये others, केचित् some, इतरत् something else, बुध्यन्ति thought of doing.

text: ये ऽप्यत्र मधुपालाः स्युः प्रेष्या दधिमुखस्य तु । ते ऽपि तैर्वानरैर्भीमैः प्रतिषिद्धा दिशो गताः ॥५-६२-१५॥
translation: All the guards engaged in protecting the garden were driven away in all directions by the fierce vanaras.
word_meanings: अत्र there, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, प्रेष्याः engaged, मधुपालाः guards of Madhuvanam, ये those, स्युः to cover, तेऽपि were also, भीमैः fierce, वानरैः vanaras, प्रतिषिद्धाः driven away, दिशः in all directions, गताः went.

text: जानुभिस्तु प्रकृष्टाश्च देवमार्गं प्रदर्शिताः । अब्रुवन् परमोद्विग्ना गत्वा दधिमुखं वचः ॥५-६२-१६॥
translation: Some were dragged on their knees and tossed up. Some monkeys exhibited their private parts, showing indecent behaviour. Dadhimukha, highly disturbed at this, said:
word_meanings: जानुभिः knees, प्रकृष्टाः drawn forth, देवमार्गम् towards the path of gods, प्रदर्शिताः exhibiting, परमोद्विग्नाः greatly disturbed, दधिमुखम् to Dadhimukha, गत्वा having gone, वचः these words, अब्रुवन् said.

text: हनूमता दत्तवरैर्हतं मधुवनं बलात् । वयं च जानुभिः कृष्टा देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः ॥५-६२-१७॥
translation: Permitted by Hanuman (to enter Madhuvanam and drink), they dragged one another forcefully tossed up on their knees showing their private parts.
word_meanings: हनूमता Hanuman, दत्तवरैर्हतं by whom they were permitted, वयं च and us, मधुवनं Madhuvanam, जानुभिः knees, बलात् forcefully, कृष्टा holding, देवमार्गं च dragged to the private parts, दर्शिताः and showed.

text: ततो दधिमुखः क्रुद्धो वनपस्तत्र वानरः । हतं मधुवनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वयामास तान् हरीन् ॥५-६२-१८॥
translation: Then Dadhimukha, the guardian of the garden became furious on the vanaras. Having heard from the guards that the garden was destroyed, he said soothing words to them.
word_meanings: ततः then, तत्र there, वनपः guardian of the garden, दधिमुख: Dadhimukha, वानर: vanara, क्रुद्धः furious, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, हतम् destoyed, श्रुत्वा having heard, हरीन् vanaras, सान्त्वयामास with soothing words.

text: इहागच्छत गच्छामो वानरान् बलदर्पितान् । बलेन वारयिष्यामो मधु भक्षयतो वयम् ॥५-६२-१९॥
translation: "Come, we will all go there to Madhuvanam and prevent forcibly the vanaras who have consumed honey proud of their power.
word_meanings: इह here, आगच्चत come, गच्चामः will go, वयम् we, बलदर्पितान् proud of their power, मधु Madhu, भक्षयतः consume honey, वानरान् vanaras, बलेन forcibly, वारयिष्यामः will prevent them.

text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं वानरर्षभाः । पुनर्वीरा मधुवनं तेनैव सहसा ययुः ॥५-६२-२०॥
translation: "The heroes, bulls among vanaras, heard Dadhimukha and quickly entered Madhuvanam along with him.
word_meanings: वीराः heroes, वानरर्षभाः bull among vanaras, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, इदम् this kind of, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सहसा quickly, तेनैव along with him, पुनः again, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, ययुः went.

text: मध्ये चैषां दधिमुखः प्रगृह्य तरसा तरुम् । समभ्यधावद्वेगेन ते च सर्वे प्लवङ्गमाः ॥५-६२-२१॥
translation: On the way, the energetic Dadhimukha took up a tree and ran to the leaping vanaras swiftly with guards following him.
word_meanings: एषाम् their, मध्ये way, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, तरसा energetic, तरुम् tree, प्रगृह्य taking up, वेगेन swiftly, समभ्यधावत् following, ते they, सर्वे all, प्लवङ्गमाः च the leaping vanaras.

text: ते शिलाः पादपांश्चापि पर्वतांश्चापि वानराः । गृहीत्वा ऽभ्यगमन् क्रुद्धा यत्र ते कपिकुञ्जराः ॥५-६२-२२॥
translation: The furious vanara guards lifted rocks, trees and even mountains and went behind Dadhimukha the elephant among the vanaras.
word_meanings: ते वानराः those vanaras, क्रुद्धाः furious, शिलाः rocks, पादपांश्चापि also trees, पर्वतांश्चापि even mountains, गृहीत्वा took up, ते they, कपिकुञ्जराः elephant of monkeys, यत्र there, अभ्यगमन् went.

text: ते स्वामिवचनं वीरा हृदयेष्ववसज्य तत् । त्वरया ह्यभ्यधावन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः ॥५-६२-२३॥
translation: The heroic vanaras held Sala and Tala trees and rushed at once keeping their leader's words in mind.
word_meanings: वीराः heroic, ते they, तत् that, स्वामिवचनम् leader's words, हृदयेषु in their heart, अवसज्य rushed, सालतालशिलायुधाः Sala, Tala trees as weapons, त्वरया at once, अभ्यधावन्त ran.

text: वृक्षस्थांश्च तलस्थांश्च वानरान् बलदर्पितान् । अभ्यक्रामंस्ततो वीराः पालास्तत्र सहस्रशः ॥५-६२-२४॥
translation: Then the heroic guards in their thousands fell on the vanaras proud of their power on and under the tala trees.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीराः heroic, पालाः guards, सहस्रशः in thousands, वृक्षस्थांश्च on the trees, तलस्थांश्च under the trees, बलदर्पितान् proud of their power, वानरान् vanaras, अभ्यक्रामन् attacked.

text: अथ दृष्ट्वा दधिमुखं क्रुद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः । अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन हनुमत्प्रमुखास्तदा ॥५-६२-२५॥
translation: Having seen the fury of Dadhimukha, Hanuman the leader of the vanaras went to him swiftly.
word_meanings: अथ and then, हनुमत्प्रमुखाः leader Hanuman, वानरपुङ्गवाः foremost of vanaras, तदा then, दधिमुखम् Dadhimukha's, क्रुद्धम् fury, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वेगेन swiftly, अभ्यधावन्त went there.

text: तं सवृक्षं महाबाहुमापतन्तं महाबलम् । आर्यकं प्राहरत्तत्र बाहुभ्यां कुपितो ऽङ्गदः ॥५-६२-२६॥
translation: Seeing the revered, powerful and strongarmed Dadhimukha rushing to him, the angry Angada caught him with both hands tightly.
word_meanings: कुपितः angry, अङ्गदः Angada, सवृक्षम् with trees, महाबाहुम् strongarmed, महाबलम् powerful, आपतन्तम् coming, तम् him, आर्यकम् तत्र there, बाहुभ्याम् with both hands, प्राहरत् clasped tightly.

text: मदान्धश्च न वेदैनमार्यको ऽयं ममेति सः । अथैनं निष्पिपेषाशु वेगवद्वसुधातले ॥५-६२-२७॥
translation: "Blinded by arrogance, the prince pushed him (Dadhimukha) on the floor forcibly, forgetting that he was his revered granduncle.
word_meanings: सः he, मदान्धश्च blinded by arrogance, अयम् this, मम my, आर्यकः revered, इति this, एनम् therefore, न वेद not understnding that (I am his granduncle), अथ now, एनम् therefore, वसुधातले on the floor, वेगवत् forcibly, आशु him, निष्पिपेष pushed.

text: स भग्नबाहूरुभुजो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः । मुमोह सहसा वीरो मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-६२-२८॥
translation: The heroic Dadhimukha, an elephant among monkeys, with his shoulders and arms broken, and body drenched in blood lost his consciousness instantly.
word_meanings: भग्नबाहूरुभुजः with shoulders and arms broken, विह्वलः battered, शोणितोक्षितः body drenched in blood, सः he, Dadhimukha, वीरः a hero, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, सहसा at once, मुहूर्तम् in a moment, मुमोह lost conciousness.

text: स समाश्वस्य सहसा संक्रुद्धो राजमातुलः । वानरान् वारयामास दण्डेन मधुमोहितान् ॥५-६२-२९॥
translation: At once Dadhimukha, the maternal uncle of the king became conscious and chased with a stick the intoxicated vanaras.
word_meanings: राजमातुलः maternal uncle of the king, सः he, सहसा at once, समाश्वस्य coming out of unconscious state, सङ्कृद्धः furious, मधुमोहितान् deluded by drinking, वानरान् vanaras, दण्डेन with a stick, वारयामास chased.

text: स कथंचिद्विमुक्तस्तैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभः । उवाचैकान्तमाश्रित्य भृत्यान् स्वान् समुपागतान् ॥५-६२-३०॥
translation: Escaping from the vanaras with great difficulty, Dadhimukha, a bull among monkeys, repaired to a secluded place and said to his servants:
word_meanings: तैः they, वानरैः vanaras, कथञ्चित् with great difficulty, विमुक्तः escaped, सः he, Dadhimukha, वानरर्षभः bull among monkeys, एकान्तम् secluded, आश्रित्य reached, समुपागतान् returned, स्वान् them, भृत्यान् servants, उवाच said.

text: एते तिष्ठन्तु गच्छामो भर्ता नो यत्र वानरः । सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सह रामेण तिष्ठति ॥५-६२-३१॥
translation: "Let them stay here. Our broadnecked king Sugriva will be there with Rama. Let us go to him.
word_meanings: एते let them, तिष्ठन्तु stay, नः our, भर्ता king, वानरः vanaras, विपुलग्रीवः one with broad neck, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, रामेण सह with Rama, तिष्ठति will be staying, गच्चामः let us go.

text: सर्वं चैवाङ्गदे दोषं श्रावयिष्यामि पार्थिवे । अमर्षी वचनं श्रुत्वा घातयिष्यति वानरान् ॥५-६२-३२॥
translation: I will make all of Angada's faults known to the king; hearing it, the furious one will have the monkeys put to death.
word_meanings: अङ्गदे Angada, सर्वम् all, दोषम् mistakes, पार्थिवे to the king, श्रावयिष्यामि will let him know, वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमर्षि very furious, वानरान् vanaras, घातयिष्यति will put an end.

text: इष्टं मधुवनं ह्येतत् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । पितृपैतामहं दिव्यं देवैरपि दुरासदम् ॥५-६२-३३॥
translation: 'Madhuvan has come down to us from our forefather's time. Dear to the king, its entry is prohibited even to the gods.
word_meanings: पितृपैतामहम् from grandfather and father, दिव्यम् wonderful, देवैरपि even for devatas, दुरासदम् forbidden, एतत् this, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, महात्मनः great self, पार्थिवस्य to the king, इष्टं हि very dear.

text: स वानरानिमान् सर्वान् मधुलुब्धान् गतायुषः । घातयिष्यति दण्डेन सुग्रीवः ससुहृज्जनान् ॥५-६२-३४॥
translation: 'Sugriva will chase all the vanaras and their friends greedy for honey. They will be punished with a stick. They are doomed'.
word_meanings: सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, मधुलुब्धान् those greedy for honey, गतायुषः doomed, ससुहृज्जनान् their friends, इमान् these, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, दण्डेन with a stick, घातयिष्यति will be beaten.

text: वध्या ह्येते दुरात्मानो नृपाज्ञापरिभाविनः । अमर्षप्रभवो रोषः सफलो नो भविष्यति ॥५-६२-३५॥
translation: 'Indeed those evilminded ones who have disobeyed the king's order deserve to be killed.That way our fury and forbearance will result in success'.
word_meanings: नृपाज्ञापरिभाविनः who have disobeyed the king's order, एते they, दुरात्मनः evilminded, वध्याः हि indeed deserve to be killed, अमर्षप्रभवः forbearance king, नः रोषः our fury, सफलः will result in success, भविष्यति will be.

text: एवमुक्त्वा दधिमुखो वनपालान् महाबलः । जगाम सहसोत्पत्य वनपालैः समन्वितः ॥५-६२-३६॥
translation: Powerful Dadhimukha having said that to the guardians of the garden rose up to the sky and went off with them.
word_meanings: महाबलः very powerful, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, वनसालान् garden protectors, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सहसा at once, वनपालैः garden guards, समन्वितः along with them, उत्पत्य rising to the sky, जगाम went.

text: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण स हि प्राप्तो वनालयः । सहस्रांशुसुतो धीमान् सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥५-६२-३७॥
translation: In a moment, Dadhimukha reached the place where wise Sugriva, the son of Sungod was there
word_meanings: सः he, वनालयः forestdweller, सहस्रांशुसुतः to the son of Sungod, धीमान् wise, सुग्रीवः वानरः to the vanara Sugriva, यत्र there, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a moment's time, प्राप्तः reached.

text: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवमेव च । समप्रतिष्ठां जगतीमाकाशान्निपपात ह ॥५-६२-३८॥
translation: Seeing Rama, Lakshmana and also Sugriva from the sky he landed on an even ground.
word_meanings: रामं च Rama, लक्ष्मणं चैव and also Lakshmana, सुग्रीवमेव च and also Sugriva, दृष्ट्वा seeing, आकाशात् from the sky, समप्रतिष्ठाम् even, जगतीम् ground, निपपात landed.

text: सन्निपत्य महावीर्यः सर्वैस्तैः परिवारितः । हरिर्दधिमुखः पालैः पालानां परमेश्वरः ॥५-६२-३९॥
स दीनवदनो भूत्वा कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम् । सुग्रीवस्य शुभौ मूर्ध्ना चरणौ प्रत्यपीडयत् ॥५-६२-४०॥
translation: Dadhimukha, a great hero and king of the guards protecting Madhuvanam surrounded by his servants, with a sad expression on his face offered painful obeisance with folded hands bowing down his forehead at the feet of Sugriva. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सर्वैः all, तैः पालैः those guards, परिवारितः the servants, पालानाम् king, परमेश्वरः lord, हरिः of monkeys, महावीर्यः great hero, सः दधिमुखः that Dadhimukha, दीनवदनः with a painful expression on the face, शिरसि head bowed down, अञ्जलिम् salutations with folded hands, कृत्वा having offered, सन्निपत्य surrounded by, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva, शुभे auspicious, चरणौ feet, मूर्ध्ना touching with his forehead, पत्यपीडयत् painful obeisance.

text: ततो मूर्ध्ना निपतितं वानरं वानरर्षभः । दृष्ट्वैवोद्विग्नहृदयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ॥५-६३-१॥
translation: Feeling anxious on seeing Dadhimukha touching his feet with his forehead, Sugriva, the bull among vanaras said:
word_meanings: ततः then, वानरर्षभः bull among vanaras, मूर्ध्ना forehead, निपतितम् prostrated, वानरम् vanara, Dadhimukha, दृष्ट्वैव as soon as he saw, उद्विग्नहृदयः anxious at heart, एतत् these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke.

text: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ कस्मात् त्वं पादयोः पतितो मम । अभयं ते भवेद्वीर सर्वमेवाभिधीयताम् ॥५-६३-२॥
translation: "O heroic Dadhimukha, get up. Tell me why you have fallen at my feet. I give you protection from all.
word_meanings: वीर hero, उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ get up, get up, त्वम् you, कस्मात् why, मम my, पादयोः feet, पतितः fallen, ते to you, अभयम् give you protection, भवेत् you be, सर्वमेव from all, अभिधीयताम् you may tell.

text: स तु विश्वासितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना । उत्थाय सुमहाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं दधिमुखो ऽब्रवीत् ॥५-६३-३॥
translation: When great Sugriva gave assurance to wise Dadhimukha, he got up and said:
word_meanings: महात्मना great self, तेन सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, विश्वासितः given assurance, सुमहाप्राज्ञः very wise, सः दधिमुखः that Dadhimukha, उत्थाय got up, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: नैवर्क्षरजसा राजन्न त्वया नापि वालिना । वनं निसृष्टपूर्वं हि भक्षितं तच्च वानरैः ॥५-६३-४॥
translation: "O king in your time or even before, during the time of Vali, that (Madhuvanam) was forbidden for entry. Now it has been laid waste by the trespassing vanaras.
word_meanings: राजन् O king, वनम् garden, ऋक्षरजसा in Riksharaja's time, नैव निसृष्टपूर्वं हि or even before, त्वया your time, न not, वालिनापि even at the time of Vali, न not, तच्च accessible to go, वानरैः vanaras, भक्षितम् finished eating.

text: एभिः प्रधर्षिताश्चैव वानरा वनरक्षिभिः । मधून्यचिन्तयित्वेमान् भक्षयन्ति पिबन्ति च ॥५-६३-५॥
translation: "Even though the garden guards forcibly tried to prevent them they did not care and have devoured all the honey.
word_meanings: एभिः they also, वनरक्षिभिः garden guards, प्रधर्षिताश्चैव even though resisted, वानराः vanaras, इमान् them, अचिन्तयित्वा not cared for, मधूनि honey, भक्षयन्ति finished eating, पिबन्ति च and drinking.

text: शिष्टमत्रापविध्यन्ति भक्षयन्ति तथा ऽपरे । निवार्यमाणास्ते सर्वे भ्रूवौ वै दर्शयन्ति हि ॥५-६३-६॥
translation: "Some have thrown off the leftovers, when others were prevented from drinking off the honey, they raised their eyebrows (to show their grouch).
word_meanings: शिष्टम् left over, अत्र there, अपविध्यन्ति thrown off, तथा similarly, अपरे others, भक्षयन्ति eating, ते सर्वे all, निवार्यमाणाः when we prevented, भ्रुवः eyebrows, दर्शयन्ति च raising to show (a sign of arrogance)

text: इमे हि संरब्धतरास्तथा तैः संप्रधर्षिताः । वारयन्तो वनातस्मात् क्रुद्वैर्वानरपुङ्गवैः ॥५-६३-७॥
translation: "When the guards asked the vanaras to leave the garden the enraged vanaras misbehaved with them.
word_meanings: संरब्दतराः when enraged guards, तथा that way, तस्मात् from that, वनात् garden, वारयन्तः vanaras, इमे to go, क्रुद्धैः angry, तैः they, वानरपुङ्गवैः vanara leaders, सम्प्रधर्षिताः ill treated them.

text: ततस्तैर्बहुभिर्वीरैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभः । संरक्तनयनैः क्रोधाद्धरयः प्रविचालिताः ॥५-६३-८॥
translation: "O Sugriva the vanara guards were chased away by the many heroic monkeys, angry and redeyed.
word_meanings: वानरर्षभ bull among vanaras, ततः then, क्रोधात् in fury, संरक्तनयनैः redeyed, वीरैः heroes, बहुभिः many, तैः them, वानरैः vanara guards, हरयः monkeys, प्रविचालिताः chased.

text: पाणिभिर्निहताः केचित् केचिज्जानुभिराहताः । प्रकृष्टाश्च यथाकामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः ॥५-६३-९॥
translation: "Some were struck with hands, some beaten on their knees and were dragged as they liked and showed up their private parts.
word_meanings: केचित् some, पाणिभिः with the hands, निहताः struck, केचित् some, जानुभिः on the knees, आहताः beaten, यथाकामम् as they liked, प्रकृष्टाः dragged, देवमार्गम् private parts, दर्शिताः च showed.

text: एवमेते हताः शूरास्त्वयि तिष्ठति भर्तरि । कृत्स्नं मधुवनं चैव प्रकामं तैः प्रभक्ष्यते ॥५-६३-१०॥
translation: These heroes struck that way devoured the Madhuvanam on the earth at their will and devoured the honey even when you are there as king.
word_meanings: त्वयि you, भर्तरि when you are the king, तिष्ठति staying, एते these, शूराः heroes, एवम् in that way, हताः striking, तैः they, कृत्स्नम् on the earth, मधुवनं चैव Madhuvanam aslo, प्रकामम् at their will, प्रभक्ष्यते eating so.

text: एवं विज्ञाप्यमानं तं सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम् । अपृच्छत्तं महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ॥५-६३-११॥
translation: While Dadhimukha appealed thus to wise Sugriva, Lakshmana the killer of enemies happened to see them and enquired:
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, विज्ञाप्यमानम् having appealed, वानरर्षभम् bulls among vanaras, तं सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, परवीरहा killer of enemies, महाप्राज्ञः very learned, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अपृच्छत् enquired.

text: किमयं वानरो राजन् वनपः प्रत्युपस्थितः । कं चार्थमभिनिर्दिश्य दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥५-६३-१२॥
translation: "O king why has this protector of the garden come here? Why is he sad? What is he narrating, asked Lakshmana.
word_meanings: राजन् O king, वनप: protector of the garden, अयं वानरः this vanara, किम् why, प्रत्युपस्थितः came here?, दुःखितः sad, कम् why, अर्थम् for what, अभिनिर्दिश्य what is he telling, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ॥५-६३-१३॥
translation: Great prince Lakshmana thus said, Sugriva the proficient speaker replied:
word_meanings: महात्मना great prince, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, वाक्यविशारदः proficient in speech, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: आर्य लक्ष्मण संप्राह वीरो दधिमुखः कपिः । अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्भक्षितं मधु वानरैः ॥५-६३-१४॥
विचित्य दक्षिणामाशामागतैर्हरिपुङ्गवैः ॥५-६३-१५॥
translation: 'O venerable Lakshmana Dadhimukha as complaining that the fruits and honey have been consumed by the vanara heroes, Angada and others who have come after their search for Sita in the southern direction.
word_meanings: आर्य O venerable one, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वीरः hero, कपिः monkey, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, सम्प्राह to search, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् hope, विचित्य having searched, आगतैः have come, हरिपुङ्गवैः monkey leaders, वीरैः heroic ones, अङ्गदप्रमुखैः Angada and others, वानरैः vanaras, मधु honey, भक्षितम् eaten.

text: नैषामकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः । आगतैश्च प्रमथितं यथा मधुवनं हि तैः ॥५-६३-१६॥
धर्षितं च वनं कृत्स्नमुपयुक्तं च वानरैः ॥५-६३-१७॥
translation: "Those vanaras having entered Madhuvanam and broken the trees are quite right. Had they not accomplished their purpose they would not have indulged themselves that way.
word_meanings: आगतैः having come, तैः those, वानरैः vanaras, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, यथा that way, प्रमथितम् entered, कृत्स्नम् whole, वनम् garden, धर्षितम् broken, उपयुक्तं च right, एषाम् they that way, अकृतकृत्यानाम् if they had not accomplished their purpose, ईदृशः this way, उपक्रमः indulged, न स्यात् not done.

text: वनं यदाभिपन्नास्ते साधितं कर्म वानरैः । दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता । न ह्यन्यः साधने हेतुः कर्मणो ऽस्य हनूमतः ॥५-६३-१८॥
translation: "If they have trespassed into the garden that way, they might have done their duty. No doubt, Hanuman alone among them might have seen Sita.
word_meanings: ते they, यदा like that, वनम् garden, अभिपन्नाः entered, वानरैं कर्म their duty, साधितम् had done, देवी queen, दृष्टा saw, सन्देहः doubt, न no, अन्येन others, न not, हनुमता Hanuman.

text: कार्यसिद्धिर्मतिश्चैव तस्मिन् वानरपुङ्गवे । व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च श्रुतं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥५-६३-१९॥
translation: "Hanuman alone has the ability to do it, the reason being he has the capacity the wisdom, streneous effort, virility and enthusiasm to accomplish it. These attributes are wellestablished in him.
word_meanings: अस्य कर्मणः that duty, साधने capacity, हनूमतः Hanuman, अन्यः others, हेतुः the reason being, न हि not indeed, कार्यसिद्धि: capacity to accomplish, मतिश्चैव even wisdom, व्यवसायश्च even strenuous effort, वीर्यं च and virility, श्रुतं चापि enthusiasm, तस्मिन् for him, वानरपुङ्गवे to only the foremost of the monkys, प्रतिष्ठितम् are wellestablished.

text: जाम्बवान् यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च महाबलः । हनूमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा ॥५-६३-२०॥
translation: Where Jambavan, Angada and Hanuman are leaders directing the task of the army it must have been accomplished.
word_meanings: यत्र where, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नेता is the leader, स्यात् remains, महाबलः strong, अङ्गदश्च Angada also, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, अधिष्ठाता directing, तस्य that, गतिः will be done, अन्यथा otherwise, न not.

text: अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्हतं मधुवनं किल । वारयन्तश्च सहितास्तथा जानुभिराहताः ॥५-६३-२१॥
translation: Angada and the other heroes have indeed laid waste Madhuvana, and when we together tried to stop them, we were beaten back with their knees.
word_meanings: अङ्गदप्रमुखैः Angada and other leaders, वीरैः heroes, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, हतं किल destroyed the garden, सहिताः along with others, वारयन्तः च when they were obstructed, तदा then, जानुभिः knees, आहताः beaten.

text: एतदर्थमयं प्राप्तो वक्तुं मधुरवागिह । नाम्ना दधिमुखो नाम हरिः प्रख्यातविक्रमः ॥५-६३-२२॥
translation: "Here is Dadhimukha, a vanara, known for his valour and sweet tongue. He came here this incident to tell.
word_meanings: नाम्ना named, दधिमुखो नाम Dadhimukha, प्रख्यातविक्रमः known for his valour, हरिः monkey, एतदर्थम् on account of it, वक्तुम् to tell, मधुरवाक् sweet tongued, इह here, प्राप्तः came.

text: दृष्टा सीता महाबाहो सौमित्रे पश्य तत्त्वतः । अभिगम्य तथासव- ?पिबन्ति मधु वानराः ॥५-६३-२३॥
translation: "O strongarmed Saumitri the Vanaras must have seen Sita. Or else, they would not have arrived to drink honey.
word_meanings: महाबाहो strongarmed, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, सीता Sita, दृष्टा would have seen, तत्त्वतः truly, पश्य seen, तथा so, वानराः vanaras, सर्वे all, अभिगम्य having arrived, मधु honey, पिबन्ति drank.

text: न चाप्यदृष्ट्वा वैदेहीं विश्रुताः पुरुषर्षभ । वनं दत्तवरं दिव्यं धर्षयेयुर्वनौकसः ॥५-६३-२४॥
translation: "If the renowned vanaras had not seen Vaidehi, they would not have entered the wonderful garden granted as boon (by Brahma).
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, विश्रुताः renowned, वनौकसः forestdwellers, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अदृष्ट्वा not seen, दत्तवरम् that which was given as boon, दिव्यम् wonderful, वनम् garden, न धर्षयेयुः entered.

text: ततः प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणः सहराघवः । श्रुत्वा कर्णसुखां वाणीं सुग्रीववदनाच्च्युताम् । प्राहृष्यत भृशं रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ॥५-६३-२५॥
translation: "Then righteous Rama and Lakshmana rejoiced to hear the words of Sugriva, which were pleasing to the ears.
word_meanings: ततः then, सह राघवः also Rama, धर्मात्मा righteous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रहृष्टः very cheerful rejoiced, सुग्रीववदनात् Sugriva's mouth, च्युताम् delivered, कर्णसुखाम् pleasing to the ears, वाणीम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, प्राहृष्यत felt happy, महाबलः mighty strong, लक्ष्मणश्च even Lakshmana, भृशम् very, प्राहृष्यत happy.

text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं सुग्रीवस्तु प्रहृष्य च । वनपालं पुनर्वाक्यं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत ॥५-६३-२६॥
translation: Beautifulnecked Sugriva heard Dadhimukha, the protector of the garden, felt very glad and replied:
word_meanings: सुग्रीवः one with beautiful neck, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, इदम् thus, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्प्रहृष्य च very glad, पुनः again, वनपालम् protector of the garden, वाक्यम् these words, प्रत्यभाषत replied.

text: प्रीतो ऽस्मि सो ऽहं युद्भुक्तं वनं तैः कृतकर्मभिः । मर्षितं मर्षणीयं च चेष्टितं कृतकर्मणाम् ॥५-६३-२७॥
translation: "They went to the garden to drink only after having performed their duty. I am glad about it. Since they have accomplished the purpose, they are to be excused for their behaviour. I have pardoned them.
word_meanings: कृतकर्मभिः having performed the duty, तैः they, वनम् garden, यत् भुक्तम् for drinking that honey, सः अहम् I, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, कृतकर्मणाम् having accomplished the task, मर्षणीयम् are to be excused, चेष्टितम् their behaviour, मर्षितम् excused.

text: इच्छामि शीघ्रं हनुमत्प्रधानान् शाखामृगांस्तान् मगृहराजदर्पान् । द्रष्टुं कृतार्थान् सह राघवाभ्यां श्रोतुं च सीताधिगमे प्रयत्नम् ॥५-६३-२८॥
translation: I long to see those triumphant monkeys led by Hanuman, proud as the king of beasts, together with Rama and Lakshmana, and to hear of their effort in finding Sita.
word_meanings: हनुमत्प्रधानान् led by Hanuman, मृगराजदर्पान् with the majesty of the lion, कृतार्थान् acomplished ones, तान् them, शाखामृगान् vanaras (who live on trees), राघवाभ्यां सह Rama and others, द्रष्टुम् to see, सीताधिगमेन to see Sita, प्रयत्नम् endeavour, श्रोतुं च to hear, इच्छामि desiring.

text: प्रीतिस्पीताक्षौ सम्प्रहृष्टौ कुमारौ दृष्ट्वा सिद्धार्थौ वानराणां च राजा । अङ्गैः संहृष्टैः कर्मसिद्धिं विदित्वा बाह्वोरासन्नां सो ऽतिमात्रं ननन्द ॥५-६३-२९॥
translation: "Beholding young Rama and Lakshmana extremely delighted, their eyes filled with joy out of fulfilment of the purpose, Sugriva who was also highly delighted felt an auspicious thrill on his limbs and knew that good time had come. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सः he (Sugriva), वानराणां राजा king of vanaras, प्रीतिस्फीताक्षौ eyes filled with joy, सम्प्रहृष्टौ very happy, सिद्धार्धौ accomplished, कुमारौ young, दृष्ट्वा seeing, संहृष्टैः very glad, अङ्गैः limbs of the body, कर्मसिद्धिम् task has been accomplished, बाह्वोः shoulders, आसन्नाम् time has come, विदित्वा recognising, अतिमात्रम् highly, ननन्द delighted.

text: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हृष्टो दधिमुखः कपिः । राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं चाभ्यवादयत् ॥५-६४-१॥
translation: Pleased with Sugriva's command (to send forth Angada and Hanuman) Dadhimukha offered salutations to Sugriva, Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, कपिः monkey, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, हृष्टः pleased, राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं चैव and also Lakshmana, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, अभ्यवादयत् offered salutations.

text: स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ । वानरैः सहितैः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह ॥५-६४-२॥
translation: Dadhimukha offered his obeisance to Sugriva and the mighty Rama and Lakshmana and rose up to the sky followed by the vanaras.
word_meanings: सः he, Dadhimukha, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, महाबलौ mighty strong, राघवौ च Rama, प्रणम्य offering obeisance, शूरैः heroes, वानरैः vanaras, सहितः followed by, दिवमेव to the sky, उत्पपात rose up.

text: स यथैवागतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः । निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौ तद्वनं प्रविवेश ह ॥५-६४-३॥
translation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).
word_meanings: मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, विमदान् intoxication, मदूदकम् honey and water, मेहमानान् voiding urine, सर्वान् all, हरियूथपान् troops of vanaras, ददर्श saw.

text: स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान् । विमदानुत्थितान् सर्वान् मेहमानान् मधूदकम् ॥५-६४-४॥
translation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).
word_meanings: मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, विमदान् intoxication, मदूदकम् honey and water, मेहमानान् voiding urine, सर्वान् all, हरियूथपान् troops of vanaras, ददर्श saw.

text: स तानुपागमद्वीरो बद्ध्वा करपुटाञ्जलिम् । उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमिदं हृष्टवदङ्गदम् ॥५-६४-५॥
translation: Heroic Dadhimukha went to Angada, holding his cupped palms reverentially and spoke these conciliatory words with joy:
word_meanings: वीरः hero, सः he, करपुटाञ्जलिम् cupping his palms reverentially, बद्ध्वा holding, तान् him, उपागमत् returned, हृष्टवत् with joy, अङ्गदम् Angada, श्लक्ष्णम् conciliatory, इदं वचनम् these words, उवाच spoken.

text: सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यदेभिरभिवारितः । अज्ञानाद्रक्षिभिः क्रोधाद्भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः ॥५-६४-६॥
translation: "O handsome one, do not react harshly at these guards who have obstructed your companions out of ignorance and fury.
word_meanings: सौम्य prince of mild disposition, एतत् all this, यत् परिवारितम् that your companions, रोषः harsh, न कर्तव्यः not react, भवन्तः you, रक्षिभिः even the guards, अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, क्रोधात् fury, प्रतिषेधिताः have obstructed you.

text: युवराजस्त्वमीशश्च वनस्यास्य महाबल । मौर्ख्यात् पूर्वं कृतो दोषस्तं भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति ॥५-६४-७॥
translation: "O mighty Angada you are heir apparent and also king. Out of foolishness I obstructed you. You ought to pardon me this mistake.
word_meanings: महाबल mighty, त्वम् you, युवराजः heir apparent, अस्य वनस्य at this garden, ईशश्च king also, पूर्वम् earlier, मौर्ख्यात् out of foolishness, दोषः mistake, कृतः did, तम् to you, भवान् you, क्षन्तुम् be at peace, अर्हति is proper.

text: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ । इहोपयातं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम् ॥५-६४-८॥
translation: "O blameless prince I have already told your father's elder brother and all the forestdwellers about your arrival here.
word_meanings: अनघ blameless, मया I, गत्वा gone, तव your, पितृव्यस्य elder brother of your father, सर्वेषाम् all, एतेषाम् your people, वनचारिणाम् forestdwellers, इह here, उपयातम् your arrival, आख्यातं हि indeed told.

text: स त्वदागमनं श्रुत्वा सहैभिर्हरियूथपैः । प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टो ऽसौ वनं श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम् ॥५-६४-९॥
translation: "He was not angry at your destruction of the garden. On the other hand, he was very glad to hear about your arrival.
word_meanings: सः he, एभिः these, सह with, त्वदागमनम् your arrival, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रहृष्टः very glad, तु you, वनम् garden, प्रधर्षितम् destroying, श्रुत्वा having heard, असौ he was, न रुष्टः not angry.

text: प्रहृष्टो मां पितृव्यस्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः । शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तानिति होवाच पार्थिवः ॥५-६४-१०॥
translation: "Your father's brother, Sugriva, the lord of vanaras felt very glad and indeed asked me to send you quickly."
word_meanings: ते पितृव्यः your father's brother, वानरेश्वरः lord of vanaras, पार्थिवः king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रहृष्टः happily, तान् सर्वान् all of them, शीघ्रम् quickly, प्रेषय send, इति this, माम् to me, उवाच ह said indeed.

text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं श्लक्ष्णमङ्गदः । अब्रवीत्तान् हरिश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ॥५-६४-११॥
translation: At these good words from Dadhimukha, Angada, the monkey leader, an eloquent speaker said this:.
word_meanings: दधिमुखस्य to Dadhumukha, इदम् this, श्लक्ष्णम् very good, वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हरिश्रेष्ठः monkey leader, वाक्यविशारदः eloquent in speech, अङ्गदः Angada, तान् to them, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: शङ्के श्रुतो ऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः । तत्क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परन्तपाः ॥५-६४-१२॥
translation: "O scorcher of enemies I presume Rama has already heard the news of our arrival on accomplishment of the task. Hence it is not proper for us to tarry here.
word_meanings: परन्तपाः scorcher of enemies, हरियूथपाः leader of monkeys, अयं वृत्तान्तः about this here, रामेण by Rama, श्रुतः having heard, शङ्के I presume, तत् that, कार्ये task, कृते having done, इह here, स्थातुम् to be here, नः for us, न क्षमम् not proper.

text: पीत्वा मधु यथाकामं विश्रान्ता वनचारिणः । किं शेषं गमनं तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः ॥५-६४-१३॥
translation: "The vanaras of the forest have taken rest after drinking as much honey as they desired. What is left here to do? We have to go wherever Sugriva is."
word_meanings: वनचारिणः forestrangers, vanaras, यथाकामम् as they desire, मधु honey, पीत्वा having drunk, विश्रान्ताः rested, किम् what, शेषम् is left, मे my, गुरुः king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र where, तत्र there, गमनम् have to go.

text: सर्वे यथा मां वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरियूथपाः । तथा ऽस्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवानहम् ॥५-६४-१४॥
translation: Angada said to the vanara troops assembled, "Tell me what we have to do. I shall act as you wish.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, समेत्य assembled together, माम् me, यथा like that, वक्ष्यन्ति would tell, यथा in that way, कर्ता we are to do, अस्मि we, कर्तव्ये in our duty, अहम् I am, भवद्भिः as you say, परवान् have to do.

text: नाज्ञापयितुमीशो ऽहं युवराजो ऽस्मि यद्यपि । अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं मया ॥५-६४-१५॥
translation: "Even though I am heir apparent, it is not proper for me to order you.You have accomplished the purpose and to command you is not befitting on my part."
word_meanings: अहम् I am, युवराजः heir apparent, अस्मि यद्यपि even though I am, आज्ञापयितुम् to order you, न ईशः not lord, कृतकर्माणः accomplished dones, यूयम् troops, मया by me, धर्षयितुम् ordering, अयुक्तम् not proper.

text: ब्रुवतश्चाङ्गदश्यैवं श्रुत्वा वचनमव्ययम् । प्रहृष्टमनसो वाक्यमिदमूचुर्वनौकसः ॥५-६४-१६॥
translation: On hearing Angada's valuable words said in that way, the vanaras repled:
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवतः when said, अङ्गदस्य by Angada, अव्ययम् priceless, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वनौकसः forest dwellers, प्रहृष्टमनः glad at heart, इदम् these, ऊचुः said.

text: एवं वक्ष्यति को राजन् प्रभुः सन् वानरर्षभ । ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तो हि सर्वो ऽहमिति मन्यते ॥५-६४-१७॥
translation: "O king O bull among monkeys we think you are an exception to those to whom prosperity brings arrogance.
word_meanings: वानरर्षभ bull among vanaras, राजन् O king, प्रभुः सन् who is lord, कः who, एवम् in that way, वक्ष्यति said so, सर्वः all others, ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तः arrogant on account of prosperity, अहम् I, इति thus, मन्यते हि think .

text: तव चेदं सुसदृशं वाक्यं नान्यस्य कस्यचित् । सन्नतिर्हि तवाख्याति भविष्यच्छुभयोग्यताम् ॥५-६४-१८॥
translation: "You alone could speak such words. Your humility speaks of your fitness for a bright future.
word_meanings: इदं वाक्यम् these words, तव च you alone would have said, सुसदृशम् your humility, अन्यस्य in others, कस्यचित् you only, न not, तव your, सन्नतिः humble, भविष्यच्छुभयोग्यताम् fit for a bright future, आख्याति speaks of.

text: सर्वे वयमपि प्राप्तास्तत्र गन्तुं कृतक्षणाः । स यत्र हरिवीराणां सुग्रीवः पतिरव्ययः ॥५-६४-१९॥
translation: All of us have come here, ready to set out at any moment for wherever Sugriva, the immortal lord of the vanara heroes, may be.
word_meanings: प्राप्ताः come here, वयम् us, सर्वेऽपि all of us, हरिवीराणाम् vanara heroes, पतिः lord, अव्ययः one who is immortal, सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, यत्र to him, तत्र there, गन्तुम् to go, कृतक्षणाः ready at any moment.

text: त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभिर्नैव शक्यं पदात्पदम् । क्वचिद्गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते ॥५-६४-२०॥
translation: "O Angada the best of vanaras without your command none will find it possible to put forward even a single step."
word_meanings: हरिश्रेष्ठ best of the vanaras, Angada, त्वया your, अनुक्तै: order, हरिभिः vanaras, पदात् on foot, पदम् one step, क्वचित् not even, गन्तुम् to go, न शक्यम् not possible, सत्यम् it is true, इदम् this, ते to you, ब्रूमः appealed.

text: एवं तु वदतां तेषामङ्गदः प्रत्यभाषत । बाढं गच्छाम इत्युक्त्वा खमुत्पेतुर्महाबलाः ॥५-६४-२१॥
translation: Thus addressed by all the vanaras, Angada said 'Well, let us go'. Then the powerful vanaras rose up the sky.
word_meanings: तेषाम् those vanaras, एवम् that way, वदताम् spoken, अङ्गदः Angada, बाढम् very good, गच्छाम let us go, प्रत्युवाच ह replied, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, महाबलाः powerful vanaras, खम् to the sky, उत्पेतुः rose up.

text: उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतुः सर्वे ते हरियूथपाः । कृत्वा ऽ ऽकाशं निराकाशं यन्त्रोत्क्षिप्ता इवाचलाः ॥५-६४-२२॥
translation: All the vanara troops sprang up into the air as though there was no sky, like stones shattered by machines from the mountains rise up.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, ते हरियूथपाः vanara troops, यन्त्रोत्क्षिप्ताः stones shattered by machines, अचलाः mountain, इव like, आकाशम् sky, निराकाशम् as if there is no sky, कृत्वा did, उत्पतन्तम् rising up, अनूत्पेतुः sprang up.

text: ते ऽम्बरं सहसोत्पत्य वेगवन्तः प्लवङ्गमाः । विनदन्तो महानादं घना वातेरिता यथा ॥५-६४-२३॥
translation: The swift monkeys roared aloud as though they went up the sky like thundering clouds driven by the wind.
word_meanings: वेगवन्तः swift, ते प्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, महानादम् roared aloud, विनदन्तः noise, वातेरिताः driven by the Wind, घनाः यथा like heavy clouds, सहसा at once, अम्बरम् to the sky, उत्पत्य went up.

text: अङ्गदे समनुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः । उवाच शोकोपहतं रामं कमललोचनम् ॥५-६४-२४॥
translation: Seeing the griefstricken, lotuseyed Rama, the lord of the vanaras Sugriva said this before the arrival of Angada:
word_meanings: अङ्गदे Angada, अननुप्राप्ते before he came, वानराधिपः lord of the vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शोकोपहतम् stricken with grief, कमललोचनम् lotus eyed, रामम् Rama, उवाच said.

text: समाश्वसिहि भद्र ते दृष्टा देवी न संशयः । नागन्तुमिह शक्यं तैरतीते समये हि नः ॥५-६४-२५॥
translation: "Trust me, Rama. Be blessed. The vanaras have seen the divine lady. There is no doubt. It is not possible for them to come here after exceeding the time limit (in their search for Sita).
word_meanings: समाश्वसिहि trust me, ते to you, भद्रम् auspicious, देवी queen, दृष्टा have seen, संशयः doubt, न not, नः us, समये time, अतीते exceeded, तैः they, इह here, आगन्तुम् to come, न शक्यम् not possible.

text: न मत्सकाशमागच्छेत् कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते । युवराजो महाबाहुः प्लवतां प्रवरो ऽङ्गदः ॥५-६४-२६॥
translation: "My heir apparent, the strongarmed Angada, and the best of the monkeys is endowed with virtues. He would not come near me if his mission had failed.
word_meanings: युवराजः heir apparent, महाबाहुः strongarmed one, प्लवताम् leaping, प्रवरः endowed with good virtues, अङ्गदः Angada, कृत्ये mission, विनिपातिते has failed, मत्सकाशम् near me, नागच्छेत् will not come.

text: यद्यप्यकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः । भवेत् स दीनवदनो भ्रान्तविप्लुतमानसः ॥५-६४-२७॥
translation: "In case the vanaras have returned without accomplishing the task, Angada would have assumed a pathetic face, perplexed and unsteady in mind.
word_meanings: अकृतकृत्यानाम् in case they have not accomplished, उपक्रमः return, ईदृशः this way, यद्यपि स्यात् acted that way, सः he, दीनवदनः pathetic face, भ्रान्त विप्लुतमानसः perplexed and unsteady in mind, भवेत् would be.

text: पितृपैतामहं चैतत् पूर्वकैरभिरक्षितम् । न मे मधुवनं हन्यादहृष्टः प्लवगेश्वरः ॥५-६४-२८॥
translation: "If Angada, lord of the vanaras had not been happy, he would not have destroyed the Madhuvanam of my father's and my grandfather's time. O Rama, follower of righteous practices, Kausalya has an excellent son in you. Trust me.
word_meanings: प्लवगेश्वरः lord of monkeys, अहृष्टः not been happy, पितृपैतामहम् father and grandfather's time, पूर्वकैः ancestors, अभिरक्षितम् protected, मे मधुवनम् my Madhuvanam, न हन्यात् not destroy, कौसल्यासुप्रजाः Kausalya's son, सुव्रत one who pracitces good traditions, राम Rama, समाश्वसिहि trust me.

text: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत । दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता ॥५-६४-२९॥
न ह्यन्यः कर्मणो हेतुः साधने ऽस्य हनूमतः । हनूमति हि सिद्धिश्च मतिश्च मतिसत्तम । व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च सूर्य तेज इव ध्रुवम् ॥५-६४-३०॥
