translation: "O Rama, the best among the wise just like the luminosity that abides in the Sun, capacity to succeed, energy, intelligence, even courage and steadfastness reside in Hanuman.
word_meanings: मतिसत्तम best one among the wise, हनूमति Hanuman, सूर्ये Sun, तेजः इव like the luminosity, सिद्धिश्च capacity to succeed, मतिश्च intelligence, व्यवसायश्च effort, वीर्यं च and even courage, ध्रुवम् steadfast.

text: जाम्बवान् यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च बलेश्वरः । हनुमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा ॥५-६४-३१॥
translation: "Where Jambavan is the leader, Angada the commander of the army and Hanuman the guiding force, the end result will not be otherwise.
word_meanings: यत्र there, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नेता leader, स्यात् remains, महाबलः commander of army अङ्गदश्च and Angada, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, अधिष्ठाता the guiding force, तस्य that, गतिः end result, अन्यथा otherwise, न not be.

text: मा भूश्चिन्तासमायुक्तः सम्प्रत्यमितविक्रम ॥५-६४-३२॥
translation: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.
word_meanings: अमितविक्रमः extremely valiant, सम्प्रति at this time, चिन्तासमायुक्तः anxious, मा भूः do not, ततः at that time, हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानाम् in the pride of Hanuman's success, नार्धताम् roaring, सिद्धिम् successfully completed the work, कथयतामिव talking, किष्किन्धाम् in Kishkinda, उपयातानाम् have reached, काननौकसाम् forestdwellers, vanaras, अम्बरे in the sky, आसन्नम् have arrived, किलकिलाशब्दम् chatterings, शुश्राव was heard.

text: ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे । हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नर्दतां काननौकसाम् । किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव ॥५-६४-३३॥
translation: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.
word_meanings: अमितविक्रमः extremely valiant, सम्प्रति at this time, चिन्तासमायुक्तः anxious, मा भूः do not, ततः at that time, हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानाम् in the pride of Hanuman's success, नार्धताम् roaring, सिद्धिम् successfully completed the work, कथयतामिव talking, किष्किन्धाम् in Kishkinda, उपयातानाम् have reached, काननौकसाम् forestdwellers, vanaras, अम्बरे in the sky, आसन्नम् have arrived, किलकिलाशब्दम् chatterings, शुश्राव was heard.

text: ततः श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः । आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः सो ऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः ॥५-६४-३४॥
translation: The great Sugriva heard the roar of the monkeys and was extremely happy. He kept raising and shaking his long tail in joy.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः कपिसत्तमः that great monkey, Sugriva, कपीनाम् of the monkeys, तं निनादम् that roar, श्रुत्वा having heard, आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः lifting and shaking the long tail, हृष्टमानसः extremely happy, अभवत् remained.

text: आजग्मुस्ते ऽपि हरयो रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः । अङ्गदं पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ॥५-६४-३५॥
translation: The joyful monkeys with Angada and Hanuman leading them descended with eagerness to have a close look at Rama.
word_meanings: ते हरयः those joyful monkeys, कपिः monkeys, अङ्गदम् Angada, वानरम् vanaras, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, पुरतः in front, कृत्वा having, रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः eager to have a look at Rama, आजग्मुः reached.

text: ते ऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदा ऽन्विताः । निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च ॥५-६४-३६॥
translation: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.
word_meanings: अङ्गदप्रमुखाः Angada, the chief of the army of monkeys, ते वीराः the heroes, प्रहृष्टाश्च very joyfully, मुदा exuberant, अन्विताः descended, हरिराजस्य to the king of monkeys, राघवस्य च and Rama, समीपे near, निपेतुः landed.

text: हनुमांश्च महाबाहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः । नियतामक्षतां देवीं राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ॥५-६४-३७॥
translation: Then the strongarmed Hanuman with his head bowed down offered salutations and reported, 'Divine lady Sita with her constant devotion to Sri Rama is sound in body'.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाबाहुः strongarmed, हनुमान् Hanuman, शिरसा with head bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, देवीम् divine lady, नियताम् with her constant devotion, अक्षताम् sound in body, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् reported.

text: निश्चितार्थस्ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवः पवनात्मजे । लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत ॥५-६४-३८॥
translation: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.
word_meanings: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तस्मिन् पवनात्मजे that son of the Windgod, निश्चितार्थम् surely, प्रीतम् very affectionately, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, बहुमानात् respectfully, अवैक्षत glanced.

text: प्रीत्या च रममाणो ऽथ राघवः परवीरहा । बहुमानेन महता हनुमन्तमवैक्षत ॥५-६४-३९॥
ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम् । प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ॥५-६५-१॥
translation: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, ते they, चित्रकाननम् wonderful forest of Chitra, प्रस्रवणम् शैलम् to Prasravana mount, युवराजम् heir apparent, पुरस्कृत्य placing in front with respect, गत्वा having arrived, रामम् to Rama, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, शिरसा bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिवाद्य च offered obeisance, अथ and then, सीतायाः regarding Sita's, प्रवृत्तिम् state, प्रवक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमुः began.

text: युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च । प्रवृत्तिमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः ॥५-६५-२॥
translation: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, ते they, चित्रकाननम् wonderful forest of Chitra, प्रस्रवणम् शैलम् to Prasravana mount, युवराजम् heir apparent, पुरस्कृत्य placing in front with respect, गत्वा having arrived, रामम् to Rama, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, शिरसा bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिवाद्य च offered obeisance, अथ and then, सीतायाः regarding Sita's, प्रवृत्तिम् state, प्रवक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमुः began.

text: रावणान्तःपुरे रोधं राक्षसीभिश्च तर्जनम् । रामे समनुरागं च यश्चायं समयः कृतः । एतदाख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो रामसन्निधौ ॥५-६५-३॥
translation: The monkeys in Rama's presence narrated all about Sita's detention in Ravana's Ashoka garden, the ogresses threatening her and the time limit fixed by Ravana (for her survival).
word_meanings: सर्वे all, ते हरयः those vanaras, रावणान्तः पुरे in the chambers of Ravana, रोधम् detention, राक्षसीभिः ogresses, तर्जनं च threatening, रामे to Rama, समनुरागं च her devotion, यः that which, अयम् thus, समयः time limit, कृतः set, एतत् all that, रामसन्निधौ in Rama's presence, आख्यान्ति told.

text: वैदेहीमक्षतां श्रुत्वा रामस्तूत्तरमब्रवीत् ॥५-६५-४॥
translation: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.
word_meanings: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अक्षताम् not harmed, श्रुत्वा hearing, रामस्तु Rama too, उत्तरम् responded, अब्रवीत् asked, देवी divine lady, सीता Sita, क्व tell me, वर्तते she is, मयि to me, कथम् how, वर्तते is she, वानराः vanara, वैदेहीं प्रति her disposition towards, एतत् all that, सर्वम् every thing, मे to me, आख्यात asked.

text: क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते । एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः ॥५-६५-५॥
translation: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.
word_meanings: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अक्षताम् not harmed, श्रुत्वा hearing, रामस्तु Rama too, उत्तरम् responded, अब्रवीत् asked, देवी divine lady, सीता Sita, क्व tell me, वर्तते she is, मयि to me, कथम् how, वर्तते is she, वानराः vanara, वैदेहीं प्रति her disposition towards, एतत् all that, सर्वम् every thing, मे to me, आख्यात asked.

text: रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्वा हरयो रामसन्निधौ । चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम् ॥५-६५-६॥
translation: On hearing the words from Rama, the vanaras requested Hanuman who was aware of Sita's position to tell Rama all about her.
word_meanings: हरयः vanaras,रामस्य Rama's, गदितम् words spoken, श्रुत्वा hearing, सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम् who was aware of Sita's position, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रामसन्निधौ in the presence of Rama, चोदयन्ति requested to tell.

text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै तां दिशं प्रति । उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा ॥५-६५-७॥
translation: The son of the Wind god, Hanuman who was wise in speech heard the words of Rama, offered salutations to Sita in the direction in which she was located and narrated the story about her discovery.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, वाक्यज्ञः wise in speech, हनुमान् Hanuman, तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, देव्यै to the divine lady, सीतायै Sita, तां दिशं प्रति to the direction in which she was located, शिरसा with head down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सीतायाः about Sita's, दर्शनम् finding, यथा these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

text: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा ऽहं शतयोजनमायतम् । अगच्छं जानकीं सीतां मार्गमाणो दिदृक्षया ॥५-६५-८॥
translation: "Having crossed the sea consisting of a hundred yojanas in quest of Vaidehi, I found her.
word_meanings: अहम् I, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, आयतम् wide, समुद्रम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा having crossed, जानकीम् Janaki,सीताम् Sita, मार्गमाणः searching, दिदृक्षया with the intention of seeing, आगच्छम् reached.

text: तत्र लङ्केति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे ॥५-६५-९॥
translation: "On the southern shore of the ocean is situated the city of Lanka , ruled by the evilminded Ravana.
word_meanings: तत्र there, दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य on the southern side of the sea, दक्षिणे तीरे of the southern shore, दुरात्मनः evilminded, रावणस्य Ravana's, लङ्केति in Lanka, नगरी city, वसति there is.

text: तत्र दृष्टा मया सीता रावणान्तःपुरे सती । संन्यस्य त्वयि जीवन्ती रामा राम मनोरथम् ॥५-६५-१०॥
translation: "There in the inner palace of Ravana, I saw your lovely wife Sita, with all her hopes pinned on you, giving up all other desires.
word_meanings: रामा Rama, तत्र there, रावणान्तः पुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, सती your wife, त्वयि your, मनोरथम् her hopes, सन्न्यस्य giving up desires, जीवन्ती living, राम lovely, सीता Sita, मया by me, दृष्टा seen.

text: दृष्टा मे राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः । राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदावने ॥५-६५-११॥
translation: "I found her in the beautiful garden guarded by hideous ogresses threatening her again and again৷৷
word_meanings: प्रमदावने in that beautiful garden, विरूपाभिः hideous, राक्षसीभिः rakshasas, रक्षिता guarded, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तर्ज्यमाना threatening, मे I, राक्षसीमध्ये in the midst of ogresses, दृष्टा saw.

text: दुःखमासाद्यते देवी तथा ऽदुःखोचिता सती ॥५-६५-१२॥
translation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.
word_meanings: तथा in that way, दुःखोचिता mind filled with grief, देवी divine lady, दुःखम् grief, आपद्यते not deserve to experience, रावणान्तःपुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा detained, राक्षसीभि by ogresses, स्सुरक्षिता guarded by, एकवेणीधरा wearing a single braid( a mark of desolation),दीना pathetic, त्वयि your,सती wife,चिन्तापरायणा absorbed in your thought, अध: शय्या now lying on bare ground, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनीव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी limbs turned pale, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था averse to Ravana, मर्तव्यकृन्तिश्चया determined to die, काकुत्स्थ Rama alone, त्वन्मनाः in her mind, देवी Sita, कथञ्चित् somehow, मार्गिता found.

text: रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता । एकवेणीधरा दीना त्वयि चिन्तापरायणा ॥५-६५-१३॥
translation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.
word_meanings: तथा in that way, दुःखोचिता mind filled with grief, देवी divine lady, दुःखम् grief, आपद्यते not deserve to experience, रावणान्तःपुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा detained, राक्षसीभि by ogresses, स्सुरक्षिता guarded by, एकवेणीधरा wearing a single braid( a mark of desolation),दीना pathetic, त्वयि your,सती wife,चिन्तापरायणा absorbed in your thought, अध: शय्या now lying on bare ground, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनीव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी limbs turned pale, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था averse to Ravana, मर्तव्यकृन्तिश्चया determined to die, काकुत्स्थ Rama alone, त्वन्मनाः in her mind, देवी Sita, कथञ्चित् somehow, मार्गिता found.

text: अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे । रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया । देवी कथंचित् काकुत्स्थ त्वन्मना मार्गिता मया ॥५-६५-१४॥
translation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.
word_meanings: तथा in that way, दुःखोचिता mind filled with grief, देवी divine lady, दुःखम् grief, आपद्यते not deserve to experience, रावणान्तःपुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा detained, राक्षसीभि by ogresses, स्सुरक्षिता guarded by, एकवेणीधरा wearing a single braid( a mark of desolation),दीना pathetic, त्वयि your,सती wife,चिन्तापरायणा absorbed in your thought, अध: शय्या now lying on bare ground, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनीव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी limbs turned pale, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था averse to Ravana, मर्तव्यकृन्तिश्चया determined to die, काकुत्स्थ Rama alone, त्वन्मनाः in her mind, देवी Sita, कथञ्चित् somehow, मार्गिता found.

text: इक्ष्वकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयता ऽनघ । सा मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता ॥५-६५-१५॥
translation: "O sinless one O tiger among men To inspire confidence in her I praised the glory of your Ikshvaku dynasty.
word_meanings: अनघ sinless one, नरशार्दूल tiger among men, इक्ष्वाकुवंशविख्यातिम् all about the glory of Ikshvaku race, शनैः slowly, कीर्तयता praised, मया by me, सा she, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता to inspire.

text: ततः सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता । रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ॥५-६५-१६॥
translation: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.
word_meanings: ततः then, देवी divine lady, सम्भाषिता talked, सर्वम् all,अर्थम् all facts,दर्शिता presented to her, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रीतिम् affectionately, उपागता became, अस्याः her, समुदाचारः virtuous, नियतः fixed, तथा so also, त्वयि towards, भक्तिश्च and devotion.

text: नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्यास्तथा त्वयि ॥५-६५-१७॥
translation: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.
word_meanings: ततः then, देवी divine lady, सम्भाषिता talked, सर्वम् all,अर्थम् all facts,दर्शिता presented to her, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रीतिम् affectionately, उपागता became, अस्याः her, समुदाचारः virtuous, नियतः fixed, तथा so also, त्वयि towards, भक्तिश्च and devotion.

text: एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी । उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ ॥५-६५-१८॥
translation: "O bull among men I saw Janaki,the delight of Janaka, a formidable lady filled with devotion to you and richly endowed with austerity.
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, उग्रेण formidable, तपसा austerity, त्वद्भक्त्या devotion to you, युक्ता filled with, महाभागा prosperous, जनकनन्दिनी delight of Janaka, मया by me, एवम् that way, दृष्टा seen.

text: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथा वृत्तं तवान्तिके । चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव ॥५-६५-१९॥
translation: "O wise one, with your ring given her, she told me an anecdote of a crow that took place at Chitrakuta.
word_meanings: महाप्राज्ञ very wise, चित्रकूटे in Chitrakuta, तव your, अन्तिके provided me, वायसं प्रति with an anecdote of a crow, यथा so also, वृत्तम् told, अभिज्ञानम् as an identification for you, मे to me, दत्तम् presented.

text: विज्ञाप्यश्च नरव्याघ्रो रामो वायुसुत त्वया । अखिलेनेह यद् दृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी ॥५-६५-२०॥
translation: (She said)'O son of the Windgod you should let Rama, the tiger among men know all that you have seen here.
word_meanings: वायुसुत son of the Windgod, नरव्याघ्रः tiger among men, रामः Rama, त्वया your, इह here, यत् that which, दृष्टम् seen, अखिलेन should tell, विज्ञाप्यः should let him know, इति thus, जानकी Janaki, माम् me, आह told.

text: अयं चास्मै प्रदातव्यो यत्नात् सुपरिरक्षितः । ब्रुवता वचनान्येवं सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः ॥५-६५-२१॥
translation: 'Within hearing of Sugriva, tell him about your efforts. Present this(signet) to Rama carefully preserved by me.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवस्य while Sugriva, उपशृण्वतः within hearing of, एवम् that way, वचनानि these words, ब्रुवता that I said, यत्नात् the efforts, सुपरिरक्षितः kept with great care, अयं च and I, अस्मै this, प्रदातव्यः be presented.

text: एष चूडामणिः श्रीमान् मया सुपरिरक्षितः । मनःशिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः ॥५-६५-२२॥
translation: 'This auspicious (jewel) Chudamani has been preserved by me very carefully. Remind him of the decorative red mark he painted with a stone pigment on my forehead, indeed, it is proper to remind him of this.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् prosperous, एषः this, चूडामणिः Chudamani, मया by me, सुपरिरक्षितः very carefully preserved, तिलके red mark on the forehead, प्रणष्ठे when it was, त्वया by you, मनश्शिलायाः with the stone pigment, तिलकः mark on the forehead, गण्डपार्श्वे on my forehead, निवेशितः किल decorated indeed, तम् स्मर्तुम् remind him, अर्हसि is proper.

text: त्वया प्रनष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि । एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान् मया ते वारिसम्भवः ॥५-६५-२३॥
एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रमोदिष्ये व्यसने त्वामिवानघ । जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज । ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवयं रक्षसां वशमागता ॥५-६५-२४॥
translation: 'O Son of Dasaratha I will hold on to life for a month. Captured by the demons, I will not live for more than a month'.
word_meanings: दशरथात्मज Dasaratha's son, मासम् one month, जीवितम् living, धारयिष्यामि will hold on to, रक्षसाम् these demons, वशम् captivated by, आगता completion, मासात् after a month, ऊर्ध्वम् more than, न जीवेयम् will not live.

text: इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्मचारिणी । रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना ॥५-६५-२५॥
translation: "With her limbs emaciated through austerities detained in Ravana's inner palace, eyes wide open in fear, Sita said this to me:
word_meanings: कृशाङ्गी enfeebled lady, धर्मचारिणी following righteous ways, रावणान्तःपुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा detained मृगीव like a doe, उत्फुल्ललोचना eyes wide open in fear, सीता Sita, माम् to me, इति this, अब्रवीत् said.

text: एतदेव मया ऽ ऽख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा । सर्वथा सागरजले सन्तारः प्रविधीयताम् ॥५-६५-२६॥
translation: "O Rama I have spoken everything that has happened. We have to pay attention to the means of crossing the ocean."
word_meanings: राघव Rama, यत् that which, यथा like that, एतत् happened, सर्वमेव every thing, मया by me, ख्यातम् has been said, सर्वथा ever, सागरजले water of the ocean, सन्तारः means to cross the ocean, प्रविधीयताम् pay attention to.

text: तौ जाताश्वासौ राजपुत्रौ विदित्वा तच्चाभिज्ञानं राघवाय प्रदाय । देव्या चाख्यातं सर्वमेवानुपूर्व्याद्वाचा सम्पूर्णं वायुपुत्रः शशंस ॥५-६५-२७॥
translation: Coming to know that the two princes were sighing in relief, Hanuman presented the token of identification given by Sita to Rama, after having communicated in full the messsage of Sita in an orderly manner. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: वायुपुत्रः son of the Windgod, तौ राजपुत्त्रौ the two princes Rama and Lakshmana, जाताश्वासौ sighing in relief, विदित्वा knowing, तत् that, अभिज्ञानम् identification, राघवाय to Rama, प्रदाय communicated, देव्या by Sita, आख्यातम् having spoken, सर्वमेव everything, सम्पूर्णम् completely, आनुपूर्व्यात् in an orderly manner, वाचा spoken, शशंस Hanuman.

text: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मजः । तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः ॥५-६६-१॥
translation: Thus addressed by Hanuman, Rama held the token (Chudamani) against his bosom and wept with Lakshmana.
word_meanings: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः spoken, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, तं मणिम् that ornament, हृदये to the bosom, कृत्वा held, प्ररुरोद wept.

text: तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघवः शोककर्शितः । नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ॥५-६६-२॥
translation: Seeing the precious jewel, Rama's eyes were filled with tears. Overwhelmed with grief, he spoke to Sugriva.
word_meanings: तं मणिश्रेष्ठम् the precious jewel, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राघवः Rama, शोककर्शितः overcome with sorrow, अश्रुपूर्णाभ्याम् filled with tears, नेत्राभ्याम् both eyes, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला । तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात् ॥५-६६-३॥
translation: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.
word_meanings: वत्सला fond of its calf, धेनुः cow, वत्सस्य at the sight of calf, स्नेहात् out of love, यथैव in the same way, स्रवति distils milk from its teats, मम हृदयमपि my heart also, मणिरत्नस्य at this excellent jewel, दर्शनात् on seeing, तथा so does.

text: मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याः श्वशुरेण मे । वधूकाले यथा बद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते ॥५-६६-४॥
translation: "At the time of marriage, this jewel was presented by my father-in-law. Vaidehi wore it on her forehead and it looked charming.
word_meanings: वधूकाले at the time of marriage, मूर्ध्नि to the head, आबद्धम् tied, यथा so, शोभते charming, इदम् this, मणिरत्नम् gem of ornament, मे श्वशुरेण my fatherinlaw, वैदेह्याः to Vaidehi, दत्तम् presented.

text: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिः सज्जनपूजितः । यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता ॥५-६६-५॥
translation: "This was found in water and was bestowed by Indra out of great joy on Janaka who had performed a grand sacrificial ceremony. So it was worshipped by elders of the family.
word_meanings: जलसम्भूतः found in water, सज्जनपूजितः worshipped by elders of the family, अयं मणिः this jewel यज्ञे in sacrificial ceremony, परमतुष्टेन great joy, धीमता wise one, शक्रेण by Indra, दत्तः given.

text: इमं दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं यथा तातस्य दर्शनम् । अद्यास्म्यवगतः सौम्य वैदेहस्य तथा विभोः ॥५-६६-६॥
translation: "O noble Sugriva now when I see this excellent jewel, I get direct sight of my father and king of Videha (in the same way as I obtained the sight of Sita).
word_meanings: सौम्य noble, अद्य now, इमम् this, मणिश्रेष्ठम् gem of jewel, दृष्ट्वा when I see, तातस्य father's, तथा so also, विभोः king, वैदेहस्य of Videha, दर्शनम् seeing, यथा as if, अवगतः get.

text: अयं हि शोभते तस्याः प्रियाया मूर्ध्नि मे मणिः । अस्याद्य दर्शनेनाहं प्राप्तां तामिव चिन्तये ॥५-६६-७॥
translation: "This jewel was shining on the head of my beloved. Now its mere look makes me feel that I am seeing her.
word_meanings: अयं मणिः this gem, मे प्रियायाः my beloved, मूर्ध्नि head, शोभते हि indeed shone, अद्य now, अस्य its, दर्शनेन mere look, ताम् her, प्राप्तामिव as if I am seeing, चिन्तये I think.

text: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः । पिपासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ति वाक्यवारिणा ॥५-६६-८॥
translation: "O handsome Hanuman Sita is like water for a thirsty person. Tell me again and again what Sita said to you. Sprinkle on me (lifegiving) water of her words in the form of message.
word_meanings: सौम्य O handsome (Hanuman), पिपासुम् for a thirsty one, तोयेन इव like water, वाक्यवारिणा in lifegiving water of words, सिञ्चन्ती sprinkle, वैदेही Vaidehi, सीता Sita, किम् what else, पुनः पुनः again and again, आह to speak, ब्रूहि asked.

text: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम् । मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतं विना ॥५-६६-९॥
translation: "O Saumitri I see this jewel born (formed) under water but not her. What can be more sorrowful to me?
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, वारिसम्भवम् found in water, इमं मणिम् this jewel, वैदेहीम् of Vaidehi, आगतां विना without her, यत् पश्यामि seeing this, इतः here, दुःखतरम् cause more sorrow, किम् what?

text: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति । क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम् ॥५-६६-१०॥
translation: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.
word_meanings: सौम्य O dear!, वैदेही Vaidehi, मासम् one month, धरिष्यति यदि if she lives, चिरम् for long, जीवति living, सौम्य O dear, ताम् her, असितेक्षणां विना without the (enchanting) black-eyed, क्षणम् for a moment, न जीवेयम् I cannot live

text: नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया । न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च ॥५-६६-११॥
translation: "Take me to the place you saw my beloved. Knowing where she is I cannot stay here even for a moment.
word_meanings: मम my, प्रिया beloved, यत्र दृष्टा where you saw, मामपि me too, तं देशम् that place, नय take me, प्रवृत्तिम् where she is, उपलभ्य च and knowing, क्षणमपि even a moment, न तिष्ठेयम् not stay here.

text: कथं सा मम सुश्रोणी भीरुभीरुः सती सदा । भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम् ॥५-६६-१२॥
translation: "She is always very timid. How can my fairhipped beloved remain in the midst of dreadful and fearsome demons?
word_meanings: सदा always, भीरुभीरुः सती very timid, मम सुश्रोणी my fairhipped beloved, भयावहानाम् fearsome forms, घोराणाम् dreadful ones, रक्षसाम् demons, मध्ये midst, कथम् how, तिष्ठति does she remain.

text: शारदस्तिभिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः । आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः ॥५-६६-१३॥
translation: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.
word_meanings: तिमिरोन्मुक्तः bereft of brightness, अम्बुदैः by rainclouds, चन्द्रः इव like the Moon, राक्षसैः by demons, आवृतम् surrounded by, तस्याः her, वदनम् countenance, न विराजति not shine, नूनम् surely.

text: किमाह सीता हनुंस्तत्त्वतः कथयाद्य मे । एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा ॥५-६६-१४॥
translation: "O Hanuman Tell me now truly what has been told by her. I am eager to know. Indeed, it will keep me alive just as medicne does. (I shall survive on the strength of her message)
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, सीता Sita, किम् what, आह to go, अद्य now, तत्त्वतः truly, मे I am, कथय told by her, आतुरः eager, भेषजेन यथा just as medicine does, एतेन that alone, जीविष्ये खलु indeed, keep me alive.

text: मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी । मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन् कथयस्व मे ॥५-६६-१५॥
translation: That lovely Sita who speaks sweetly, that fairhipped beautiful one who has been separated from me, my beloved, what did she say? Please narrate. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: मधुरा lovely one, मधुरालापा one who speaks sweetly, वरारोहा fairhipped one, मद्विहीना separated from me, मम भामिनी my beloved, किम् what, आह did she say, मे to me, कथयस्व you may narrate.

text: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना । सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे ॥५-६७-१॥
translation: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.
word_meanings: महात्मना great soul, राघवेण to Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः spoken, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, भाषितम् said, सर्वम् everything, राघवे to Rama, न्यवेदयत related.

text: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ । पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम् ॥५-६७-२॥
translation: "O bull among men queen Janaki related to me as a token of identification an incident that had taken place at Chitrakuta in the past.
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, देवी queen, जानकी Janaki, चित्रकूटे at Chitrakuta, पूर्ववृत्तम् incident of the past, अभिज्ञानम् as an identification, यथातथम् as it is, इदम् this, उक्तवती she said.

text: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता । वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विरराद स्तनान्तरे ॥५-६७-३॥
translation: "When she was lying on your lap happily she awoke early and a crow came swiftly and scratched on her breast.
word_meanings: त्वया सार्धम् along with you, सुखसुप्ता lying down happily, जानकी Janaki, पूर्वम् earlier, उत्थिता woke up, वायसः a crow, सहसा swiftly, उत्पत्य got up, स्तनान्तरे on her breast, विददार scratched.

text: पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज । पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम् ॥५-६७-४॥
translation: "O Bharata's brother, when Sita awoke from sleep you slept on her lap. The same crow again hurt her.
word_meanings: भरताग्रज elder brother of Bharata, त्वम् you, पर्यायेण woke up, देव्यङ्के on her lap, सुप्तः slept, सः पक्षी that crow, पुनश्च again, देव्याः Sita's, व्यथाम् hurting, जनयति किल started hurting.

text: पुनः पुनरुपागम्य विरराद भृशं किल । ततस्त्वं बोधितस्तस्याः शोणितेन समुक्षितः ॥५-६७-५॥
translation: Again and again the crow came to her and scratched her. She woke you up as you were getting wet with blood shed from her body.
word_meanings: पुनः पुनः again and again, उपागम्य coming over her, भृशम् violently, विददार किल started scratching, ततः then, त्वम् you, तस्याः her, शोणितेन by blood, समुक्षितः wet by shedding, बोधितः किल woke you up.

text: वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया । बोधितः किल देव्या त्वं सुखसुप्तः परन्तप ॥५-६७-६॥
translation: "O scorcher of enemies pained by the crow hurting her repeatedly, while you were sleeping happily, she woke you up and informed you about it.
word_meanings: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, तेन by that, वायसेनैव by the crow, सततम् repeatedly, बाध्यमानया pained, देव्या by the divine lady, सुखसुप्तः sleeping happily, त्वम् you, बोधितः किल woke you up and informed you.

text: तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो दारितां च स्तनान्तरे । आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः ॥५-६७-७॥
translation: "Seeing the blood flowing from her breasts you became furious like a hissing serpent and said:
word_meanings: महाबाहो one with strong arms, स्तनान्तरे from the breasts, दारिताम् flowing, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा seeing, क्रुद्धः furious, आशीविष इव like a serpent, निश्वसन् sighing, अभ्यभाषथाः you said this.

text: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम् । कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ॥५-६७-८॥
translation: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?
word_meanings: भीरु timid, ते you, स्तनान्तरम् from the breasts, केन who, नखाग्रैः with the tip of the nails, दारितम् scratched, सरोषेण furious, पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना fivehooded serpent, कः who, क्रीडति sported.

text: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः । नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥५-६७-९॥
translation: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.
word_meanings: निरीक्षमाणः seeing all over, सरुधिरैः with blood, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, नखैः nails, तामेव of her, अभिमुखम् in front of, स्थितम् stood, वायसम् crow, सहसा at once, समवैक्षथाः glanced.

text: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः । धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ॥५-६७-१०॥
translation: 'That crow, the foremost of the birds was the son of Indra moving about all over the earth swiftly. His speed matched the Windgod's.
word_meanings: पतताम् among birds, वरः foremost, सः वायसः that crow, शक्रस्य Indra's, पुत्रः son, किल moving about, धरान्तरगतः all over the earth, शीघ्रम् swiftly, गतौ flying, पवनस्य windgod's speed, समः equal.

text: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः । वायसे त्वं कृथाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर ॥५-६७-११॥
translation: 'O longarmed, wise and revered Rama, then in anguish you took a cruel decision'.
word_meanings: महाबाहो longarmed one, मतिमताम् very wise one, वर reverred, त्वम् you, कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः anguished, ततः then, तस्मिन् its, वायसे the crow's, क्रूराम् cruel, मतिम् in your mind, कृथाः decision took.

text: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण ह्ययोजयः । स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम् ॥५-६७-१२॥
translation: 'You took out a blade of grass from your mat and chanted the mantra to invoke the weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra) and hurled it on the crow. It blazed like the fire of the doom's day.
word_meanings: सः he, संस्तरात् from your mat, दर्भम् a blade of grass, गृह्य took out, ब्राह्मेण अस्त्रेण by the mantra of the weapon of Brahma, योजयत् chanted, सः he, दीप्तः blazed, कालाग्निरिव like the fire of the demon's day, द्विजम् bird, अभिमुखः towards the direction, जज्वाल hurled.

text: क्षिप्तवांस्त्वं प्रदीप्तं हि दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति । ततस्तु वायसं दीप्तः स दर्भो ऽनुजगाम ह ॥५-६७-१३॥
translation: 'You hurled the blazing blade of grass on to the crow. That burning blade of grass chased the crow.
word_meanings: त्वम् yourself, प्रदीप्तम् blazing, तं दर्भम् that blade of grass, वायसं प्रति over the crow, क्षिप्तवान् burning, ततः then, सः दर्भः that blade of grass, दीप्तः glowing like fire, वायसम् to the crow, अनुजगाम ह chased.

text: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः । त्रिल्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति ॥५-६७-१४॥
translation: 'He was abandoned by his father, even by great sages and gods. Then he went round the three worlds but could not find a saviour.
word_meanings: सः he, पित्रा च by the father, समहर्षिभिः even the great sages, सुरैश्च and gods, परित्यक्तः abandoned, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, सम्परिक्रम्य went round also, त्रातारम् saviour, नाधिगच्छति was not found.

text: पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वकाशमरिन्दम । स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ॥५-६७-१५॥
वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया पर्यपालयः ॥५-६७-१६॥
translation: 'O destroyer of enemies the crow came back again to you trembling seeking protection from you and fell on the ground. Even though it deserved to be slayed, you saved him out of compassion.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम destroyer of enemies, त्रस्तः trembling, पुनरेव again, त्वत्सकाशम् that crow, आगतः came back, शरण्यः for protection, सः काकुत्स्थ: to Rama, शरणागतम् seeking protection, भूमौ on earth, निपतितम् fell down, तम् him, वाधर्हमपि that which deserved to be slayed, कृपया in compassion, पर्यपालय: saved.

text: मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव । भवांस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् ॥५-६७-१७॥
translation: 'O Rama since a divine weapon cannot be withdrawn, it did strike his right eye'.
word_meanings: राघव Rama, अस्त्रम् weapon, मोघम् divine one, कर्तुम् to withdraw, न शक्यम् not possible, इत्येव therefore, भवान् you, तस्य काकस्य that crow, दक्षिणम् अक्षि right eye, हिनस्ति स्म struck.

text: राम त्वां स नमस्कृत्य राज्ञे दशरथाय च । विसृष्टस्तु तदा काकः प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् ॥५-६७-१८॥
एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्त्ववाञ्छीलवानपि । किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ॥५-६७-१९॥
न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः । न च सर्वे रणे शक्ता रामं प्रतिसमासितुम् ॥५-६७-२०॥
तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः । क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः ॥५-६७-२१॥
भ्रातुरादेशमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः । स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः ॥५-६७-२२॥
शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ । सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ॥५-६७-२३॥
ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः । समर्थो सहितौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ ॥५-६७-२४॥
वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् । पुनरप्यहमार्यां तामिदं वचनमब्रुवम् ॥५-६७-२५॥
त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे । रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ॥५-६७-२६॥
कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् । इम मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि ॥५-६७-२७॥
तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ राजपुत्रावनिन्दितौ । त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ॥५-६७-२८॥
हत्वा च समरे रौद्र रावण सहबान्धवम् । राघवस्त्वां वरारोहे स्वां पुरीं नयते ध्रुवम् ॥५-६७-२९॥
यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते । प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य प्रदातुं त्वमिहार्हसि ॥५-६७-३०॥
सा ऽभिवीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा वेण्युद्ग्रथनमुत्तमम् । मुक्त्वा वस्त्राद्ददौ मह्यं मणिमेतं महाबल ॥५-६७-३१॥
प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दिव्यं तव हेतो रघूद्वह । शिरसा तां प्रणम्यार्यामहमागमने त्वरे ॥५-६७-३२॥
गमने च कृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य वरवर्णिनी । विवर्धमानं च हि मामुवाच जनकात्मजा ॥५-६७-३३॥
अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पसन्दिग्धभाषिणी । ममोत्पतनसम्भ्रान्ता शोकवेगसमाहता ॥५-६७-३४॥
हनुमन् सिंहसङ्काशावुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । सुग्रीवं च सहामात्य सर्वान् ब्रूया ह्यनामयम् ॥५-६७-३५॥
यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः । असमाद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ॥५-६७-३६॥
इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च । ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ॥५-६७-३७॥
एतत्तवार्या नृपराजसिंह सीता वचः प्राह विषादपूर्वम् । एतच्च बुद्ध्वा गदितं मया त्वं श्रद्धत्स्व सीतां कुशलां समग्राम् ॥५-६७-३८॥
अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्तः ससम्भ्रमः । तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य वै ॥५-६८-१॥
translation: "O tiger among men In view of her regards for me and and her love for you she was confident and once again addressed me:
word_meanings: नरव्याघ्र tiger among men, अथ and then, अहम् I, देव्या to Sita, तव your, स्नेहात् love, सौहार्दात् having affection, अनुमान्य confident, पुनः again, उत्तरम् addressed, ससम्भ्रमम् hurrying up, उक्तः said.

text: एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया । यथा मामाप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे ॥५-६८-२॥
translation: 'You may appeal to Rama, the son of Dasaratha in many ways, that he should come quickly and slay Ravana in the battle and get me back.
word_meanings: दाशरथिः Dasaratha's, रामः Rama, आहवे in battle, रावणम् Ravana, शीघ्रम् quickly, हत्वा slaying, माम् me, यथा so that, आप्नुयात् he will get me, तथा so that, एवम् in that way, बहुविधम् in many ways, वाच्यः you may appeal.

text: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम । कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ॥५-६८-३॥
translation: 'O crusher of enemies O brave Hanuman I wish you rest for a while in a secluded place around here and leave tomorrow .
word_meanings: अरिन्दम crusher of enemies, वीर brave, मन्यसे यदि I wish, कस्मिंश्चित् for a while, संवृते around, देशे this place, एकाहम् in a secluded place, वस stay, विश्रान्तः after resting, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि (you) may leave.

text: मम चाप्यल्पभाग्यायाः सान्निध्यात्तव वीर्यवन् । अस्य शोकविपाकस्य मुहूर्तं स्याद्विमोक्षणम् ॥५-६८-४॥
translation: 'O valiant (Hanuman) by your presence here, the less fortunate me, will be relieved of sorrow for a while.
word_meanings: वीर्यवन् valiant (Hanuman), तव your, सान्निध्यात् by your presence, अल्पभाग्यायाः less fortunate one, मम to me, अस्य your, शोकपाकस्य from sorrow, मुहूर्तम् for a while, विमोक्षणम् relieved, स्यात् will be.

text: गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै । प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ॥५-६८-५॥
translation: 'O courageous tiger among monkeys when you depart (abruptly) I doubt if I would be alive by your return.
word_meanings: विक्रान्ते courageous, त्वयि your, हरिशार्दूल tiger among monkeys, पुनरागमनाय by your return, गते gone, मम me, प्राणानामपि even my life, सन्देहः doubt, स्यात् will be, अत्र that, संदेहः doubt, न no.

text: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् । दुःखाद्दुःखपराभूतां दुर्गतां दुःखभागिनीम् ॥५-६८-६॥
translation: I am an unfortunate one, afflicted by sorrow and tormented (by demons). If I am not able to see you I will be lamenting in grief.
word_meanings: दुःखात् afflicted by sorrow, दुःखभागिनीम् unfortunate one, दुर्गताम् tormented, माम् me, तव your, अदर्शनजः not seeing you, शोकः grief, भूयः will be, परितापयेत् will be lamenting further.

text: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः । सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ॥५-६८-७॥
translation: 'O brave vanaras I have great doubts about your assistants the vanaras and bears, crossing the ocean.
word_meanings: वीर brave, हरीश्वर vanara, त्वत्सहायेषु your helpers, हर्यृक्षेषु the vanaras and bears, अयम् this, सुमहान् highly, सन्देहः doubt, मम अग्रतः I have, तिष्ठतीव will cross this ocean.

text: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् । तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ॥५-६८-८॥
translation: 'How will the vanaras and bears cross this great, impassable ocean? How will the princes Rama and Lakshmna be able to cross it?
word_meanings: तानि those, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि the army of vanaras and bears, तौ both, नरवरात्मजौ princes Rama and Lakshmana, दुष्पारम् impassable, महोदधिम् great ocean, कथं नु how will, तरिष्यन्ति be able to cross.

text: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने । शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ॥५-६८-९॥
translation: 'Only three among all beings, Garuda, the Windgod and you have the capacity to cross the ocean.
word_meanings: अस्य that, सागरस्य ocean, लङ्घने to cross, वैनतेयस्य वा to Garuda, तव वा or you, मारुतस्य वा or wind god, त्रयाणाम् three of you, भूतानाम् among all beings, शक्तिः the capacity, स्यात् have.

text: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे । किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वर ॥५-६८-१०॥
translation: 'O heroic Hanuman you know how to succeed. But I wish to know what expedient you have to accomplish which is difficult by all means. O foremost vanara, please tell me .
word_meanings: वीर hero, तत् that, एवम् in that way, दुरतिक्रमे who knows to succeed, अस्मि I, कार्यनिर्योगे difficult to accomplish, किम् what, समाधानम् expedient, पश्यसि are you perceiving, ब्रूहि tell me, कार्यविदाम् to accomplish the task, वर हि foremost indeed.

text: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने । पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः ८.१० ॥५-६८-११॥
translation: 'O Slayer of enemy heroes you have the ability to accomplsh this task singlehanded. By succeeding in accomplishing the objective you will become renowned (and not Rama).
word_meanings: परवीरघ्न slayer of enemy heroes, अस्य कार्यस्य in this task, परिसाधने ability to succeed, त्वम् for you, एक एव single handed, पर्याप्तः कामम् to accomplish the desired object, ते to you, फलोदयः having succeed, यशस्यः you will be renowned.

text: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां हत्वा रावणमाहवे । विजयी स्वां पुरीं रामो नयेत्तत् स्याद्यशस्करम् ॥५-६८-१२॥
translation: 'When Rama slays Ravana and his entire army and takes me to his city after becoming victorious it will add glory to him.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, रावणम् Ravana's, समग्रैः entire, बलैः with army, आहवे in battle, हत्वा slaying, विजयी becoming victorious, स्वाम् his, पुरीम् city, माम् me, नयेद्यदि will take, तत् that, यशस्करम् glorious, स्यात् will be.

text: यथा ऽहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता । रक्षसा तद्भया देव तथा नार्हति राघवः ॥५-६८-१३॥
translation: 'Tell valiant Rama not to take me back the way Ravana, the demon abducted me out of fear. Which is not right.
word_meanings: अहम् I am, रक्षसा by the demon, वीरस्य valiant one, उपधिना cheat, यथा like, हृता abducted, तथा that way, तद्भयादेव out of fear of, राघवः Rama, नार्हति not right.

text: बलैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः । मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ॥५-६८-१४॥
translation: 'If Rama, the slayer of the enemy army, could fill Lanka with his arrows and take me that will be a good sight for him to see.
word_meanings: परबलार्धनः one who is a slayer of the enemy army, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, लङ्काम् Lanka, शरैः with arrows, सङ्कुलाम् filling, कृत्वा does, माम् me, नयेद्यदि takes, तत् that, तस्य to him, सदृशम् pleasing to look, भवेत् will be.

text: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः । भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ॥५-६८-१५॥
translation: 'You may make arrangement in such a way that the exalted hero Rama exhibits his might according to his stature'.
word_meanings: तत् that, महात्मनः great soul, आहवशूरस्य exalted hero, तस्य his, अनुरूपम् according to his might, विक्रान्तम् exhibiting, यथा that way, भवेत् will be, तथा like, त्वम् you, उपपादय make arrangement.

text: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम् । निशम्याहं ततः शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रुवम् ॥५-६८-१६॥
translation: "Hearing the meaningful, courteous and reasonable words of Sita, I replied :
word_meanings: अहम् I am, अर्थोपहितम् meaningful, प्रश्रितं courteous, हेतुसंहितम् reasonable, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य hearing, ततः then, शेषम् rest, उत्तरम् reply, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवम् said.

text: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः । सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ॥५-६८-१७॥
translation: 'O queen The lord of the army of bears and vanaras who is the foremost among the monkeys is endowed with enough strength and has resolved to rescue you.
word_meanings: देवि O queen, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानाम् army of bears and vanaras, ईश्वरः lord, प्लवतां वरः foremost among leaping beings, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with strength, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तव अर्धे your task, कृतनिश्चयः resolved.

text: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नाः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः । मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः ॥५-६८-१८॥
translation: 'Mighty, powerful and tough monkeys who have the speed of thought are under the command of Sugriva.
word_meanings: विक्रमसम्पन्नाः mighty, सत्त्ववन्तः powerful, महाबलाः tough, मनः सङ्कल्पसम्पाताः having the speed of thought, हरयः monkeys, तस्य his, निदेशे under his command, स्थिताः remain.

text: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः । न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः ॥५-६८-१९॥
translation: 'All of them can go upward in the sky, downward into the underworld or obliquely in any direction without obstruction. They are brilliant enough to do any great task without any difficulty.
word_meanings: येषाम् all of them, गतिः can go, उपरि in the sky, न सज्जते not obstructed, अधस्तात् in the underworld, न not, तिर्यक् obliquely, न not, अमिततेजसः very brilliant, महत्सु very great, कर्मसु task also, न सीदन्ति without any difficulty.

text: असकृत्तैर्महाभागैर्वानरैर्बलदर्पितैः । प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः ॥५-६८-२०॥
translation: 'O great lady the mighty vanaras of extraordinary strength can fly with the wind and have even circumambulated the earth.
word_meanings: महाभागैः great lady, बलदर्पितैः by extraordinary might, वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः flying with the wind, तैः they, वानरैः vanaras, भूमिः earth, प्रदक्षिणीकृता have circumambulated.

text: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः । मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ॥५-६८-२१॥
translation: 'There are monkeys who are more powerful than me or equal to me. None are less strong than me or Sugriva.
word_meanings: तत्र there, मद्विशिष्टाश्च greater than, तुल्याश्च equals, वनौकसः monkeys, सन्ति are there, मत्तः compared to me, प्रत्यवरः less valiant, कश्चित् none, सुग्रीवसन्निधौ in front of Sugriva, नास्ति not there.

text: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः । न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ॥५-६८-२२॥
translation: 'When I could come here, what to speak of the mightier monkeys?, People do not send the superior ones on errand, but send only the juniors.
word_meanings: अहं तावत् therefore I, इह here, अनुप्राप्तः have come, महाबलाः highly powerful ones, ते they, किं पुनः why to say again, प्रकृष्टाः superior, न प्रेत्यन्ते हि indeed do not send, इतरे others, जनाः people, प्रेष्यन्ते हि will send.

text: तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युर्व्यपैतु ते । एकोत्पातेन वै लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ॥५-६८-२३॥
translation: 'O noble lady give up your lamentation. Enough of sorrowing. The vanara army will fly and reach this place at one leap and fill it.
word_meanings: देवि O noble lady, तत् that, परितापेन lamentation, अलम् enough, ते your, शोकः sorrow, व्यपैतु will fill this place, ते they, हरियूथपाः vanara army, एकोत्पातेन in one jump, लङ्काम् Lanka, एष्यन्ति will fly to reach.

text: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ । त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ॥५-६८-२४॥
translation: 'O noble lady the lions among men, Rama and Lakshmana who resemble Sun and Moon will ascend on my back and reach here.
word_meanings: महाभागे O noble lady, नृसिंहौ lions among men, तौ च they both, मम my, पृष्ठगतौ on back, उदितौ ascend, चन्द्रसूर्याविव like Sun and Moon, त्वत्सकाशम् newly risen, आगमिष्यतः will reach here.

text: अरिघ्नं सिंहसङ्काशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् । लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणीं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम् ॥५-६८-२५॥
translation: 'You will see the lionlike Rama, a slayer of enemies and Lakshmana wielding bow in hand standing at the entrance of Lanka very soon.
word_meanings: लङ्काद्वारम् at the entrance of Lanka, उपस्थितम् standing, अरिघ्नम् slayer of enemies, सिंहसङ्काशम् like a lion, तं राघवम् that Rama, धनुष्पाणिम् wielding bow in hand, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् very soon, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.

text: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् । वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ॥५-६८-२६॥
translation: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.
word_meanings: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् like rainclouds on the mountain, लङ्कामलयसानुषु Lanka's mountain Malaya, नर्दताम् roaring like lion, कपिमुख्यानाम् generals of monkey army, स्वनम् sounds, अचारत् making, श्रोष्यसि will hear.

text: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु । नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामचिराच्छ्रोष्यसि स्वनम् ॥५-६८-२७॥
translation: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.
word_meanings: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् like rainclouds on the mountain, लङ्कामलयसानुषु Lanka's mountain Malaya, नर्दताम् roaring like lion, कपिमुख्यानाम् generals of monkey army, स्वनम् sounds, अचारत् making, श्रोष्यसि will hear.

text: निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिन्दमम् । अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ॥५-६८-२८॥
translation: 'You will soon see Rama, the slayer of enemies crowned as king of Ayodhya with you, having duly completed the term of exile in the forest'.
word_meanings: निवृत्तवनवासम् completing the exile in the forest, अरिन्दमम् slayer of enemies, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, त्वया सार्धम् along with you, अभिषिक्तम् crowned, राघवम् Rama, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.

text: ततो मया वाग्भिरदीनभाषिणा शिवाभिरिष्टाभिरभिप्रसादिता । जगाम शान्तिं मम मैथिलात्मजा तवापि शोकेन तदा ऽभिपीडिता ॥५-६८-२९॥
translation: Sita though afflicted heard from me that you were also in excessive grief on account of separation from her and from my soothing, auspicious and welcome words, she derived comfort and remained quiet. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः then, तव your, शोकेनापि also in grief, तदा then, अभिपीडिता much grief, मैथिलात्मजा princess of Mithila, अदीनभाषिणा soothing words, मया of me, शिवाभिः auspicious also, इष्टाभिः welcome, मम my, वाग्भि: words, अभिप्रसादिता having spoken, शान्तिम् quiet, जगाम became.
